quests.title: Casus belli
quests.content:
Casus belli was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Heya, warrior! Got something for you, it's urgent. I recently rolled out a new feature for the Arena, called it Seasons. Fighters aren't just chasing cash anymore, they're fighting for unique rewards. Whole system built around it... Turns out it's a big hit. I've already got Season Three lined up, just waiting on a shipment of reward gear and some upgrade schematics. And now some piece of shit caught wind of the convoys and decided to mess with me. Can you believe that? They're trying to ruin a whole season the gladiators have been waiting on since New Year's! Go take a look and find out who's behind it. You should be able to spot them by their gear, Arena rewards stand out from standard kit after all. Find those bastards, deal with them, and bring me whatever you can pull off them. At least I'll know how bad things are and which convoys they've already hit.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 pillagers
Hand over 3 found in raid painted CQCM masks

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
50 GP coins
52 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
57 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× SIG MCX .300 Blackout assault rifle
1× AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG 40 GEN M3 STANAG 40-round magazine (Black)
2× .300 Blackout BCP FMJ ammo pack (50 pcs)
+1 Operational event task
Alright, these masks tell me enough. They're from previous seasons, so those assholes have only hit convoys carrying older stock so far. But I've lost contact with the convoy carrying the new rewards and the schematics, and that's the one that matters. If that gets intercepted, the new season's screwed. So don't go missing on me, we've still got Arena to save!

== Guide ==
In this quest you need to kill 5 Pillagers and hand over 3 painted CQCM masks with the found in raid status.

Pillagers can be found in groups of 3-4 on Customs, Interchange, Lighthouse, Shoreline and Woods.

Oh yes yes my friend, you are just in time! I conducted an investigation and found the source of the faulty weapons. Turns out Prapor had nothing to do with this. The imported guns in this condition and quantity are only available to those ex-USEC bandits. It seems they've decided to join the market themselves. However, they can't sell their goods on their own for obvious reasons, meaning they must have accomplices... You need to set up surveillance at their base so we can find their dealers.

Install a WI-FI Camera to watch the first water treatment plant building entrance on Lighthouse

quests.title: Cease Fire!
quests.content:
Cease Fire! is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I'm stumped today, warrior. There are good people who need to escape the city. The closest they can get is through Avenue of Death, but there are snipers overlooking the whole area. One kid told me that if you shoot a signal flare there, the snipers should let you pass through, in that particular spot. But who knows if the kid was lying? Maybe he's trying to lead us to death. How do we find out if it's true that the snipers will stop firing after the signal... I got a couple flares lying around, why don't you go check it out, eh?

== Objectives ==
Survive and extract from Streets of Tarkov through Klimov Street

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
So he was correct, it is the cease fire condition, I'll keep that in mind. You really put your head on the line, didn't you? I respect that.

== Initial equipment ==

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to extract from Streets of Tarkov via the "Klimov Street" extraction with the "survived" status. For the extraction to open, you have to shoot a green flare into the sky while being inside the signal flare area. Upon entering the signal flare area, a notifcation will pop up in the bottom right corner of the screen:  If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the extraction won't open. If the flare was fired correctly, a new notification pops up:  You can use either the handheld RSP-30 green flare provided by Jaeger via in-game mail or a 26x75mm green flare cartridge fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 green flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. If you need additional flares you can buy them from Jaeger. To avoid the "run through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting.

Extraction marked on map
The extraction
Signal flare area and extract zone map

quests.title: Ceasefire - Information
quests.content:
Ceasefire - Information was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The rat race that Skier and Peacekeeper have been running around here has not pleased some pretty important people. It's got to stop. You're up to your neck in this shit, so go ahead and make it up to me. Both of these crooks are running silent. We need to figure out what they're up to. According to my intel, they've been communicating with each other. You know, one of them sends a messenger, the messenger hides a note in a safe house, the other messenger picks it up. I'm sure you've done this kind of shit yourself. My people managed to find out the location of the note. Go down to the village on Shoreline and bring me their damn notes.

Hand over the letter

1,290 Euros

Let's see what they're chatting about. In the meantime, here's your reward.

quests.title: Ceasefire - Part 2
quests.content:
Ceasefire - Part 2 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

I've been reading their girlish chat. The doves want to team up because they've lost too many people in these stupid skirmishes. We need to stop them from forming an alliance. They've done enough damage as it is. And I already have a plan. Grab your gear and go make some noise. It will make them doubt their idea.

Eliminate any 5 targets while using an M4A1, UNTAR helmet and armor on Customs

== Skier questline exclusive ==
It worked out well. Better than I expected. Here, you deserve it.

== Peacekeeper questline exclusive ==
I think Peacekeeper's realized he's been acting like a moron. Now everyone in Tarkov will mark him as an outcast. You deserve credit for that.

quests.title: Charisma Brings Success
quests.content:
Charisma Brings Success was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey. I’ll tell you as a friend, that in trade what matters is how you present yourself, not being a dork or a nerd. Then, not only girls, but also customers will love you. This is my secret, feel free to use. I have a little business proposition to Elvira, the chief therapist at the hospital. But I can only trust you with this if you pump up your charisma, because right now she won’t even look at you, no offense. Gonna make a real man out of you.

Reach the required Charisma skill level of 10

== Rewards ==
+15,600 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.03
60,000 Roubles
63,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
69,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Ars Arma A18 Skanda plate carrier (MultiCam)
Unlocks barter for FORT Redut-M body armor at Ragman LL4
Wow wow, easy there, I'm on your side, man! Sorry, I'm just fucking around. I see you have mastered your charisma, that's good. Let's talk about business then.

quests.title: Charity
quests.content:
Charity is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Young man, I have a task for you. By now, you've likely realized that I continue to support the civilians who were unable to make it beyond the cordon. Unlike many of your colleagues who come to see me, you haven't lost your humanity yet. That is why I would like to ask for your help. I need adrenaline injectors, strictly for medical purposes. I have no intention of selling it to anyone. I took an oath, and I will continue helping people for as long as I live. I've been informed that a large number of syringes have been spotted in vehicles around the city, but my people haven't been able to reach them. Please obtain at least a few for me.

== Objectives ==
Find the 5 item in raid: Adrenaline injector
Hand over the 5 items

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
I thank you from the bottom of my heart. I won’t even explain how much and at the same time how little it is, in our conditions. Most people would keep it for themselves, but you shared it with those who needed it. Thank you.

== Guide ==

quests.title: Cheer Up
quests.content:
Cheer Up was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Have you even prepared for the holiday? And don't give me that bullshit about the fighting going on. I've seen plenty of soldiers and let me tell you this: if a man doesn't have a good soul, he won't last long in the field. You may not like holidays. You can laugh at people who talk to pictures of their relatives before they go to bed. But if there's nothing left in you but your fighting skills, you're gonna die quick. If not today, then tomorrow. Because you need a good fighting spirit. And where's it gonna come from if you don't have anything to hold on to? Ah well, I've rambled for too long, I'm getting old... But you get the point. So even if you don't have anyone to celebrate with, at least put up a Christmas tree in your bunker or wherever you live now.

== Objectives ==
Christmas Tree level 1

== Rewards ==
+5,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.02
50,000 Roubles
52,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
57,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× SR-2M Veresk 9x21 submachine gun
3× SR-2M 9x21 30-round magazine
4× 9x21mm BT ammo pack (30 pcs)
Well, there you go, that's something! There's still time, maybe you'll get some friends together.\n\nHere's a little something to keep your spirits up, so to speak.

To complete this quest you have to construct the Christmas Tree module in the Hideout.

quests.title: Chemical - Part 1
quests.content:
Chemical - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So, Sherlock, you want a riddle? You’re our pro on these headcrackers, right? Here, look. One lame hobo came around here. Either nuts of just demented, hell if I knew. All in rags, dirty head to toe, and the stench! A walking chemical weapon. Launched one on some vector, and where he goes, everything dies off. Hehe. Oh, damn, laughter through tears. But I digress. Just wanted to dispose of him, a bit farther away so the stink wouldn’t reach us, but one of our boys recognized his former homie in that pile of turd. Imagine that! Horrid things are going on, turning people from normal beings to such rubbish, and all for nothing! But that's not the point. The dude that recognized this heap of rags, said that he was not just a regular prick, but a Deputy Head of Security for two special sensitive zones on the Polikhim! Just imagine what kind of source could he become if he could at least remember his name, not just chew snots and mumble while slapping lips like a madman. What a shame! I don't know what got to him, but here's what I think. All this time that bagger lived somewhere, sleeping on some pissed-through mattresses, right? Right! You should look for that place. Need a hazmat suit? Haha, kidding. But if it comes to it, the hazmat’s on me, and not only it.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain any information about the Deputy Chief's past life on Customs
(Optional) Locate the sleeping place of the former Deputy Chief of Security on Customs
Hand over the information to Skier
Locate and obtain any item that could help with the investigation
Hand over the items to Skier

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
450 Euros
472 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
518 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× MSA ACH TC-2002 MICH Series helmet (Olive Drab)
1× 7.62x54mm R SP BT gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of 7.62x54mm R SP BT at Skier LL1
How long I live and wonder still. How was he surviving all this time? He can’t put two words together! Whatever. Let's first disinfect all this and wash it with cologne, and then open it and have a look.

== Guide ==

This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it.

In this quest you have to pick up a secure folder and hand over a Dorm room 220 key. The wanted folder can be found in a train car on the western side of Customs. There are multiple spawns throughout the train car. After obtaining the folder, you must successfully extract from the location.

Train car marked on map
The train car

== First spawn ==
Under a brick pallet in the northwestern corner of the train car.

== Second spawn ==
Under a pallet in the southeastern corner of the train car.

== Third spawn ==
Between the wall and a pallet in the northeastern corner of the train car.

quests.title: Chemical - Part 2
quests.content:
Chemical - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Got tired of waiting for you already. The documents that you got from the den of this tosspot weigh quite a bit. Pretty heavy they are. But this is a damn dangerous stuff. And there is no clarity who will be the best buyer for it. And it's not even so much about the profit, as it is about getting some enormous fuckin' problems if we choose the wrong address. So here's the key that you found there as well, and try to dig up further. My guys said it's from a dorm room. And judging from the documents, our deputy chief was seen on the second floor of the first building, the three-story one. Any info you could find in this room can come in very handy, and the prize will be impressive.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain any evidence on Customs that could help with the investigation
Hand over the evidence to Skier
Locate and obtain any information on Customs that could help with the investigation
Hand over the info to Skier

It seems this problem is not solved, but only got more complicated. Well, whatever. Come what may.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find a flash drive and a letter on Customs. They can be found in room 220 on the second floor of the three-story dorms building. A Dorm room 220 key is required to enter it. You get one in the mail from Skier upon accepting this quest.

The flash drive can be found plugged into the laptop on the desk, and the letter is tucked between the binders on the metal shelf.

3 story dorms and room 220 marked on map
The flash drive plugged into the laptop
The letter tucked between the binders

quests.title: Chemical - Part 3
quests.content:
Chemical - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
That envelope from the dorm contained some chemical formula. And the flash drive described the reaction process. We found a guy here who’s good with the subject. So he said that they cooked up something like this at Polikhim, experimenting with some blue liquid shit, adding some other shit into it. Sorry, I wasn’t into chemistry at school! All these chemicals, valences, indecent bonds! Fuck that! Hehe. See, I even still remember some words. That was some teaching in schools back then! But whatever. It is necessary to confirm the experiment described there. And then this matter will shine upon us with new colors. This blue shit is abundantly scattered in barrels throughout the region, but nobody knows what it is. And nobody is too eager to figure that out either. But we will take our chance and find out. And make some profits with it. But this requires another stuff, It should be somewhere in the factory. There was a room filled with garbage - they had a laboratory there. Look for a bright yellow sort of syringe, looks like a pen, like a morphine syringe. Well, you get the idea.

== Requirements ==
Reach Loyalty Level 2 with Jaeger to obtain this quest.

== Objectives ==
Obtain the chemical-filled syringe hidden in Factory
Hand over the chemical-filled syringe to Skier

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
1,000 Euros
1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× ORSIS T-5000M 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle
1× 7.62x51mm M80 ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of ORSIS T-5000M 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle at Skier LL2
Well, great. Now it’s time to get as far as possible while they do their experiments. We can have a look later.

== Guide ==

The wanted Syringe with a chemical is located in a room on the 3rd floor of the Factory offices behind a door which must be breached. There are multiple spawns throughout the room.

Location marked on map
The door to the "breach room" where you find the syringe
Syringe in the bottom compartment of the shelf to the right after entering
Syringe on the floor next to the stacked chairs

quests.title: Chemical - Part 4
quests.content:
Chemical - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Here’s the thing. This whole chemical stuff worked like a charm, and it immediately became clear who do we push it to. And the receiving party is ready. Only one issue left to resolve. Find more of these yellow chemicals. The crux of the issue was partly resolved before us - someone has already tried. Don't know, intentionally or not, but if you believe the consignment notes from the same docs, the whole box of that stuff was already tried to be taken out from the factory. But this cargo was not logged on any of the checkpoints, so I figure it’s worth looking for somewhere in the warehouses on Customs. If they tried to transport it, then it's most likely still in the car, probably a van. And not just one lousy syringe, but a whole crate. Look out for some markings maybe, the crate has them. Got it? Ah, one more thing. My sweet friends Prapor and Therapist popped up, poking around. So come on, better not turncoat now. Just a bit more and we’ll be running this place. Good luck, bruv. I'll tell about you to Ragman - he'll get some good helmets for you to buy.

== Objectives ==
Locate the transport with the chemicals on Customs
Mark the vehicle with an MS2000 Marker

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
1× Key case
1× Magazine case
2× TerraGroup Labs access keycard
Now that is right on! Well, now we’re tied up good, bro. Awesome that you didn’t chicken out at the last moment. Now I can fill you in on some real serious business.

== Failure Dialogue ==
Oh, you bloody bastard! Everything down the damn drain! So much fucking effort just wasted! The hell is wrong with you? Thought you were a sensible dude, not an airhead. Ah, to hell with you, spoiled such a jackpot! No way I’m letting you in on something major. You won't take part in any of my serious jobs, that's for sure. Gonna get smoked someday since you love ratting so much.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==
By completing either Out of Curiosity or Big Customer, you will fail and lose access to this quest.

If you do not have one already, purchase a MS2000 Marker from Prapor.
After placing the marker, the player must stay alive for 30 seconds or they will have to place another beacon in the van. You do not need to be near the van after the marker has been placed. Find a nearby hiding spot and wait until the timer is complete.

Warehouse marked on map
The warehouse with the vehicle inside.
The vehicle where the beacon is placed.

== Trivia ==
You can buy additional MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

Chemical Experiments is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

Hello again, friend. There are many people in Tarkov who are in need of my assistance. For example, a local chemist recently asked me to provide him with a hose for his equipment. This is too easy of a task for my men, and they simply do not have the time. Could you help this local from customs?

quests.title: Chemistry Closet
quests.content:
Chemistry Closet is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, come on in. Have you heard about some new guy that appeared in the resort area? Calls himself Sanitar. Not a simple man either, definitely worked for TerraGroup when they settled in the health resort. Either a major scientist there or just close to guys who were, no info on that. I've heard he's selling some secret stimulants, this means he understands chemistry quite well. But long story short, he's got some sort of an office or stash in the health resort, and I want you to find that place. I'll send specialists, maybe they'll find some interesting devices there. Just be careful, this man is dangerous.

== Objectives ==
Locate Sanitar's office in the health resort on Shoreline

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
So that's how it is, it's right on the first floor? How many times have my people been there and found nothing. Did you get inside the room? Found anything interesting in there? Well, doesn't matter, I'll send my boys to check it out anyway. Here's your reward, you've earned it. Thank you.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find Sanitar's office, which is located in the health resort on Shoreline. The wanted office is room 110 on the first floor of the resort east wing. A Health Resort office key with a blue tape is required to unlock the room. After you unlocked the door, simply walk into the room to complete the objective. After you completed the objective, you have to extract from Shoreline.

Health resort east wing location marked on map

quests.title: Chilly
quests.content:
Chilly was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come on in, sit down. Tea's almost ready, it'll warm you up. We haven't had such temperatures since 1873. That winter was as tough as this one, I even warmed up a stray fox here! It makes a big difference in a combat situation. You can freeze your fingers so cold that you can't even pull the trigger. Can't sit in an ambush either when you're freezing cold. If you want to survive, you gotta toughen up your body. Try to take out a few enemies when you're cold.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 10 targets while suffering from the Frostbite effect

== Rewards ==
+8,900 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.02
72,000 Roubles
75,600 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
82,800 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
4× Salewa first aid kit
So how's your condition? Now you need to warm up, or you'll be out of commission for a week. After you're warmed up, you'll have to practice again, otherwise your body won't get used to it. Then the cold will be an advantage, not a setback.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill any 10 targets while being under the  effect.

The effect is caused by being exposed to snowfall. It can be avoided in shelters, near firebarrels or with alchohol.

While the effect is active, the following debuffs apply:
Hands tremor effect
Decreases Endurance (-5)
Decreases energy recovery (-0.1/s)
Decreases hydration recovery (-0.1/s)
Decreases maximum stamina (-20)
Decreases stamina recovery rate (-1/s)
Lowers body temperature (-0.1 °C/s) (minimum 28 °C)

quests.title: Choose Your Friends Wisely
quests.content:
Choose Your Friends Wisely is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The assault is called off. Someone tipped off the driver about the ammo crates, so this motherfucker booby-trapped them! My lads got nailed. Now we're out of both manpower and ammo. We'll have to look for shells again. The driver's gonna start his bullshit counterattack now, you need to stop him. If we let him build his route system now, he's gonna be a pain in the ass later. He's got some mercs around him again, but now they all know they're going against Skier! You need to do this quickly so that no one thinks they can oppose me and fucking survive. I got a route where you'll find all these shitheads.

== Objectives ==
Use the transit from Customs to Reserve
Use the transit from Reserve to Woods
Use the transit from Woods to Lighthouse

Eliminate 5 PMC operatives while completing the other objectives

5,000 Euros

1× T H I C C Weapon case

Well, no one can help him after something like this. I'll take care of the little stuff, but without you, it could have gone south. You're a smooth guy, and you kept your word, unlike that driver fuck.

== Failure Dialogue ==
So it was you who was helping him the whole time? No wonder you're backing off now. You know I can deal with him one way or the other, right? But you, you're gonna be cleaning up this shit for a very long while.

Come on in if you're serious, got a new task for you! Those cameras you planted actually bore some fruit. Managed to find the right men, on good terms with Scavs. In short, I want to chum them up a bit, for the sake of peace. Because nowadays they are just too fucking mental. Wasting anyone indiscriminately, scared all my customers away, those motherfuckers. The trick is, these thieving bitches are from different gangs, and all need a different approach. I don't have enough chains for all of them, but you're a smooth operator, you'll get them in no time. I'll point you where to stash them. quests.content:
Claustrophobia is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
My friend and I were talking about you yesterday. About capable young folks... Then he told me about a couple of soldiers who went down into some catacombs. One panicked and fired off a shot for no reason, the other botched a grenade throw. My friend ended up having to disarm one of his own tripwires on the way back, never got to use it because of this embarrassment. If you don't want to end up making the same kind of mistakes, grab whatever weapon suits you and head into those "dungeons" beneath the Factory. quests.title: Clearing the Way
quests.content:
Clearing the Way was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Well, well. Look who decided to drop by. You had something important to chat about? It'll keep. I've got something pressing, and you fit the bill. I've got a big shipment lined up through Customs, but the lads moving it are just my usual muscle. In this weather they won't just struggle to fight, they'll barely be able to move. Funny thing is, that actually works in our favor. Less chance of bumping into anyone. That's exactly why I picked this moment. Still, the load's heavy, so I want some cover. Make sure my boys don't cross paths with anyone on Customs, yeah? And wrap up warm yourself. These frosts don't care who you are.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 20 targets on Customs

+12,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.01
51,000 Roubles
53,550 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
58,650 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
2× Set of files "Master"
2× Smoked Chimney drain cleaner
So, safe corridor's clear? Lovely, mate. If this cold hangs around, we might as well keep cashing in on it. Don't go vanishing on me. I'll be needing you again.

quests.title: Clip Their Wings
quests.content:
Clip Their Wings was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov: Arena.

== Dialogue ==
Here comes my favorite gladiator! There's a big score coming up, you'll come in very handy for it. So long story short, I've gotten new shareholders in place of Kaban and Kollontay. Thing is, even they have gotten cocky lately, trying to redistribute power, those pricks. They're bringing out more and more of their own fighters, even for that one tournament with all kinds of big shots. I'm not happy with that. I want only my guys there, you know? So this is where you come in. Go ahead and fuck those candidates up, gladiator style. And I'll make sure you get the proper reward, a flashy new spray paint kit Tiger Stripe Green.

Eliminate 75 enemies in LastHero mode
Eliminate 35 enemies in TeamFight or BlastGang mode

quests.title: Closer to the People
quests.content:
Closer to the People was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Terrible news, young man. I have stopped receiving communications from my group, and the documents you brought me have been scrubbed of all the essential information. We know neither the project code, nor the detailed itinerary. Not even a summary of these boxes' contents! I cannot possibly ask you to open them yourself. What if my group's demise has something to do with their contents? Instead, I came up with another idea. The documents said that in the event of obstacles along the transit, the delivery crews could opt to deviate from the route. If the movers were attacked during transit, we might learn about it from the workers' records. Examine the places where the delivery crews may have stayed and search for this information.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the delivery crew's shipment notes on Customs
Hand over the found information

== Rewards ==
+10,300 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.02
10,300 Roubles
10,815 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
11,845 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
2× Portable defibrillator
Impossible... According to these records, no one attacked the movers, the path was clear! Yet the workers who spent several hours near the boxes reported itching and fever, and asked to go home. The foreman's notes say that two delivery crews abandoned the boxes during transportation and flatly refused to continue their work! It turns out that the transportation of these boxes required special protective equipment, which no one considered to provide to ordinary workers. It's unclear how dangerous the boxes are at the moment, but I wouldn't recommend approaching them without the appropriate equipment.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find the delivery crew's shipment notes on Customs. They can be found in the locker room on the first floor of the boiler building. There are multiple spawns throughout the room.

Boiler building location marked on map
The building
Door to the locker room

First spawn in the wall-mounted tool cabinet
Second spawn on the floor under the fully opened locker in the middle row
Third spawn in the locker next to the sinks
Fourth spawn on the floor next to the shelf

quests.title: Cocktail Tasting
quests.content:
Cocktail Tasting was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Opa, hey there! So listen up, there's this big chemist guy in the city. Makes all kinds of fucked-up drugs. And there's a rumor going around that he created some new stimulant. The bums say they saw a jacked-up PMC merc running around the block like a fucking lunatic, dodging bullets Neo style. But then he tripped over a rock and gone to forever sleep, can you believe it? Looks like that chemo took a toll on his health. There's a price to pay for everything in life... Find out what kind of drugs he was stoned on and if there's any reason to peddle that shit.

Eliminate 20 PMC operatives while under the influence of the "Obdolbos" cocktail

quests.title: Cold Start
quests.content:
Cold Start was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You tried out my new heater yet? This little thingie works perfectly! But getting out on the routes now is a whole different story... I have to warm the engine for an hour, and that's not even counting the start itself! At first the old girl wouldn't start cold at all. Diesel was waxing up like a bastard. Had to double the amount of additives. And you know that stuff's not exactly growing on trees around here anymore. Every can counts now. Say, maybe you could help a friend out? Since you're not hiding in your basement right now, you should be able to track down some fuel conditioner. I doubt you need it for anything, but it'd save my ass big time.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 4 Fuel conditioners to the BTR Driver

== Rewards ==
+13,000 EXP
60,000 Roubles
2× Topographic survey maps
You're a hell of a guy, that's what I'll say! I owe you one.

quests.title: Colleagues
quests.content:
Colleagues is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon. It is obvious that in the current difficult situation, everyone who has medical knowledge is worth gold, not to mention actual working doctors. And it looks like such a doctor has appeared. I was told that someone on the Shoreline is treating the locals and selling them medicine. I have hired several groups to go there. They had to find this doctor, enter into negotiations and offer the best terms. But today, none of the groups got in touch. We need these medications, I've got clients... ahem, people in need to worry about. Find my people and find out what happened.

== Objectives ==
Locate the group that was sent to the Health Resort on Shoreline
Locate the group that was sent to the pier on Shoreline
Locate the group that was sent to the cottages on Shoreline
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
All three groups wiped out? I don't understand how this could happen. They were not supposed to attract attention and get involved in a fight. They were negotiators with a very lucrative trade offer. Looks like the negotiations went horribly wrong.

== Guide ==
Locate the three bodies of the people Therapist hired on Shoreline. These corpses will be covered with white shrouds. All three corpses must be found in a single raid. If you leave the raid and have only found some of the corpses, the quest will reset. You must extract in the same raid in which you found all the corpses.

The three corpses can be found in the following locations:

Locations marked on map

In the backyard of the locked cottage
In front of the office building at the pier

quests.title: Collector
quests.content:
Collector is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, mercenary. I have been watching you for quite a while now, and I know that you are able to solve the tasks assigned to you. Don't get too cocky now, you're not the only one who knows how to follow orders. There are more fighters like you, even more competent. I want to offer you a job, to give you a chance to become a part of something bigger than you can imagine. If you are ready, then here's an assignment for you: my people operate all over Tarkov and often leave souvenirs after themselves. The mission is to obtain and deliver those items to me. No questions asked. The things are extremely rare. I hope I don't have to remind you that you have to obtain all these items by yourself? Believe me, I like no other know when people lie. You will be informed of the drop spot. And one more thing, all my partners have already mastered their skills a long time ago and proven themselves reliable, and if you want to be one of them, then prove to me that you are not inferior to them in training. Don't try to contact me, I will do it myself when the time comes.

== Quest description decryption ==
Solving the riddle starts with the quest description, the first paragraph of the hex encoded text equating to At interchange we were at bash zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba pryz1uts8q5onmlkj3hgfe4c2a and the second one to 6t th1 1na of 8t 6ll, 2ou must 58ll th1 58ll6 and UrAgCe DEroRRiM. The first uncovered paragraph indicates the existence of Atbash ciphered text, the text zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba pryz1uts8q5onmlkj3hgfe4c2a equating to abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz kiba1fgh8j5lmnopq3stuv4x2z, a clear substitution pattern. Using the aforementioned substitution pattern, we can take the second paragraph found in the quest description and translate it to 6t the end of it 6ll, you must kill the kill6, a clue which will become useful later along with the UrAgCe and DEroRRiM texts.

== Quest reward text decryption ==
The first operation to be applied to the quest reward text seems obvious, either from the DEroRRiM (MiRRorED if mirrored) text or from the nature of the text, it being a simple mirror of the whole text block. After a mirror, the paragraph First truth is, at the base you see the sum of 4 and 6, second truth is that thirteen is false number is revealed, making us understand that the number 13 should be eliminated in all further findings and that the base being used for them will be 64, instead of the human-used 10. Thus, after removing the already used text, removing the number 13 and decoding the text from Base64, we can observe the following text: thirteen is rot ten number as well, rotate yourself out of it which indicates the use of the rot13 cipher. After another removal of our used text and a rot13 decryption we can observe the following lines: Affine brought you two of the first numbers coupled with vjg pwodgt qh uycp ykvjjqnfu hkxg and how many steps should emperor of rome walk, one or three coupled with bgufs efbmjoh xjui txbot, zpv xjmm gjoe zpvstfmg jo b trvbsf pg gpvs / wkhuh lv d vshfldo sodfh wr uhyhdo brxuvhoi lq d vkdsh ri wxeh, wkh vkruw zdb wx.eh which indicate the Affine and  Caesar ciphers respectively. After decyphering the Affine encoded text with the values a = 1; b = 2 we obtain the number of swan withholds five and after decoding the Caesar encoded texts with a shift of 1 and 3 respectively we obtain after dealing with swans, you will find yourself in a square of four / there is a special place to reveal yourself in a shape of tube, the short way tu.be, both clues helping later.

== Piecing everything together ==
To continue, we'll start with the remainder of our quest reward text: 266b2269726c336c4261 a hex encoded string which we should not decrypt for now. The clue the number of swan withholds five shows that 2 (a number which looks similar to a swan) should be replaced by the number 5, doing so in our hex text and then finally decoding it, indicated by the square of four clue, giving us VkUiul3lEa. Looking closely at the obtained string, we can observe the existence of the word killa within it, the clue 6t the end of it 6ll, you must kill the kill6 telling us to remove it from the text. Doing so will finally reveal the text VUu3E which if attached to the UrAgCe string obtained earlier, and being added onto a YouTube short link, as indicated by there is a special place to reveal yourself in a shape of tube, the short way tu.be revealing a YouTube video.

== The pastebin ==
Approximately a week after finding the first YouTube video, a Pastebin link surfaced in the video description. For ease in describing the decryption progress, we'll split the document in 4 sections, one for each paragraph and will start with the last one since it exposes the 1st step within the process.

== Paragraph 4 ==
The paragraph is Base64 encoded, but before decoding it, all characters that are found surrounded by a + character need to be deleted and the contents need to be set aside to form the string 524f543437 which equates to ROT47 in hexadecimal. After the removal of the odd characters, the text File119111====T10p2 ...Be advised, we've  got... (transmission interrupted)====end of file is revealed. We can note down the "file number" as the rest is just flavor text.

== Paragraph 3 ==
Using the former ROT47 clue we can solve this paragraph, applying a ROT47 decryption after a Base64 decode yielding the content we need, but slightly malformed. To clear this malformation every 22nd character in the original string needs to be removed (all of the characters being a 0), thus revealing File108070107==== T10p1 Overseer, this is team 8 unit 13 Foreman callsign. We got ambushed, requesting backup.... ====end of file. Like the last paragraph, we can ignore all text besides the file number.

== Paragraph 2 ==
After a reverse of this paragraph we can observe the string m1560red})>/|:\ (originally t3bahpl4{()}der0651m) is an outlier and will serve as a clue later, so we can remove it. The rest of the paragraph (still reversed) can simply be Base64 decoded to find File086078121==== OVRp2 ...Possible locals ambush. ====end of file. As with the former paragraphs, keep the file number and ignore the rest.

== Paragraph 1 ==
As with the former paragraphs we start with a simple Base64 decode. We can now take the m1560red})>/|:\ clue and use it as a substitute alphabet while ignoring the importat numbers, giving us the File082056117==== OVRp1 team 10, recon detail, moving to polikhim 1-12. backup call from team 8, unknown detail.... ====end of file string, which again, can be disregarded besides the file number.

== Finale ==
Concatenating all file numbers together yields 082056117086078121108070107119111. If we group the characters and get their coresponding ASCII character, we obtain R8uVNylFkwo which leads to the final YouTube video. The video had a few game keys in its description.

quests.title: Come by the Fire
quests.content:
Come by the Fire was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You look half frozen, mate. Want some vodka to warm you up? Like the frost wasn't enough, now we've got this bloody blizzard on top of it. But I told you already, didn't I? If you want business to keep moving, you find opportunities where everyone else backs off. Logistics are dead for everyone right now, I heard even the BTR won't start. And that means the roads are wide open for us, as long as you've got the nerve. So listen up. I need to move a few weapon shipments through disputed ground. The route goes through Priozersk. Without a plan, my lads will end up buried in the snow out there. They'll be moving from the RUAF checkpoint by the lake, heading northeast toward the village, where the SUV driver on the bridge usually picks people up. But they need shelters. Places to hide from the storm. You probably won't run into anyone on the way, but my guys definitely won't be there. So if you do see someone, feel free to drop them. Your job is to find good spots along the route and mark them with IR strobes. If everything goes smoothly, I'll cut you in on the profit from the deal.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark the first spot from Skier's route with an MS2000 Marker
Locate and mark the second spot from Skier's route with an MS2000 Marker
Locate and mark the third spot from Skier's route with an MS2000 Marker
Locate and mark the fourth spot from Skier's route with an MS2000 Marker
Eliminate any 5 targets while wearing a Pompon hat on Woods

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.01
42,000 Roubles
44,100 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
48,300 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
1× TDI KRISS Vector Gen.2 9x19 submachine gun
4× Glock 9x19 "Big Stick" 33-round magazine
4× 9x19mm AP 6.3 ammo pack (50 pcs)
I got the signals already. Clean work, mate. The deal's not finished yet, but I'll slide you something as an advance. You didn't just help move cargo. At this rate, by the time Prapor crawls out of his bunkers, we'll have half his routes under control.

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks barter for Pompon hat at Ragman LL1.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to mark 4 locations for Skier's route with MS2000 markers and kill any 5 targets while wearing a Pompon hat on Woods.

== Trivia ==

It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

quests.title: Comfort Zone
quests.content:
Comfort Zone was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov: Arena.

== Dialogue ==
Usually I don't meddle in my crew's work. A show's a show. But I heard everyone's tired of sniper duels. They want something heavier, more brutal. Close range stuff. What do you think? Actually forget this question, just go do it. I need you taking out opponents from five meters or less. Make it messy, make the limbs fly off. That'll wake the audience right up.

Eliminate 10 enemies from less than 5 meters away in any game mode

quests.title: Communication Difficulties
quests.content:
Communication Difficulties was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, what's up. Listen, can you help me out with some stuff? There are rumors that a new trader settled right on the lighthouse island at the cape, and he's got some serious guards with him, like some presidential security. I wanna establish communication with that guy, to cooperate, to make deals, well, you know what I mean. Can you go and contact him and check out the situation? If something doesn't go according to the plan, then come back to me right away, okay? Alright, see ya, brother.

== Objectives ==
Recon the area around the Lighthouse
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+9,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.02
40,000 Roubles
42,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
46,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
What an adventure for your ass, that's for sure! Looks like our salesman is not ready to talk business. Alright, I'll think of something.

== Guide ==
Locate the road leading to the currently closed lighthouse on Lighthouse. You need to move at least in front of the military truck to get the quest completion.

== Notes: ==
The Border Sniper will shoot at you once you enter the quest area
Make sure you are not overweight and have enough stamina to run to the quest trigger area and back
It is recommended to use painkillers before moving in
Taking cover is pointless as the Border Sniper ignores objects

Quest area marked on map
View on the road, military truck on the left

quests.title: Compensation for Damage - Barkeep
quests.content:
Compensation for Damage - Barkeep is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Do you want people to think the "right" things about you? What do you think of yourself, mercenary? Probably thinking you're a great guy? Thinking you're the future Tarkov Legend, maybe even a hero already? You came here to bow to me, which means that you are nothing more than just an errand boy... I'm serious, you're doing everything you get told to: for money, guns, reputation... What if I told you to wipe my people's asses, for the most pimped-out gun in the whole county? Listen, I'm in a good mood today, so I'll just ask you to bring me a Cuba Libre cocktail. I'll remind you of the ingredients, just in case you've been hit on the head too much to forget such basic things. You'll need rum, coke, lime, and ice. Although... Yeah, you'll be searching for lime the whole decade. I'll make it easier for you: bring me a Jack and Coke.

== Requirements ==
Scav karma of -1

== Objectives ==
Hand over the found in raid Bottle of Dan Jackiel whiskey
Hand over the 3 found in raid Can of TarCola soda

== Rewards ==
Fence Rep +1
The best way to finish a day of hard work, wouldn't you say? Hurry up and open it then.

== Guide ==

quests.title: Compensation for Damage - Collection
quests.content:
Compensation for Damage - Collection is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
What, came to bow again, tormented by guilt? You know, merc, I'm not your image-maker or a PR manager... Alright, I can help you. One of my contacts is a big shot who collects US weaponry. Yes, he could just order fresh ones from the factory. But he needs an already used weapon, the one that still smells of gunpowder. That's why his whole collection is guns from conflict zones. Afghanistan, Iraq,... Tarkov. I want to gift him some of the local M4s, but the guy is smart, so you'll need to find the guns yourself, not from some trader. Help me, and I'll help you in return. I'll make people forget the Scav blood on your hands.

== Requirements ==
Scav karma of -1

== Objectives ==
Hand over the 2 found in raid Colt M4A1 assault rifles

== Rewards ==
Fence Rep +1
That's it then, your request for a new dust filter for the ProVacuum model 60 has been approved, hehe. Your new life as a clean man begins, so don't mess it up again.

== Guide ==

To hand over a weapon it must be in usable condition. If a weapon's icon is red, it is missing vital parts and can not be turned in.

== Trivia ==
The reward completion text is a reference to the "Disappearer's" password in the TV series "Breaking Bad".

quests.title: Compensation for Damage - Trust
quests.content:
Compensation for Damage - Trust is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello there, mercenary. You really messed up, huh? You know what people are saying about you? you are unrealiable and not to be trusted. Simply saying, you're an idiot who shoots without thinking at everything that moves. Well, we all can't be saints, right? I'm the man who can improve your reputation. You just have to show that you wouldn't mind helping Scavs. Eliminate several PMC groups and bring me their dogtags. After that, I'll start new rumors about you, something more interesting.

== Requirements ==
Scav karma of -1

== Objectives ==
Hand over the 5 found in raid BEAR PMC dogtags
Hand over the 5 found in raid USEC PMC dogtags

== Rewards ==
Fence Rep +1
Welcome back, merc. Hand over the dogtags, I'll pass them to where they need to be.

== Guide ==

quests.title: Compensation for Damage - Wager
quests.content:
Compensation for Damage - Wager is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So, you want to improve your crappy rep around these parts? Two influential people made a bet on you: can you repeat your success of shooting at everything that moves, but with a specific weapon you are told to use? Lucky for you, the tossed coin didn't fall on a knife, but on a Kalashnikov rifle. A pity, honestly, I'd rather look at you running around with a knife and getting messed up every time. Would be a great redemption arc, wouldn't it? Well, since they've chosen an AK, I made a bet too: that you will handle it. Your targets are the unwanted mercs wandering around some places. So you better not screw up.

== Requirements ==
Scav karma of -1

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 7 PMC operatives while using any AK-series assault rifle

== Rewards ==
Fence Rep +1
You've pleased my friends. Congratulations on your success.

AK-101
AK-102

quests.title: Compensation for Damage - Wergild
quests.content:
Compensation for Damage - Wergild is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You know, doing errands all day is still not enough to improve your poor situation. I think there is and easier way. Bribe the right people and they'll sing praises about how amazing you are. For example, you can compensate the friends of those you killed due to your brain disorder. Something like a wergild for murder in the Middle Ages.

== Requirements ==
Scav karma of -3

== Objectives ==
Hand over 1,000,000 RUB

== Rewards ==
Fence Rep +1
Outstanding. Part of the compensation will go where it needs to go, and the other part will stay with me. Let's say it's for maintaining our cooperation.

== Guide ==

quests.title: Competition Protection
quests.content:
Competition Protection was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, gladiator! I hear you're interested in those health resort cellars. I'll be honest, the idea was a good one, I might even revisit it later... But at this moment, it's not the right time for the Labyrinth. So I'm not gonna tell you anything about it, sorry. If you want to go to the entry site on your own and rummage through the garbage left there, I won't stop you. But without the access keycard, you can't get inside the Labyrinth. That's where our interests align. One of my gladiators has been getting a little starstruck lately. He thinks that nobody can beat his arena performance, and wants to up his salary. Even took to blackmailing me, the bastard! However, it's not profitable to just outright take him out of the fights. I want to show him that there are no indispensable people, and to do that, we need to make some noise in the Arena. Hopefully that'll bring this guy to his senses. You're a capable fighter, and I'll make you a fair deal: if you can get on the Arena's best gladiator ranks, I'll help you with the keycards to the Labyrinth. You up for it?

== Notes ==
This quest is not available in the PvE game mode.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 50 enemies in any game mode in Arena
Take at least 3rd place in LastHero mode in Arena

== Rewards ==
Ref Rep +0.03
+24,600 EXP
125 GP coins
131 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
144 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× Labrys access keycard
1× Lega Medal
Unlocks purchase of Labrys access keycard at Ref LL1
You turned out to be a real dark horse... The results are remarkable. Not everyone can pull this off. I'll unlock one of the keycard stashes for you. But be aware that this is a very special item, and I'm not going to give it to you for free. One more thing. Arena rewards the best gladiators, and you clearly have potential. If you get tired of scavenging the ruins and want real glory, you know where to find me.

quests.title: Compromise
quests.content:
Compromise was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov: Arena.

== Dialogue ==
Let me tell you what I got up to with those top brass people. But first please answer this question — what's the most important thing in this business? No... not surviving! Well, actually, I guess it is. Anyway... What's the second most important thing? Right. Damn right! Money! Cash, dough... cheese! Whatever you want to call it, it all brings joy. Now, these people. Yes, the same ones who wanted to kill you — they're willing to bet on you. But you have to show them real results: kill and rise to the top. So go do it!

== Objectives ==
Win 10 rounds in TeamFight or BlastGang mode
Score 4500 points in CheckPoint mode
Claim at least 3rd place in Last Hero mode

== Rewards ==
+31,000 EXP
Ref Rep +0.04
60 GP coins
500,000 Roubles
+2,500 Arena BattlePass EXP
4 Battle Points
1× Lega Medal

quests.title: Confidential Info
quests.content:
Confidential Info is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, my friend. According to my information, you've gained access to one of TerraGroup's abandoned facilities. We've witnessed many times what happens when dangerous developments fall into the hands of unqualified people. Our partners are very concerned about what happened in Tarkov after that outbreak in the Laboratory. There's no way we're going to let this crisis happen again. That's why I have a high-priority assignment for you. I need to retrieve a storage device containing sensitive information from that facility. The details are highly classified. The client can trace an independent attempt to read the data and cancel the contract, so please do not even attempt it. In addition to the storage device, I was told that there is also a maintenance room on the site, the client has said that it should look like a workshop. It must be destroyed or at least damaged. But be careful with the explosives: we don't want you perishing with the storage device.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the special storage module inside The Labyrinth
Plant a hand grenade in the assembly workshop inside Labyrinth
Hand over the found information

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
1,900 Dollars
1,995 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,185 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG D-60 STANAG 60-round magazine
1× Final Moment poster
Unlocks barter for AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG D-60 STANAG 60-round magazine at Peacekeeper LL4
Great job, my friend! My partner especially appreciates your respect for privacy and requested a proper reward for you.

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to find a special storage module in the prototype weapon area inside The Labyrinth. Afterwards you have to stash a fragmentation grenade in the prototype weapon. Note: The F-1 hand grenade (Reduced delay) can't be used.

Prototype weapon area marked on map
Spawn 1: On the tool trolley next to the whiteboard
Spawn 2: On the center table closest to the whiteboard
Spawn 3: Ontop the pallet next to the grate door
Spawn 4: On the center table closest to the laptop
Spawn 5: On the tool trolley next to the missile
Spawn 6: On the table next to the laptop

quests.title: Connections Up North
quests.content:
Connections Up North is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I've got some special supply channels. Hell, I can even get certain bits shipped in from Finland! My contact over there has set up a route for some seriously dangerous toys. This isn't some TOZ or VPO, you know. But I can't just sell stuff like that to anyone. I've learned that the hard way. A bunch of clumsy idiots can ruin the reputation of even the best product in the world. So I came up with a little scheme. I want to start a rumor first. Make people believe there's a bloke roaming Tarkov who's not just some fighter, but a proper master, yeah? Shoots with deadly accuracy, leaves nothing but piles of dead PMCs behind him. And nobody can even spot him because he's a professional, using bolt-action rifles with electronic scopes. Then, bam! The guy shows up with my gear in his hands. Everyone will understand that the best operators come to me for their kit. I reckon you're the right man for it. Make people afraid to even step outside at night, and I'll sort you out with these hot new imports. First batch is on me!

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 20 PMC operatives with a bolt-action rifle with night or thermal scope

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Attention skill levels
+4 Covert Movement skill levels
Skier Rep +1.5
2,400 Euros
2,520 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,760 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Sako TRG M10 .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle
2× Sako TRG M10 .338 LM 8-round magazine
1× .338 Lapua Magnum FMJ ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of Sako TRG M10 .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle at Skier LL4
Even my contacts have started hearing the rumors! They reckon there's no countering a trick like that. With a rifle like this, you'll become a proper legend.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 20 PMCs while using a bolt-action rifle with a night or thermal vision sight. To have the kills count for this quest, the sight just needs to be installed on the gun, and not necessarily be actively used. This means you can use a sight that supports backup sights, like the Armasight Vulcan MG 3.5x Bravo night vision scope, and use any compact reflex sight of your choice on top.

quests.title: Consequences of Our Decisions
quests.content:
Consequences of Our Decisions is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. I know you've been working with Fence lately. I'm not going to lecture you about the risks of dealing with him, but there is something I have to say. Somehow, he's managed to locate TerraGroup facilities that were never mentioned anywhere, and now he's hauling materials and equipment out of them. Think about what could be hidden in places like that, if even human experimentation and deadly viruses were easier to uncover than these secret sites. Fence stopped caring about the outside world a long time ago, and honestly, I don't really feel like I'm part of it anymore either. But that doesn't mean common sense goes out the window. Putting materials like these into the hands of someone who'd sell them to anyone willing to pay is an enormous risk. If you want, read these documents yourself first. I'll give you the keys to try and break the encryption. I hope you'll make the right choice and bring that laptop to me.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Decrypt the data from the secret facility laptop
Read the data recovered from Fence's laptop
Hand over the laptop

== Rewards ==
+35,000 EXP
300,000 Roubles
315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
5× Electric drill
3× Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter
5× Cyclon rechargeable battery
5× Toolset
1× Briefcase with documents
Unlocks achievement Profit Over Principles
I'm glad you're on my side. For a while, I thought you were actually going to sell the data to Fence. Honestly, it wouldn't have surprised me, considering the direction this world is heading... But people like you give me hope that we might still be able to fix some of this without killing each other in the process.

== Failure Dialogue ==
I don't believe you made that choice knowingly. Maybe you rushed it, or maybe you underestimated the consequences. All we can do now is hope that facility and the data it contained were classified for reasons other than how dangerous or important they are. Though, truth be told, I don't believe that myself...

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks craft for Data from Fence's laptop at Intelligence Center level 1.

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to find the Laptop from an unknown facility. Then craft the Data from Fence's laptop at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout and read it from the off-raid quest inventory. Afterwards hand over the laptop to Mechanic.

The laptop is located at a ventilation shaft in an alley behind the diner on Nikitskaya Street at Streets of Tarkov.

Location of the laptop marked on map.
Enter the diner to access the alley behind it.
The ventilation shaft where the laptop is located.
The laptop location.

quests.title: Conservation Area
quests.content:
Conservation Area was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello again. Still feeling strong? Well, keep it that way. We're not going to get much rest any time soon. Whatever's going on with the treatment of this disease, there's still a lot of sick people all over the city! That's why I once again ask for your support. The infected have been seen in our forest, and we can't let that go unnoticed. What if this virus stays in the soil? Is this what we'd leave behind? We can't let them roam the nature reserve, we have to drive them away. Try hunting them at night and see how they behave... It might make things easier.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 40 infected on night-time Woods

== Rewards ==
+40,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.05
200,000 Roubles
210,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
230,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× Canister with purified water
So the infected are deadly at night, too? Even the fiercest beast needs rest too, I thought... After this, I don't know if we can truly cure them. It's getting harder and harder to see them as human beings with each passing day...

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 40 infected on Woods during the time period 21:00-04:00.

Infected PMC

quests.title: Consolation Prize
quests.content:
Consolation Prize is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Luka hasn't been answering for over a week. Those motherfuckers screwed us both over like a pair of bloody idiots. I've looked into every option, and there's no way we're getting our hands on those pricks. We both sank a serious amount of money into this whole thing. Need to save what's left of our position, and this time without any of those useless idiots involved. Just you and me. I've got a lead on the lab. My lads spotted Raiders moving a bunch of gear around. Looks like they were evacuating one of their own stashes and hid it somewhere in the lab until they could find somewhere better. You'd never track down a hideout like that on your own, but I've got specialists who know exactly what to look for. The main thing is keeping them safe. Clear the lab out. My lads will need more than a day to search the whole place. Doubt you'll find anything useful for yourself in there, but I'll think of something to make it worth your while.

== Objectives ==
Survive and extract from The Lab 15 times
Eliminate any 100 targets in The Lab

== Rewards ==
+1 Aim Drills skill level
+1 Assault Rifles skill level
+1 Sniping skill level
+1 Weapon Maintenance skill level
+1 Troubleshooting skill level
+1 DMRs skill level
+1 Heavy Machine Guns skill level
+1 Light Machine Guns skill level
+1 Melee skill level

Unlocks achievement All on Red
While you were running around the Lab, I sorted out your reward. You liked that whole extra education thing, didn't you? I've got a mate who used to work for Ref. Was a gunsmith there. Here's his contact. Tell him you're from me and have a chat. Won't make back the money you spent on this, but it might save your life one day. And that's worth more.

quests.title: Contagious Beast
quests.prerequisites: Accept Darkest Hour Is Just Before Dawn
quests.content:
Contagious Beast was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I never thought we'd have so much on our plate. Did you hear that the infected have gotten to Tagilla? He was already furious before, and now even more so. With such an active carrier of contagion, we'll soon run out of healthy people. He must be stopped. Sure, there are tons of infected everywhere now, but none of them are as dangerous as Tagilla. So I'm asking you to put everything on hold and find the bastard. And don't leave until his body stops twitching. After everything that's happened, it wouldn't surprise me if Tagilla survives several magazines and then gets up as if nothing had happened... And hey, be careful out there.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize infected Tagilla
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.05
100,000 Roubles
105,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
115,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)
You made sure this demon is out of commission, yes? Well, let's hope we've dealt with this threat for good. Conserve your ammo and check back soon, it's important we all work together right now.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill infected Tagilla and survive the raid. He can be found wherever there are currently other infected.

Infected Tagilla

quests.title: Corporate Perks
quests.content:
Corporate Perks is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, mercenary. Before all the chaos happened in the city, there was this Russian software company. Can't remember the name anymore, only that they made the best software in their niche. I still use some of their work to this day. It wasn't a large company, which is exactly why I can't understand how they managed to deliver such high-quality software so quickly. They had to be hiding something, and I'd very much like to know what it was. Would you satisfy my curiosity? Find their office and take a look around.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Locate the IT firm office on Streets of Tarkov
Unravel the secret of the firm's success
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
A torture room, you say? Very, uh... medieval. But apparently it got results. Well then, here's your payment.

Afterwards you have to unravel the secret of the firm's success. To do that, you need to enter the locked "negotiation room" on the south end of the building. A "Negotiation" room key is required to access it.

quests.title: Courtesy Visit
quests.content:
Courtesy Visit is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come in, I want to ask you for something. You know the health resort area, right? At first, the factory workers were convalescing there, and then the TerraGroup employees settled there their staff. I’ve been to those parts a long time ago, my classmates lived there. So, I want you to check on them, it's the old village with the church. The priest, his name is Pyotr. Misha, the fisherman. quests.title: Cream of the Crop
quests.content:
Cream of the Crop was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good of you to drop by! Got a job for you, cargos again. It seems someone has figured out that some of the equipment has fallen into the wrong hands. But that is not the problem. We got word of an important airdrop they will target immediately if they see it. We're gonna have to work hard to get it. Keep it as confidential as possible. The key is to make sure you don't get spotted with the package. Get a special yellow RSP flare at the coast. They're stashed at high elevations, like roofs and towers. Then find a spot somewhere out of the way and shoot it. The necessary people will recognize it and send the package. Wait for it and take whatever's in it. Then, run to stash the devices at the designated spots at the Lighthouse. Go straight from the coast, it'll be quicker. Do it all in one go, don't get killed or go back to your bunker until you've finished the job. Oh, and avoid shelling, obviously. This equipment can't be wasted. Serious people are interested in this matter, and mister Lightkeeper expects to hear from me when the task is completed.

== Objectives ==
Find the KOSA UAV electronic jamming device in raid
Use the transit from Shoreline to Lighthouse
Stash the KOSA device on the second floor of the yacht club cottage on Lighthouse

== Rewards ==
+52,600 EXP
195,000 Roubles
204,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
224,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Blue)

quests.title: Cut Down to the Root
quests.content:
Cut Down to the Root is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, kid. The Rogues have badly overestimated their strength lately and lost a lot of men. Many are glad that it's now easier to move through the territory around the lighthouse. But we need to look at the consequences and act ahead of time. Given enough time under Knight's leadership, they'll certainly replenish their supplies and recruit new fighters. We can put an end to that right now, if we don't waste any time. I can't get to the coast myself right now, and Partisan could still be overwhelmed by their numbers. So your help would be most welcome. But keep in mind that their new positions are much easier to defend. Be careful.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 15 Rogues on Lighthouse

== Failure Dialogue ==
Never thought Lightkeeper could cloud your judgment. We could've gotten rid of a serious threat to Tarkov, but you chose to walk away so you could climb higher in some imaginary hierarchy. Leave me be, kid.

They've got a gang, they think they're the hippest guys in the neighborhood, and they're interfering with my business as well! We gotta show them where they belong. And it ain't in that fancy barbershop they're holed up in, that's for sure. No, no need to kick anyone out. We're gonna be subtle. Pretend to be one of them and shoot pretty much anyone you see. I need everyone in the city to start hating them. When you're done, drop the outfit off at their barbershop so people know who's the maniac shooting everything. Can you do that?

quests.title: Dark Times
quests.content:
Dark Times was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, mercenary. Many think that things cannot get worse in Tarkov, but they do not have the knowledge that I do. Some changes are inevitable. That is why I seek out reliable professionals with valuable skills. There will be very few good soldiers in the future. Only those who can fully control and manage their emotions will survive. Such men are capable of the impossible, and only they can be relied upon when my predictions come true. That is why I am offering you an accelerated test. Prove to me that you are capable of fighting under unfavorable conditions, regardless of the circumstances around you. You survive – you win. And to survive, you must kill.

== Notes ==
This quest is not available in the PvE game mode.

== Dialogue ==
You're quick, I'll give you that! Now listen up. When I first came up with the Arena, I had no idea how much cash it would actually take. And once my own money ran out, I had to dip into someone else's pockets. Long story short, I borrowed from a couple of influential investors. Hey, friend. There's been an unexpected emergency. No, I decrypted the flash drive, sent it with my guys. But somebody intercepted them. I heard on the radio they got gunned down. Horrible. The attackers were obviously after the flash drive. This is a dangerous business I've gotten myself into... Anyway, I gotta honor my promises anyway. I need your help again. The shooting happened at Customs. I don't think the attackers have gotten very far. Chase them down and take them out. You might want to just give the flash drive straight to Skier. More secure that way.

quests.title: Delivery From the Past
quests.content:
Delivery From the Past is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Stay well, fighter. Still in our sinful world, I see? But enough of that. There is this one thing. Rather sensitive, so to say. We kind of reached mutual trust with you, right? So I’ll be trusting you with a serious task now. I won’t go into details of why, who and for what, it's not really related to the task anyway. And the task is to procure a package and move it to another place. Doesn’t sound hard, but there is a nuance. The pickup is on Customs, and the drop-off is in the Factory. Customs has a big warehouse, the red one, near the garages. The package is located there on the second floor in the office. Grab it and stash it on Factory, in a metal shack on the second floor, near the dressing room area. Interested?

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the valuable folder in Tarcone director's office on Customs
Stash the package in the break room on the 2nd floor near Gate 3 on Factory

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Toolset
Unlocks English herringbone Hideout floor style
What, success again? Bit of a warrior, eh? The freaking Terror of Tarkov! Hey, don’t get me wrong! Everything’s done right, I owe you one. Important business is taken care of - I feel good. And when I feel good, proper people around me start feeling good as well. Got it?

== Guide ==

To begin, you need to have the Tarcone Director's office key. If you do not have one, you can find it within drawers or from Scavs. It can also be bartered for with Therapist. Once you have obtained one, head to Customs. The first place you want to visit is the red Paradigm warehouse on the east side of the map. The office is found at the top of the metal stairs. After unlocking the door there will be two rooms. The second room is the one containing the documents. Be warned though, to enter this room the door must be breached, which will create a lot of noise. After entering the room, go to the desk and look just under the table top, on top of the drawers. Leaning may help you to see it. Extract from Customs. If you die at any point after picking up the documents and you still have them in your in raid quest inventory, they will be lost and must be reacquired. If you don't want to do the second part of the quest immediately, you can move the documents into your off-raid quest inventory in the character menu under the "tasks" tab.

Warehouse marked on map
The warehouse
The office
The second room
Docs 0022 is under the desk, on top of the drawers

It's time to head to Factory. You can complete this during the daytime or nighttime. With the documents in your in raid quest inventory, head towards the Gate 3 extraction. To the left of the extraction is a short metal staircase leading to a sheet metal room. This is where you must place the documents. To place them you, must hold down your use key (default F) for 10 seconds. For safety, you should lie down when placing them to be out of sight from the doorway and windows. If you die before the timer finishes, you need to retrieve the documents again. Hence, try to make sure nobody is around to disturb while you place the documents (i.e. either kill all other PMCs or wait until they have left the raid). After the placement is complete, you have to extract from the raid. The "Survived" extraction status is not required. You do not have to survive and extract on the same raid that you planted the documents, it can be done in any Factory raid.

Desperate Assault is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. I can't ignore this anymore. We talked not long ago about the materials Black Division has been extracting from Tarkov. You already made your decision back then, but I'm asking for your help once again. According to my information, these operatives have driven every other force out of the TerraGroup laboratory, and now they return there on a regular basis. Maybe they're searching for something, or maybe they're stripping the place clean. Either way, it's nothing but a risk for us. What if the only reason the city hasn't been reduced to rubble yet is some plain gray folder with a chemical formula inside? I'd rather not test that theory firsthand. We have to clear the facility, or at least slow Black Division's operation down. I'll provide whatever resources I can, but I need you directly involved.

quests.title: Digital Puzzle
quests.content:
Digital Puzzle is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I think I've figured out what they're looking for. The laptops Black Division has been collecting from TerraGroup facilities each contain fragments of some kind of access code... It could be a universal key, or maybe a command used to activate a special protocol. The pattern only becomes visible after an initial decryption pass, and even then, only on some of the laptops. I simply don't have time to process enough data on my own, so I can't do this without your help. If you want to find out what Black Division is really after, look for the laptops bearing their seal. I need you to perform the initial decryption, basically applying the first few ""keys,"" before I take over the main part of the hack. I'll give you the instructions. Once you're done, transfer the data to any suitable storage device and bring it to me. I'll pay you for your work, whether or not we end up finding all the answers.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Hand over the data from the Black Division rugged laptop

== Rewards ==
+35,000 EXP
150,000 Roubles
157,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
172,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× T H I C C Weapon case
1× T H I C C item case
1× Briefcase with documents
Thanks for bringing these drives. I've already analyzed the data from several of the laptops we've recovered and discussed it with Elektronik. I was wrong about it being a protocol. I think it's simply a distributed database. But unlike commercial systems from the IT world, this database is built very differently. TerraGroup clearly sacrificed performance and accessibility in favor of layered security and an extensive access control system. It almost seems like they'd rather lose the data forever than let it fall into someone else's hands. So I'm afraid I won't have anything interesting to tell you until I've had time to dig much deeper into these laptops.

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks craft for Data from Black Division laptop at Intelligence Center level 1.

== Guide ==

Howdy. A curious letter came by a while ago... I'll tell you right up front: we're in deep shit. The letter said where and what to look for, my guys went there and got their asses kicked by some assholes. They stole the drive with the data mentioned in the letter! Looks like they're working for someone. Seems like I'm not the only one who got the letter. But let's not give up at the first sign of trouble. The letter did say something... And damn it, I need to get to the truth! I've got to get the drive back, search in the area of their base and show the Scav bums that stealing is very nice.
