quests.title: Down the Rabbit Hole - Part 3
quests.content:
Down the Rabbit Hole - Part 3 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
A little birdie told me you were looking for something. Hey, don't cry, Tarkov's like a big village, people in one end know that someone farted in the other. Anyway, you've got a problem and I've got a solution. But I'm not just gonna hand it to you on a silver platter. Do a lil gig for me: go to the city's big car dealership and set up some cams. I think there's something going on there, so having eyes on it wouldn't hurt. Also, get the docs from there I've heard Kaban's been after them. They found it, but never shipped further. And Kaban is out of town now, know what I mean? But once you get them don't bring them to me straight up. You stash it at Customs, my buddies will take it. And be like a mouse, don't get anyone alarmed or killed. You down with that?

quests.title: Doxed
quests.content:
Doxed was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey. As I understand it, you and Therapist want to intercept the remaining shipments in the city that a TerraGroup employee was selling on the side. The question is, how exactly was he delivering his goods to his customers? This guy had a workstation at the TerraGroup headquarters. There could be records there that we're still missing: addresses of precursor drop-off points and other information used by the sender. Given the risks he was taking, there could've been quite a few addresses and fake identities. Something like that definitely wouldn't be stored on a work PC, but on a separate storage device somewhere nearby. So look around carefully. You should search the open-plan office with the kitchen on the second floor.

== Objectives ==
Locate the SSD with delivery routes on Ground Zero
Hand over the found intel

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Desert Tech MDR 7.62x51 assault rifle
4× 7.62x51mm M61 ammo pack (20 pcs)
1× Vortex Razor HD Gen.2 1-6x24 30mm riflescope
Great, I think this is it. Just give me a minute to check... How were they even letting these shipments through? Get this: our "dealer" was sending precursors through regular mail! He disguised the chemical containers among other fragile and awkward cargo, and apparently never got caught. He traveled all over the city, sending packages under different names and from different parts of Tarkov. The good news is that he used the downtown Rus Post office quite frequently. So you still have a chance of finding the precursor boxes you need there.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to locate and obtain the SSD with shipment data in the main building of the TerraGroup building complex on Ground Zero. It can be found in office no. 3 on the second floor, on top of a red PC.

You know what's gonna happen when people find out about this. One will ask to retrieve it, another will try to intercept it. Now imagine it falls into the wrong hands. Duck Hunt was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come on in, take a seat, kid. You're just the right person for what I've got in mind. Not long ago, Partisan and I got into a disagreement. I said a strong fighter always pays attention to what's going on around him and notices anything out of the ordinary. Partisan argued that it doesn't work that way. We don't usually argue for this long, but this time we couldn't see eye to eye. So we decided to put it to the test. That's where you come in. Partisan hid toy ducks all over Tarkov. If you manage to find all of them in about a week, I win. If you don't, then he does. I'll say this up front: you'll need to look for the ducks not just in the woods, but inside all kinds of buildings too. And one more thing, the very first duck is in the Customs offices. But if anyone asks, you figured that out yourself. And also… I've heard rumors that someone found an undelivered shipment of duck pâté. They say all the cans are intact and the expiration dates are fine. It's been such a long time since I've had any decent pâté… Bring me a few cans, would you?

Greetings, soldier. Got an assignment for you, and I'd advise against putting it off.You know the water treatment plant out on the coast? No, not the one by the resort. The one out on the cape. If things ever go completely to hell in this city, you could probably try using it to get out of here. But that's not why I'm interested in it. According to my sources, there's enough valuable gear around that bird to make your head spin. Take this marker, tag the helicopter, then clear the area so my boys can move in safely.

Well, in any case, my scouts said they've spotted Scavs at the helipad - looks like they found out about the supplies. The cargo from that heli is very valuable, but there's no point in sending in my people for a gunfight. I see you're interested. You heard anything about the Arena yet? You gotta put up flyers around Tarkov. Like "come and check it out", shit like that, you know. Hey, serious people always start small! I've got a couple of posters ready for ya, but if you lose them, it's your own bloody problem, got it? Bring them to the Scav stronghold at the customs terminal. Off you go then.

Problem is, order are piling up, and sending them out without protection is asking for trouble. That's where you come in. Keep my boys safe along their route. Make those former PMC mercs think twice before taking a shot at them. I'll show you the route on the map. Got it? Good. Here's the catch: you've got to do it all in only a couple runs maximum. quests.title: Every Hunter Knows This

Every Hunter Knows This is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come on in. So, how's your tripwire business going? No luck? Figures. This isn't like mindlessly shooting everyone. You've got to have a sense of intuition and know where the prey's gonna be. If you were a hunter, you'd understand. Try watching where the bandits hang out. Think about where your wire would catch the bastard off guard and how to conceal it. Take your time, use your best judgment. Only then will your hunt be fruitful. Come back when you find at least a couple good spots. I wouldn't be so quick to set these tripwires around, otherwise you'll kill some of your teammates by accident.

Locate a good tripwire installation spot on Factory
Locate a good tripwire installation spot on Customs

You're not the only one who knows how to set a tripwire, which means every bush, every room, and every rock can kill you. Remember that well.

quests.title: Examinatio - Part 1
quests.content:
Examinatio - Part 1 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov: Arena.

== Dialogue ==
Howdy there, champion. I see you're doing well, since even the audience recognizes you from the rest of the fighters. You can't slack off at times like this, so I thought I'd do something special for you. Remember me saying that as long as the audience is happy, you and I will be happy as well, right? Together we're going to try out a new format of audience interaction. While you're the center of attention, the crowd wants to test your true strength. From now on, the audience will determine the challenges for their gladiator. Obviously, they'll be more interested in seeing you croak in the process. But if you don't break and go through whatever the spectators suggest, you'll get a special reward. It's your choice, you can always bail if you want. But trust me, there's no worse way to go than to blow your moment of glory and be left in the shadows as the crowd screams your name.

Win 2 matches in CheckPoint mode

Take what you've already earned in the recent contests and use it the way you know best. Apparently, our spectators are tired of watching the constant change of fighters whose success depends purely on luck. To win, you'll need to do more than just take out a couple of opponents or win a match. You'll be expected to demonstrate skills that guarantee the repeatable results you want.

External Interest was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

Hello. There are some interesting rumors going around... Yes, about you and some programmer from the reserve base. And what a coincidence: we're interested in him too. Not him, to be specific, but what he left behind in Tarkov. We need everything you've got. Everything. So would you be so kind as to pass it all along?

quests.title: Failed Setup
quests.content:
Failed Setup was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Well, hello there. Come in, there's something I need you to do. An unpleasant situation has arisen. As you know, my little hobby is in demand among the remaining residents of this great city. But here's the trouble, one of the rifles I assembled fell into the wrong hands and ended up in the hands of those who draw their circles around town. Scavs found it in one of the circles and accused me of supplying the creeps with weapons. I don't need that kind of complaint. Do the job, cut through the ranks of these artists. And I'll make sure to find a decent reward. And another thing, try not to harm Scavs. Enough trouble with them as it is.

Eliminate 30 of the group responsible for the marked circles

I told you not to touch Scavs!

This quest was released together with the video "Unknown"

quests.title: Fair Price - Part 1
quests.content:
Fair Price - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello mate. People say you're looking for something, and that you and Mechanic desperately need this fuckin' piece of junk. What, thought I wouldn't find out? I've ran through your little project, so you two aren't gonna bullshit me with the price. If you really want it, you'll have to pay the proper price. Twenty... No, fifty grand! And no bargaining. Your little handguard is already locked up in a safe place, you won't find it on your own. So, ready to pay for your project or not?

== Objectives ==
Hand over 50,000 EUR

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Fucking splendid! Mechanic's a fucking gun nut, I get it, but I sure didn't expect YOU to pay that kind of money for some bloody handguard. Whatever, I don't care. If you two want it, you can go play in your little workshop. This oversized rubbish won't even fit any AK! I'll tell my boys, they'll drop your part off at the transfer point.

== Guide ==

Euros can be purchased from Skier with Roubles.

quests.title: Fair Price - Part 2
quests.content:
Fair Price - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Don't regret your investment yet? Let me give you an advice, nerds like Mechanic are the ones who pull off the most rotten schemes! He'll get his profit, and you won't even realise you've been screwed. All right, quit bitching! I'm telling you the honest bloody truth. If you're still confident about this "project", you can collect the handguard at the abandoned sawmill near the village in the nature reserve, there's a UN post not far from there. The lads have already dropped it off. But I wouldn't stay there too long, who knows what other scum's there. If someone steals it before you, don't come to me with any claims!

== Objectives ==
Complete the task Hobby Club
(Optional) Locate the stash spot
(Optional) Locate and obtain the AK-50 handguard at the old sawmill on Woods

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
What, you got it already? Well done mate, you're a good little mule. When you get tired of playing gunsmith with Mechanic, you know who to go to. Oh, and, uh, if you can get the part back, that'd be sweet. Maybe we'll make some business with it, because I think I found really valuable info on this overseas AK...

The handguard can be found inside a barn at the old sawmill in the east of Woods. There are multiple spawns throughout the barn. The handguard is required for the quest Hobby Club.

quests.title: Fairy Tale Showdown
quests.content:
Fairy Tale Showdown was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
== BEAR ==
Heard the news, warrior? Those USECs are getting bold. Walking around like they own the place, shoot anyone on sight. Whats even worse is that they got more active right with New Year approaching. What do they want to tell with this? That every soldier we lose is a gift to their UN occupants? Im asking you to fulfill your duty and avenge your fallen brothers. Oh, and put on your Ded Moroz hat. Ill instruct some of your colleagues too. So that when people start asking whos tearing down the USEC ranks, everyone would answer "Hell knows, might as well be Ded Moroz!"

== USEC ==
Merry Christmas, mercenary. As you have probably noticed, the BEARs are becoming bothersome for us. There isn't a single day when brave USEC soldiers sent on a mission return as caskets. Do you think they were killed by Scavs, or maybe Bosses? You are mistaken. BEARs are planning something. There are especially many reports of assassins dressed as a certain "Ded Moroz". Who is that, you ask? That's what they call their local Santa Claus, more precisely, his evil counterpart. We suspect that these attacks are not coincidental, but a whole ideological movement aimed to remove the UN from here! We most show that we do not take BEAR seriously and are ready to put forward countermeasures. Put on your Santa Claus hat and lay down some enemies.

== Objectives ==

Eliminate 10 BEAR PMC operatives while wearing a Ded Moroz hat

Good afternoon, young man. Last fall, Tarkov experienced a severe influenza outbreak. I caught it twice myself. This year, however, I managed to arrange for an influenza vaccine to be delivered through the UN peacekeepers' supply channels... Though that isn't why I asked you here. I'm planning to organize a vaccination campaign this fall, but before that, I need to vaccinate myself and everyone working at my clinic. Unfortunately, sterile syringes are in short supply. Could you obtain five for me? Please make sure their packaging remains intact!

Before the conflict, I frequently ordered stuff online. Used to come regularly, I even put together a drone from parts once. The last order was 4 sets of computer components. Only 2 have made it to the city, and those are stuck somewhere in the Customs area. Now, as you can perceive, they would really come in handy. Try to search the seized goods warehouse, it's a big red hangar building. There was a big confusion there, so the cargo could still be there.

quests.title: Farming - Part 2
quests.content:
Farming - Part 2 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I think you’ve already guessed that I’m building a bitcoin farm. Thanks to the satellite "Ebambium", it’s not all surfing and memes. The more time you spend online, the more you realize the new age is upon us. Change in data distribution speed changed everything. The world has entered a new industrial revolution, though it has moved on from the real world into the virtual one. We create whole worlds, with their own economies and laws. And, looking at what is happening around us I'm almost sure the digital world is more honest and better than real. Much more depends on yourself here. It doesn’t matter just as much where you were born and who your parents were. Okay, I’m almost done with the power supply. Just need a few more details. Bring over some cables, tee-connectors, and line peripherals.

quests.title: Fearless Beast
quests.content:
Fearless Beast was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Despite our efforts, the scum in Tarkov is not getting any weaker. Skier changed his tactics, now the stations are mobile, and we won't be able to keep up with all of them. The locals are starting to gather around him. We can't put innocent civilians in danger. There's still plenty of Scavs who don't need to be proven guilty. We need to show people what pillaging and banditry leads to. They've already lost hope, but fear is definitely still there. Partisan just came in with a couple of his experimental grenades. He took the retarder out of them, says they used to use them in Afghanistan very often. No bang delay at all. And if you make turn it into a booby trap... No one would have time to react to that. Take them and show the people what awaits those who abandon human morality. We need to make sure no one ever thinks about working with Skier. Better yet, make even the PMCs see the risks and quiet down.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 3 targets while using the F-1 hand grenade (Reduced delay)

== Rewards ==
+24,200 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.05
200,000 Roubles
210,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
230,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× RShG-2 72.5mm rocket launcher
So, what do you think of these grenades? I wouldn't risk using one, the delay's too short for my reflexes. Thugs are already talking about your endeavors, which means our message has been heard loud and clear. I hope it will cool their tempers and help those who question human values. They won't thank us, but they can live to see better days. And for you, I have a special gift. Prapor passed it on. Use it wisely and stay safe.

== Failure Penalty ==
Jaeger Rep -0.05
What brings you here? Have you seen Partisan by any chance? He was supposed to show up half an hour ago... He would never be late, it's not good. There are still too many bandits out there! You better leave now, I'm not in the mood. I've got a friend to help, and you seem to be nothing but trouble.

quests.title: Fertilizers
quests.content:
Fertilizers is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there. See what’s going on? Bitcoin plunges into the abyss. I don’t know if that’s a conspiracy or a logical pattern. This whole business was shady from the start, but well, there’s nothing left to do but to salvage what we can. To cut the long story short, my farm is acting up lately - bugs, freezes, and everything. Fix me up with some wires and capacitors. I have a little idea on how to improve the system stability. And make sure it's all new and untouched!

Hand over the items

+28,000 EXP

Now we’re talking! I’ll grab a soldering iron and get to work. Perhaps the market's gonna stabilize already by that time.

Wires and capacitors can most commonly be found in PC blocks, in tech stores on Interchange such as TechLight, Texho, or Rasmussen, they can also be crafted in the hideout.

quests.title: Field Testing
quests.content:
Field Testing was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov: Arena.

My guys are prepping a new Arena location right now. I'm gonna call it Gate. The, um... architect, Trombon, decided to check the routes, sightlines, and the overall layout ahead of time. So don't mind the place looking a bit empty for now, they just haven't had time to clutter it up yet. Your job's simple: run around, shoot a bit, and win one match. Just a routine test, pretty much.

quests.title: Fight Back
quests.content:
Fight Back was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
One thing I don't understand about all this bandit scum in Tarkov is how they still manage to recruit new thugs over and over again. Seems the locals have had a hard time since the start of the conflict, and now there's nowhere else to go for those who were left behind. Banditry, however, is a one way road that won't lead to any good. That doesn't change our goal. The filth has to be cleaned out, and we're the ones who'll do it. I hear the Scavs have made the most noise on the coast, at the customs district and in Priozersk. Get out there and drive the bandits back. We can't let them expand their territory.

== Requirements ==
Must be level 10 to start this quest.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 7 Scavs on Shoreline

Eliminate 7 Scavs on Woods

Good work. I went there myself as well and showed them where the marauder's path leads. I don't like all this sudden new activity. I got a feeling this is just the beginning of some big operation or some kind of gang war. Stay in touch, kid.

quests.title: Final Stretch
quests.content:
Final Stretch is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good thing you didn't disappear. Even with your help, they somehow spotted my people. Every last one of them got killed on the way back while crossing part of their route through the center of downtown. But before that happened, my team reported finding a rugged laptop protected by some serious security. During the attack, my boys were supposed to stash it in one of the hidden caches there in the center. I've got no reason to doubt them, so the hardware should still be there. Check those stashes, find the laptop, and bring it to me. Whatever's stored on a sealed TerraGroup site like that will be worth a great deal, even if not directly.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the laptop from Fence's stash on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+35,000 EXP
300,000 Roubles
315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× RB-BK marked key
1× Briefcase with documents
Unlocks achievement Profit Over Principles
You didn't see my people's bodies near the stashes? Then they managed to draw those operators away before they went down. That's good. I'm not some cheap hustler. When I make a deal, I honor it. Your reward's already waiting. Go collect it.

== Failure Dialogue ==
Good thing I don't put my trust in outsiders. You had a rare chance to work with me, and you blew it over some naive bullshit Mechanic fed you. Should've seen that coming. Get lost, merc.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find and hand over a Laptop from an unknown facility to Fence. The laptop is located at a small ventilation chimney in an alley behind the diner on Nikitskaya Street on Streets of Tarkov.

quests.title: Find the Source
quests.content:
Find the Source was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
It's good you're back. The TerraGroup information was useful, but still not enough to create a working antidote. However, I did find an important lead. The project to create this virus was highly classified, but Mechanic matched the virus codes with TerraGroup's internal division indexes. And we found an overlap. One of the key employees, not officially assigned to any open project, was a certain Vladimir O. I'm sure that a specialist of such importance kept everything important on his person, so as not to risk the spread of information. You need to thoroughly check the territory of the Laboratory, especially in the area of the block where the virus was developed. If my hunch is correct, you may find Vladimir's records there.

You're looking suspiciously cheerful, man! Doesn't exactly look like you've been sweating and pushing yourself to the limit. Greetings. Here's the thing: you can see for yourself how far out in the wilderness I live. Things happen out here. I've got some smart guys working for me, real brainiacs in glasses. Sitting around juggling numbers all day... They've never let me down, so I trust them. quests.title: First in Line

First in Line is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, young man. I need you to complete a quick assignment for me. Nothing too extraordinary yet, we have only just begun working together. There are still civilians in the city, and they're trying to get out. The best place to organize an evacuation would be the Emercom checkpoint: it should have both the vehicles and the necessary equipment. At least, I hope so. I haven't been to that part of the city very often, so I don't know exactly where the checkpoint is located. Find it for me. Once you do, I'll send my people to inspect the area. And one more thing. I'm in need of supplies for my medical duty. I can't exactly import them to Tarkov anymore, so we have to look for what we can find. It doesn't matter what you bring: consumables, medicine, stimulants. Anything useful will do. I'll be waiting.

Listen, I've got an unusual task to do, Mechanic asked me to make one special thing for his home, and this \"thing\" is such a complicated one that it requires some advanced electronics. Hey, come here for a sec. As you can see, your fellow PMCs are having a hard time these days, weak ones don't make it. I tell you more: they seem like serious fighters, but if they're in some serious shit, they die like flies. Panic kills them, or tremor, fuck knows, but the result is the same. quests.title: Fog of War
quests.content:
Fog of War was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey. Been out by the treatment plant lately? There's some real shit going down there. Looks like the Rogues got softened up by the PMCs first, then the smugglers launched an assault. All that commotion screwed up one of my boys' jobs. They were supposed to pick something up from a contact on Reserve, but with the assault going on, they had to pull back to a better position. They've set up camp high in the mountains now. At least we won't be running into the Rogues by accident at the new spot. Problem is, our contact who was supposed to hand over the package got cold feet and went to ground, claiming the risks were too high. Can you help me sort this out? First thing is to scout the area and see what the Rogues' positions look like now. They're expecting that package from me at the Lighthouse, so you know what that means... Better not drag your feet.

== Objectives ==
Scout the Rogues' position near the BRDM car in the northern part of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
Scout the Rogues' checkpoint with the guard tower in the southwestern part of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
Scout the water treatment plant territory from the roof of any of the plant buildings on Lighthouse

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
300,000 Roubles
315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× SVDS 7.62x54R sniper rifle
3× SVD 7.62x54R 10-round magazine
2× 7.62x54mm R PS gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)
What, for real? Didn't think anyone could drive the Rogues out of the treatment plant. They used to be able to pick off anyone from those fixed positions. You couldn't get anywhere near the place. Though if the smugglers already had the approaches mapped out, plus mortars... And after that little war and their operations on that ship, looks like the Rogues were pretty damn worn out. They're probably up in the cliffs now, holed up in the chalets. Which means we can finally work in the rest of the coastal area without worrying about them. That's good news, rookie.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to scout the northern BRDM position, the southwestern checkpoint and the roof of building #1, #2 or #3 at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse.

The message found its recipient. Rats on a sinking ship began to scurry. The customers gave orders to destroy all evidence of ongoing developments. Your mission is to infiltrate TerraGroup's lab, find the data carrier containing the data we need, and deliver it to me. What are you waiting for, a candy for good luck? Hurry up!

quests.title: Forbidden Knowledge
quests.content:
Forbidden Knowledge is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I liked the documents you brought me. But there'll be a lot more intel on digital storage devices, and those are definitely getting evacuated along with those little folders. They might even be tagged or sealed somehow. For now, I'm not willing to risk my own people, so this job's yours. I don't think you've got much chance of finding their camps, so the plan stays the same: intercept them in the areas you already know, and hope for a good haul. Bring me every hard drive you find with data on it. Any questions?

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

That'll do for now. Makes you wonder if there's anything left at those TerraGroup sites after these operators finish raiding them. With this much data, it's obvious they already had detailed information on every TerraGroup facility: locations, access codes, and everything else. Things even I don't have. And those rumors about unknown facilities out in the region? They're not bullshit after all.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to obtain and hand over two 14-4 KORD SSDs to Fence. The SSDs can be found on Black Division.

quests.title: Forced Alliance
quests.content:
Forced Alliance was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Been waiting for you. I don't know about your own search, but I think I found a way to get the keycards. Apparently, Sanitar had access to the basement beneath the health resort. That alone proves my hunch about Knossos' ties to TerraGroup. But right now, we need to find the keycards. I can't help you with that, but Therapist definitely has Sanitar's contacts. I've already reached out to her, and she's willing to help. I believe that the trail we've found is more important than our conflicting viewpoints. However, if you can find another way to get the keycards without having to deal with Sanitar, I'll wish you luck.

== Objectives ==
Find a way to get behind the Health Resort bunker door on Shoreline
(Optional) Assist Therapist with her investigation

== Rewards ==
Mechanic Rep +0.01
37,000 Roubles
38,850 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
42,550 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× FireKlean gun lube
Excellent, now we have access to this facility. There's no time to lose. The rumor of the health resort cellars and the keycards has already spread throughout the city, and you may very well have competition on your tail. Gotta hurry up.

== Guide ==

The goal of this quest is to get a Labrys access keycard into your stash. You can acquire one by completing Hot Zone or The Tarkov Butcher.

quests.title: Forced Measure
quests.content:
Forced Measure was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I know that everyone has put aside their former concerns for the sake of survival. But whatever is happening at the Laboratory is beyond anything that can be tolerated! There are so many infected there that the danger of new dangerous drugs spreading is extremely high. The sick are evidently losing their minds, and don't realize the risks when they smash the chemical flasks or break the rare equipment... We must take back control of the Laboratory. We're the closest we've ever been to saving the city, and we can't allow another disaster. Tarkov won't survive it. Sadly, there's no saving those already infected—eliminate as many as possible using any means at your disposal. The safety of Tarkov is at stake.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 100 infected on The Lab

== Rewards ==
+60,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.01
Therapist Rep +0.03
500,000 Roubles
525,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
575,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× TerraGroup Labs weapon testing area key
1× TerraGroup Labs keycard (Red)
So many lives have been lost. But, you do realize that it had to be done, don't you? We can't let this virus spread all over Tarkov again.

== Guide ==

Infected PMC

How are you doing, mercenary? If you're still able to operate, you can help me with an important matter. We need assistance in the city. According to my information, right now there is a large number of infected in the central area. The West already knows what's happening and doesn't want to stay aside. However, the convoy that was sent to contain the situation has been destroyed. I have no more men left to spare, but the task must be accomplished. And we need to do it in a way that makes our partners' involvement obvious.

Hello. I used to walk many a footpath myself, but time has bested me. The looters have cleaned out all the popular places, and now they're heading into the forests. I saw some of those Scavs the other day. They were dragging something through the swamp near Azure Coast. Even before the war, people used to call this place a death trap. Only I and my mushroom picker friend knew how to cross it in one piece and survive. Would you scare those bandits away? Make them know the forests are not for them to ravage. Make sure you cross that path I mentioned too, clean it for good.

Forgotten Oaths was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Wait! Did you also not know that she developed this "cure" with Sanitar? I bet they made a simplified version so they could just kill all the sick people without blinking an eye, yeah? I'm not going to let this happen. I know her nature... She definitely developed a less lethal version of the drug for her own use, or for sale. But if she worked on it with this punk, that means he's the one who's keeping it! Punish the bastard and get the real version of the drug. If not the drug itself, at least find the recipe... We'll figure it out from there, probably!

== Dialogue ==
With your help, I figured out the decryption way quicker — both in the phone and the diary. Just one last issue. I managed to extract a strange phrase: "Diary. wvyglv. oiphxifq: sbb onfz qulve. rgx: ssemddvyl". This is clearly a Vigenère cipher. It needs a key, but my friend didn't leave it anywhere in his notes. We'll have to figure it out ourselves. Here are some copies of the diary. I'll keep the original for now. If you lose it, you can have another one from me. Just don't overdo my generosity.

== Requirements ==

SVDS 7.62x54R sniper rifle

Oh wow, you figured it out. Great. Anyway, I'll check what's on this disk and contact you.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to obtain the disk with unknown data through a unique sacrifice at the Cultist Circle in the Hideout.

The items that need to be sacrificed are: Programmer's diary (Copy), Expeditionary fuel tank (any durability) and Zibbo lighter.

Only these 3 items must be put into the Cultist Circle for the sacrifice to work.

== Trivia ==
The first word in the phrase "Diary. wvyglv. oiphxifq: sbb onfz qulve. rgx: ssemddvyl" mentioned in the quest's description is hinting at where to get the key. The first letters of words in the table of contents in Programmer's diary (and likewise its copy) form together the word "UNHEARD". Using this as a key for the Vigenère cipher returns "circle. location: you know where. add: flammable", hinting at the sacrifice to obtain the Disk with unknown data.

quests.content:
Friend From the West is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So, ready for some serious work? Long story short, the tourists have started getting on my nerves. They're sticking their noses everywhere, taking ou my lads, messing with my supply routes. I don't like it one bit. I'll pay you nicely if you give them a proper shake-up.

quests.title: Friend From the West - Part 2
quests.content:
Friend From the West - Part 2 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Well, since we’re now best pals forever and shit, I think it makes sense to let you in on a real business that real folks are running. There are orders from a certain dude. Peacekeeper is the name - I think you know who he is. Man himself is from the UN force, which is here to prevent violence, supposedly. Can’t help laughing, ha-ha! I roll with him from the very beginning of all this fuck-up here. Working here, peddling stuff, stirring shit up, and occasionally dropping a body or two. So to the point, he’s snowed under with work and needs a  tough reliable guy, just like you. Obviously, I have my cut. And, as it is easy for you to guess, the opportunity to work directly with an imported kingpin is not free. Yeah, yeah, off with that sour snot. Roll a several thousand bucks my way, and you’ll be doing business with all the benefits of Western civilization.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 5,000 USD to Skier

+10,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.05
Unlocks purchase of TDI KRISS Vector Gen.2 .45 ACP submachine gun at Skier LL3
Now we're talking! Rouble's dropping, and green ones grow like buns of a roadside hooker, ha-ha. Wait for a call from Peacekeeper, you careerist.

Dollars can be purchased from Peacekeeper with Roubles.

Later on, I'll open it up to the public: less people will want to get their hands on my goods in popular places. But right now, I need to move one shipment across the city, pronto. You'll lead the way to secure the path for my men in dangerous areas. I've already got some of the routes under my people's control, so they can transfer your things to your Hideout.

Hey there, brother! Mechanic stopped by recently. Grumpy and quiet as always, but I've gotten used to it. He's asking for fuel, and wouldn't you know it, I'm completely out! == Dialogue ==
Hello again. I have a temporary shortage of lasting foods in the form of canned meat. Can you help? I need a reserve of 15 cans of beef. And I know a couple of places where we could get them. From our Scav friends, of course. They used to have a storeroom at the gas station near the Factory - maybe there's still something left. Another food storage was somewhere in the dormitories, with more than canned goods there. But now I’m only interested in them, so you’re free to take the rest for yourself. Deal? I know that these two gangs are allied, but to prevent theft from the warehouses by their own people, their leaders have exchanged keys from each other's warehouses. quests.title: Goals and Means
quests.content:
Goals and Means is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. I used to believe that staying inside clear boundaries and doing the job by the book was the highest form of professionalism. When you can pick the right tool for any task and never step out of the top league. Working only with the best equipment. But Tarkov showed me that being just a professional isn’t enough. Here I learned that true mastery is forged under harsh conditions with limited resources, when the outcome can’t be predicted. You start relying more on your own experience and intuition, and if you’re good enough — you rise to the very top. Since the Contract Wars, I’ve held on to a small reserve of special weapons. But like in my line of work, they’re only tools. An ordinary professional doesn’t have the skills to unlock the full potential of such a piece. It takes a true master. And I’m starting to think you might be able to handle such a temperamental weapon. If you can prove that you can solve problems no matter what tools you’re given — I’ll open access to this special section of my arsenal.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 20 PMC operatives from over 50 meters away while using any 9x39 caliber weapon

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Weapon Maintenance skill levels
+4 Troubleshooting skill levels
Mechanic Rep +1.5
400,000 Roubles
420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× AS VAL MOD.4 9x39 special assault rifle
Unlocks barter for AS VAL MOD.4 9x39 special assault rifle at Mechanic LL4
Managed it? Honestly, I wasn’t sure we’d ever come back to this conversation. But I’ll keep my word. Back during the Contract Wars, everyone feared this weapon. BEAR operatives who carried it were unbeatable. And for USECs, getting their hands on one was considered an incredible stroke of luck. Not because the weapon makes you immortal. But because its owner is a true master — someone nobody wants to face.

quests.title: Golden Swag
quests.content:
Golden Swag is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Alright, you little criminal! I've got this one bloke who didn't like my terms and tried to get smart with me. I put him in his place once, but now he's gotten far too cocky. Time to teach him a lesson. Simple job. There's a group of Scavs holed up at the Factory. One of their top dogs is some bloke called Uruguay. What a bloody stupid nickname! Best put an end to his little adventure. But that's only half the job. He's got a supposedly lucky gold-plated Zibbo, he keeps fiddling with it all the time. Even came by my place, couldn't stop clicking the fucking thing. Bring it to me. Alright, rere's the plan... Stop by the dorms, get inside this fucker's room 303, grab the golden Zibbo and stash a regular Zibbo in its place. Got it? Write it down if you need to. Now get out there and get to work!

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the Golden Zibbo lighter from Dorm room 303 on Customs
Stash a regular Zibbo at Dorm room 303 on Customs
Hand over the Golden Zibbo lighter

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP

450 Euros
473 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
518 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Pack of screws
Proper good job. Let's see what comes of it. You go get some rest, yeah?

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to find a golden Zibbo lighter on Customs. It can be found on a desk in room 303 on the third floor of the three-story dorms building. A Dorm room 303 key is required to enter it. Afterwards a Zibbo lighter has to be stashed in the same location.

quests.title: Granny's Tales
quests.map: Ground Zero, Customs, Woods, Shoreline, Interchange, Reserve, Lighthouse, Streets of Tarkov
quests.content:
Granny's Tales was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Seems like it's more complicated than I thought. I guess it's nothing terrible, but it still gives me the chills. You know, once you've served, you're not afraid of anything but the living. Though I remember when I was a kid, my granny used to scare me. She'd start telling me stories about all sorts of evil things! She was born before the revolution, she'd seen all sorts of things, maybe that's why. I was about five years old, playing with my toys. She came in, locked all the doors, covered the windows, and was like, "There's that striga again". I asked her what the word striga meant. And so she began to tell my five year old ass about some monster at night, how scary it is and how it drinks blood. Fucking why?  These "spirits of winter" guarding the bonfires seem to have grown in body, but not in mind. I have an idea how to change things up. Do this, and we'll see how they react. Try shooting tracers at the bonfire at point-blank range, like 10-20 meters, to set it on fire. I think there's more of those spirits out there than meets the eye, and it probably won't make them happy. Just take the tracers and remember the basics of CQC! And when they come out, let's chase the winter away, so to speak, hehe!

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 50 followers of Morana

quests.title: Green Corridor

Green Corridor is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Those bloody westerners! All they want to do is shoot everybody! It's already been negotiated, we even paid them to let us through! But no, they want to spill more of our blood! All right, soldier, come here and listen. A convoy was passing through town. With important cargo. Very important. Even I don't know what's in it. Somebody took money for the convoy's safe passage, and then the convoy went dark. Think about it, such bastards! Find out what's going on and if anything could be saved. And find out where the shooting came from...

Guardian of Nature was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good to see you, kid. You've probably heard of Ref, maybe even worked for him... Well, he's decided to stick his Arena into the nature reserve. At first he wanted to negotiate, even tried to buy me off. I made my position perfectly clear through his messengers. But there was a fight near the EMERCOM camp yesterday, and I don't think that's a coincidence. If Ref doesn't understand words, then you and I may have to settle this another way. First, though, we need information. Find out who's occupying that camp now and try to learn what they're planning. It wouldn't hurt to take a look around other parts of the city as well. The more we see, the clearer the picture becomes.

And judging by these locations, he's managed not only to lease the smugglers' camp, but also strike a deal with Skier over the dormitories. I trusted him because of old acquaintances, but the guy went straight to the lab as soon as he received the weapon, and so far there is no word from him. Got too greedy, that's my guess... Well anyway, I can deal with this matter later, but I also have something else on my mind. I'm collecting feedback on my services, looking for a fresh perspective, you know? I've decided not only to do individual orders, but to sell guns in sets, fully loaded out of the box. Test it out properly, ask your colleagues maybe. Every little detail and view point is important! And be sure to check the weapons in action, I'm sure you know how....

quests.content:
Gunsmith Master - Part 12 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. Do you ever find yourself crossing paths with a classmate decades after high school and hardly recognizing them? Although, I'd likely shock some of the folks from my class myself. Recently, a certain guy from my school days reached out to me. After school, he went into the army, wanting to join the special forces... It was clear even then that he had a peculiar, uh, aptitude for that job. Somehow he found me here and asked me for a favor. He wants to remember his early years in basic training. I'm not a big fan of that sort of hospitality, plus I've got heaps of work to do. But let me put it this way: he was, um, very insistent. I don't need any more trouble, so I agreed to his deal, hoping you'd help me sort it all out. People say this kind of equipment used to be somewhat standard issue at his job: ORSIS T-5000, Vityaz and a Glock 17. All with the special mods, of course. The rifle was equipped with an ATACR 7-35x56 34mm scope, Harris bipod, and a suppressor, I can't recall which exact one... Well, probably doesn't matter. Just get any suitable silencer, that'll work. For Vityaz I need the Micro T-1 red dot with a spacer, Zenit RK-6 front grip and RK-3 pistol grip, PT-3 Klassika buttstock... I also need a PEQ-15, Klesch-2P flashlight, and, as you probably guessed, a suppressor, the standard Vityaz one. Ergonomics no less than 49, recoil sum no more than 400, and at least a 30-round magazine. The Glock is simple. You need to replace the barrel with the Double Diamond with their thread protector, add a Pachmayr Grip Glove, Klesch-2P flashlight, and a 21-round extendo mag. I think that's everything.

Gunsmith Master - Part 9 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
What do you think, how much does human life cost? Not much, I guess. But what’s even more surprising for me, it’s the contemporary art market. The value of art pieces by renowned artists grows every year. They are definitely talented, but the more you look at it, the more it seems that anything can be art. It can be a Rothko painting, a displaced urinal, or a bunch of garbage. However, in my opinion, the most amazing pieces of art are weapons, starting from the melee - which is already universally recognized as such and can be found in many museums - to an old AK or M4, which are beautiful as they are. But a weapon only transcends to true art when it becomes unique, one-of-a-kind, in the hands of someone who knows how to use it, who modifies it for his own needs, creating a masterpiece worthy of being displayed in the best of museums. Bring me one such masterpiece, an M4A1 with a KAC QDSS NT-4 (FDE) silencer, Alexander Arms MK10 rifle-length handguard, REAP-IR thermal scope, and a 60-round magazine. == Dialogue ==
Things are moving along nicely on our end, we've hit a couple more convoys. So yeah, we've properly messed with Ref by now, and funny enough, my workers suddenly forgot all their complaints! But I don't just want to annoy the bugger, I want to put him flat on his back. My machine gunners caught one of the convoys on boats over at Customs, but those pricks managed to slip away toward Interchange. My lads dropped most of them, but the boats were empty. That means it was the real deal. No one bolts like that over a pile of shitty old masks! They couldn't have gone far with a load that big, so the shipment's gotta be somewhere on Interchange. Help me track down those crates, yeah? They wouldn't risk going into Ultra, so they must've stashed it nearby. There are a couple of fenced warehouses with containers by the exit toward Customs... check those out. Might've even loaded everything into a vehicle to fix it up later and make a quick getaway. If you find anything, mark it with strobes. And it's about time we show Ref that his so-called "gladiators" aren't any better than our Tarkov lads! == Dialogue ==

As a result, the disease now progresses faster, the infected are more aggressive, and our previous methods of suppression are becoming less effective. If you decide to stay with me, you'll need to work directly in the infected areas. Well, looks like Therapist's vaccine actually works, but it ain't much use if there's not enough to go around. So we're keeping the quarantine in place, and personally, I'd tighten the screws even more. Better to stop someone unnecessarily than have to clean up all of Tarkov again. But we've got a more pressing job now. TerraGroup have been watching us this whole time and leaking data through their transmitters. Those are what we need to shut down. Find the equipment and smash the lot to bits. I'm sick of being a lab rat for those c***s. And one more thing: bring me some of Therapist's RDA-78 vaccine. For my lads, and, well, a few others too.

== Dialogue ==
Listen, this infection's spreading across Tarkov a bit too neatly. One place flares up, then another, like someone's deliberately testing the quarantine to see how much it'll take. Things don't usually happen like that on their own. On top of that, my lads picked up some dodgy signal coming from Lighthouse. What the hell it is, I've no bloody idea, but I don't like the coincidence. Get over there, find the source and have a proper rummage around the area. If you find anything useful, bring it straight to me. I want to know what the hell's going on.

quests.map: Ground Zero, Customs, Woods, Interchange, Shoreline, Streets of Tarkov, Lighthouse, Reserve
quests.content:
Halloween: Danger Zone was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Things are kicking off all over Tarkov. Someone coughs in the wrong place and they've got a gun shoved in their face. The bosses are tightening the screws, searching everyone at the checkpoints and shooting anyone who looks dodgy without asking questions. And, funny enough, that could work in my favor. Reputation's a funny thing. You've just got to know when to make your move. Since everyone's decided I'm somehow mixed up in this shit, I'll show 'em how to get things under control. I've supplied the men, the guns, the grub, and the ammo. My lads are keeping the quarantine in place and chasing off anyone who looks even remotely infected. You're joining in, too. Spot someone suspicious? Deal with 'em before they infect half of Tarkov. And I've got a little something useful for you in return. I'll give you access to the bodies of the infected. Word is, Therapist pays good money for tissue samples. I'm not about to start poking around in that filth myself, but if you're up for it, get cutting, collect what you can and take it to her. Might as well squeeze some cash out of the old c***.

== Objectives ==

quests.unlocks: Halloween: Blind the EnemyHalloween: Enemy of My Enemy - An Agreement
quests.content:
Halloween: Enemy of My Enemy was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Well, fuck me sideways. Now it all makes sense. TerraGroup deliberately unleashed this infection AGAIN. The whole of Tarkov's their bloody testing ground, same as before. And that vaccine they palmed off on me? Part of the scheme. That's what they used to kick off the next stage. Those c***s were watching the whole bloody thing: how fast the quarantine went up, how people fought back, whether anyone could cook up a cure. We're all just lab rats in their reports. So, for the record, I'm not the only one to blame here. They slipped me the shit, and I had no idea what was in it. Looks like it's time to stop butting heads with Therapist, at least for a bit, and give the people playing games with us a bloody nose instead. Take these documents to her. Let her have a read.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. I have already been informed that Skier wishes to get in touch again. To be frank, after everything that has happened, I wasn't particularly eager to speak with him. However, if he really has information about the origin of the outbreak and what caused it, I'm willing to examine it. Bring me everything you've managed to find. If the information proves significant enough to support his claims, I'll try to put our previous conflict behind us.

I've reviewed the materials. They confirm what was already becoming clear. Skier was certainly deceived, although he would do well to reflect on his own conduct. For now, however, working with him is the more practical option. I've managed to develop a working vaccine, but producing it requires far too many resources. For the time being, I can only manufacture limited batches alongside the prototype. It's too early to lift the quarantine. There won't be enough doses for everyone.

quests.content:
Halloween: First Results was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The vaccine prototype works, but it only slows the progression of the infection. I've prepared an antibody serum and want to test it directly on the infected. Administering the drug by hand is too dangerous, so we'll try dispersing it as a gas. For that, we need gas grenades, and there are very few left in Tarkov. If you find any, bring them to me. If not, valuable items will do. Anyone who still has grenades is bound to be interested in a trade. In return, you'll receive an experimental sample. Use it on the infected and check the results.

quests.content:
Halloween: Follow-Up Examination was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon. It seems Tarkov still won't give us a moment's peace... Yes, I am aware of the infection. Something similar happened not so long ago. Back then, we managed to stop the disease from spreading, with my help among other things. It seems I'll have to get involved again, fortunately, we already know where to start. First, we need to establish whether this is the same pathogen. Bring me a blood sample. Bear in mind, I don't need a specimen you've killed yourself. It must be someone who died from the virus on their own. That is the only way I can be sure the virus had enough time to develop inside them. We absolutely cannot afford to waste time on careless mistakes right now. Head to the infected areas and look for lab personnel in protective suits. I suspect they were the first to bear the brunt of the outbreak.

== Dialogue ==
I've compared the data we've obtained with the records from the previous outbreak. There are too many similarities to be coincidental. The strain has changed, as has the infected's response to our treatments, but the overall pattern is almost identical. Skier is still sticking to his story, claiming he was set up. I'm not prepared to take his word for it. However, he now claims to have important information. I'm willing to examine it and share some of my own findings on the infection with him. Perhaps by comparing our information, we'll finally understand what they're testing here and how to fight it. Deliver my findings to Skier.

Hello. I know Skier has asked you to deliver a batch of vaccine. That's precisely why I'm contacting you now. We still haven't identified the exact strain of the virus, and we don't know whether this preparation has anything to do with it at all. Its origin, storage conditions, and composition have barely been checked. Yet Skier has already decided that's good enough. If you hand the shipment over to him, the drug will immediately be distributed to the public. I'm asking you to do otherwise and bring the batch to me. Anyway, her little lapdogs are carrying these prototypes around. Know how to haggle? Good. Time to show us what you're made of! Get yourself over to the Flea Market and ask around. Go check the factory, then come back and tell me what you've seen. I'll sort you out when you're back. And if you bump into any of those nutters, put 'em down. == Dialogue ==
== Skier questline exclusive ==
Well, fuck me. It's all gone tits up. Since that vaccine went out, people have been dropping like flies even faster. The infected turn feral in no time, and they take one hell of a lot to put down. My suppliers have vanished off the bloody map and left me holding the bag! And who's getting the blame? Yours fucking truly. That old cow Therapist has already blabbed to half of Tarkov about who got the vaccine and handed it out. So now we've got to clean up this shit ourselves, especially since you're in it up to your neck as well. It's not like I was the one who brought the vaccine here! We put down the infected and keep the clean areas under quarantine. And make your mind up whose side you're on. If you go helping Therapist, don't come crawling back to me. I don't keep rats around. Here's what I need from you now: round up whatever medical supplies you can find. I'll hand them out to my lads in case things go sideways.

== Therapist questline exclusive ==
Fucking finally. I got my hands on the vaccine you decided to drag over to Therapist like the fucking turncoat you are. Had a feeling something stank about the whole thing, didn't ya? Since that vaccine went out, people have been dropping like flies even faster. The infected turn feral in no time, and they take one hell of a lot to put down. And my suppliers have done a runner, leaving me high and dry! Now I'm the one taking all the bloody blame. That old bitch Therapist has already blabbed to half of Tarkov about who got the vaccine and handed it out. So now we have to clean up this mess. Kill the infected and keep the clean areas under quarantine. I've already talked to the right people, and we've reached a deal. Nobody wants to die, and everyone needs protection from these fucking zombies. I'll cut you in, seeing as you're helping me. But decide right now whose side you're on. If you keep helping Therapist, don't bother coming back to me. I don't keep rats around. Here's what I need you to do: collect all kinds of medical supplies for me. I'll hand them out to my boys in case something happens.

== Notes ==
This quest gets automatically added to the quest list upon accepting Halloween: A New Vaccine.

Hand over the found in raid item: 2 Any medical balm

quests.content:
Harley Forever was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey brother, you like motorcycles? I've got a customer who's a real fan of them. He just got his A-levels and he's ready to race. You know the song? "On the back of a Harley he took me for a ride in the sky"? That's exactly what the kid wants to do. Only they don't import Harley to us no more, you know, sanctions and all that. I promised my client I'd get him a proper bike... How's he gonna get it running, I wonder. All the equipment's blacked out, I don't know. Buy a new one? I'm not a moron. They're free in this town, you just have to find them. One Scav guy said he saw a bike in the car dealership, but he's not sure if it's a Harley or not. Anyway, look for bikes in town. There were some at the Lighthouse too. Nah, you don't need to bring 'em in. I know you, you'll bring them back with bullet holes in them. Just mark them with the strobes, my men will handle it from there.

quests.title: Health Care Privacy - Part 1
quests.content:
Health Care Privacy - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good day, young man. Many people have tried to escape the current predicament, and some of them behaved like they were not human beings anymore, but for us, medics, nothing has changed. Our job is to save lives, no matter what the circumstances could be. When the shoreline tunnel collapsed, quite several survivors were injured. The ambulances were immediately dispatched to a distress call, but, well, I assume you know what has broken out there. Long story short, that's where they stayed. I know that there were three or four vans, and the chances are high that most of the equipment and medicine is still inside... If you happen to find them, just mark them with beacons and my people will take care of the rest.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark the first ambulance with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Locate and mark the second ambulance with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Locate and mark the third ambulance with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Locate and mark the fourth ambulance with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline

Unlocks barter for Bottle of OLOLO Multivitamins at Therapist LL1
So you're telling me that one of the ambulances was parked next to the health resort, hmm... Something is not right here. Well, I will send my people there, they will take care of the cars.

== Guide ==

Two of the wanted ambulances are located at the "Tunnel" extraction. The third one is located at the health resort near the helicopter. The fourth one is located next at the cottages.

quests.title: Health Care Privacy - Part 2
quests.content:
Health Care Privacy - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Thanks for your assistance with the vans. We were just in time, even those Scavs didn't have time to pull them apart. While researching the aftermath of the tunnel collapse, we’ve run across a TerraGroup executive's Geländewagen. It appears that part of the company’s top managers perished there while trying to evacuate. I’m aware that medical research was one of the top priorities for the company, and I'm almost sure that they had no time to evacuate its data and materials in time. Whatever they were doing, I think it can turn out to be very valuable, both for us and for medical science in general. It can earn us a ticket from Tarkov, even more than one. I’ve regularly met up with certain TerraGroup employees to discuss health care issues, so I'm pretty familiar with some of their works. One of my acquaintances, who, by the way, directly reported to that deceased Geländewagen management, used to live in the health resort building. Let me look it up... here it is, room 306. Search it for anything that could possibly be left behind.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain any info about TerraGroup's research in Health Resort west wing on Shoreline
Hand over the retrieved information
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Propital regenerative stimulant injector
Unlocks barter for Propital regenerative stimulant injector at Therapist LL2
Do you have the documents? Let me have a look... Indeed, the distinctive doctor’s handwriting. Thank you, young man.

== Guide ==

The Secure Folder 0060 can be found on Shoreline, in room 306 of the west wing at the Resort, located on a windowsill.

quests.title: Health Care Privacy - Part 3
quests.content:
Health Care Privacy - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
While you were searching the room, have you found anything unusual? Two bodies? Such an atrocity... It can't be just a coincidence. No wonder, though, the documents that you've managed to find are dedicated to some serious research in the field of Immunology, and from what we can understand, they have made some significant progress in that direction. Judging by the signature on the documents, the research was supervised by the head of the Medical Service of the health resort. Quite an elderly person, I've met him a couple of times on Health Care Worker Day. Although he was a venerable scholar he preferred the repose of the countryside over the bustle of laboratories and often spent time in the Woods, driving around in a white minivan. Witnessing the success, I believe, could have motivated him to start experimenting on humans, the first one most likely being himself, according to medical tradition. Scientists are always like that. Find his vehicle, and, if you also happen to find his blood samples, that would be great.

== Objectives ==

Hand over the blood sample

quests.title: Health Care Privacy - Part 4
quests.content:
Health Care Privacy - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good day, young man. The degree of your deftness never ceases to leave me in admiration, but you shouldn't stop there. You understand that training must be continuous, don't you? Especially when surviving in Tarkov. Physical exertion has never harmed anyone. Try pushing yourself to the peak of your abilities. You may record your times and results for me, but that is entirely optional.

Gain the Fatigue status effect and maintain it for 8 minutes

+28,000 EXP
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× Aluminum splint
Unlocks purchase of Aluminum splint at Therapist LL3
Have you noticed that with each attempt, you are able to maintain peak performance for longer? Excellent.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to gain and maintain the  effect for 8 minutes. The effect is caused by constant use of stamina during the critical amount state (red bar) and can be stacked infinitely. One stack only lasts for 3 minutes, so continual use of stamina in the the critical amount state is required to get the effect for 8 minutes. The duration can be checked on the thorax in the health tab.

quests.title: Health Care Privacy - Part 5
quests.content:
Health Care Privacy - Part 5 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Blood is a good source of information. Not as good as proper paperwork of course, but still good enough. It’s been a while since I did my last research. I was assisting an intern virologist with his thesis. Feels like it was yesterday, and at the same time so long ago. When the Internet was invented, it made it much easier to exchange information, even with colleagues from other countries. I miss this opportunity now to sift through the Scopus database, I am pretty sure that it has the answers to my questions, emerged after that blood sample research. Where could one possibly find access to the web now, you ask? To address this issue, I was advised to contact the one going by the name of Mechanic. As it turned out, he has access to the Internet, and it’s even relatively fast. I’ve asked him to look up the necessary articles for me. He asked for a small fee for his services, in the form of gunpowder, for whatever reason. It looks like he’s supplying someone with ammunition or something like that, but I am not really interested in that. Most importantly, he will provide the information we need. Find what he asks for, and leave it at the specified spot in the Factory. The place is swarmed with Scavs in the daytime, so it’s best to do it at night.

== Objectives ==
Locate the drop spot on night-time Factory
Obtain 3 packs of Gunpowder "Kite" and stash them in the designated spot

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1

Unlocks purchase of IFAK individual first aid kit at Therapist LL3
Nicely done, Mechanic has received the propellant. Thank you.

== Guide ==

The required room is the "Breach Room" on Factory. Place 3x Gunpowder "Kite" while night time there.
The "Breach Room" is the room between the office and the locked room on the third floor. Each Gunpowder "Kite" takes 30 seconds to place, leading to a total placement time of 90 seconds. Closing the door to the breach room is recommended while placing them, as Scavs will wander down the hallway periodically. If you wish to complete this quest with little to no resistance it is recommended to bring a squad to defend you as you plant the items. You do not have to successfully extract to complete this quest.

quests.title: Hidden Layer
quests.content:
Hidden Layer is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You know, I've thought it over again and I'm definitely positive there's a hidden layer to TerraGroup's connection with Knossos. Granted, we don't know what they were hiding yet, but that just means we haven't searched hard enough. We need to double-check everything again. Try to examine the Knossos facilities from the list again, you can also check out the adjacent buildings. Although last time my advice didn't lead you to a proper result... This time, you'd better trust your skills and intuition. Maybe we'll get lucky this way.

== Objectives ==
Locate a good lead related to Knossos LLC
Find a way inside the Knossos LLC facility
(Optional) Locate and obtain the Knossos LLC facility key

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
1× FN SCAR-H 7.62x51 assault rifle (FDE)
3× FN SCAR-H 7.62x51 20-round magazine (FDE)
4× 7.62x51mm M80 ammo pack (20 pcs)
Why didn't I think of that before? Knossos didn't purchase the whole territory of Azure Coast, but only the basements under it! That's why I thought this playground was our target. A door like this is unlikely to be accessed with a regular TerraGroup keycard. Considering they, meaning TerraGroup specifically, disguised that place as a Knossos facility, the keycard to access it should probably also have a suitable design. I'll try to find out more about these keycards and secure access to them, but it will take a considerable amount of time. If you don't wanna wait, try to find some other useful information, or better yet, the keycards themselves.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to locate, and open the door to the Knossos LLC facility, which means the transit to The Labyrinth. It is located in the basement of the health resort west wing on Shoreline. A Knossos LLC facility key is required to unlock the door. Transiting is not required.

Historical Prospects is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
It's better to discuss that with the Witnesses. They're willing to do anything to see the new world. Most will never rise to prominence under the new rules. But even the smallest actions and events will become the foundation humanity will rely upon after the transition. You probably won't understand the essence of the process you've already become a part of simply by being in Tarkov. Black Division has a special role to play, but even they aren't destined for rebirth. They'll pave the way, a path that only a select few will be permitted to walk. If you resist the inevitable, Black Division will come for you as well. It would be wiser to accept reality. The Witnesses report that a PMC group is interfering with Black Division's night-time operations. Put an end to it, and bring the dogtags of those you kill to the ritual sites as proof.

You're trying to oversimplify the situation. I've never met Thomas personally, but I understand how he sees the world. Years of service in the SAS have done their work, and after the incident that got him removed from active duty... Nothing surprises me. In Black Division, he works on operations to clear facilities and eliminate targets, and he likely wouldn't find a better use for himself anywhere else. Wedge became, or rather made himself into, a tool perfectly suited for specific tasks, but no longer useful for anything else. Of course, he doesn't believe in rebirth or the new order that will come afterward. But history has never depended on the faith or opinions of the people caught in its millstones.

quests.title: Hobby Club
quests.content:
Hobby Club is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Excellent, I've been waiting for you. I have a friend in the States, a very skilled weapons professional. He's obsessed with Russian firearms, and for several years now he's been working on his own project, called the AK-50. I don't think you've ever seen an AK that fires a .50 cal... The NATO one, I mean. So the project is finally finished, and he sent me a test sample. Such a heavy and specialized rifle is too risky to be imported in one piece, so we broke the package into several parts. Well guess what, things in Tarkov didn't go according to plan. Shocker, I know. The main body comes as one part, and it was seized in Atlantic waters. However I have the blueprint, so I need you to use it to build a new one for me. It certainly won't be easy in our circumstances. But at least you'll still have a copy of the blueprint for later use. The handguard comes with the gas tube, and it was somehow intercepted by Skier's thugs. This part took two years to assemble, fit, and test, and the cost of development and prototypes has already gone over a couple million. The dust cover was intercepted at one of the checkpoints already in Tarkov. I don't know which one, you'll have to search through all of them. But the barrel is definitely at the military base. Glukhar's personally organized an ambush on my convoy, and apparently knew about this shipment. You'll have to fight for it, or hope for some divine intervention. When you've collected all the parts, drop them off at the transmission tower shack near the gas station at the customs district. I'll ask my crew to deliver them from there, and after that I'll be able to manufacture the parts myself. And, of course, I won't forget your help.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the AK-50 barrel on Reserve
(Optional) Locate Glukhar's workshop on Reserve
Locate and obtain the AK-50 dust cover at one of Tarkov's security checkpoints
(Optional) Locate the checkpoint with seized cargo
Stash the AK-50 body at the specified spot on Customs
(Optional) Build the AK-50 body

Stash the AK-50 barrel at the specified spot on Customs

== Rewards ==

2× M82A1 .50 BMG 10-round magazine
50× .50 BMG M33
Unlocks barter for AK-50 .50 BMG muzzle brake at Mechanic LL4
Unlocks barter for AK-50 M-LOK handguard with gas tube at Mechanic LL4
Unlocks barter for AK-50 dust cover at Mechanic LL4
Unlocks barter for AK-50 .50 BMG 24 inch barrel at Mechanic LL4
You got everything? This is definitely something to celebrate... There's no other rifle like it not just in Tarkov, but in the whole world! This is what happens when a man with skills takes his dream seriously. You already have the blueprint with the main rifle body, and you can get the missing parts from me in the future. And yes, drop by my place after you've tested this beast. I plan to send word to my friend and tell him what his creation can do in the field.

quests.title: Hot Zone
quests.content:
Hot Zone was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Okie-dokie, so I took some time to think about the Labyrinth and your interest in it. Things have cooled off, so I might be able to help you out. Maybe we can find some mutual benefits along the way, eh? But first, I need you to help me with a specific order. For the kind of information I'm about to give you, it's a real bargain! I've got two shipments that are sitting on hold right now. One is waiting at Customs, the other at the military base. My couriers were really badly received there. I lost one group, and from the second one, only half of them came back. The fuckers took almost all the goods! Things are too hot in those areas for my courier guys. The PMC pricks really took a liking to those places or something. It's either camping snipers, some ushanka-wearing psychos with shotguns, or fucking "grenadiers" in the military bunkers. Thing is, this order is big and important for me, I can't let it go to waste. You have good experience in this kind of work. Maybe not in one go, but I'm sure you'll do everything perfectly. And while you're at it, I'll arrange everything for your Labyrinth business! Here's the gear that survived the ambushes. Take it right away, it'll be less work later. Stash the rigs at the gas station near the road on Customs, and the plates on the roof of the military base's workshop with, uh, a black knight symbol, whatever that means.

Never doubted you, brotherman! Alright, time to do my part. One day, Ref came to me with an idea for a big project. He found these cellars under Azure Coast, he even had investors already. Even back then I already thought that somebody out there really liked the chaos we had going on here a little too much. Everything went as planned, we agreed on deliveries and drop-off points. He even had a name for the new Arena format: you guessed it, "The Labyrinth"! I don't know what it had to do with these cellars. So, after that, Ref suddenly canceled everything, said that it wasn't up to him, and disappeared from the radar for a while. It was hard to give up such a good deal. However, I still have those keycards, I even wanted to stop by sometime to see the arena with my own eyes. There's not many of them, but for you, I'll make a good deal. No haggling though!

Back in the day, all sorts of businessmen used to stash their rivals there. Looks like someone else has taken over the place now. Shket was the only one from his group who managed to get out, but now he's keeping his head down and won't answer calls. Didn't even bother telling us where the rest of the boys are, the sniveling little rat. I took him in, gave him work, and the prick bailed the moment things got difficult.
