quests.title: Humanitarian Supplies
quests.content:
Humanitarian Supplies is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Our team always works for the good of the people, or at least we try to make it look so. The Blue Helmets peacefully deliver relief supplies to our region, but sometimes, attacks happen on us as well. That’s what happened to two Ural trucks that were carrying UN-marked crates. We wouldn't be upset if not for the delicacy of the cargo, this time crates contained a little help not only for the people but also for the USEC company. You understand that we cannot allow casting a shadow on the United Nations' reputation. Find and wear UN uniform (UNTAR helmet, MF-UNTAR body armor) and teach local scum a lesson. Also, locate the spot where trucks were attacked, mark them with beacons, and bring me several MRE ration packs so I could present them as evidence, just in case. From the intelligence, one of those trucks has to somewhere in the Health Resort area, but there is no info about the other one. I think it's best to look somewhere near the port area, possibly at the construction site.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark the first truck with an MS2000 Marker
(Optional) Locate the first truck that was holding the lost UN cargo on Shoreline
Locate and mark the second truck with an MS2000 Marker
(Optional) Locate the second truck that was holding the lost UN cargo on Shoreline
Obtain the item: 5 MRE ration packs
Hand over the items

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.25
1,100 Dollars
1,155 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,265 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Weapon parts
Unlocks purchase of 5.56x45mm Warmageddon at Peacekeeper LL2
Unlocks purchase of AK-74 Hexagon 5.45x39 sound suppressor at Skier LL2
I assume you don't need to be reminded that all this is only between us. If the Blue Helmets' reputation gets tarnished, you will have problems too, mercenary.

== Guide ==

Map with truck locations marked.
The first UN truck is located on the north side of the health resort, next to the tennis court.
The second UN truck is located at the construction site along the southern main road, near the crane.

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work.

quests.title: Hunting Trip
quests.content:
Hunting Trip is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come in, have a seat. Want some tea? Well, suit yourself. Listen, I've got a bit of a situation. I'll be having guests before long, and I can't exactly take them hunting with worn-out old rifles, can I? I've got a couple of fine foreign bolt-action rifles, but they still need to be sighted in. Then it occurred to me... why not kill two birds with one stone? Break in the rifles and thin out the ranks of those gang leaders at the same time. Don't worry kid, I'll make it worth your while.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize any 20 Bosses with a bolt-action rifle

Unlocks purchase of Accuracy International AXMC .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle at Jaeger LL4
Those rifles turned out real fine! Maybe I'll take up gunsmithing myself one day. I like this kind of work. Here's your reward, just as I promised.

== Initial Equipment ==

quests.title: Hypotheses Testing
quests.content:
Hypotheses Testing is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I was able to decipher the signal. It's old and very faint, apparently the bunker completely blocked it until you opened the doors. For some reason, the message is on loop, but this doesn't mean anything, the equipment inside could have been damaged for a while. Besides, we still don't know what the TerraGroup team was doing in there. The message says that the facility still contains materials and data that fall under the first priority of evacuation. Moreover, it mentions reports of experiments conducted at the site. This is astonishing, we couldn't have found a better time to discover something as valuable as this! Knowing more and more people are finding out about these cellars every day, it means that soon the traders and other PMCs will want to explore the area we've discovered. Perhaps even Lightkeeper will be interested... I need those documents mentioned in the signal. Whatever you can find, please bring them to me as soon as you can.

== Objectives ==
Locate the lab area with the prototype weapon inside The Labyrinth
Hand over 5 found in raid Labrys research notes

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
1× Ballistic plate case
Well done. The data is fragmented, but still extremely useful. The health resort's basements have changed a lot since the disaster began, but at some point in time, they were definitely used as a testing ground for some kind of weapon... An experimental EW or hacking device, maybe. This remains to be determined. I can already see that some of the measurements and experiments will be very useful in their own right. So your labors were definitely not in vain. Thank you.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find the prototype weapon area inside The Labyrinth and hand over 5 found in raid Labrys research notes.

Prototype weapon area marked on map

== Trivia ==
During The Labyrinth event, this quest unlocked the In Search of an Exit achievement.

quests.content:
I Am Speed - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

I hate it when fighters just sit in corners like scared little rats. Long pauses are a disgusting, exhausting sight for the audience. Show me a slaughter! Speed! Adrenaline! Only speed will flush those rats out of their holes!

Eliminate 2 enemies within 10 seconds 10 times

I Am Speed - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

Admit it, there's nothing better than completely crushing an opponent, right? The easiest way to do it is by taking them out faster than they can even react. From what I've seen, you've learned to act fast, but let's make sure the result sticks.

quests.title: I Need More Power
quests.content:
I Need More Power is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
What can you even expect when things have gotten this bad, kurwa! Our local generators have failed. My men are experiencing interruptions with electricity, and that is not acceptable. After all, time is money. But I am already working on it. Many people were conducting their operations in the Resort before us. Search for functional generators. Most likely, they are inside locked rooms on the second floor of both wings. Once you find them, simply report the room numbers to me. We also need fuel cans so the generators can keep running. That should be much easier.

== Objectives ==
Locate the generators in the east wing of the Health Resort on Shoreline
Locate the generators in the west wing of the Health Resort on Shoreline
Hand over 3 found in raid Metal fuel tanks or Expeditionary fuel tanks

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.25
1,100 Dollars
1,155 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,265 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Military flash drive
Unlocks purchase of AR-15 Magpul PRS GEN3 stock (Black) at Peacekeeper LL3
Good work, my friend. I will pass this information on to my men. Now, if only we could move those generators to our base without drawing attention...

== Guide ==
Only one of the keys is required to complete the quest.

In this quest you have to locate generators in two rooms in the health resort on Shoreline.

== East wing generators location ==
The generators in the east wing are located in room 220 on the second floor. It is always unlocked.

220 east with generators

== West wing generators location ==
The generators in the west wing are located in room 219 on the second floor. You can complete the objective by getting into the room, which requires a Health Resort west wing room 219 key, or by looking into it from the joint balcony in room 220 which requires a Health Resort west wing room 220 key.

219 west with generators
Looking into 219 west from the joint balcony

quests.title: I'm Something of a BTR Myself
quests.content:
I'm Something of a BTR Myself is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The Scavs at Lighthouse are getting a little too damn bold. They won't let me work in peace. They try to ambush my passengers at the stops, and they're even looting the stops themselves! Naturally, they do it when the BTR isn't around, so there's nobody there to teach them a lesson. Maybe you could help me out? We need to scare them off, or better yet, make it clear that the BTR is here on this stretch of coast for the long haul. I can't be here all the time myself. I've got business in Priozersk and in the city, but you could make it look like I'm still around! Just use the same caliber my coax gun does. Once you scare the shit out of them, they'll probably get used to how things work around here now.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 15 Scavs with any 7.62x54R caliber weapon on Lighthouse
Report back to the BTR Driver

== Rewards ==
+30,000 EXP
2× VPX Flash Storage Module
2× Virtex programmable processor
2× Military flash drive
Well shit, you saved my ass, dude! My passengers are already asking where I got a second BTR from, since I'm somehow in two places at once... Here, take this. I found it recently at my old depot base. Pulled it out of the basement there.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 15 Scavs on Lighthouse using a 7.62x54mmR weapon.

quests.title: Ice Cream Cones
quests.content:
Ice Cream Cones is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there, warrior. Still fighting? Good. There is this job, a cakewalk, really. Obviously, not of your caliber, it's gonna be a favor, so to say. I've received an order, they need some 60-rounders for 5.45 AKs. I know there definitely were some in bunkers near the sawmill, my guys stashed some goods there before. But they got driven out of there by those TerraGroup people, who then locked the bunkers with a key of some sort. Well, if you're going for the bunker, you'll need that key, I think it's hidden somewhere in dorms on Customs, people have seen some TerraGroup brass there a couple of times. Anyway, I don't care where you find them, but I need you to get them fresh and untouched by some traders. And hurry up, the order is urgent.

== Objectives ==
Find 3 AK-74 5.45x39 6L31 60-round magazines in raid
(Optional) Obtain the key to the bunker in the TerraGroup employee's dorm room
(Optional) Locate the locked bunker on Woods
Hand over the items

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Well, they say money can't buy friendship, but I still owe you.

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks craft for AK-74 5.45x39 6L31 60-round magazine at Lavatory level 1.

== Guide ==

The locked section of the ZB-014 bunker on Woods mentioned by Prapor does not have a guaranteed chance for the wanted magazines, but they can be found there quite often. A ZB-014 key is required to enter it.

Magazines on the barrels and on the ground

quests.title: If I Can't Have It
quests.content:
If I Can't Have It was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The work Elektronik and I are doing is taking longer than expected, so I need your help once more. While I'm connected to the system, I'm receiving data from several sensors, and I can see the laboratory is crowded with lots of "visitors". The risks I warned you about haven't gone away. That's why I'm prepared to pay for the elimination of those who are stripping the laboratory of everything valuable without giving any thought to the danger they're creating.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 30 targets in The Lab

== Rewards ==
+46,000 EXP
220,000 Roubles
231,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
253,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× U.S. Ordnance M60E6 7.62x51 light machine gun
5× M60 7.62x51 Capco 100-round Assault Box
35× 7.62x51mm M61 ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks achievement Going Dark

U.S. Ordnance M60E6 7.62x51 light machine gun with an Armasight Zeus-Pro 640 2-8x50 30Hz thermal scope

I'm glad to see you made it back safely. We've finished developing the updated security protocols. All that's left is deploying them across the entire laboratory. I doubt I'll ever be able to make use of those intrusion devices again, but that's a small price to pay for a result like this. Thank you for your help, and for acting responsibly. For many people, the chance to make a profit has completely overridden their common sense. I'm glad you're not one of them.

quests.title: Ill-Wisher
quests.content:
Ill-Wisher is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Ah, it's you. Good. Your help will come in handy. Someone's been jamming my communications lately. I managed to work around the interference without tipping them off, but that's only half the job. Now we need to find the source and shut it down. I've already traced it to the coast line. A setup like that would require some serious antennas, probably satellite dishes. Find them and install signal jammers.

== Objectives ==
Locate the first signal source on Shoreline
Place a Signal jammer on the first signal source
Locate the second signal source on Shoreline
Place a Signal jammer on the second signal source

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
I checked the frequency. The interference really was coming from those towers. What I still can't figure out is why anyone would bother doing it...

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks purchase of Signal Jammer at Mechanic LL1.

In this quest you have to locate two antennas on Shoreline and place a Signal Jammer on them.

Antenna #2 at the weather station

quests.title: Illegal Logging
quests.content:
Illegal Logging was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You know what hasn't changed since the peace times? This whole Christmas mess. Everyone's stocking up on groceries like it's the last time. And even normal-looking people get the stupid idea of cutting down a live tree in the forest for their celebrations. These savages can't even tell the difference between a 200-year-old juniper and the weeds in their backyards. So they come into my woods at night in groups. I can't shoot them all by myself. I need help. You seem like an alright kid, and you're a good shot, too. Can you help me save this nature reserve?

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 5 targets in the forest area in the time period of 22:00-10:00 on Woods
Eliminate any 5 targets in the forest area in the time period of 22:00-10:00 on Shoreline
Eliminate any 5 targets in the forest area in the time period of 22:00-10:00 on Lighthouse
Eliminate any 5 targets in the forest area in the time period of 22:00-10:00 on Customs

65,000 Roubles

2× Vortex Razor HD Gen.2 1-6x24 30mm riflescope
Good, good! Now they'll think ten times before going to my forest for Christmas trees. Just go to IDEA for your stupid plastic ones. They have no business in my nature reserve.

All areas covered with trees count for the kills.

quests.title: Illusion of Mercy
quests.content:
Illusion of Mercy was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov: Arena.

== Dialogue ==
Good to see you, gladiator. I see you're still resisting. I've been trying to get you the very best battles. Bribing people to put some of the shittiest mercs against you. Proving something to people. And what do I get in return? What is this shit? You want to quit? To sleep in peace? It's not gonna work. Listen. I like you, and I see you're clearly a capable gunfighter. You want to have a moral high ground, so be it. All I can offer you is a little mercy. In the last few matches, a couple of big shots have been betting high on headshot kills. For you, it's quick mercy kills without suffering, and for me, it's a good opportunity to justify your involvement. And the cash, naturally.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 30 enemies with headshots in any game mode

+8,000 EXP

quests.title: Immunity (quest)
quests.content:
For the skill, see Immunity.

Immunity is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Well, you've proven you won't shoot indiscriminately. Recently, one of my men was poisoned on a mission and didn't even make it to the extraction point. We couldn't figure out what toxin caused his death. The guy went on a scouting trip to the white chalk circles. I need a more fresh sample and a tough employee who can survive the poisoning and make it back from the raid.

== Objectives ==
Extract from the location with the "Unknown toxin" status effect

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Fence Rep +0.02
1,150 Euros
1,208 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,323 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
5× XTG-12 antidote injector
You survived the poisoning? Now I'll try to get some information from your blood samples and get in touch with the right people. Either way, you've already earned your reward.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to extract from a raid while suffering from the  effect.

The effect is inflicted by being stabbed with a Cultist knife, by either a Cultist or another player. Barbed wire in The Labyrinth also has a chance to inflict the effect upon contact.

While being afflicted with the status effect, your health points will drain at a rate of 140/min. You can use a Propital injector to partially counteract the health drain for 5 minutes, or an ETG injector to fully nullify the damage for 60 seconds. It is highly recommended to bring multiple medkits.

quests.title: Import
quests.content:
Import is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

I came across some interesting devices recently. The first one is clearly a storage unit, and the second appears to be an RFID reader. Nothing like this has ever been seen in Tarkov before. Most likely, they're either from new shipments that bypassed the usual channels, or they were recovered from a sealed storage facility. Either way, both options won't stay available for long, so deliver one of each device to my people. Don't bring them directly to me - it's too risky while we don't know where these devices came from.

quests.title: Import Control

Import Control was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

Hello, I'll bring you up to speed. Apparently Peacekeeper and comrade Prapor are trying to re-divide the weapon market. They're both dumping to win customers from each other. Rings a bell, doesn't it? History always repeats itself, and we are in yet another page of the book with this arms race... Well, whatever, no point in rambling now, plus this situation could prove beneficial to me. I was just about to restock my supply of imported weapons. I heard that even the Scavs at Polikhim have tuned western guns now! Can you get me some of those? I don't think anyone will mourn these bandits.

New mission, soldier. I want whatever it is that comes in those crates. According to the intel, there's valuable military equipment inside. quests.title: In the Name of Humanity...
quests.content:
In the Name of Humanity... is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You want to see the whole picture, but you forget that you're still just a tool. To learn more, you'll have to rise above the situation and forget about the sides of the conflict you're familiar with. Are you sure you're ready for that? Then listen carefully to your next assignment. You must follow the instructions precisely. First, retrieve the object from Container 14 in the Ultra parking garage. To do that, restore power at the power station, then go up to Burger Spot and find the hidden panel in the restroom. Use the card marked #11SR on the panel, then go down to the TerraGroup safe room in the parking garage. It's next to the escalator from OLI and the breach in the parking garage wall. There's a lever inside that will open Container 14. The container itself is in the parking garage beneath IDEA, by the exit toward the power station. Look for the green container marked TerraGroup. Once you've retrieved the suitcase, head downtown. Make your way to the restaurant on the third floor of the Pinewood Hotel. Leave the suitcase on the balcony. After that, send a yellow signal flare near the tram that collapsed underground. And remember: there must be no witnesses. Conduct the operation at night and leave no one alive who could have seen you. When everything is done, return to me.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 3 targets during 20:00-08:00 on Interchange (In one raid)
Locate the hidden keycard panel in the Burger Spot bathroom on Interchange (In one raid)
Locate the hidden TerraGroup saferoom on Interchange (In one raid)
Locate and access Container 14 on Interchange (In one raid)
Obtain the carbon fiber case from Container 14 on Interchange (In one raid)
Use the transit from Interchange to Streets of Tarkov (In one raid)
Eliminate any 3 targets during 20:00-08:00 on Streets of Tarkov (In one raid)
Stash the carbon fiber case on the 3rd floor balcony of the Pinewood Hotel restaurant on Streets of Tarkov (In one raid)
Launch a yellow signal flare at the tram that collapsed into the sewers on Streets of Tarkov (In one raid)

== Rewards ==
+70,000 EXP
If I had told you what was inside, you wouldn't have agreed to this job. But don't worry, there's neither a virus nor radiation inside. You were right about one thing. Black Division has assignments beyond clearing facilities. There are still samples in Tarkov that TerraGroup's closest competitors would need at least ten years to obtain. I won't tell you what they are or what they do. Some things are worth more than the entire city and everyone living in it. People may die, but the gifts must survive into the new world. After Black Division's operation in Tarkov, there will be nothing left to stand in the way of the plan.

== Guide ==

All of the following has to be done in one raid, while also killing any 3 targets each on Interchange and Streets of Tarkov in the time period of 20:00-08:00.

You first have to obtain the carbon fiber case from the TerraGroup Object-14 container on Interchange. To access it, its power lever inside the "Saferoom Exfil" extraction in the parking garage section C has to be activated. To enter the extraction, power and Object #11SR keycard swipe in the "Burger spot" restaurant urinal are required. Note: Even when someone else has already activated the extraction, the urinal and the saferoom still have to be visited to complete the related objectives.

"Saferoom Exfil" location marked on map
Door to the extraction
The Object-14 power lever

The Object-14 container is located on the opposite side of parking garage section A. The case can be found under a metal shelf.

Object-14 location marked on map
The group of containers that encloses the Object-14 container
In front of the Object-14 container
The case under the shelf

After obtaining the case you have to transit to Streets of Tarkov.

Transit location marked on map
The transit

Now the carbon fiber case has to be stashed at a balcony on the third floor of the Pinewood Hotel restaurant building on Streets of Tarkov.

As last step a yellow flare has to be fired into the sky while being next to the tram at the collpased sewers on Streets of Tarkov. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you.

quests.title: Indisputable Authority
quests.content:
Indisputable Authority is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Oi, operator! There's a job for you, I don't want no tosser for this. Everyone's been checking out the dungeons under the resort, you ought to know about it by now. They say there's a bogeyman sitting there, safeguarding the whole territory, yelling like a madman and chasing everyone outta there. Nobody can put him down! Some partners of mine have started asking questions, trying to drive down prices because of this situation. But let me tell you this: the key to authority is not to fuck up the opportunity. We need to act now, and we need to do it in a way that every little prick knows his place. So we gotta take this fucker down. If you do it in my name, so to speak, everyone will understand. You've got the skills, so this "Minotaur" idiot won't be a problem for you. But still, better be careful, this bastard is no joke either.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize the "Minotaur" inside The Labyrinth
Eliminate 6 of "Minotaur's" guards inside The Labyrinth

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
1,650 Euros
1,733 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,898 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Tark Souls poster
3× AK CSS knurled charging handle
3× Zenit RK-1 tactical foregrip on B-25U mount
Unlocks purchase of AK CSS knurled charging handle at Skier LL3
Unlocks purchase of Zenit RK-1 tactical foregrip on B-25U mount at Skier LL4
I knew I bet on the right guy! So, all safe and sound, ye? Good for you, good for you... Word's already out about your feat, no one's gonna blabber any bullshit to me anymore. Surely a lasting impression. You helped my business today, so I won't disappoint you either. Here, all yours.

In this quest you to have to kill Shadow of Tagilla and 6 Scavs inside The Labyrinth.

quests.content:
Information Trail was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The informant has finally made contact. However, he wasn't able to find any information about the specific developments, only about one of TerraGroup's employees. This person worked in administration, but had access to the underground facility and visited the laboratory from time to time. My specialist confirmed that Ref was interested in this employee, his routes, access, and responsibilities. But we still don't understand exactly what we're looking for. So we'll have to act more aggressively. I want to know more about the orders Ref gave his mercenaries. Most likely, their commander, Scourge, has this information. I hope it's clear what I need you to do.

quests.title: Informed Means Armed
quests.content:
Informed Means Armed is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Oh, Hey! Come here, lemme tell you something. Seems live I've settled into the region pretty well but I still can't shake this feeling you know? No confidence about what tomorrow's gonna bring. Ah forget it. Getting all gloomy for no reason... Anyway, I'd like to have a decent picture of  what's going on around here. Makes things a lot safer. I've got a couple of sketchy spots in mind where we should stick some smart cameras. Need you to watch two locations: put one camera near the pier by the sawmill in the woods. Place it right on the boards along the slope. Then set up the second one across from the entrance to Kiba. That's the shop in Ultra. You can probably get the cameras from Mechanic, I heard he was dealing them.

== Objectives ==
Install a WI-FI Camera to watch the sawmill dock on Woods
Install a WI-FI Camera to watch the Kiba Arms store entrance on Interchange

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.1
450 Euros

All this tech shit is clearly not for me, the picture is hazed and the signal is shit, but I've already spotted some "fat rats" while you were setting the last cams up. Thanks, huge help!

Unlocks purchase of WI-FI Camera at Mechanic LL1.

== Guide ==

Placing each camera requires you to be stationary for 20 seconds, so be sure to secure the area first.

Greetings. There's quite a noticeable increase in the number of Scavs, have you noticed? Noticeable so much that my couriers can't even get through the previously safe areas, all get clapped indiscriminately can't even make a deal with them. We need to teach those bastards a lesson so that they piss their pants with any sound of gunshots in a kilometer radius. quests.title: Into the Inferno
quests.content:
Into the Inferno was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The soldier of fortune has come for his new task! Rumors have it that Tarkov has become even more dangerous. Who would've thought, right? Someone's started targeting certain areas with mortar fire. You better go and see what's going on. And yes, this means going right into the middle of those mortar strike areas. Yup. Alright, so we've noticed the bombardments in the nature reserve, the military base, the customs office, and the coast line. Off you go then.

== Objectives ==
Visit an active mortar strike area on any specified location (Shoreline, Woods, Reserve, Customs)

== Rewards ==
+5,000 EXP
30,000 Roubles
31,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1

2× Maska-1SCh bulletproof helmet (Olive Drab)
Alive and well, that's great. So let's see what we're working with here. Somebody stole the mortars and now they're hitting various locations right before the airdrop supplies come in. Very suspicious. These local powdermen sure couldn't have secured communications with the outside world, could they? Either way, all we can do for now is watch.

quests.title: Introduction
quests.content:
Introduction is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Mercenary, come here, I've been waiting for you. Just a couple of hours ago, my old friend Jaeger got in touch with me and informed me that he had quite useful information for me. The package with the information I need is encrypted and is located in the Priozersk Natural Reserve area. Where exactly - Jaeger did not specify, but he left a clue: “Look where the hunter would wait for his prey. Where the iron bird has fallen”. Bring me this package and I'll introduce you to Jaeger, he'll definitely have work for you.

== Objectives ==
Find Jaeger's camp at the specified spot on Woods
Obtain Jaeger's encrypted message
Hand over the message to Mechanic

== Rewards ==
+4,500 EXP
30,000 Roubles

34,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks Jaeger as trader
Do you have it? Good job. Well, I think you're worthy to get in contact with Jaeger. He might have plenty of work for you.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find Jaeger's encrypted message on Woods. The message is located under a hunting stand which is located in the eastern part of the location, near the crashed plane. Once you have obtained the message, you must extract from the location and hand it over to Mechanic.

quests.title: Invasive Therapy
quests.content:
Invasive Therapy is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. I ask that you not discuss this assignment with anyone. You may also keep any questions you have to yourself. Recently, one of my shipments of injectors was intercepted by the Rogues. It seems that after the battle at the treatment plant, they have started carrying out bolder and more aggressive raids in search of equipment and medical supplies. I would be more than happy to help the wounded, but these people are trying to obtain what they need behind my back! I'm sorry... In any case, I cannot allow them to conduct business this way, and I have no choice but to respond. This needs to be handled in such a way that they never try to take my goods without my knowledge again. They keep the medications taken from my group in their chalets. Replace some of them with experimental drugs produced by Sanitar.

Oh, hey, partner! I was just thinking: it’d be damn useful to have some intel on the shipments at Ultra. What was delivered, where it went, and in what quantities. You probably won't find stuff like that for the small stores, and honestly, that's not the kind of catch worth putting in all this effort for. I'm aiming bigger. Search Goshan, OLI, and IDEA for the records. They’re probably somewhere in the offices. Find them and bring them back.

== Trivia ==
The "outside contact" that is hinted at in the dialogue and success message, is the character "Deadpool" from the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
The "amphibian pizza lovers' hideout" is a reference to the "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles" franchise.
The "burned girl's sickroom" is a reference to Alessa Gillespie, one of the main characters in the "Silent Hill" game series.
The "barbed wire body" is a reference to the game "Death Stranding".
The "really scary hole in the wall" is a reference to the game "Silent Hill 4: The Room".
The "high rise where one die-hard guy kicked ass" is a reference to the movie "Die Hard".
The "computer with a joke for programmers" is not a reference to anything in particular, but shows a folder with the name "gun porn", an opened text document with binary code that decodes to "there is no escape from Tarkov" as well as an ongoing "Minesweeper" game.
The "little chair surrounded by big black chairs" is a reference to the meme "Piper Perri Surrounded".
"Your friend Wilson" is a reference to the movie "Cast Away".
The "kindled rest place" is a reference to "Dark Souls" game series.
The "ominous welcome sign" is a reference to the "Silent Hill" game series.
The "megagenius scientist's seat" is a reference to the "Rick and Morty" sitcom series.
The "place where conscripts did a very important task" is a reference to soldiers cleaning their barracks for visits of higher-ups, even "painting the grass green" to make a good impression.
The "two chair riddle" is a reference to a Russian prison riddle/initiation ritual "There are two chairs. One has sharp knives sticking out. The other has erect penises. Which one do you sit on and which one do you have your mother sit on?"
"Every tank driver's first videogame" is a reference to the game "Battle City".
The "bucket-head villain" is a reference to the "Silent Hill" game series.
The "Anvil 3-4 crew member's execution site" is a reference to the game "Battlefield 3".
"Every indie developer's worst nightmare" is a reference to the game engine "Unity", which the game is made with. The developers have mentioned multiple times that the engine was not the best choice for the game.
The "room where the firefighter burned the books to become happy" is a reference to the novel "Fahrenheit 451".
The "place where some valve technicians couldn't finish their third project" is a reference to the unannounced game "Half-Life 3" from the developer Valve.
The "dangerous Russian chocolate beauty" is a reference to the chocolate brand "Alenka" and the "The Terminator" movie series.
The "conspiracy theorist's room" is a reference to the meme "Pepe Silvia".
"Where someone thought he'd get transported to the magic school" is a reference to the "Harry Potter" movie series.
The "mother of all strategy games" is a reference to the game "Minesweeper".
The "stairway to the skies" is a reference to the song "Stairway To Heaven" from Led Zeppelin.
The "bear who sat into a flaming car" is a reference to the Russian joke "Bear walks by the forest, sees a burning car. He sits inside and burns to ashes."
According to the developers, the room with the "upside-down chair" was originally planned to get a spooky atmosphere, but the idea was never finished.
The "not-so-lonely bathroom" is a reference to the meme "Versus Pooping".

quests.title: Keep Them in Line
quests.content:
Keep Them in Line is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, mercenary. I've received a contract that needs handling. I think you can guess who's behind it. Have you had any recent dealings with the Rogues' leaders? It seems they've had some sort of falling-out with Black Division operatives, or perhaps they've decided to turn against the Lighthouse altogether… They've been spotted wearing Black Division gear taken as trophies. Retaliation was only a matter of time. I've now been "asked" to find a suitable contractor and put an end to this. You were the first person who came to mind. If you don't think you can handle it, tell me now. This contract could cost me a couple of my deals with Lightkeeper. I'd rather not see all the groundwork I've put in go to waste because I hired an unreliable mercenary.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize Knight (In one raid)
Locate and neutralize Big Pipe (In one raid)
Locate and neutralize Birdeye (In one raid)
Survive and extract from the location (In one raid)

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
1× Weapon case
5× TerraGroup Labs access keycard
1× Briefcase with documents
2× Black Division gear crate
Thank you for taking on this contract. I had a few backup candidates in mind for the job, but their chances of handling it properly were nowhere near as good as yours.

== Guide ==
All objectives have to be completed in a single raid, dying or extracting early fails the quest.

quests.content:
Keeper's Word is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I have a new job for you. Someone found a way into the cellars under the health resort. This is not a good set of circumstances for Tarkov. Excessive curiosity often ruins a man in peacetime, but in the present situation, the mistake of one will lead to the death of many. I know how to safeguard the bunker. You may not have yet met the wardens who watch the city at night. But they certainly have met you. And now I need you to leave a short message for them at the Knossos facility, with their instruments. However, just dropping these knives in the rubble won't be enough. You need places with meaning, so that the knife you stick in becomes a symbol of sorts. Which places should you choose? You'll figure it out on your own. And if you can't, why should I even work with you?

== Notes ==

Perhaps now you've saved Tarkov from a new calamity that could have wiped the city off the face of the earth... before its time. Your reward is here. Oh, and one more thing. If I were you, I'd stop enquiring about those dungeons if you want to survive these troubled times.

Time to find out if that bloke we squeezed was telling the truth. You wouldn't believe the strings I had to pull to get hold of that little informant… While the lab's still running on emergency power, I need you to find that emergency access code and make sure it actually works. I don't have blueprints for the place, but I've heard one of your lot's been in there before. You'll find your way around, yeah? If I were you, I'd start with the admin office. Somewhere near security, the power systems, or the main server room. Bet it's locked behind some fancy key. And if anyone comes asking you questions about any of this, you've never heard my name, yeah? Better yet, nick yourself something expensive from the lab and forget this little side job ever happened.

quests.content:
Khorovod was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So the officers and I couldn't resist and we've already started celebrating... We haven't touched the salad yet, and we'll still get more booze, so don't worry. We talked about the fighting spirit, so we've come up with something you'll like! Anyway, we want the whole city to have a party. Then even loners like you will think of home, even if it's just for a second. Our guys have already found the good big trees and dressed them up properly. We don't have enough fuel to keep them lit permanently, but we can still light them up all over the city for some time! Here's the plan: you take the fuel canisters, get to the holiday tree and turn on the generator.  But regular gasoline won't do, you need special, industrial fuel. The tree lights up, but you have to hold it up for everyone to see.  Obviously, this will attract all sorts of scum, but you're not going empty-handed. We can't surrender the trees to the bandits, you'll be the first and last line of defense. Once you're done, go straight to the next one. We've prepared the trees wherever we could. It all has to be done at once, it's the only way to have the desired effect. I'll find someone else to help you. I've dug up some special armbands so you don't shoot each other. Put them on and don't shoot the people wearing them as well.

== Objectives ==
Reach Interchange in the Khorovod mode

== Rewards ==
+18,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.02
126,000 Roubles
132,300 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
144,900 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× SR-3M 9x39 compact assault rifle
2× VSS/VAL 9x39 SR3M.130 30-round magazine
5× 9x39mm BP ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks achievement Khorovod
What an awesome celebration! People are out on the streets, gathering and celebrating! I even got a message from a comrade I've thought was dead for a long time!\n\nI think you've already figured out that what you've done is very important. When things get tough, you'll remember. And when you do, you'll feel better.

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks purchase of Khorovod armband at Prapor LL1.

== Guide ==

Can be found at Christmas trees and TarCola trucks

The Khorovod mode can be accessed in the top right corner of map-selection screen. A Khorovod armband must be equipped to enter a raid.

To complete this quest, you need to refuel the generators that power the Christmas trees on Shoreline, Lighthouse, Reserve, Woods and Customs with Special 40-degree fuel and afterwards transit to Interchange in one life.

When you refueled a generator, a 5 minute timer begins and you need to defend it against Scavs.

The generator may break down, requiring to be repaired. A Leatherman Multitool will speed up the repair, but it is not required. It's going to happen several times during the 5 minutes.

When the timer is over, use the transit to the next map and repeat till you reach Interchange. The generator on Interchange does not need to be refueled to complete the quest.

You will have to use transits in this order: Shoreline > Lighthouse > Reserve > Woods > Customs > Interchange.

Shoreline: In front of the health resort west wing.
Lighthouse: At the convenience store next to the bridge to the water treatment plant.
Reserve: At the barracks parade ground, next to the helicopter.
Woods: At the sawmill.
Customs: At the "Sniper Roadblock" Scav extraction near the main crossroad.

If you don't want to get frostbite in the middle of an important task, you need to think ahead. Plan how you'll survive. Prepare your body. Walk the routes you know. Test your limits. Honest work, soldier! Now get going. I need to get in touch with the deserter. Can't let this opportunity slip!

In this quest you have to eliminate Glukhar and 5 of his guards on Lighthouse. During the current event he can be found at the water treatment plant in the north.

quests.title: Lost Contact
quests.content:
Lost Contact is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Young man, I require your assistance. The other day, I sent a group of workers to collect supplies in the Cape Dalniy area, to the former USEC base of operations in the cottage area. I think you are more than familiar with this place, given the nature of your work. This mission is vital to getting supplies out of this zone. Unfortunately, the group has ceased all communication since yesterday. We suspect someone found out about our operation. Please, mercenary, find my people and, most importantly, their cargo.

== Objectives ==
Find the lost group in the chalet area on Lighthouse
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
So all the workers got executed... I figure the cargo wasn't anywhere near them, mercenary? This is unfortunate. Well, you have completed your task, which means that you are entitled to a reward.

== Guide ==
The lost group is located on a tennis court that is part of the chalet on the hill in the south-east of Lighthouse.

Tennis court marked on map
The corpses of the lost group

quests.title: Loyalty Buyout
quests.content:
Loyalty Buyout was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Well hello-hello, little rat. That last trick you pulled was total bullshit, that's for sure. I even thought of getting a team to get rid of you, mister fancypants. Well, since you're here, I guess you want to amend for your sins. It's simple to me, like taking candy from a baby - my trust can be bought. One million in rubles - and we'll forget about past misunderstandings.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 1,000,000 RUB to Skier

== Rewards ==
Skier Rep +0.25
Well, now all the crap's behind us. Clean slate, yopta. Till next time.

== Guide ==

quests.title: Luxurious Life
quests.content:
Luxurious Life is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey! You did well on the first job, but it's not enough to make me happy. You're gonna have to do a little more legwork, soldier. I need to find a bottle of wine. I myself am more of a hard drinker, but I know a man who collects wine. And not just any kind, but the rarest kind! I want to give him a bottle as a gesture of goodwill. Nowadays in Tarkov, any connections with reputable people are worth their weight in gold, you know? There was a liquor store in the city center. They used to sell booze three times the price, for the elite folks. I'm sure there's some left. Go there and search the place and get me a good bottle of some French wine! And don't even try to slip me some fake shit.

== Objectives ==
Locate the liquor store on Ground Zero
Locate and obtain the wine bottle in the store
Hand over the wine bottle

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
O-ho, that's a beautiful bottle! The man is gonna love it. Here's your reward, well deserved.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find a wine bottle in the liquor store on Ground Zero. The wanted store is called "ASAP winery" and located across the street from the TerraGroup building complex. There are multiple spawns throughout the store.

Liquor store marked on map
The "ASAP winery" liquor store

== First spawn ==
On the corner shelf to the left of the big bar counter.

== Second spawn ==
On the shelf to the right of the big bar counter.

== Third spawn ==
On the shelf behind the big bar counter.

== Fourth/Fifth/Sixth spawn ==
On the shelves in the storage room in the back of the store behind the big bar counter.

quests.title: Magazines Are for the Weak
quests.content:
Magazines Are for the Weak was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

== Dialogue ==
Alright, I've almost sorted out the whole magazine shortage. Give it a couple more days and our supply lines will be back to normal. There'll be enough gear for everyone. But until then, we're sticking with this one-round setup. You're a good shot when you've got time to line up your sights. But what happens when you don't? Can you survive—and outplay your opponent anyway? While you're keeping the Arena crowd entertained, I'll deal with the gifted geniuses responsible for this little logistics disaster.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 30 opponents with hip-fire in CheckChamber mode

== Rewards ==
+18,000 EXP
500,000 Roubles
50 GP coins
1× Echo Belli crate
2 Battle Points
Unlocks achievement Such a lonely bullet...

quests.title: Make Amends
quests.prerequisites: Make Amends - EquipmentorMake Amends - Sweep UporMake Amends - Quarantine
quests.content:
Make Amends is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Lightkeeper said he's ready to accept you in again. But the old flash drive doesn't work anymore, so you'll have to find a new one, reflash the transmitter, and give it to me. I'll update your transmitter properly.

== Objectives ==
Obtain the V3 Flash drive on Lighthouse
Reflash the Radio transmitter
Hand over the flash drive to Mechanic
Visit the Lighthouse building

== Rewards ==
Mechanic Rep +0.01
Hope all this mess doesn't happen again.

== Guide ==
By killing Zryachiy you will fail and lose access to this quest.

There are multiple spawns for the V3 flash drive at the black (southern) chalet on Lighthouse. After obtaining it, you have to reflash the transmitter at the Intelligence Center level 2 in the Hideout. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted. After the reflashing is done, the transmitter is fully functional and can be used to bypass the Claymores and Zryachiy guarding the bridge to the lighthouse peninsula, allowing you to visit the lighthouse building and meet Lightkeeper.

Note: If not all members of your lobby-made group have an encoded transmitter, it will have the "blocked" state and the bridge can't be passed.

== First/Second spawn on the first floor ==

Chalet location marked on map
Plugged into a laptop on the dining table
Plugged into a laptop on the dining table

== Third spawn in the basement ==

Chalet location marked on map
Plugged into a laptop on a table

== Fourth spawn at the tennis court ==

Tennis court location marked on map
Plugged into a laptop on a table in the tent

quests.title: Make Amends - Buyout
quests.content:
Make Amends - Buyout is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I hear you've pissed off Lightkeeper. Friend, I won't get involved in your personal affairs, but be very careful, okay? Stay out of trouble. You've seen for yourself what this man is capable of. Well, we can still make up for it. Remember the situation with the ransom and the extortion of the traders? I remember it well. I think we can at least bribe Lightkeeper.

== Requirements ==
Getting the Digital secure DSP radio transmitter decoded the first time.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 1,000,000 RUB to Mechanic

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
Okay, we're all set. I'll let you know how it goes.

== Guide ==

quests.title: Make Amends - Equipment
quests.content:
Make Amends - Equipment is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. Listen, mercenary, I've made arrangements with Lightkeeper for a test delivery of the supplies he needs from the list. I think I might be able to get close to him. That's what I wanted to talk to you about. There's a rumor going around that you two have trust issues. So let's help each other. You find me the supplies I need, and I'll handle the transportation. I'll put in a good word for you. Okay, he needs... Whoa. He needs sniper rifles, and lots of them.

== Objectives ==
Hand over the 4 found in raid SVDS sniper rifles

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
Are the weapons ready? Great, thanks for your help!

== Guide ==

quests.title: Make Amends - Quarantine
quests.content:
Make Amends - Quarantine is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Mercenary, by spoiling relations with the Lightkeeper, you also obstruct me. It's one thing to feud with some looters, but you don't mess with Lightkeeper, believe me. I'll tell him you're willing to redeem yourself and do some work for him. For all I know, he's collecting data on movements inside the Lab right now. We'll set up a camera inside and send a signal to Lightkeeper. Deal?

== Objectives ==
Place a WI-FI Camera inside the quarantine zone in The Lab

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
Picture's clear, that's good. Let's not make any jokes with Lightkeeper this time, shall we, friend?

== Guide ==

Despite the quest objective suggesting to place a WI-FI Camera in the quarantine zone (Blue keycard), it actually has to be placed in the human experiment's area (Black keycard).

Experiment's area marked on map
Placement location

quests.title: Make Amends - Security
quests.content:
Make Amends - Security is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
These are difficult times we live in, indeed. I can help you regain Lightkeeper's trust. I don't see the point in having a conflict. So, he wants wireless cameras placed around the perimeter of the Rogue base, apparently, for security purposes. Try to stay away from the base itself - I don't think Rogues know that you're acquainted with their friend.

== Requirements ==
Getting the Digital secure DSP radio transmitter decoded the second time.

== Objectives ==
Place a WI-FI Camera at the yellow bus on the southern bridge approaching the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
Place a WI-FI Camera at the yellow bulldozer in the south-eastern part of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
Place a WI-FI Camera at the police truck in the western part of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
Place a WI-FI Camera at the army truck near the industrial zone in the northern part of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
The cameras are set up, the signal is coming through. Lightkeeper is happy, which is great news.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to place 4 WI-FI Cameras at different vehicles around the water treatment plant on Lighthouse.

Vehicles marked on map
The bus
The bulldozer
The police truck
The army truck

quests.title: Make Amends - Software
quests.content:
If you get your DSPT decoded a fourth time after finishing this questline, there is no way to get it encoded again!

Make Amends - Software is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I understand if you and Lightkeeper have disagreements, but solving them with violence is not the answer. It taints our entire ecosystem. Okay, listen, I'm running out of software from the corporate flash drives that I use to flash transponders for Lightkeeper. Help me with these flash drives, and I'll try to change Lightkeeper's mind about you.

== Requirements ==
Getting the Digital secure DSP radio transmitter decoded the third time.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 15 found in raid Secure Flash drives

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
Great, thank you. I'll take it from here.

== Guide ==

quests.title: Make Amends - Sweep Up
quests.content:
Make Amends - Sweep Up is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Friend, now is not the time to spoil relations with influential people. Lightkeeper told me about your conflicts. He offers a deal - you help his allies with their personal problems, and he forgets old grudges. We need to eliminate a group of Raiders encroaching on Rogue territory. You'll have to sweep their ranks at the federal reserve base. Can you do that?

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 25 Raiders on Reserve

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
Lightkeeper told me that you had completed the "request". Thank you.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 25 Scav Raiders on Reserve.

quests.title: Make an Impression
quests.content:
Make an Impression is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
It seems that before my marksman decides to take risks at your prepared positions, he needs proof of your skill as an experienced spotter. Which makes sense. Time allows, thankfully. Let's just say there are snipers in and around the city who are operating out of their positions. Improve your counter-sniper skills, and then my man will trust you. Go on then, seven feet under the keel.

== Objectives ==
Reach the required Bolt-action Rifles skill level of 10
Eliminate 10 Sniper Scavs from over 200 meters away

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.04
2× Phased array element
1× Substation marked key
1× Lighthouse island stash key
Unlocks the Lightkeeper service "Zryachiy support"
We've been watching you. My shooter gave the go-ahead. That's all for now. I'll let you know when the time comes.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 10 snipers from the Scavs faction from over 200 meters away, and reach level 10 in the bolt-action rifles skill. The Vortex Ranger 1500 rangefinder or the Wilcox RAPTAR ES Tactical Rangefinder can be used to determine the required distance.

Aside from regular sniper Scavs, the following enemies also count:
Shturman
Shturman's followers
Glukhar's scout followers
Kaban's snipers

quests.title: Make ULTRA Great Again
quests.content:
Make ULTRA Great Again is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Back in the day, Ultra was always packed: moms with their kids, couples, random people just wandering around. I always liked that kind of energy! But now... Ah, forget the reminiscing. Time to get things done. I don't like how Scavs and everyone else stroll into Ultra like they own the place, hauling off anything that isn't nailed down. Head over there and remind them it isn't their territory. Once you've cleared things up, I'll send my boys in to bring a little life back to the place.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 10 targets on Interchange

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
My guys said it'll take them another week to clear out all the bodies. Good work!

== Guide ==
Scavs can commonly be found at the front of OLI, Goshan, IDEA. Another spawn is in the main center hall of the mall, near the Kiba gun store. You can find more at power station, and also the road that runs parallel to the mall on the opposite side of the parking lot.

== Trivia ==
The quest name is likely a reference to the slogan "Make America Great Again", which was used by several US presidential election candidates in their election campaigns.

quests.title: Martial arts course
quests.content:
Martial arts course was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==

== Objectives ==
Score a melee kill on Tagilla
Kill 15 PMC operatives with a melee weapon

== Rewards ==
Jaeger Rep +2
Ragman Rep +2
Skier Rep +2
Mechanic Rep +2
Peacekeeper Rep +2
Therapist Rep +2
Red Rebel ice pick
Miller Bros. Blades M-2 Tactical Sword

== Guide ==
Stun grenades or a KS-23M with flashbang rounds will be useful in blinding both the PMCs and Tagilla
It is recommended to aim for the head when fighting Tagilla, since the back of his head is unprotected.

quests.title: Master Key
quests.content:
Master Key is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, how are you? I know, probably not exactly amazing. These are difficult times. My men have discovered several interesting rooms inside the Health Resort, but unfortunately they are locked. They used to be occupied by USEC soldiers. Their keys were kept at the checkpoint, inside the concrete bunker northwest of the Resort. They evacuated in a hurry, so they may have left something behind. Bring me the keys to those rooms.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the key to the closed premises of the Health Resort on Shoreline
Hand over the key to Peacekeeper

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.1
550 Dollars
578 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
632 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× CPU fan
Unlocks purchase of HK MP5 9x19 submachine gun (Navy 3 Round Burst) at Peacekeeper LL2
Excellent, great work! So, a single key is used for all of the rooms...

== Guide ==

The Key to the closed premises of the Health Resort has to be picked up on Shoreline, laying on a chair in the bunker that is located north of the health resort. It only spawns while the quest is active. Once retrieved, you must extract and turn in the item to Peacekeeper. If you die after retrieving it and before turning it in, you will have to go and retrieve it again.

Bunker marked on map
The bunker north of the health resort
The key on the chair

quests.title: Matter of Technique
quests.content:
Matter of Technique was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Tough times are upon us, huh? TerraGroup is one big box of mysteries. What could be crazier than turning a man into the living dead? I doubt Tarkov will survive this blow if we can't stand up to it. At Therapist's request, I did some research and found a working computer that might have some useful data left on it. But now we need you. Prepare the thumb drive exactly as instructed, get to TerraGroup's computer in their office in the city, and leave it there. You'll have to stay at the PC to make sure the connection is established. Once you've done your part, our mutual acquaintance and I will do the rest - all a matter of technique.

== Objectives ==
Locate the required computer at TerraGroup's Cardinal office on Streets of Tarkov
Install the flash drive at the computer to download the files

== Rewards ==
+20,500 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.02
100,000 Roubles
105,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
115,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× 4.6x30mm FMJ SX ammo pack (40 pcs)
3× HK MP7 4.6x30 40-round magazine
3× HK MP7A2 4.6x30 submachine gun
Okay, I see the connection, so you did everything right... Oh, they're DDoS-proofed. But what if we access it from here, you assholes? Hm, that's where Mr. Kerman comes in. Are you still here? I'm sorry, I don't have time to chitchat anymore. Kerman just sent over his data, said he's not gonna let TerraGroup's projects ruin our city. While he takes down the security, I have to format the drives to give Therapist everything we can find out.

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks craft for Flash drive with special software at Intelligence Center level 1.

== Guide ==

To complete this quest, you first need to craft a Flash drive with special software at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. Afterwards you have to stash it near the screens in the surveillance room inside the TerraGroup security post building on Streets of Tarkov.

Jump onto the desk and stand right in the corner of the room. The infected cannot climb and will struggle to path to you and hit you while on top of the desk. The flash drive can be stashed from this spot.

Building marked on map
The building entrance
Way to the surveillance room 1
Way to the surveillance room 2
The stashing area in the room

quests.title: Mayday
quests.content:
Mayday was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
After our last surveillance attempt, the Rogues reinforced their units, and now they're interfering with my people's work even away from the coast. I need you to clear the routes, otherwise I may lose several important partners in the city. And that means you lose profit as well. I still don't understand what Knight is willing to risk so much for... Try to gather more information about this operation directly from the Rogues. Though I doubt anyone outside Knight and his inner circle is carrying anything truly valuable.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 14 Rogues
Hand over the found Rogue intel

== Rewards ==
+13,000 EXP
4,000 Dollars
4,200 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
4,600 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Desert Tech MDR 7.62x51 assault rifle
2× AR-10 7.62x51 Magpul PMAG 20 SR-LR GEN M3 20-round magazine
2× 7.62x51mm M80 ammo pack (20 pcs)
2× SAPI level III+ ballistic plate
Unlocks achievement Awaiting Departure

Modified Desert Tech MDR 7.62x51 assault rifle

Great! Judging by the markings on the maps you brought back, Knight is trying to track some kind of facility in the gulf, still inside the blockade perimeter... and reach it. It could be one of the unnamed islands, or even a vessel. If you want to get to the bottom of this, I suggest you stay active, not tucked away in your hideout.

== Guide ==

Kill 14 Rogues on Shoreline, Lighthouse or Reserve and hand over Rogue intel maps. Rogue intel maps can be found on Knight in the area from the gas station to the hydroelectric power station on Shoreline.

Shoreline Rogue spawns marked on map
Lighthouse Rogue spawns marked on map
Reserve Rogue spawns marked on map

quests.title: Mentor
quests.content:
Mentor was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
How's life treating you, mercenary? Maybe you will be interested, a friend of mine is exceptionally skilled at shooting sniper rifles. But I'm afraid that his services are not cheap. He worked as a PMC, but now he has retired and is mentoring people for cash. If you decide, I think I could arrange a meeting for you.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 50,000 EUR to Peacekeeper

== Rewards ==
+3 Bolt-action Rifles skill levels
So, I've been told you took up the training. Well, with your skills, I'm sure you'll learn quick.

== Guide ==

Euros can be purchased from Skier with Roubles.

quests.title: Metal Birds
quests.content:
Metal Birds is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello again! Modern warfare is a really high-tech enterprise. My men have spotted drones operating in Tarkov. They were shot down, but we were unable to recover them. Search the Woods for them. If you find the controller or any other components, bring them to me. You will be well compensated.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the motor controller on Woods
Hand over the found item
Locate and obtain the single-axis fiber optic gyroscope on Woods
Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.1
550 Dollars
578 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
633 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
Wonderful, you found everything! Thank you for your work. Here is your share of the payment.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to pick up a motor controller and a single-axis fiber optic gyroscope on Woods.

The motor controller can be found on the center console of a black SUV at the USEC checkpoint west of the sawmill.

Location marked on map
The wanted SUV
The controller on the console

The single-axis fiber optic gyroscope can be found in an open weapon box located in the back of a blue pickup at the sawmill.

Location marked on map
The wanted pickup
The gyroscope in the box

quests.title: Minibus
quests.content:
Minibus is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Oh, so glad to see you. Let’s go straight to business, I have to deliver stuff quite frequently, and carrying everything as a mule is hardly an option anymore. All vehicles are dead after some kind of EMP strike during the conflict. Nothing starts no matter how hard you try, even if you take them apart and put them back together, only cars that came from outside can still run. There are bound to be some minibusses at the parking lot at the Interchange, mark at least three of them with beacons. My mechanics will examine them in detail, maybe there is a chance of success if I procure some electronics from the outside. Just do it right, don't need no pieces of trash. Look for the yellow ones, you'll figure it out.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark the first yellow minibus with an MS2000 Marker on Interchange
Locate and mark the second yellow minibus with an MS2000 Marker on Interchange
Locate and mark the third yellow minibus with an MS2000 Marker on Interchange
Hand over 10 any found in raid items from the Tools category

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Phase control relay
1× MSA Sordin Supreme PRO-X/L headset
1× Walker's XCEL 500BT Digital headset
1× ANA Tactical Beta 2 Battle backpack (Olive Drab)
Welcome back. The signal is clear, all good, I'll send the guys to salvage the cars. Thank you, helped a brother out.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to mark 3 yellow minibuses with MS2000 Markers on Interchange and hand over 10 found in raid items from the tools category.

The first one is located southwest of the mall at the container lot.

Location marked on map
Minibus 1 in the container lot.

The other two are in the western parking garage.
One of them can be found at the transition from section B to section C, close to the blocked-off down-ramp.
The second one is located in section C, right next to the "Saferoom Exfil" extraction and the hole in the wall that connects the western with the eastern parking garage.

Locations marked on map
Minibus 2 close to the blocked-off down-ramp
Minibus 3 opposite of the "Saferoom Exfil"

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

quests.title: Minute of Fame
quests.content:
Minute of Fame is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Sup, bandit! How's life? A little birdie told me there's a special magazine in the Ultra mall at the Interchange. They wrote about our Russian video game, which is recognized all over the world! I guess the guys really came up with a great concept!

== Requirements ==
This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

Locate and obtain the special edition of the gaming magazine on Interchange
Hand over the found item

2× AWC Thor PSR XL multi-caliber sound suppressor

Now this is a victory! The magazine hit the jackpot! Looks like real historical shit.

== Guide ==

The magazine can be found on the second floor of the ULTRA shopping mall on Interchange, in a book store called "МУЗЕЙ ИСТОРИИ" ("Museum of History"). There are multiple spawns throughout the store.

The store

On one of the billard tables.

The magazine referenced in this quest is issue #216 of the Russian computer games magazine "Навигатор игрового мира" (Game World Navigator).

quests.title: Miracle Worker
quests.content:
Miracle Worker was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

== Dialogue ==
Come on over, you're right on time. I've got a little bet going with one of the regular spectators, and you're the subject. He says you should've been taken out ages ago, statistically speaking, you know what I mean? But in my experience, luck and skill can work some pretty serious miracles. This spectator of mine put a lot of money against you and got some of his friends in on it. But I believe in you, so I put down a little bet at some nice odds that you'd beat the statistics. Time to show these mathematicians how things really work in the real world. Don't let me down.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 25 enemies in BlastGang mode
Win 3 matches in BlastGang mode

== Rewards ==
+20,000 EXP
1,000,000 Roubles
100 GP coins
1× Panacea crate
1× Morbus crate
2 Battle Points

quests.title: Missing Cargo
quests.content:
Missing Cargo is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, tactical, come on in! Do you remember that civilian helicopter that was shot down somewhere by the Lighthouse, according to rumors? So, the headache is that on that helicopter was a certain man with an inconspicuous folder, but it, in fact, was very much conspicuous - a lot of money was paid for it. Well, a birdie said the helicopter got shot down somewhere on the way to our meeting point. So here's your task: confirm the helicopter's whereabouts and that the rumors are true. Then find that folder for me, it's extremely important. I've got no idea who could've shot it down, honestly. Who's got the resources for that?.. USECs? I did hear that they took a liking to those cottages near the mountains, so it might be worth checking that area out. Hope those stray westerners didn't nick my goodie.

== Objectives ==
Locate the crashed helicopter on Lighthouse
Locate and obtain the informant's intelligence folder
Hand over the folder to Skier

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.75

Well hey there, warrior. How you holding up? Haven't frozen anything off yet? I've already got plenty of guys laid up because of these New Year frosts. We're short on hands back at base, but we'll scrape by. Out in the field though, things are a real mess, and I need your help. One squad was running an important job in the southwest. There are three possible rally points they can reach once the weather clears. I need you to stash some food there so they can make it back to base without keeling over. In Priozersk, you need the little house on the outskirts, near the trail that leads toward Reserve. You also need to leave supplies at the military base; there's an old barrack right by the path from the forest, there's a room right by the entrance. Hide the stuff somewhere in the lockers so the Scavs don't steal it. They might also make it to Interchange if they follow the river. The river access is in the smuggler camp. quests.content:
Morituri te salutant was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good thing you're here. My guys made it back to me.. well, the ones who survived. The convoy got hit hard on Customs, so they had to pull out fast and took losses. They made it out on foot toward Ultra, and only there did they manage to regroup. They stashed most of the shipment at an open warehouse yard near the road to Customs. Somewhere among the containers, there should be a yellow minibus. That's where the cargo is. Check it and make sure the area's clear, would you? If you spot any signs of trouble, bring me whatever you find. The case with the templates and blueprints was hidden separately. There's an old TerraGroup container at the same yard, that's where everything was supposed to go in the first place. But they didn't make it in time, someone was on their tail. So they only managed to stash the case inside and lock it back up. Your main objective is to secure that case and bring it to me personally. I'll give you the keycard. Look for a red container, it should be somewhere up top near the minibus. And one more thing. Show that thug what real Arena fighters are capable of. I've hired other gladiators to help clear the area, so you don't start shooting each other, wear the colored masks from previous collections.

quests.title: My Blood Type Mark is on the Sleeve
quests.content:
My Blood Type Mark is on the Sleeve was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon. One of my recent patients previously worked at TerraGroup's underground facility. I tried to learn more about the laboratory and its security systems, but the man refused to cooperate. Shortly after his discharge, he was intercepted by one of the local Scav gangs. Hm, which one? Why would you assume I know the answer? I suggest you keep such speculation to yourself. What matters is that the previously sealed sections can now be accessed using the emergency override code. We are unlikely to have a better opportunity to recover the research materials I am interested in. I need blood samples labeled TG-Y. They were most likely used in one of the facility's isolated testing chambers, while processed samples may have been stored in laboratory refrigeration units. There is one more thing. Somewhere inside the facility is the office of the scientist who led the project I am investigating. Search it for notes, reports, or any other documentation related to that research.

Set the vials down here, carefully! How were they stored? Hmm… I only hope there is still enough left to identify what I'm looking for, even if only through indirect traces. I will review the documents later. Whatever the outcome, material of this nature should never be left unsecured. And I would strongly recommend disinfecting your hands.

quests.title: New Paths
quests.content:
New Paths is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, mercenary. My partners urgently need to move something important through the city center. You know how isolated the districts have become and how dangerous the main roads are. We need you to scout a route from TerraGroup Headquarters to the Rodina Cinema. My men noticed that some bandits have found a shortcut between the districts. It would allow us to reach several different locations in a single raid. Make sure the route is safe.

== Objectives ==
Scout the intersection of Mira Ave and the overpass on Ground Zero (In one raid)
Locate the passage leading to Streets of Tarkov on Ground Zero (In one raid)
Use the transit from Ground Zero to Streets of Tarkov (In one raid)
Survive and extract from Streets of Tarkov (or transit to the next location)

+3,000 EXP

== Ground Zero intersection ==

Location marked on map
The intersection
