Next to the Mira Ave extraction. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start.

quests.title: Night of The Cult
quests.content:
Night of The Cult was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
About time you stopped by. You've noticed those night devils coming out of everywhere too, haven't you? They're arming themselves a lot better, huh. It's like someone's actually working with them. From above, you know? We should look into what those bastards are up to. Besides, all the better if you can reduce their numbers. Just be careful. There's a rumor among the scavengers that you can run into an invincible beast at night. They say it hunts and devours humans. I remember an Eastern story about such a demon, its nickname was, uh... "The Oni". I wouldn't have brought these stories up before. But now something's definitely brewing, and dark thoughts just keep creeping into my head.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 hooded night people

== Rewards ==
+12,500 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.02
50,000 Roubles
52,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
57,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Cult Locust ballistic plate
1× Cult Termite ballistic plate
1× L3Harris GPNVG-18 night vision goggles
1× Dorm room 314 marked key
So, what'd you find? I didn't sit idle either while you were gone, I met with Partisan. He says they're preparing a special ritual, and that's why they're coming out of their dens. They're all mentioning some kind of "Night of The Cult". I don't know what's this about, but it's definitely bad news for Tarkov. And something tells me there's somebody who's orchestrating the whole thing. That demon didn't just show up in our parts for no reason. I saw something myself last night, though. His face was red, like it was burning. I grabbed my gun and aimed, but just as I blinked, there was no one there. Old man hallucinations, perhaps...

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 5 Cultists.

== Trivia ==
This quest was released together with the video The Chronicles of Ryzhy [S2 Chapter 6: "Viam supervadet vadens"]

quests.title: Night Sweep
quests.content:
Night Sweep is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Oi, come here, need to talk to you. Got a job for you, a dry one, if you ask me. My folks were looking for loot at night recently and ran into some hooded morons, and, well, shit went south. Naturally, my dudes managed to retreat in the end and even smoked some of those psychos, though we still lost around a dozen of ours. Eh, that's not the point. The guys found some kind of a dagger on one of those psychos, and apparently, some serious people are willing to pay a fortune for those. Anyway, I've got an order for those daggers. If you find any, bring'em here.

== Objectives ==
Obtain 12 unusual knives
Hand over 12 knives to Skier
Eliminate 5 hooded men

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Search skill levels
+4 Stress Resistance skill levels
Skier Rep +1.5
2,400 Euros
2,520 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,760 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× CMMG Mk47 Mutant 7.62x39 assault rifle
5× 7.62x39mm PP gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of CMMG Mk47 Mutant 7.62x39 assault rifle at Skier LL4
Unlocks purchase of Magpul MOE Carbine rubber buttpad at Skier LL4
Bloody hell... You got them all by yourself? You've got guts, that's for sure. Somethin' ain't right about those psychos, I'm tellin' you...

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find 12 Cultist knives and hand them over to Skier. They are carried by the Cultist priest and sometimes by his followers. You also have to kill 5 Cultists.

quests.title: No Fuss Needed
quests.content:
No Fuss Needed was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Alright, so here's the deal. Here's the note I was talking about, bring it to the doc lady. Nothing criminal in there, just a few lines about our business. But here's the pain in the ass: if she knows that the note is from me, she'll just tear it up on the spot. Try to gain her favor first, earn some trust, and only then pass the note over. And don't lose it, I'm not writing another one.

== Objectives ==
Reach Loyalty Level 3 with Therapist

== Rewards ==
+15,800 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.03
32,000 Roubles
33,600 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
36,800 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Altyn assault helmet (Olive Drab)
Seems like it went without a hitch, thanks.

quests.title: No Gifts for You
quests.content:
No Gifts for You was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come on in, kid. Ive seen lots of things during this conflict, but bribes... Someone bribed the local bandit leaders, others found out about it and started doing that too, then the others. Cowards fill the leaders pockets with goods, and now we have a whole charade of arse-licking around us. Theyre using those red backpacks to carry all those bribes, like some Christmas presents. Theyre ruining such an important symbol! Go there and confiscate these bribes from those corrupt bandit leaders.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 3 found in raid Santa bags to Jaeger

== Rewards ==
+13,800 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.02
77,000 Roubles
80,850 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
88,550 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle
You showed those bastards whats right, kid? Thats for the best.

== Guide ==
== Note: ==
Killing Santa Claus will lose you significant rep with Fence (-0.50pts / -1.50pts)!

quests.title: No Limit to Perfection - Part 1
quests.content:
No Limit to Perfection - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

== Dialogue ==
Soft types don't last long in the Arena, so you better stay in shape! We've got a big iron here, try handling that beast if you've got the strength for it. And if you don't, drag your ass to the gym and keep at it until you do!

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 10 enemies while using an RSh-12

== Rewards ==
+15,000 EXP
+100 Strength skill points
10 GP coins
1× Valuables crate (Rare)

== Guide ==

quests.title: No Limit to Perfection - Part 2
quests.content:
No Limit to Perfection - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

== Dialogue ==
Your strength's just fine, but I can see your endurance needs work. If you're crawling around slow and stopping every few steps, you'll miss all the action. Show me in the Arena that you're not snoozing out there!

== Objectives ==
Get the first kill of the round 5 times in BlastGang or TeamFight mode

== Rewards ==
+20,000 EXP
+200 Endurance skill points
5 GP coins
1× Valuables crate (Rare)

quests.title: No Limit to Perfection - Part 3
quests.content:
No Limit to Perfection - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

== Dialogue ==
When your conditioning's solid, it's time to start working on applied skills. For a good fighter, a rifle is an extension of his hands! Grab whichever one you like best and get out there to train.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 50 enemies while using assault rifles

== Rewards ==
+25,000 EXP
+300 Assault Rifles skill points
10 GP coins
1× Valuables crate (Rare)

quests.title: No Limit to Perfection - Part 4
quests.content:
No Limit to Perfection - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

== Dialogue ==
You know what a lot of fighters forget? How to fight at distance. Our Arenas aren't huge, sure, but there's still room to stretch things out. Don't waste that advantage. A talented fighter has to be good at everything!

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 50 enemies while using marksman rifles

== Rewards ==
+26,000 EXP
+300 DMRs skill points
15 GP coins
1× Valuables crate (Rare)

quests.title: No Limit to Perfection - Part 5
quests.content:
No Limit to Perfection - Part 5 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

== Dialogue ==
It's not enough to just shoot from a distance, you've got to anticipate your enemy's moves! A lot of my guys rush it, starting blasting the moment they spot someone. And of course they miss! The whole point is careful aiming and understanding how your opponent behaves. I think you could use some practice too. Get to the Arena!

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 100 enemies while aiming down sights

== Rewards ==
+27,000 EXP
+300 Attention skill points
20 GP coins
1× Valuables crate (Rare)

quests.title: No Limit to Perfection - Part 6
quests.content:
No Limit to Perfection - Part 6 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

== Dialogue ==
It's one thing to handle a weapon, but a whole other thing to understand its strengths and weaknesses. Submachine guns, for example, perform best in the hands of a mobile fighter at close range. Don't try to make a weapon do something it's not meant for — you wouldn't slice bread with a fork, would you? So get out there and practice!

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 2 enemies within 15 seconds while using a submachine gun 20 times

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
+300 Submachine Guns skill points
20 GP coins
1× Valuables crate (Rare)

quests.title: No Limit to Perfection - Part 7
quests.content:
No Limit to Perfection - Part 7 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

== Dialogue ==
You know what's the deadliest weapon up close in the Arena? A shotgun! One point-blank blast and your opponent's practically scraping off the walls. Learn to handle it properly, and nothing will be able to stop you. Guess what it takes to get there? Practice, of course. Lots and lots of practice.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 50 enemies while using shotguns

== Rewards ==
+30,000 EXP
+300 Shotguns skill points
25 GP coins
1× Valuables crate (Rare)

quests.title: No Limit to Perfection - Part 8
quests.content:
No Limit to Perfection - Part 8 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

== Dialogue ==
You've got to know how to fight with style! If you're packing a heavy caliber, then use it to the fullest. Light them up straight through cover! The crowd loves it when someone turns the place into a bloodbath without all the fancy tricks. Just go in and crush your opponents. Forget about careful aiming! Show everyone what you're capable of.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 50 enemies with point fire while using light machine guns

== Rewards ==
+32,000 EXP
+300 Light Machine Guns skill points
30 GP coins
1× Valuables crate (Rare)

quests.title: No Limit to Perfection - Part 9
quests.content:
No Limit to Perfection - Part 9 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

== Dialogue ==
It's never precise enough — you've got to hit the head on the first shot, not the twentieth. Go train, fighter. You'll pick up some serious sniper skills along the way.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 10 enemies with headshots while using bolt-action rifles

== Rewards ==
+35,000 EXP
+300 Bolt-action Rifles skill points
30 GP coins
1× Valuables crate (Rare)
Unlocks achievement The Time to Live and the Time to Die

quests.title: No Man Is an Island
quests.content:
No Man Is an Island was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

== Dialogue ==
Listen. The spectators are loving this one-round gimmick, and the bets keep getting bigger. So we'd better milk it while it's hot. Just don't forget you've got teammates. Work with your squad. Yeah, yeah, I've heard all that "one man can win the battle" nonsense, but there's a reason we pit teams against each other out here. You're part of a team now, so prove you've got what it takes as one.

== Objectives ==
Win a CheckChamber match while placing 4th or higher on your team

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
400,000 Roubles
35 GP coins
1× Weapon crate (Rare)
2 Battle Points

quests.title: No Peeking!
quests.content:
No Peeking! was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. It's good to have you here, I need some outside help. You'll do just fine. Recently, my people have noticed that someone is installing cameras in the city center. They're trying to spy on us! My men must not be seen involved in this matter, so we need your help. Take down the people who are installing the cameras. I'll pay for everything, don't worry.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 PMC operatives at the TerraGroup HQ on Ground Zero

== Rewards ==
43,400 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.02
850 Dollars
893 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
978 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× SIG Sauer SRD762Ti 7.62x51 sound suppressor

I've already been told you've handled everything. Well done!

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 5 PMCs at the TerraGroup HQ on Ground Zero.

Kill area marked on map

quests.title: No Place for Renegades
quests.content:
No Place for Renegades is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, warrior. I've got a new assignment for you, regarding that military base, the one you were checking out for me some time ago. In short, I'm not happy that my boys got killed in vain in that bunker. That's just not right. I'd like to let those Raiders know the consequences of their actions. An eye, for an eye, you know? Return to that bunker and fuck up some of them in that command offices area you found. Just so they know who they're messing with and that they better stop.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 Raiders in the command bunker on Reserve

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Good work out there. I hope they get what's going on now and that they can't just kill my people like that. Here's the reward.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 5 Scav Raiders in the underground bunker on Reserve. Scav Raiders have the chance to spawn there at the start of a raid, and additional ones may appear after the "D-2" extraction switch has been activated.

Quest area marked on underground map

quests.title: No Smoke Without Fire
quests.content:
No Smoke Without Fire was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, mercenary. My people have been reporting unusually high Rogue activity along the coast line. There are indications they may have been seen near the Reserve base as well, though that information hasn't yet been confirmed. Your task is to conduct reconnaissance around the Lighthouse and the port terminal area. While you're at it, please check the military base as well. We need to understand what they are looking for. Casualties are acceptable, the priority is to identify new Rogue positions and gather as much intelligence as possible.

== Objectives ==
Survive and extract from Shoreline
Survive and extract from Lighthouse
Survive and extract from Reserve
Eliminate 10 Rogues on any location

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
2,500 Dollars
2,625 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,875 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× FN P90 5.7x28 submachine gun
2× FN P90 5.7x28 50-round magazine
3× 5.7x28mm SS197SR ammo pack (50 pcs)
So, the Rogues are indeed preparing a large-scale operation? They would not risk their personnel without a serious reason. Stay in contact. It appears something significant is about to unfold.

== Guide ==
Kill 10 Rogues on Shoreline, Lighthouse or Reserve and extract from each location with the "Survived" extraction status.

Shoreline spawns marked on map
Lighthouse spawns marked on map
Reserve spawns marked on map

quests.title: No Swiping
quests.content:
No Swiping is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Let's skip the small talk and get straight to business. My mates have set up shop at the coast and Interchange, moving all sorts of contraband. Useful lads. A couple of days back they had to clear out of their base and leave everything behind. No idea what happened, and we're not exactly close enough to share every little detail with each other. Anyway, now some randoms have started poking around those bases, taking whatever they can get their hands on. Go over there and explain to these newcomers that they shouldn't stick their noses where they weren't invited. Just clean up the area around the bases. They'll get the message.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 10 targets at the smuggler bases on Shoreline or Interchange

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.1
450 Euros
472 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
517 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Pack of screws
Yeah, yeah, I've heard all about those shits running away with tails between their legs. Here, your goodies.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill any 10 enemies in and around the smugglers base on Shoreline or Interchange.

Shoreline base location and kill area marked on map
Interchange base location and kill area marked on map

quests.title: Nostalgia
quests.content:
Nostalgia is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello there, come in. You know, at times, sitting by the campfire, I look back on how it all began. That time I've been on vacation in the health resort, it was in the evening, I remember that as if it was yesterday. I have just returned to the room after dinner, sat by the window to gaze at the bay. It looked marvelous. And then I hear trucks, not just a single one, a whole convoy. It was your colleagues, the USECs. They kicked everyone out of the resort, didn’t even let people pack their belongings. I don't care about my clothes as much as my photo album which remained there. Not as a service but as an act of friendship, please try to find it there. It is painfully dear to me as a memory of those calm days. My room was on the top floor of the health resort, in the west wing. The reward will be bountiful.

== Objectives ==
Locate Jaeger's Health Resort room with a view of the bay on Shoreline
Locate and obtain Jaeger's Photo album
Hand over the Photo album to Jaeger

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× KEKTAPE duct tape
There's no way you actually found it! Thank you so much! Wait. Here, take this. A few days ago I've picked up a badly wounded USEC in the forest. I bandaged him up, but the poor fella didn't make it. Before dying, he gave me a key, looks like it is from one of his stashes somewhere in the Health Resort area. I don't need it, but you might find it useful.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find Jaeger's photo album in the health resort on Shoreline. It can be found in west wing room 303 on the third floor, located in the bottom drawer of a nightstand. The room is always unlocked.

Health resort west wing location marked on map
Door to west wing room 303
Photo album in the bottom drawer

quests.title: Not a Step Back!
quests.content:
Not a Step Back! was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Times are hard, but you are a real warrior! Who else but you to defend our country from these monsters? I keep receiving reports of numerous enemy breakthroughs, and the least defended location is the nature reserve. You'll have to move into the area and kill as many of those freaks as you can. And yes, bring tons of ammo and stay on the high ground, you'll need it. And remember to stay at a distance, shoot them on the approach! Don't let them get too close to you.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 35 infected from over 70 meters away on Reserve

== Rewards ==
+42,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.03
Jaeger Rep +0.01
150,000 Roubles
157,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
172,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Body armor repair kit
1× Weapon repair kit
So many? Man, normally we'd just artillery the fuck out of them... But you gave them a hell of a beating. If any of my soldiers managed to hide somewhere, now's the time to get out. I'm gonna go check the frequency.

== Guide ==

Infected PMC

quests.title: Not Below Zero
quests.content:
Not Below Zero was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov: Arena.

We're striking while the iron's hot. You can climb the rankings if people are betting on you. Just don't end up at the bottom or you'll lose cash. But you know what you're doing, so I'm not worried.

quests.title: Nothing Fishy About This
quests.content:
Nothing Fishy About This is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, brother. Kinda in a bad mood today, not gonna lie. I feel like I've been ripped off! I bought an apparently running SUV for 2,000 bucks. And everything seemed fine, they brought it to Shoreline, but the driver never contacted me back after that. It's not a lot of money, but still sucks. Can you go see if the car's actually there?

== Objectives ==
Locate Ragman's SUV on Shoreline
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
It's in the fucking swamp? That explains the fucking price. It would cost more to get it out from there and clean it up! All right, here, that's for helping me out.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to find Ragman's lost SUV on Shoreline. It is located in the east of the swamp village, driven into a pond.

SUV location marked on map
The SUV in the pond

quests.title: Number Temporarily Unavailable
quests.content:
Number Temporarily Unavailable was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
We need you again. Looks like this rat's not crawling out of his hole with that package unless we give him a kick. So you need to get in touch with him ASAP, and my guys are short on equipment. Can you bring it? I'll give you the list. The main thing is finding our new camp. Use the mountain ridge directly across from the peninsula with the lighthouse as your landmark. Off to the side of both chalets, closer to the blown-up tunnel. Maybe this bastard won't be too scared to get on the radio this time! I don't even know anymore if that BEAR dossier is worth all this trouble. But the client knows best.

== Objectives ==
Stash 3 Electronic components at Prapor's new camp on Lighthouse
Stash a Military cable at Prapor's new camp on Lighthouse
Stash 3 Capacitors at Prapor's new camp on Lighthouse

== Rewards ==
+15,000 EXP
300,000 Roubles
315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× 6B45 armored rig (Medic, EMR)
Whatcha think of our camp? Why the hell didn't we set up there sooner, huh... That's what you call a good position. I'll let my guys know all the electronics are in place. No point keeping my men on neutral ground now, so they'll move in once they get the signal. And don't disappear on me. We might need some more help after the broadcast with that Glukhar deserter.

== Guide ==

Camp location marked on map
The camp
Stashing location at medical boxes

quests.title: Obstacle Course
quests.content:
Obstacle Course was a community goal Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, so somebody managed to get into the lab and steal the information I need. He like downloaded it all, you know what I'm saying? Anyway, I need to find this asshole, but the blueberries are trying to make peace and friendship here. They're pissing me off, getting in my way. Why don't we get rid of them?

== Objectives ==
Eliminate Peacekeeper's people on Shoreline

== Rewards ==
+126,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.05
134,000 Roubles
140,700 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
151,100 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
3× Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
Yeah, I heard, we all did great. I'd like to see that European prick's face now, ha!

In this quest you have to kill 1 of Peacekeeper's people on Shoreline.

They can be found in squads of 3-6 at one the following locations in every raid:
Near the cottages
In the east and west wing of the health resort
At the port/pier area
At the smuggler base

quests.title: Obstruction Destruction
quests.content:
Obstruction Destruction was a community goal Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Morning. I sent my men to inspect the laboratory, but someone's gotten there first. They've destroyed all the useful data, those bastards! My men say that they must have copied it all to themselves. It's important to catch them, but Skier's rednecks are obstructing us. I'm counting on your help to rid the territories of criminal elements. Don't worry, you won't be working alone.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate Skier's people on Customs

== Rewards ==
+126,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.05
1,300 Dollars
1,365 Dollars with Intelligence center Level 1
1,495 Dollars with Intelligence center Level 2
3× Intelligence folder
I am surprised and disappointed. The task was simple! Maybe I should reconsider my views on outside help.

In this quest you have to kill 1 of Skier's people on Customs.

At the shipping yard premises
At the Scav base (ZB-1013 extraction) building with the numerous mounted weapons
At the dorms area, either in one of the dorms or in the yard between them
In the area between warehouse 17 and the bridge
In the entire area east of the river

quests.title: Offensive Reconnaissance
quests.unlocks: Vacate the PremisesHypotheses TestingConfidential InfoIndisputable AuthorityThis Tape Sucks
quests.content:
Offensive Reconnaissance is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You got the keycard? Perfect. Judging by how much everyone's interested in these cellars, you and I are on a truly important trail. There could be a TerraGroup warehouse or another lab that's been sealed there ever since the evacuation! We don't have time to waste. First we need to search these premises and figure out what the purpose of the facility is. TerraGroup would not be so eager to hide it if what is going on inside corresponds to their company's public profile. Try to memorize everything you see: the structure of the premises, equipment, tools, markings or other symbols... Every detail counts. I'll wait for your return and set up my surveillance system to track any information about the health resort. If anyone finds more than we do, I'll see it.

== Objectives ==
Find out what is behind the Health Resort bunker door on Shoreline
(Optional) Obtain the Labrys access keycard

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
An old bunker? Yes, there was one mentioned in the archives, an old Soviet shelter. Thing is, it was closed down about twenty years ago due to some kind of technical failure. Looks like Knossos restored it to working order. But why would TerraGroup need an abandoned bomb shelter? Um, hang on. I'm picking up a signal from my interception network. An encrypted message that seems to be coming straight from these cellars... Give me a minute.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to transit from Shoreline to The Labyrinth. The transit is located in the basement of the health resort west wing and requires a Labrys access keycard. The door to the transit is locked and requires the Knossos LLC facility key. Surviving the raid is not required.

Health resort west wing location marked on map

Door to the transit

quests.title: Oil Change
quests.content:
Oil Change is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Heya there, warrior! Since you already know about my little helicopter secret, I've got a job for you. If you want my bird to keep picking you up from the ship, it needs regular maintenance. Remember that special lubricant you brought me? You won't find that stuff in Tarkov, but there should still be some supplies left on the Icebreaker. Go take a look, check the helipad and storage areas. Anything you find in cans, bring it back to me. You've got your own interest in this too, so you won't be doing it for nothing. And if you manage to pull together a decent stock, I'll even pay extra.

== Requirements ==
Hand over the hard drives from compartment C-1 on Icebreaker to Mechanic in the Boreas story chapter.

== Objectives ==
Find 5 AMG-10 hydraulic fluid in raid
Hand over the items

330,000 Roubles
346,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
379,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks barter for Kalashnikov AK-308 7.62x51 assault rifle at Prapor LL1
Alright, you handled that job well. I'll give you that. Maybe things between us will keep going smooth, just don't forget your reputation and don't even think about screwing me over. You're dismissed for now, soldier.

== Guide ==

quests.title: Oil Run
objectivesKo: 세관(Customs)에서 아무 유조차에 MS2000 마커 부착하기
quests.content:
Oil Run is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello there, drifter! Good timing. I've been scratching my head over a little problem. Word came in about a job: scout out an area where there might still be some fuel left. You know how valuable that stuff is. Not exactly something I'd trust just anyone with. Anyway, you've worked with strobe markers before, right? Couldn't be simpler. Stick it somewhere out of sight, press the button, and walk away. Got it? All that's left is to find one of the fuel tankers and mark it. Here, take a beacon. Think of it as a little bonus for working with me. Just don't lose it. If you need more, you'll be paying for them.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark any of the fuel tank trucks with an MS2000 Marker on Customs

quests.title: Old Patterns
quests.content:
Old Patterns is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
We did a great work together with the new gear line! Just like back in the old days when business was booming and cash was rolling in. By the way, I got an idea for a special cut to make pants pockets bigger. You want me to try it out on yours? Then you'll have to pay for them. The patterns are pretty old and expensive. You can't do that from memory!

This quest is not available to owners of the "The Unheard" edition of the game.

+2 pocket slots
:

quests.title: One Less Loose End
quests.content:
One Less Loose End is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, dear friend. There's an important job just for someone like you. You need to pick up a journal from the TerraGroup field lab at the Polikhim factory and drop it off at a specified location. It's at an old sawmill in Priozersk nature reserve. Leave the package at the house with transformers. I don't want to upset my influential customer, so I can't trust a random person with the job.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the lab journal on Factory
Stash the journal at the old sawmill on Woods

550 Dollars

3× CPU fan
Unlocks purchase of SIG MPX 9x19 submachine gun (variant Silenced) at Peacekeeper LL2
Great! You know the saying "What happens in Vegas, stays in Vegas"? Everyone has their secrets, and prying into those secrets might be too dangerous...

== Failure Dialogue ==
Are you sure you did the right thing, mercenary? My client won't stand for it, and I'd recommend you look over your shoulder more often from now on. Don't count on me for protection.

In this quest you first have to locate and obtain a journal in Factory. Afterwards it has to be stashed on Woods.

quests.title: One-Way Ticket
quests.content:
One-Way Ticket is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. Things have been going very well between us. That is why I would like to involve you in one... complicated task. My men attempted to pass through the Factory, but they were not allowed through. They all died. Now I must fill out a great deal of paperwork and request reinforcements... And we must also punish those responsible. I do not know exactly who was responsible for the deaths of my men, so engage everyone you encounter. And make your shots count, headshots only. I want the enemy to understand that this was not a coincidence.

Eliminate 15 targets with headshots while using an AUG on Factory

Good day to you, merc! Wanna become a respected member of Tarkov's fine society? Then you'll have to do some business with me, Wanna do some trading, perhaps? Or you can help me out with a few little tasks. There's always work to be found. Well, I'll do my best to find some for you, at least.

quests.title: Operation Aquarius
quests.content:
Operation Aquarius is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon, young man. You came at just the right time. I have a job with a very generous payout. Interested? I'm sure you are aware that our region has a serious drinking water problem. It was recently discovered that the aquifers have been contaminated. But do not worry, my team and I are already working on a solution. I need you for something else. Certain people have decided to profit from everyone else's misfortune. I know one gang has stockpiled all the clean water they could get their hands on in the Dorms area. I'm sure you know where that is. Now they are selling it behind my back while innocent people suffer! Bring me that water.

== Objectives ==
Locate the water stockpile hidden inside one of the dorms rooms on Customs
Hand over 3 any found in raid drinking water items

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Excellent work! Share the profits with you..? Surely you don't think I'm going to sell the water. This is purely a humanitarian effort!

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find the hidden water on Customs. It can be found in room 206 on the second floor of the two-story dorms building. A Dorm room 206 key is required to enter it. You also need to hand over 3 water drinking items found in raid to Therapist.

quests.title: Order From Outside
quests.content:
Order From Outside is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Surely you don't think I would be interested in petty local conflicts? I have much more important matters to attend to, and I am not going to help either of the parties. Speaking of which. I need to move an item from point A to point B. It is hidden at the electromechanical warehouse in the airspace control center at the military base. It's to be delivered to the Priozersk nature reserve. The landmark will be a small cemetery. You'll recognize it by the stretchers and the bodies around it -- not everyone has been buried in time. Since my cargo is very specific, some people may have a particular interest in it. That is why I need someone who can guarantee the safety of the cargo during transportation.

== Objectives ==

Stash the device at the specified location on Woods

quests.title: Our Own Land
quests.content:
Our Own Land is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, comrade. Come on in, come on in. And lock the door behind you. Gonna have a serious talk... It's time to show everyone whose land we're standing on and who's the boss around here. Because there are already more of these tourists than us - everything that's left in Tarkov has been plundered. They turned Norvink region into some garbage lot. You agree, right? It's not even about the money, it's about driving those fuckers out from our own land! Although I will make it worth your while anyway, as always. Start by clearing the area near the Lighthouse, and then we will throw them out of our other territories. So, are you in?

This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

Ours by Right was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Okay, I got word of a major fuck-up. It may not be your fault, but that's beside the point. The assholes at the water treatment plant intercepted a bunch of these crates with portable EW equipment in them. They're obviously useless at this point, but I'm not gonna let them steal government property like this. For a warrior like you, the task is feasible. Go to the WTP and get me those EW thingies. And yes, those rats need to be put down. The EWs themselves have probably already been handed over to their commanders, so you're guaranteed to get this equipment from them. Assuming you don't die, I suppose.

quests.title: Out of Curiosity
quests.content:
Out of Curiosity is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Young man, I cannot stand aside on this one. I'm aware that you are now working with this so-called Skier. This disreputable man pursues completely lucrative interests and that is a matter of great concern to me. Especially all this story with secret experiments on a substance that you call the yellow chemical. The substance is extremely dangerous, and I have a major request for you, could you give up the coordinates of the chemicals to me? Yes, I'm aware of all the details of your adventures with the Skier. I would come up with good payment for that. Again, this is all just for the sake of our people.

== Objectives ==
Locate the transport with the chemicals on Customs
Mark the vehicle with an MS2000 Marker

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
1× Medicine case
1× Document case
2× Salewa first aid kit
1× Aluminum splint
1× CMS surgical kit
Wonderful! I can already see how that nasty grin fades from the Skier's face. He will definitely be unhappy with you, but you acted for the good of the civilian population, so there is no need to be upset. Let this reagent be under the control of competent people, I will take care of the transportation. Your share, as agreed. You made the right choice.

== Failure Dialogue ==
I have nothing to say. It scares me to think of who and why might need this chemical.

== Guide ==
By completing either Chemical - Part 4 or Big Customer, you will fail and lose access to this quest.

You can buy the MS2000 Marker from Prapor.
After placing the marker, the player must stay alive for 30 seconds or they will have to place another beacon in the van. You do not need to be near the van after the marker has been placed. Find a nearby hiding spot and wait until the timer is complete.

You can buy additional MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death. However, unlike most quests that require you to mark an object, this one does require that you survive after placement. In the event of death, you will need to acquire another and re-place.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

Mercenary, I have a job for you. At the former USEC base belonging to your associates in the chalet area at Cape Dalniy, a large amount of valuable equipment and information was left behind after the conflict. This could help fund our operations. But there is one problem: the entire area is currently under enemy control. We need to eliminate them permanently, or at least temporarily remove the threat. While you are there, search the location for documents and bring them to me. That is your task, my friend. Naturally, everything you have heard will remain between us. I await your report.

quests.title: Paramedic
quests.content:
Paramedic is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Young man, I have a task that suits your area of expertise. A friend of mine, a paramedic still early in his career, recently told me a disturbing story. Just before the catastrophe, he was transporting patients with unexplained symptoms, almost as if there had been an outbreak of a new disease. At the hospitals, unfamiliar individuals would take them away and transfer them to private wards. The young man managed to photograph their observation logs while they were collecting another patient. However, in the midst of the catastrophe, he dropped his smartphone containing all the data. He says they were on their way to pick up another patient near the Concordia residential complex. For everyone's sake, please find this phone for me. The paramedic will be waiting for you under the protection of my people, inside an SUV on Primorsky Avenue, and he will confirm its authenticity. I sincerely hope I can count on you, young man.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the ambulance paramedic's smartphone on Streets of Tarkov
Extract from Streets of Tarkov through Primorsky Ave Taxi V-Ex
Hand over the smartphone

Yes, I've heard the report, this is what we've been looking for. My men will begin retrieving the information immediately. And you, young man, are free to go. Thank you for your help.

Wanna hear something hilarious? People suddenly became interested in all this Christmas stuff now: hats, white beards, all that. Whol the hell would need that in war times? quests.title: Passion for Ergonomics
quests.content:
Passion for Ergonomics is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. Do you know the feeling when you change the layout of your instrument in a seemingly insignificant way and it fundamentally changes the working comfort? The Pareto principle, right. I had a friend who was the epitome of that concept. He was always tweaking something, filing, sanding a part to win a few millimeters.... His experience made me realize how important ergonomics is in any job. I have not heard from him in a while, but I know one of his outlets, it was either a sort of car service or a workshop, right in the garage complex. He always loved cars, especially the American ones. Can you come and check the place out? He probably moved somewhere else a long time ago, but his garage might still contain some of his tools or blueprints.

== Objectives ==

Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP

Hmm... He would never let his car burn down willingly. Something must have happened there. A car mechanic's death would be just an imperceptible blip in the death toll on the Tarkov scale. But hopefully he was able to make it out and find safety. Maybe we'll see each other again.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find the customized tool set at the garage complex Customs. It can be found in garage #11. There are multiple spawns throughout the garage.

quests.title: Patch the Vulnerability
quests.prerequisites: My Blood Type Mark is on the Sleeve
quests.content:
Patch the Vulnerability was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. You've undoubtedly heard what's been happening at TerraGroup's underground facility beneath the city. I never thought I'd be asking you to do this, but… we need to eliminate this vulnerability and reinforce the laboratory's security protocols. If we don't intervene, countless PMC mercenaries and bandits could unknowingly walk out of that facility carrying extremely dangerous materials. It's happened before, and Tarkov has never truly recovered from the consequences. Restoring keycard-only access is the safer options. I've already asked Elektronik for help, but without a stable connection to the facility's secure network, we won't be able to make any changes. I need you to attach these remote intrusion devices to any electronic systems that may be tied into the laboratory's security infrastructure. Don't waste your time in the server room. We already know we can't modify the security protocols from there. And if you encounter the soldiers in black, do what you can to disrupt their work. They may have ties to TerraGroup, and I doubt that bodes well for any of us.

== Objectives ==
Plant a signal jammer in the system admin's office in The Lab
Plant a signal jammer in the garage gate control room in The Lab
Plant a signal jammer in the central security monitoring room in The Lab
Eliminate 10 Black Division operatives

Excellent work. It will take us some time to remove every function tied to the emergency access code. Until then, you still have a window to recover whatever medical supplies or equipment you need from the sealed sections before they're locked down again.

quests.title: Pay the Fare!
quests.content:
Pay the Fare! is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Sup, brother! Heard you've started taking boat rides somewhere with the smugglers. You planning to get out of Tarkov by water or something? Hope you know about the naval blockade... And I hope you're not counting on the smugglers' boats being in perfect condition. If you really need to travel by water on their boats, you won't get far without the right tools. I'm telling you that straight, unlike those guys. But you're in luck, ahper! My guys recently cracked open one of the railcars headed either to the port or the Norvinsky pier, and what do you know, it was packed with special repair kits for watercraft! All kinds of patches, sealants, and other stuff. I think you know where I'm going with this, huh? Let's help each other out, and we'll both come out ahead. I could really use some of the tools that aren't included in those kits.

== Requirements ==

Now that's the kind of deal I like. As long as people have something to trade, guys like you and me will always come out on top! Here are your kits. And if you need more, you know who to come to.

== Guide ==

quests.title: Payback
quests.content:
Payback is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Well, the situation became plain enough. This group of hotshots is, as it turns out, run by Glukhar, an ex-marine who settled at the Reserve base with his crew. That's where he took the documents you planted. Who'd have thought he'd have the nerve to undermine me? Well, he signed his own sentence. Hunt them down and settle the matter. When it's done, give a signal with a flare rocket from high ground, and I'll send men to their lair to sort out their junk. We need to find out what else they've been digging up. As soon as you've fired the signal, you take the shortest possible route straight to me.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize Glukhar or his guards for 4 kills total on Reserve (In one raid)
(Optional) Bring a yellow signal flare into raid
Shoot a yellow signal flare at the radar station on Reserve (In one raid)
Survive and extract from Reserve through Cliff Descent (In one raid)
Note: The "Flare" objective will appear after the "Neutralize" objective is completed.

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.03
1× Microcontroller board
3× LEDX Skin Transilluminator
1× Substation marked key
Unlocks purchase of DevTac Ronin Respirator at Ragman LL4
Saw the signal, great job. I advise you not to go to the base while my men are out there working.

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to kill Glukhar or his guards for 4 kills total. Next, you have to shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being at the radar station area on Reserve. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. Finally, you have to extract via the "Cliff Descent" extraction. To use it, a Red Rebel ice pick and Paracord are required and you must not wear any Armor vest.

quests.title: Peaceful Atom
quests.content:
Peaceful Atom is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings. I have an urgent assignment for you. You are not yet aware of the situation, so I will need to provide some context. However, everything I am about to disclose is top secret, understood? There is a secured facility within the blockade perimeter that is of interest to my contacts in the nuclear energy sector. The issue is that it is an icebreaker ship, currently stranded in the bay. To access it, you will need to acquire suitable transport, and it is preferable to do so quietly. No one must know that the vessel is present in Tarkov's waters at all! Once you secure transport, you are to retrieve operational documentation from the ship. Search the engineering sections, there should be a logbook for the nuclear power unit control system. Do not, under any circumstances, disclose this task to anyone.

Hand over the found item

You have the logbook? I trust you avoided drawing attention on your way back. I will arrange your reward through my associates. One more thing: I strongly advise against returning to the Icebreaker. According to my sources, it has already come under the control of some special unit. You would not survive an engagement with them.

Have you seen the news? Recently, media have been pushing the agenda that \"the Blue Helmets are not doing their job in Tarkov, do not follow the procedures\" and so forth... Those damn bastards, kurwa! I hate these journalist scumbags. We are one step away from losing financing, which, my friend, is the opposite of profitable for us. So, we need to convince the public that the helmets are actually doing what they promised to do. You must address the issue of eliminating the illegal bandit group activities but do so under the UN flag. I’ll give you the initial set of equipment you'll need, but if you lose it, don't come asking for more.

Come in, have a seat. You know how angry the local scum makes me, especially the damn looters, I can't stand them. Somebody steals from others to survive, but some do it for profit, and there are especially plenty of the latter ones in Tarkov. Take the military base, for example. I've been there before this whole conflict, it was such a beautiful sight: everything is clean, in order, the ground is almost glittering under the sun. And now the whole place is filled with all sorts of scum and marauders. I have a request for you: go there and let those looters know that you have to stay human in any situation.

quests.content:
Pharmacist is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I want to ask you for a service. Don't put up that look, of course, it's not for free! In a small dorm, yes, the one inhabited by those bandits, somewhere on the first floor used to live a young paramedic from the factory. Unfortunately, I do not know the room number - when my colleagues and I were his guests on the Medical Worker Day, it was already dark, and in the middle of a party, you see. Well, he was a young specialist, still an intern, but very enthusiastic. Planned to enroll in the Military Medical Academy in St. Petersburg. And in his safe, right there in the room, he kept a case with the particular new medical device. Issued to him by the employer. He tried to get out of town on his blue VAZ 2109 with St. Petersburg plates. I don't know if he managed to get out or not, but as far as I have heard, he either got stuck near the gas station or apprehended by the military. In any case, I could really put that tool to good use. Come the darkest hour, and you might need it as well. Not that I wish for that to happen, don’t get me wrong, but... I assume you understand everything better than I. I need you to find it. Oh yes, I almost forgot, we have common interests with Arshavir in this matter. He has a good product for you. After you complete the task, of course.

quests.title: Playing the Market
quests.content:
Playing the Market is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Someone decided to crash the market recently. Dumped a massive batch of bitcoins, enough for TARGox to start filling orders at ten times below the usual market price. You could watch the order queue disappearing in real time. I barely managed to grab a couple hundred coins before it was over. And today the price is back where it was before. If the market is going to stay this heavily manipulated, we need to move fast while the opportunity is still there. There are control panels in the Polikhim factory, marked by red emergency lights. Take a couple of toolkits and repair the panels while I deal with the cooling system. Do that, and you'll get a share of the profits.

== Objectives ==
Fix the first control board with a Toolset on Factory
Fix the second control board with a Toolset on Factory

165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2

You're quicker than I expected. Nicely done. I'm almost finished with the cooling system on my end.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to repair 2 control boards with 2 Toolsets in Factory. They can be recognized by blinking red lights. It is recommended to repair them in separate raids, carrying the toolsets in your secure container. If you have a Secure container Epsilon or a Secure container Theta, you can safely place 2 per raid.

Poisoning was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

Good afternoon, young man. More and more patients come to me with abnormal fevers. I've never seen anything like this in my practice, but the symptoms are somewhat similar to poisoning. All the patients are from the Customs industrial area. Look for the source of where it originated. If you see anything suspicious, set up a gas analyzer to collect data. Then give me the coordinates of the location. My men will pick up the device later.

quests.title: Polikhim Hobo
quests.content:
Polikhim Hobo is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The bum from Polikhim? What am I, the bloody king of every stray in Tarkov now?! Alright, I know who you're talking about, same as everyone else who's lived here. He wasn't a bad bloke, but he lost the plot when all this mess kicked off. You're looking for him, are you? I can help you out, but not out of the goodness of my heart. The Scavs have been getting under my feet lately, making things difficult. Go give them a proper scare, and then I'll tell you what I know. Here's the list of places that need clearing.

Eliminate 25 Scavs on Interchange, Ground Zero or Woods

+3,000 EXP

450 Euros

Your bum was staying by the train tracks, in a wagon near the boiler building. There's a bunker nearby as well, right by the tracks. My lads used to see him in that carriage all the time.

quests.title: Population Census
quests.content:
Population Census is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon, mercenary. You're just in time, I have an errand for you. I need to determine how many people have gone missing in the city. To do this, I need a list of all the residents of the city and subtract the already evacuated, the dead, and those who found shelter in the hospital. Your task is to find that list of residents. Bring me the journal from Primorsky District's Housing Department.

== Objectives ==
Obtain the journal containing resident details on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the journal

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
36,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
40,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2

Mercenary, you know firsthand how many lives are lost in war. But you have no idea how many die not from a bullet or a knife, but by going missing. Some are buried in the concrete in their own home after the bombing. Someone died in their basement from exhaustion because they couldn't find food. Someone was swallowed by infection because they didn't have the necessary medicine and couldn't get to a hospital because of constant shelling... And there are at least fifteen percent of people like that in this journal.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find a journal in the housing department building on Streets of Tarkov. There are multiple spawns throughout the building.

Housing department marked on map
Housing department building backside with entrance

quests.title: Possessor
quests.content:
Possessor is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, warrior! You've probably seen a crashed chopper at the factory before, yeah? I wonder when and how it ended up there. But I know one thing for sure: they never sent helis to Tarkov to pick up anyone, neither before nor now. We should find out who was on that helicopter and what was their mission. You should go scout that heli. There's gotta be a logbook or something.

Hand over the found information

+10,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1

Haha! I knew you were the right merc for the job. The helicopter doesn't appear to be Russian, but that's only at first glance. It looks like our undercover operatives infiltrated the USECs and captured one of them! If there are no bodies near the helicopter, it means that the boys managed to escape, and the task was accomplished.

The logbook is located in the cockpit of the crashed helicopter under the roof on Factory, below the pilot seat.

quests.title: Postman Pat - Part 1
quests.content:
Postman Pat - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come on in, make yourself at home. How's the life of constant battle? No extra preternatural holes in your hide? Jolly good. No freaking use for them, eh? I’m in a bit of a tight unpleasant spot here. Will you help me out? My messenger vanished. I entrusted a job for this local waste of skin, he played so tough. In short, I’ve sent a little note to Therapist with some proposals for a mutually beneficial cooperation. Nothing special, but nothing outsiders should know either. And so this meat sack went missing, and a little bird told me that this postman got whacked somewhere in the Factory. Why the heck would he go there, that moron? Told him to take the straight path. So anyway, find the body and check it, my scribbles might still be there. And if by some miracle they are, hand them to that medic woman, will ya?

== Objectives ==
Locate the dead messenger and obtain his letter on Factory
Survive and extract from the location
Hand over the letter to Therapist

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Now that’s what it means to work with proven man! Said, done!

== Guide ==

The dead messenger is located in a bunker on the main floor of Factory. For orientation, the number "1986" can be seen painted above the bunker on the wall. The letter can be found next to his body on the ground.

The letter must be handed over to Therapist for her quest Postman Pat - Part 2 before this quest can be completed.

Bunker location marked on map
The wanted bunker, "1986" on the wall above it
The letter on the ground

== Trivia ==
The quest name is a reference to the British children's TV show "Postman Pat."

quests.title: Preemptive Strike
quests.content:
Preemptive Strike was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I already know what's going on, no need to tell me. Elvira is "doing what's best for people" again, obviously up to something again... But those who are thinking about working for Skier have already shown their weakness. In these situations, fear works much better than charity handouts. I've asked Partisan to look at those checkpoints. There are four places: Emercom camp at the military base, the flooded village near the water treatment plant, the old cattle farm near the health resort, and some kind of construction site near the customs district, which my comrade couldn't get to. They are going to bring supplies and the recruited people there. The recruiters themselves are already in place, they don't differ from the usual Skier's mob. Partisan has other things to do right now, no less important. That's why we need your help: remove the recruiters at their gathering points. That way the residents will think three times before coming there for aid.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 12 Scavs at Skier's charity checkpoints

== Rewards ==
+10,500 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.03
72,000 Roubles
75,600 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
82,800 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Metal fuel tank
You cleared all the spots? Good. Let's see how it affects the overall situation. For now, I'm waiting to hear from Partisan, he's still out scouting. Come back later, it's best not to make any unnecessary moves right now.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 12 Scavs at Skier's charity checkpoints. They are located on Shoreline, Customs and Woods.

== Shoreline ==
In and around the smuggler base in the northeast.

Smuggler base location marked on map

== Customs ==
In and around the Scav base (ZB-1013 extraction) building.

Kill area marked on map

quests.title: Preliminary Survey
quests.content:
Preliminary Survey was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You're familiar with the Lab, right? Me too... My guys just don't have much luck there. But that's a whole other story! There's a testing area in that lab, you know, the one with all the different fencing and that dome they put together. I need a blueprint of that area. Obviously, they didn't keep something like that on paper, so you'll have to look for a flash drive. Think you can get it? I've got something I want to pull off, but I can't tell you much just yet. Just get it done, and we'll work out the price, champion.

== Objectives ==
Locate the testing area blueprint flash drive in The Lab
Obtain the testing area blueprint flash drive in The Lab

== Rewards ==
+14,500 EXP
+1 Search skill level
185 GP coins
195 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
213 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
Got it done? Excellent! And I still can't tell you anything. You'll see for yourself soon enough!

The wanted flash drive

quests.title: Preserve a Valuable Piece
quests.prerequisites: Accept Cut Down to the Root
quests.content:
Preserve a Valuable Piece is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The Rogues' retreat to the chalets was the only correct move given the situation they found themselves in. And I'm quite satisfied with the new balance of power on my territory. But I know some people want to destroy the Rogues completely, removing one of the factions from the conflict. That cannot be allowed. So, if you're interested in strengthening your position at the lighthouse, you may take part in their defense. You don't need to enter the chalets themselves. The Rogues will shoot at you as well. But I'm willing to pay for eliminating PMC operatives in this part of the coast. Just don't work against me.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 7 PMC operatives on Lighthouse

== Rewards ==
+40,000 EXP
1× Substation marked key
It's good that you managed to avoid any surprises. Without your involvement, the Rogues would've had a much harder time surviving those first few weeks.

== Failure Dialogue ==
It's surprising that you decided to come here after the choice you made. If your disobedience had led to serious consequences, Zryachiy would've intercepted you by now. But I never intended to rely heavily on a mercenary like you in the first place. You needn't come unless there's an urgent reason. I'll entrust serious work to others.

== Guide ==
By completing Cut Down to the Root, you fail and will lose access to this quest.

quests.title: Pressured by Circumstances
quests.content:
Pressured by Circumstances was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
It's tough everywhere right now, I know. Have you ever been fascinated by this human ability to adapt to any condition? I think it's what made man the pinnacle of evolution. But to feel like you're slowly getting used to the crowds of infected people in your hometown... It makes me sick. The demand for firearms has increased tremendously, and I'm thinking that if this epidemic drags on, there will be only handguns left in the stockpiles. Can you test to see how effective they are in the current environment?

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 25 infected while using pistols or revolvers on Factory

== Rewards ==
+50,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.03
Jaeger Rep +0.01
300,000 Roubles
315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× 5.45x39mm BS gs ammo pack (120 pcs)
2× 5.56x45mm SSA AP ammo pack (100 pcs)
It turns out you can survive even with a weapon like this, if you have the skills. But I'm not sure there's enough shooters of your caliber in the city. I hope we don't need your proven tactics. But it's best to prepare for the worst-case scenario.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 25 infected on Factory while using a pistol or a revolver.

Infected PMC

quests.title: Price for Information
quests.content:
Price for Information is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
They aren't ordinary mercenaries. They play an important role in what's happening now and what will happen later. But I'm not going to tell you more than you need to know. You've already crossed paths with them. Obviously, you want to influence something. But you won't change anything this way. You'll only become another one of their targets. I propose a different arrangement. Correct your mistakes with your own hands, and perhaps I'll share the information you're looking for. First, we need to clear one route. Follow the route from the coast to the woods through the military base and eliminate any potential threats along the way. But if you see Black Division, do not engage them under any circumstances.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Use the transit from Shoreline to Lighthouse (In one raid)
Use the transit from Lighthouse to Reserve (In one raid)
Use the transit from Reserve to Woods (In one raid)
Eliminate any 10 targets except Black Division while completing the other objectives

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
1× RB-VO marked key
Do you really still not understand, or do you simply refuse to believe what you're seeing? USEC were a tool for TerraGroup from the very beginning. And like any tool, they lost their value once they had served their purpose. But unlike them, Black Division answer directly to those who shape the course of events in the world. And I'm not talking about TerraGroup's managers. The corporation's facilities in Tarkov no longer need protection. The city requires a more precise instrument to surgically remove everything that has no place here. And I wouldn't advise you to interfere with the operation.

== Guide ==
== Shoreline to Lighthouse ==
In front of the Path to Lighthouse extraction.

== Lighthouse to Reserve ==
On the road leading to the Road to Military Base V-Ex extraction.

== Reserve to Woods transit ==
At the map border northwest of the train yard.

quests.title: Private Clinic
quests.content:
Private Clinic was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good day, young man. As a doctor, I think that the Hippocratic oath must be respected even in such a difficult time. So, I have got an idea to open a clinic. Health care is always important and even more so in these circumstances. But where do I get the necessary equipment?  I will give you a list of what I need you to bring. And I don't need competition, so make sure you complete the job with no third parties involved. Of course, I will find a way to reward you for your work.

== Requirements ==
Must be level 35 to start this quest.

== Objectives ==
Find 1 Ophthalmoscope in raid
Find 1 LEDX Skin Transilluminator in raid
Hand over the 1 Ophthalmoscope
Hand over the 1 LEDX Skin Transilluminator

== Rewards ==
+30,600 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.05
130,000 Roubles
136,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
149,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 3
1× T H I C C item case
1× Health Resort east wing room 306 key
Did you bring it? Great, put it all down there in the corner. Careful, the equipment is very fragile.  Even if the whole clinic thing fails, I know some people who may be interested in this equipment, but that’s between you and me. Why waste such expensive hardware?

quests.title: Private Club
quests.content:
Private Club is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Opachki, would you look at this little character. You got any ibuprofen? My noggin's fucking killing me. What, something wrong, princess? Yes, I got hammered last night, so what? It was a major league game! They wouldn't let a twat like you anywhere near that table. Sometimes we get together to test our luck, but yesterday clearly wasn't my day. Not only did I lose a shitload of money, but also my fucking wallet. You're here for work, ye? Here, I'll give you a fucking job. Find my wallet. And don't even try any bullshit, I'd recognize mine with my eyes closed. We were at Warehouse 17 near the customs terminal, that's where I last seen it. Second floor, mate.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain Skier's wallet on Customs
Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.1
450 Euros
472 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
518 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
Proper good fucking job mate! I knew it couldn't just vanish into thin air like that. We have some kind of connection, you and I. This little baby is like a lucky charm for me. When I bought this wallet, things went booming for me. I've gotten it lost a thousand times since then, but it always comes back to me.

1× Lega Medal
You did well, took them down like puppies! I think you've got potential.

quests.title: Profit Retention
quests.content:
Profit Retention is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Luka and his boys repelled those thugs, he said it was a tough fight. And guess what, there's still no sign of the military, the thugs were definitely in on it with them. I guess you can find someone like our Prapor even beyond the cordon, huh? The only issues left are the good ones. They're ready to send a shipment from the other side, but it doesn't fit any of the old schemes. It's a wagonload of equipment! To get it all out, my mate demands a special fee, all in advance. The risks are too fucking high, so we have to pay. This bastard's got a bitcoin farm over there, I reckon.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Hand over the item: 30 Graphics card
Hand over the item: 15 Physical Bitcoin

== Rewards ==
+1 Crafting skill level
+1 Hideout Management skill level
+1 Perception skill level
+1 Attention skill level
+1 Search skill level
+1 Immunity skill level
+1 Health skill level
+1 Surgery skill level
+1 Vitality skill level
+1 Stress Resistance skill level
All right, get your stash ready. Our money's on its way.

== Guide ==

quests.title: Profitable Venture
quests.content:
Profitable Venture is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I've got an opportunity on the table right now, and it could be seriously profitable. But I need a reliable partner, and you could be just the bloke for it. I got talking with one commander, his squad is made up entirely of veterans. But the lads were abroad when all this shit kicked off. They still want to work though, and they say they've got a lead on an abandoned USEC base somewhere in the region. The problem is, some bunch of nobodies have already taken over the place. If we do this properly, Luka and his lads will be able to keep supplying us with gear and other hard-to-find stuff on a regular basis. They want to go in for reconnaissance at night, so we don't cause a stir. You know how it is, those are quiet areas and there's too much attention we don't need. But the lads don't have any thermal optics, so they asked me to get some from here, that way nobody can trace it back to them. If you want in on this business, now's the time!

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 15 Trijicon REAP-IR thermal scopes

== Rewards ==
+1 Stress Resistance skill level
+1 Perception skill level
+1 Attention skill level
+1 Aim Drills skill level
+1 Light Vests skill level
+1 Heavy Vests skill level
+1 Weapon Maintenance skill level
+1 Troubleshooting skill level
Not a cheap investment, but you'll make it back later! The lads gave me the contact of a local special forces instructor. The bloke's retired, but he knows things they never taught you in your overseas training! Consider it a little bonus from our partnership.

== Guide ==

== See also ==
Safety Guarantee - The BEAR counterpart quest

quests.title: Progression Difficulties - Part 1
quests.content:
Progression Difficulties - Part 1 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello again. Did you play it? How was it? I hope we didn't waste our time looking for that game. Huh? You're stuck? A password? Just look in the game bro. Nothing? Hm... Alright. Hand me the disk. I'll look again on the phone and the diary. There might be something.

== Objectives ==
Hand over the drive with the game

== Rewards ==
+2,500 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.01
10,500 Roubles
11,025 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
12,075 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Can of white salt
1× Electric drill
1× Sewing kit
1× Expeditionary fuel tank
Come back later. I'll check it out and let you know what I find.

== Guide ==

quests.title: Progression Difficulties - Part 2
quests.content:
Progression Difficulties - Part 2 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So, I progressed to the same stage you did. Honestly? It feels weird. It's like it's all done on purpose. Like there's a hidden layer, you know? My friend clearly went missing for a reason. And it seems like some pretty powerful people had a hand in it. I think he knew what was coming, so he set up these fool traps in his game. Looks like they tried to smuggle it out of Tarkov along with the military records. They were transferred to flash drives and encrypted. Find a few of those flash drives, and decrypt the data. It'll have the word you're looking for. And something important to me.

== Requirements ==
Unlocks 2 hours after completion of Progression Difficulties - Part 1

== Objectives ==
Hand over the item: Decrypted intelligence folder

== Rewards ==
+29,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.01
112,000 Roubles
117,600 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
128,800 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Kalashnikov AK-101 5.56x45 assault rifle
2× AK-101 5.56x45 6L29 30-round magazine
1× 5.56x45mm M855A1 ammo pack (100 pcs)
This password... What a game you've remembered, Nikita. All right, everything went smoothly. You got your word, and I got what I needed.

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks craft for Decrypted intelligence folder at Intelligence Center level 1.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to hand over the Decrypted intelligence folder to Mechanic. To obtain it, multiple military thumb drives need to be decrypted at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. It is possible that the decryption process fails and yields no progress at all, making the total amount of required thumb drives variable.

== Trivia ==
The password "TETRIANDOCH" which gets discovered in the decryption process, is a direct reference to the game "Gothic 1", in which it is also required to get past a guard.

quests.title: Project of the Century (Consequences)
quests.content:
Project of the Century (Consequences) was a community goal Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I've already given you your assignment, but there's something else. Killing a few of those pricks won't stop them from coming back. We've got to stay ahead of them and keep the pressure on. If you're willing to help, your gun won't go to waste. Take out as many as you can. The faster we clear the area, the sooner we can get the fights underway. And hey, same rules as before: wear the armband, and don't shoot your own people!

== Objectives ==
Eliminate PMC operatives at the smuggler's camp while wearing an ARENA armband on Shoreline
: Note:  The objective in the PvE mode is to eliminate PMC operatives while wearing an ARENA armband on Shoreline
Eliminate PMC operatives at the dorms while wearing an ARENA armband on Customs
: Note:  The objective in the PvE mode is to eliminate PMC operatives while wearing an ARENA armband on Customs
Eliminate PMC operatives at the EMERCOM camp while wearing an ARENA armband on Woods
: Note:  The objective in the PvE mode is to eliminate PMC operatives while wearing an ARENA armband on Woods

== Rewards ==
+12,000 EXP
75 GP coins
78 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
86 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Equipment crate (Rare)
1× Weapon crate (Rare)
1× Valuables crate (Rare)
Well then gladiator, your help came at just the right time! The matches will be starting very soon.

== Failure Dialogue ==
It's a miracle you've survived in Tarkov this long while picking allies that fucking stupid... I warned you about all the risks. You're not getting a reward. Now get out of my sight!

== Guide ==

PvP: In this quest you have to kill as many PMCs as you can or want at the dorms on Customs, at the smuggler camp on Shoreline and at the EMERCOM camp on Woods, while wearing an Armband (ARENA).

PvE: In this quest you have to kill as many PMCs as you can or want anywhere on Customs, Shoreline or Woods, while wearing an Armband (ARENA).

Smuggler's camp location on Shoreline
Dorms location on Customs
EMERCOM camp location on Woods

== Trivia ==
This is a community goal quest. Along with the results from Wolf's Grip (Consequences), the values of kills for each objective have determined which locations became available as Arena maps sooner.

After the end of the event, the exact results and final numbers were not published, but the location "Base" was added to Arena, shortly followed by "EMERCOM". The "Dorms" location was said to be coming later.

quests.title: Project of the Century (Finale)
quests.content:
Project of the Century (Finale) was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Tell me something, why the hell are these locals so attached to their ruins, huh? We could all be making money together instead of wasting time on this nonsense... Problems have popped up at all three construction sites, and now Skier's started stirring things up too. Then again, I never really trusted that alliance in the first place. I'm not stupid. Time to go back to the old reliable methods. You already know where my camps are. Jaeger's been sending his wookie warriors after them, and we need to hit back hard enough that they run straight back into the bushes. And remember, you can actually influence how quickly we get these venues up and running! I've hired a few other professionals for this job as well, so try not to shoot them. Put on one of our armbands too, so the boys know you're friendly. And remember: if you start backing the forester, I'll find out immediately.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 2 PMC operatives at the EMERCOM camp while wearing an ARENA armband on Woods
: Note:  The objective in the PvE mode is to eliminate 2 PMC operatives while wearing an ARENA armband on Woods
Eliminate 2 PMC operatives at the smuggler's camp while wearing an ARENA armband on Shoreline
: Note:  The objective in the PvE mode is to eliminate 2 PMC operatives while wearing an ARENA armband on Shoreline
Eliminate 2 PMC operatives at the dorms while wearing an ARENA armband on Customs
: Note:  The objective in the PvE mode is to eliminate 2 PMC operatives while wearing an ARENA armband on Customs

== Rewards ==
== PvP mode ==
+17,000 EXP
75 GP coins
79 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
86 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Echo Belli crate

== PvE mode ==
+17,000 EXP
200 GP coins
210 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
230 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Equipment crate (Rare)
1× Weapon crate (Rare)
1× Valuables crate (Rare)
Now that's what I'm talking about! We didn't hold every position, but we managed to beat back those forest defenders. It'll take some extra time to recover our losses and finish construction at a few of the sites, but without you we'd have been in real trouble. Once these arenas are ready, make sure you stop by. I'll have something waiting for you as a thank-you.

== Failure Dialogue ==
It's a miracle you've survived in Tarkov this long while picking allies that fucking stupid... I warned you about all the risks. You're not getting a reward. Now get out of my sight!

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks purchase of Armband (ARENA) at Ref LL1.

== Guide ==

PvP: In this quest you have to kill 2 PMCs each at the dorms on Customs, at the smuggler camp on Shoreline and at the EMERCOM camp on Woods, while wearing an Armband (ARENA).

PvE: In this quest you have to kill 2 PMCs each anywhere on Customs, Shoreline or Woods, while wearing an Armband (ARENA).

EMERCOM camp location on Woods
