Dorms location on Customs

quests.title: Proper Comeback
quests.content:
Proper Comeback is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You're a good guy, I'll tell you that. I wouldn't trust another man to do this, but you're an experienced fellow, you understand what I'm saying. I heard that Prapor is now into modern technology, and he's got cameras everywhere, watching everything from his man cave. And recently he ruined one of my deals, started yelling like a damn rooster, something about the rules of trade and military order... We have to show him what a motherfucker he's become. Oops, sorry for the offensive language. Hope it doesn't disrespect your community guidelines.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

== Objectives ==
Stash a Golden rooster figurine at Prapor's WI-FI Camera on Woods
Stash a Golden rooster figurine at Prapor's WI-FI Camera on Shoreline
Stash a Golden rooster figurine at Prapor's WI-FI Camera on Factory

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
2,400 Euros
2,520 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,760 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Golden egg
2× Tetriz portable game console
Well done! They say that even the outside world found out about our little move, haha!

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to place 1 Golden rooster figurine each on Woods, Shoreline and Factory. The locations are the same as in the previous quest Viewer from Prapor.

(These are 40 second plant times.)

On Woods it has to be placed next to a tree at a rock ledge on the mountain.

Location marked on map

Placement location

On Shoreline it has to be placed at the top of the lighthouse near the pier.

Placement location

== Trivia ==
The quest dialogue is a reference to a ban that was issued on the Battlestate Games Twitch channel after breaking the community guidelines by using "offensive language".

quests.title: Properties All Around
quests.content:
Properties All Around is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Heyo, soldier! I've got a little job for you, easy as always. You probably know that TerraGroup acted honorably at first: they filed official requests, compiled documents, paid taxes, all this crap. It's only later that they went off the motherfucking rails. I have a feeling that the city's real estate fund may have kept records of the facilities bought or leased by those fucks. If you poke around, you might find something interesting. I'll bet it'll uncover a lot of hidden assets. You up for it?

== Objectives ==
Locate the real estate fund on Streets of Tarkov
Locate and obtain the Tarkov real estate transactions document
Hand over the obtained information

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Did you find it? Nice work, now bring it here! And take your reward, you deserve it.

== Guide ==
Not all spawn locations for the quest item require this key. It is not entirely needed to complete the quest.

In this quest you have to find cadastral registry records in the real estate agency building on Streets of Tarkov. There are multiple spawns throughout the building. A Real estate agency office room key is required to access 2 of the 6 possible spawns in the locked office.

quests.title: Protect the Sky
quests.content:
Protect the Sky is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You weren't being tailed, were you? Skier is definitely up to something. I'm even afraid to sleep in the BTR now! But I can't back down now. I've started setting up a new base, and this time I want to build a solid defense. Someone's willing to provide me with a decent electronic jamming system. We've already settled the payment, it's just a matter of delivering the package to me. They picked an unusual place for the transfer: a cemetery in the forest. It's not big, but you'll find it no problem. There's a stretcher and bodies lying around near it. Can you get the package from the stash? Oh, but don't go straight there from here. Go to your base, take a breather, and then go to the stash from there. Can't let anyone find out about my new purchase.

== Objectives ==
Locate the package in the specified spot on Woods
Hand over the package

== Rewards ==
+25,400 EXP
BTR Driver Rep +0.02
96,000 Roubles
4× .300 Blackout CBJ ammo pack (50 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of Aklys Defense Velociraptor .300 Blackout assault rifle at Mechanic LL4
Thank you! At least now I have a place to sleep. Nothing will come down from above now. And on the ground, the landmines should stop them. I've covered everything. Let's see them looting my spare parts again!

== Guide ==
The quest Simple Side Job from Lightkeeper will automatically fail if this quest is completed first.
This item will only appear in your next Woods raid after accepting this quest.

In this quest you have to find a KOSA UAV electronic jamming device on Woods. There are multiple spawns at a gravesite south of the dilapidated village in the north.

quests.title: Protection of Interests
quests.content:
Protection of Interests was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Heyo, warrior! I heard about our western colleague and his so-called "investigation". The USEC deserters decided to sell used guns and got in touch with the Scavs. They say it were Kaban's boys who set Peacekeeper up. Trouble for him, but huge profit for me! The only problem is that he found out about Gus and Basmach, and now he wants to take them out. Listen, I don't really like those thugs, but they're very useful to my business. Be a good lad, go help those boys out, will you?

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 3 PMC operatives on Streets of Tarkov
Do not kill Gus or Basmach while the quest is active

== Rewards ==
+82,300 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.03
230,000 Roubles
241,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
264,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
4× Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
PK didn't spare resources to get those two, didn't he? But you've done well. I knew you'd help me out. After such an embarrassment, the tourist will take a long time to recover. The two boys seem to have good ambition, they'll go far, I'm telling you! All they need is to get out from under Kaban.

== Failure Dialogue ==
You're sabotaging my operation here, kid. Was it import jeans or fucking soda you sold out for?

== Guide ==
In this quest you must eliminate 3 PMCs on Streets of Tarkov without killing Kaban's bodyguards Gus and Basmach. Killing them will cause the quest to fail.

Gus and Basmach are found at the premises of the LexOs car dealership.

LexOs location marked on map

quests.title: Provide Cover
quests.content:
Provide Cover was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
This whole trader thing is going pretty well for me, wouldn't you say? You know, If I didn't have my wits about me, I'd be dead in this hellhole a long time ago. Anyway, I'll deal with the reports later, not the first time. Right now, I need to equip the guys posted outside my territory. Bring them this new equipment we found. I'll give you a part of it, but the rest you need to get yourself - you already know where to look. No, you won't meet them face to face. Just stash the items in the designated spot.

quests.title: Provide Viewership
quests.content:
Provide Viewership is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, gladiator! Judging by the fact that you're still in one piece, you've developed a good skill set. That's exactly what I need. Arena fights are thriving, but you know the human nature. The audience gets used to everything and will always ask for more! So I've come up with something more interesting. I want to broadcast the fights in real Tarkov conditions for a group of special customers. You need to set up a camera and then show them what you're made of. You can put the camera on some building near the construction site at customs. I don't care who's in your crosshairs. You yourself are the centerpiece of this show! People will cheer for you and pay good money for it. Of course, I've taken your commitment into account, so expect a reward.

Install the second WI-FI Camera Inside the industrial plant on Customs

There he is, a true Tarkov warrior! The audience loved it, so if you don't plan to drop out anytime soon, drop by often. Your talents deserve attention. And attention is expensive these days. Oh, by the way, here's your paycheck.

quests.title: Provocation
quests.content:
Provocation is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Time is of the essence. My cleaner crew found evidence of Glukhar's connection to the arms development that took place under the aegis of TerraGroup. The next task for you is to provoke Glukhar's contacts into doing something foolish. They probably don't know yet that Glukhar is no longer available. Go to Ultra, TerraGroup has had a staging post there since the early days. Make a mess of it, make a show of it. Use the trophy you took from the bull's body. And for the particularly savvy, leave something humiliating in place to say hello, so to speak. The mutts must know their place.

quests.title: Psycho Sniper
quests.content:
Psycho Sniper is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, mercenary. I had an acquaintance named Dima. He worked as a sniper in many hot zones. Once he told me: "Anyone can pull a trigger, but only a few can become a true Sniper". Even if that's true, knowing how to work with bolt-action rifles won't hurt in Tarkov. And I don't mind encouraging you to develop that skill. Take out your opponents, and I'll reward you for it.

Eliminate any 15 targets without dying while using a bolt-action rifle

quests.title: Pursuit of Power
quests.content:
Pursuit of Power was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon, young man. My men have reported that Sanitar is trying to expand his influence by speculating on of poisoning. Currently, he's the only one with an antidote, so he's taking advantage of his position. But his supply is obviously not endless, so he's sent a gang to search for resources. This is our chance to learn more and speed up the drug's production. According to my intel, Sanitar is leaving instructions for his men on Shoreline at three locations: some diner in the docks, hydroelectric plant, and an unspecified location near the cottages. Please go to these locations and search for information. We could benefit greatly from it.

== Objectives ==
Locate Sanitar's letter on Shoreline
Hand over the letter

+8,900 EXP

100,000 Roubles
105,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
115,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
5× CALOK-B hemostatic applicator
4× Salewa first aid kit

The letter is located on Shoreline in one of three locations: In the store at the port/pier area, at the hydroelectric power station or in the garden of the locked cottage.

quests.title: Pyramid Scheme
quests.content:
Pyramid Scheme is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Well-well, look who showed up. Right on time, like you knew I needed you! I've got a proper movie-style job for us. We're robbing banks! Well, ATMs, to be precise. There used to be loads of them scattered around the city. Most of them were on Klimov Street and in the Klimov Mall. Head over there and have a look around. Maybe not all of them have been cleaned out yet.

Mark any ATM on Klimov Street with an MS2000 Marker on Streets of Tarkov
(Optional) Locate the first ATM inside Klimov Shopping Mall on Streets of Tarkov

== Dialogue ==
Come on in. How long do you think this will last? Anyway, our job is to survive for as long as we can. Take as many of the infected with us as we can if we can't cure them. As long as we still have ammunition. What happens when we're out of firepower? That's right. It's either us or them. A lot of people have already died with no ammo, left with only a knife against crowds of infected. But my point is, even they have a weakness, we just need to find it. Can you help with that? I can't trust anyone else to do this, they'll get themselves killed for nothing. Study their tactics and find a way to defeat the infected in close combat. There's a lot of them near the Ultra shopping mall now, so go there.

quests.title: Regulated Materials
quests.content:
Regulated Materials is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come on in, warrior! Still breathing aye? Good to hear. Here's a task for you. There's this customer, showed up outta nowhere with an urgent order and the bitch wants specific equipment, the one our glorious mother Russia produced, and my heart aches that the good of the state has to be sold to whoever. Judging by the accent, the fucker is from abroad. But the cash is noble and the connections he provides are no joke. Anyway, you need one military battery, the heavy one, and several OFZ shells. I feel you'll have to sneak on the military base for it... The place is inhospitable, I know, but you won't regret it when the checkout time comes. Plus, I’ll provide you with a special gift for this. Will you take the risk?

== Objectives ==
Find 1 6-STEN-140-M military battery in raid
Hand over 1 military battery to Prapor

Now that's the good stuff! Heavy as hell, yeah? So anyway, I keep my word about the reward, check out the new rifles I have...

== Guide ==

The items required for this quest need to be found in raid. They can be found as Loose Loot on Lighthouse and Reserve, but can be found in containers elsewhere, as well as a small chance for a Scav to have it in their backpack. The 6-STEN-140-M military battery is a large 4x2 slot item that resembles a black/brown box. It can most commonly be found sitting on or near tanks. The OFZ 30x165mm shells can be found throughout the Reserve on tables, shelving and at the rear side of every tank on the map, on the ground. You can see the facility from everywhere, but nobody has a clue what is hiding under the mountain. If you've been in those places, you must have seen the hill that towers over the entire forest. So, some curious tourists began to flock around that hill, and they are itching to open all the doors they see. As you know, curiosity killed the cat. Do the right thing and get rid of those cats. quests.title: Riding the Wave
quests.content:
Riding the Wave is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Heya, brother! I'm not even gonna ask if you've run into those black uniform "visitors". I figured you didn't come here by accident. You knew I'd have a job for you on this, didn't you? From every sample that's made its way to me, it's obvious these guys are the real deal. So it's no surprise I've been flooded with people asking for gear with the same features or at least the same camouflage... I'd be a fool to let an opportunity like this slip away. I need a complete inventory of everything they wear. Once I've got that, I can put together my own versions, or maybe even make an exact copy of their whole kit. And don't worry, you'll be the first one to get your hands on it! Just don't let me down, alright?

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

Hand over the found in raid item: Ferro Concepts FCPC V5 Plate Carrier (Black Division)

quests.title: Rigged
quests.content:
Rigged was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov: Arena.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, champion. You can't even imagine the value I place on my people. Recently, I was given a lucrative proposition. They asked me to put my men in the fight, but set up things so that their gear would fail to let the enemy win. I acted like I was considering it, naturally. You can understand, it's business, first and foremost. But I turned down the proposition. Kinda regret it a little now. Money's one thing... but nobody turns down people like them. Don't worry though, I don't betray my own. Now go and show me what I've lost so much money for!

You just need to put these smart little things in containers that are in Sanitar's stashes. Prapor won't get wind of anything, it's a two-minute job, but the profit is good. So, the cameras worked just right. The ex-USECs are receiving help from the Scavs, and my man was able to ID them. They're two of Kaban's men, Gus and Basmach. I'm not certain if their boss knows about this side gig, but now is not the time to look into it. The reputational damage is already too high, and I need to take these two fucks down, ASAP. An old rival of mine has decided to take advantage of the situation, so we have to work fast!

The more experienced warriors who are already working for the good of Tarkov need to replenish their fuel reserves. So you have a chance to do a good deed and prove to me that some drunken thug won't be a problem for you. Bring me two cans of fuel. But don't run from the fight. Mercenary, there is a task for you. There's been a large firefight in the city. Someone ambushed a convoy carrying critical cargo. I'm sure it's the treacherous BEARs, but we'll have to make sure. quests.title: Root of All Evil
quests.content:
Root of All Evil was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there, ahper! I'm in a real mess this time, not something I'd wish on anyone… You've probably already heard Peacekeeper's version of the story. But it's not as simple as you think. Everyone's got a weak spot, and this Edward dude found mine, you get me? Peacekeeper doesn't give a damn about any of that, but you know me! Anyway, I talked to him, and it looks like there's a way out of this mess. Peacekeeper isn't just planning to stop Edward, he wants to shut him down for good. For a long time. If that happens, my risks disappear with him. The problem is, Peacekeeper doesn't have enough proof that Edward's been quietly writing off perfectly good gear, electronics, weapons, all that shit. That's where I can help. The shipments are so tangled up that a single package won't prove anything on its own. We need several of them together so we can piece the equipment back together and match the serial numbers. And for that, we need someone like you. Think you can haul some contraband crates over to the sawmill? Shturman seems to have cleared out for now, so grabbing the cargo from those UN guys shouldn't be a problem. I need at least ten boxes. Leave them next to the green shipping container, there's only one like it there. I've still got a few unopened crates myself, I'll give those to you right away.

== Objectives ==
Stash 10 contraband boxes near the green shipping container at the sawmill on Woods

== Rewards ==
+12,000 EXP
150,000 Roubles
157,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
172,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× IOTV Gen4 body armor (Assault Kit, MultiCam)
1× WARTECH TV-110 plate carrier (Coyote)
So, all done? You saved me again, brother! Hopefully we won't be hearing anything more about Edward. Still, makes you wonder how many "enterprising" officers like him are out there, huh? Sure, this one might end up behind bars, but he can't be the only clever one pulling tricks like that. The important thing is we dealt with the threat, and Tarkov still has a source of NATO gear. Though it'll take a while before things cool down again.

== Guide ==

quests.title: Run Aground
quests.content:
Run Aground was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Looks like we've been chasing the wrong fish, mate... We've hit five convoys already, and every one of 'em was carrying old rewards from previous seasons. Not bad, sure, but if we want to really win this, we need to cut off the one with the new gear. My lads spotted some PMCs hanging around our river. Could be that main convoy's passing through there. Trouble is, someone wiped out half my crew on site, so we've got no solid intel left. I'm sending in some reliable boys with a couple of machine guns to set up an ambush. But they'll be moving light if they're gonna make it in time. So if you're really ready to back me and screw Ref over, get some ammo and grenades stashed for my lads. Thrown in some big mags while you're at it. Where to hide it? There are a few containers by the road along the shore, stash it around there. Just keep it out of sight, bushes'll do. And just so we're clear: if you tip Ref off about this, you're done mate. No discussions.

== Objectives ==

(Optional) Do not assist Ref with eliminating pillagers and stashing the masks

Proper work mate. My lads should already be in position by now. If that convoy really comes through there, the Arena won't be seeing a new Season anytime soon. And I sorted a little something for you too. For not screwing me over.

== Failure Dialogue ==
And here I was wondering why you were so eager, always showing up geared up and helping out with all this... turns out you're a bloody double-crosser! If it weren't for our other dealings, I'd have you put down for a stunt like that! Now get lost before I change my mind.

quests.content:
Safety Guarantee is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I've got an opportunity on the table right now, and it could be seriously profitable. But I need a reliable partner, and you could be just the bloke for it. I got talking with one commander, his squad is made up entirely of veterans. But the lads were abroad when all this kicked off. And they still want to work. They say they've got a lead on an abandoned USEC base somewhere in the region. The problem is, some bunch of nobodies have already taken over the place. To take the base back, the lads need proper protection. They won't risk it otherwise. Buying gear like that on the outside would attract way too much attention. If you're interested in growing our little enterprise, get me some Zhuk armor and Vulkan helmets. Luka also asked for something else... Says he needs a helmet just like Killa's. They need to take the base quickly before the military catches on. A bit of extra intimidation never hurts, and everyone in the criminal world has heard of Killa by now. If we convince them that Killa and his lads are operating in the region, they'll run for it straight away.

It seems he made one mistake in estimating the length of the virus' incubation period... That is what probably made him the first victim of a project he himself had been involved in. We have reason to believe there's a sample of antidote number 4 in the sealed section. With it, we can recreate the vaccine formula and synthesize more. We can't lose that sample. That's why I had to arrange a deal with that car service mobster to deliver the sample to my group. You'll need to cross from the Lab to the city, and then leave the vaccine at his, uh, workstation.

Sanitary Standards is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon, young man. I'm glad you were the one who came. I have an urgent and extremely important task for you. It concerns everyone still living in Tarkov. You know where the chemical plant is, don't you? I have strong reason to believe that something hazardous from that facility is seeping into the groundwater. This is a critical issue for us, especially since humanitarian aid deliveries are constantly being disrupted. We all rely on that water. Do you understand? Even filtration is no longer enough. If this isn't addressed soon, it could cost all of us our lives. To determine exactly what's happening, I need readings from a gas analyzer. You can find one at the plant. Leave the device in the laboratory there, and my people will retrieve it afterward.

== Objectives ==
Find 2 Gas analyzers in raid
Hand over the 2 Gas analyzers to Therapist
(Optional) Locate the room with the Gas analyzers on Factory

165,000 Roubles

Our engineers have successfully neutralized the chemical leak from the factory, but the water is still not fully purified. Although the only remaining pollutants are specific to petroleum products. We assume that this is connected to the TPP fuel oil storage next to the factory. Know these? It's hard to miss, there's a big pipe there. Technical rooms of fuel oil storage and furnace facility must be nominally equipped with the same radio- and gas analyzers you found in the factory, if, of course, they weren't stolen yet. quests.title: Saving the Mole
quests.content:
Saving the Mole is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, mercenary. I've got a lot of work, so I'll be brief. TerraGroup sent a USEC task force after one of their employees. He was accused of leaking information and they wanted him removed. I don't know if they succeeded or not, which is why you need to investigate this. Check the TerraGroup complex in the city center, look for traces of both the squad and the employee. I used to work with him, so I want to know what happened in the end. He almost always carried a drive with his important data on it, so if you find it, bring it to me.

== Objectives ==
Access the lab scientist's office on Ground Zero
(Optional) Locate the USEC group at the parking lot of the TerraGroup complex
(Optional) Locate the lab scientist in the TerraGroup complex
Locate and obtain the scientist's hard drive
Hand over the hard drive

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1

They killed him? Well, that's sad, but expected. TerraGroup was desperate to cover their tracks. You've done a good job. And thanks for the data drive.

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to locate the lab scientist in the main building of the TerraGroup building complex. He can be found in a hallway behind the big TerraGroup sign in the entrance hall, buried under rubble. Inside the body, a TerraGroup science office key can be found which unlocks office no. 4 on the second floor. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid, but can be taken by other players.

Good thing you didn't disappear on me! I've got an idea how we can make sure we don't miss it when the smugglers start making a move on the lighthouse. You said yourself there's fuck-all going on there right now, but the train's still running, see? If the smugglers decide to build themselves a base at the treatment plant, or start moving fighters in there, they're gonna need the train. So all we need to do is hide some proper cameras there, and that's it. Then I won't miss anything important. You gonna set up surveillance. And put one by the road to the woods too, just in case. I heard some of your lot leaked that route to the smugglers.

At least, all current events look like preconditions to it. I worked here for the chemical plant, as an ordinary foreman. It was a good time, everyone thought so, including me. quests.title: Scrap Metal
quests.content:
Scrap Metal is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good day! As you can understand, the conflict here was rather serious and there is some heavy machinery left on the Shoreline. There are at least three T-90 of which I am aware, and I am sure there are many military devices remaining on them, such as laser rangefinders for example. Those models are not for export, and equipped with optics for domestic use. My customers would be very interested in comparing it to the samples owned by them. From the recon data, one of the tanks was left left on the small land bridge between the weather station and the hydroelectric power station, the other one must be somewhere near the north-west bunker at the Health Resort, and the last tank should be in the village on the dirt road at the collapsed tunnel. Mark the tanks with beacons, and my people will do the rest.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Mark the first T-90 tank with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Mark the second T-90 tank with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline

Hey there, warrior! One of my squads has been radio silent for a while now. When all this mess started, I sent them out near the Priozersk forest to move an important shipment. I'm afraid they got hit: last time we managed to get through, they reported USECs closing in on them from the hills. Go check it out, see if anyone's still alive. The convoy definitely had a BRDM car, a Bukhanka, and some truck, can't remember which one. Chances are the USECs have dug in somewhere nearby, so keep your head on a swivel. Oh, and so you don't get yourself lost among the scary square kilometer of trees, I'm issuing you a compass. Dismissed.

quests.title: Secret Benefactor
quests.content:
Secret Benefactor was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings. You know, during recovery, my patients often share news and rumors about what is happening in Tarkov. Most of the time it is simple everyday talk, however nowadays I have noticed a tendency that concerns me greatly. People are talking about a person or group of people in town who are willing to provide sustenance and protection for the citizens. At different times, I myself would have tried to reach out and cooperate for a noble cause. Yet you and I both are aware that there are very few honest people left in Tarkov. The ordinary citizens are already on the brink of survival. I am afraid that too many people may trust loud claims without any guarantees. We must find out who is luring people in with generous offers and for what purpose. If you are willing to help me, search the Scav checkpoints and outposts for information.

Hello. You couldn't have shown up at a better time. I went through my list of contacts, and you're the best person for this job. Word reached me through my usual channels that someone found a rare ultrasonic thickness gauge at the customs territory, along with several other valuable pieces of equipment. You know how things are these days - opportunities like that can't be wasted. I need you to head to Customs, recover everything of value, and move it to Polikhim, where my people are waiting. One more thing. Back in peacetime, when I worked at Polikhim, we had a shortcut... Mostly for moving equipment onto the factory grounds that would've otherwise sat in customs for months. An old mushroom picker showed it to me years ago. See if you can find and use it. It may come in handy in the future.

quests.title: Self-Employed
quests.content:
Self-Employed was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I was waiting for you! With these frosts and the new heater, business has been booming like never before. PMCs are lining up just to warm up or catch a ride somewhere. And trust me, that’s a lot easier and more profitable than running under the traders. So I started a rumor that my BTR was down, just to keep them from dragging me into their contracts. Figured I’d work for myself for a bit, help out the regular folks too. Only one problem though. I don’t hit the Depot often these days, but I can’t avoid it completely. There’s a bunch of important equipment still there, stuff you can’t just move in one go. And if any rats from my "partners" crew start snooping around, the whole thing goes to hell. So I need your help again. Make sure there are no extra eyes in the Depot, yeah? Just don’t touch the PMCs! They’re my main customers right now, they won’t rat me out.

Nice one! I've checked out the Depot a couple times already, saw it all with my own eyes. It's been a long time since it was that quiet there. I've got something ready for you as a thank you. Here, take it.

In this quest you have to kill 5 Scavs at the train depot on Woods. Killing any PMCs at the depot will reset the quest. The depot can only be accessed via the BTR Driver's taxi service.

He had covered the walls with strange symbols, drawn a circle on the floor, and started placing weapons inside it. Oddly enough... it made sense to me. That's how religion works, isn't it? You offer your gods the things that matter most to you. Seems those cultists think the same way. You've probably run into them already. Anyway, back to business. quests.title: Sensory Analysis - Part 1
quests.content:
Sensory Analysis - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello my brother! Okay, okay, not so loud, I'm hung over as shit. Don't know how the BTR guy's still driving after last night. The engine is surely screeching louder than fucking generators! By the way, you came at a really good time, almost like you knew I'm gonna need help. So, about the meeting we had yesterday. I have a moonshine supplier, he makes legit good stuff! We've been working together for six months now, everything was fine. And now, customers started complaining that I was selling them fake stuff. So, I had to check the product quality, and no one in our region knows as much about liquor as the BTR driver. So I invited him over for... let's call it sampling, hehe. And there he was, saying that no one starts with hard hitters right off the bat, he needed a warm-up. Then another. Then another... So after all that, I checked the moonshine in the morning, and we didn't even open it! Long story short, the driver didn't finish the job. I'm not gonna live through this kind of sampling party a second time, so I'll let him taste everything by himself. Can you pass him this bottle? Don't lose it, alright?

== Objectives ==

Go to Woods, Lighthouse or Streets of Tarkov

2× ECLiPSE RBAV-AF plate carrier (Ranger Green)
So, did'ya deliver the bottle? Huh? Man, this driver guy's such a prick. I love him! Hey, easy there, man, I get it. Listen, some things just shouldn't be talked about right off the bat, the Labyrinth is one of them. I have to consider all the risks that come with this info, so sit tight for a little while.

== Initial Equipment ==

quests.title: Sensory Analysis - Part 2
quests.content:
Sensory Analysis - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I miscalculated my abilities yesterday at a friendly get-together. Don't worry, we've sailed in worse storms than this. One time I was so wasted I couldn't find the gearbox in this thing. So I tied my hand to the lever with a bandage! Inventiveness is the main principle for a machinist! Ragman needed to check some goods, and I'm a veteran in this field. Except I can't remember, for the life of me, whether we finally got to his test sample or not. Well, whatever. If it's so important, we can get together again. Such an evening is a sin not to do again, I know you'd like it too! But still, if you need to visit Ragman, ask him about the moonshine, I promised I'd help him. And now I don't even know if I did help him or not.

== Notes ==
This quest gets automatically added to the quest list upon accepting Sensory Analysis - Part 1.

== Objectives ==
Find a Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
Hand over a Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine

== Rewards ==
Are you sure this is it? Okay, I can smell it, that's definitely the one! Ragman told me about the health resort's cellars yesterday, I even had to fucking get him wasted so we could finally change the subject. Anyway, there was a Soviet bomb shelter under the health resort, and Ref was going to organize a new arena there, for VIP audiences. I think it also involved Tagilla somehow... No, it was something else... Anyway, for this arena, Ref organized a big gear acquisition from Ragman, everything was almost ready. And then our host guy suddenly backed out. Why? Who the fuck knows. Ragman was really upset that the idea had fallen through. But he'd already delivered some of the gear, and he definitely used those keycards you're looking for. You better ask him yourself, I don't remember much from yesterday. Thanks for the drink, by the way.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to hand over a Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine to the BTR Driver and ask him about the facility under the health resort and the keycards to access it.

== Trivia ==
The quest dialogue is referencing an incident that happened in 2018 between the content creator Eroktic and Battlestate Games. Eroktic uploaded a YouTube video in which he talked about an alleged user data leak from 1,900,000 game accounts, without providing any actual evidence. In response, Battlestate Games issued 47 DMCA strikes on his YouTube channel to stop the spread of misinformation, which were later removed. Battlestate Games commented on the allegations in a Facebook post.

quests.title: Setting Priorities
quests.content:
Setting Priorities is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. One of your people stopped by recently and tried to convince me that the most important part of a fighter's gear is armor, and that situational awareness doesn't matter nearly as much. Frankly, I don't share that view. Sure, you can't see or hear absolutely everything. But armor will never give you complete protection either, especially if you walk into an ambush. Personally, I'd take a good headset over heavy, reinforced armor any day. Fortunately, I don't have to make that choice myself. So what would you choose? You've got enough experience to test this properly in the field. Better yet, let's try this: you gather some real statistics using two different loadouts, and in return I'll arrange a supply of some unique items from Peacekeeper. He owes me a favor, you see. Try neutralizing PMC operatives while wearing a headset but no armor. Then do the opposite, say... using a tank crew helmet. That should put you at a serious information disadvantage.

== Objectives ==

Hey. You may be aware that TerraGroup's aggressive expansion in Tarkov has raised quite a few questions in its time, no doubt? Back then, they were buying out properties and companies left and right in the Norvinsk region, and some of the deals were clearly shady in nature... TerraGroup has had a particularly interesting contractor, a company called Knossos. Officially they build amusement parks, playgrounds, and other family entertainment venues. But tell me, what possible connection can TerraGroup's scientific research and playgrounds have? That's exactly why this smells fishy to me. Knossos could be hiding TerraGroup documents or equipment. Yet to know for certain, we'd have to examine their facilities. And to do that, we'd have to find some kind of record... Knossos definitely had managers overseeing the facilities. Shipping Delay - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, do you know the BTR driver who's driving around Tarkov? I ordered an important delivery from him, but he just vanished somewhere. If I had a soldier like that at my disposal, I'd teach him a lesson real quick. How can you delay military cargo shipments?! He was supposed to meet with my men yesterday. I need to find that bastard and show him what responsibility means. But the package is more important at the moment. Go find it and hand it over to me. We'll deal with the driver later.

Hand over the package from the depot on Woods

You talked with the driver, huh? His base was attacked? If you ask me, those couriers will always make excuses for being late. But the guy did a good job hiring you. I've been dying to get this little package.

quests.title: Shipping Delay - Part 2
quests.content:
Shipping Delay - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So Mechanic sent you, huh? Cool. So I used to have a base, with a hangar, spare parts, cargo shipments even. Then some assholes thought they could just clean the place out! I'm gonna find those bastards. But while I'm at it, all the deliveries are messing up! The most important one is a package for Prapor, he's really anxious for it, and the box is still at the depot near the sawmill in Priozersk. If you're down to help me, look for this package and deliver it to Prapor. I can give you a ride to the depot, but I ain't leaving the BTR. I don't like it outside, it's more comforting inside this armor.

So, was Prapor pissed? Well shit, it's an emergency over here! But hey, thanks for helping me out. Now I might go and check out what's left of the base. You're a good guy, so stay in touch, yeah? When I find these shitheads, I'll need your help again.

quests.title: Shoot First
quests.content:
Shoot First was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov: Arena.

== Dialogue ==
Glad you came by. I wanted to talk to you about something. We've got a fuck ton of new recruits. New blood is the key to exciting fights, you see. We need to keep things moving, otherwise we can't keep the audience for long. Well, you already know that, we've been over this. So, to the point. The newbies aren't experienced, but they're arrogant as hell. Show them what a real hardened fighter's capable of. I hear the new blood are already fantasizing about overthrowing the current Arena champions. They've got their sights set on you. And you know the best way to avoid trouble in the Arena is to shoot first.

You know what separates a professional sniper from an amateur? The ability to approach a task from the right angle. Take eliminating several highly trained fighters in an unconventional situation, for example... It's not just about the choice of weapon and attachments, there are other factors to consider as well. My friend Dima thinks you could become a capable sniper. He just wants to make sure. If you're not afraid, complete his assignment.

Shooting Cans is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

Greetings! I hear you're looking for a little extra cash. That's perfect, because I have a job for you... I know that the city center is where AGSs and KORDs were deployed during the hottest fights. Find me one of each and report back. Also, sweep the area around them, make sure no one gets to the firing positions before my guys do. I think five bodies will be enough. Scavs, PMCs, whatever. Less trespassers, less chance of an ambush, you know?

quests.title: Shootout Picnic
quests.content:
Shootout Picnic is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Still alive, soldier? Atta boy. Means you know a thing or two if you haven't gotten yourself killed yet. I've got another job for you. Some important people have business to take care of in certain parts of Tarkov. Trouble is, the local scum's getting in their way. Can you believe those bastards actually think they own the place? According to my intel, there are around a dozen of them, maybe more. Take care of enough, and the rest will scatter on their own. A seasoned soldier like you shouldn't have any trouble handling a job like this. Get to work.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 15 targets on Woods, Ground Zero, Customs, or Interchange

+3,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
How'd it go? Ah, don't bother, I already know it went well. You're standing here in one piece, aren't you? Those people I mentioned sent word that everything worked out on their end, too. So here's a double reward: one part from me and one from them.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill any 15 targets on Woods, Ground Zero, Customs or Interchange.

quests.title: Short on Hands
quests.content:
Short on Hands was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You getting bored, mate? 'Cause I'm short on hands right now. Wanna know why? 'Cause Ref, that bloody prick, started poaching my people! Looks like his Arena's been raking it in with those new Seasons, so now he's looking to expand. Problem is, his staff keeps getting themselves killed on cleanups and other crap. So he figured he'd start pulling workers from people who actually matter. But I've got my own connections, yeah? Didn't crawl outta the gutter yesterday. Managed to get my hands on the routes for his new supply runs. If we hit those shipments, his shiny new season's dead in the water. No rewards, no hype, no money. He'll be eatin' dirt instead of profits. And my people'll see clear as day that sticking with Skier's the smarter, safer bet. We've already intercepted a few convoys, but now some mercs showed up outta nowhere, like they got tipped off. They're making things difficult. You gonna handle that for me, good lad?

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 PMC operatives on Woods, Customs, Interchange, Lighthouse, or Shoreline

== Rewards ==
+12,000 EXP
150,000 Roubles
157,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
172,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× SIG MCX .300 Blackout assault rifle
4× AR-15 5.56x45 Colt STANAG 30-round magazine
3× .300 Blackout BCP FMJ ammo pack (50 pcs)
+1 Operational event task
You did alright out there! Those painted masks are already making their way back to me. What d'you reckon, they really risk their lives for that junk? In Tarkov, some random bum with a TOZ would've dropped a flashy clown like that in seconds, I swear. Though, if I'm honest, feels like my own lads are skimming half the loot for themselves on the sly... Sneaky fucks!

quests.title: Shortage
quests.content:
Shortage is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, mercenary. Are you interested in a little part-time work? It's not a difficult task, but it's quite lucrative. Don't forget, you can get both food and drink from me, as well as expert medical care. But first, let's talk about the job. I require three emergency medical kits. They're called Salewa - the red western ones. I need you to obtain them yourself, not buy them off someone else. Just to prove that we're serious about this. We may know each other, but not enough for me to trust you yet. Are you up for the job?

== Objectives ==
Find 3 Salewa first aid kit in raid
Hand over the 3 first aid kits

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2

Thank you, young man. The first aid kits will be put to good use. I won't tell you any more than that, though.

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks craft for Salewa first aid kit at Medstation level 1.

== Guide ==

quests.title: Side Hustle
quests.content:
Side Hustle was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
We checked the smartphone and confirmed that Scourge definitely used some other device for communication, or the squad was operating under radio silence. However, an archive containing several photographs had been loaded onto the smartphone beforehand. They show various chemical containers, cargo packed in boxes, someone's case, as well as a couple of photographs of the green recreation areas located inside the laboratory. It seems that this archive is somehow connected to that TerraGroup employee, or perhaps it was copied in its entirety from this specialist's personal device. Otherwise, where would those pictures of trees have come from... In any case, we now understand what the mercenaries are looking for. We need to get those containers before Ref does. And just in case, look for that case or the boxes. The containers we need could be inside. And check the landscaped areas, too. Maybe they weren't included in the archive for no reason.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 3 of Ref's gladiators in The Lab
Locate and obtain the precursors
(Optional) Find a case or a box containing precursors
Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+1 Health skill level
+1 Surgery skill level
500,000 Roubles
525,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
575,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Medicine case
1× Item case

Excellent, thank you! To be honest, these look like ordinary precursors. Materials like these are used to develop or produce various drugs, including the injectors you use. It appears the owner of the case was secretly working with someone outside TerraGroup and selling these materials without his superiors' knowledge.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to kill Scourge or his guards for 3 kills total, and hand over a Precursor container. The Precursor container is guaranteed to be in TerraGroup employee's packages, and has a chance to be inside of TerraGroup employee's suitcases. It can also rarely be found in the laboratory security post, the laboratory security arsenal and the parking garage alarm system control room.

== Scourge  location ==
At the reception, or near the orange dome in the main working area (O11) on the first level in The Lab.

Here's the plan: I'll give you the locations, you mark them. Think of it as strolling around the city and enjoying the beautiful places. You, however, will take the less known paths. quests.title: Signal - Part 3
quests.content:
Signal - Part 3 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I've recently tried to build a neural network to control the cameras. Teaching it to differentiate between faces and look for matches in the database didn't take much time. Then I wondered, what if we ever create a mind, which will realize itself, what it will be like? In the last many years of civilization, humans kept becoming more humane. They started treating each other better, started caring for nature, animals. An opinion was formed that principles of human duty go side by side with highly developed civilization and reason. Then, shall it turn out that the mind of the computer, which of course will very quickly evolve into an over-mind due to its high learning capabilities, will also be most humane at the same time? Interesting, right? But we need to deal with these pests already. Install suppressors on the antennas you found, and, just in case, another one on the tower, also there on the Shoreline.

== Requirements ==
Must be level 15 to start this quest.

== Objectives ==
Place the first Signal Jammer on the specified place on Shoreline

quests.title: Signal - Part 4
quests.content:
Signal - Part 4 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I've been thinking about that thing we discussed last time. Have people really become kinder with the development of civilization? Do they really go hand in hand? All this time, where we believe there is civilization, life has become more comfortable, easier. There were increasingly fewer worries about safety or getting something to eat. It's easy to be humane when nothing is threatening you. The answer to these questions was right before my eyes. The situation in Tarkov has shown us how much kinder we have become. Once the issues of survival came to the front, it turned out that decent people aren’t more common than maybe 500 years ago. There're probably even less of them now. What do you think, are you one of them? Okay, don’t overthink it. I need you to do something for me. However, you will need to remember quite a lot for this job. Practice in memorizing large volumes of information, I’ll contact you later.

== Requirements ==
Must be level 15 to start this quest.

Reach the required Attention skill level of 8

quests.map: Ground Zero, Lighthouse, Reserve, The Lab

Silent Caliber is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

Hey there, how's life treating ya? You know, sometimes you have to come in and shoot the shit out of someone in CQC, and you have to do it quietly and efficiently. I prefer 12 gauge for example, and I got no clue why the hell BEARs and USECs don't appreciate it, it's a straight caliber, you know? You just gotta get as close as possible, and if you have silencer, man, you can drop people and the guy on other side of the wall wouldn't flinch. It hits silently and it hits hard. You gotta master this, while I figure out what fish we could pull out with your "talent".

quests.content:
Sisyphus is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
How's your physical shape, ahper? I've got one deal that's still hanging over my head, and I could really use some help. But I'll tell you right now, you can throw your back out in no time doing this! So, I've made contact with the smugglers. Wouldn't exactly call it a partnership, but they've got a decent job for me. We need to deliver some armor plates to their boys. Everything's already packed up and waiting at the drop-off points, so all that's left is getting it to the recipients. You in? Both cases with the armor plates are in Priozersk right now. One's in the bunker, and the other's at the abandoned USEC checkpoint. One case needs to be hauled to the guardhouse at the military base. You want the one next to the trail leading to Woods. The second case is supposed to go in the railcar with the Ural truck at the train station near the water treatment plant. Once you've left both cases at the right spots, let the armored train engineer know.

I've got a special reward ready for you. Here, take it. It'll give you an excuse to hang around the hideout and put those plates in the case properly.

quests.title: Skiing with Skier
quests.content:
Skiing with Skier was a community goal Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Looks like our comrade general crawled out of hibernation and started handing out hits for my lads! Not great that he's making a move, but there's no backing out now. You get me? If we dig in on these new lines, Prapor will never push us out. So get ready. We need to move fast and hit hard. Forget my route for now, that fucker's littered it with TNT charges, you'll just blow yourself up. Your job's simple. Drop everyone fighting on his side, as many as you can. Sounds like Prapor's handing out ushankas, so use that as your marker. I'll pull in more good lads from your lot too. Every gun counts now. Just don't forget to wear a pompon hat yourself. That's how we tell our own apart now.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate PMC operatives in Ushanka ear flap hats while wearing a Pompon hat
Note: The objective in the PvE mode is to eliminate any PMC operatives while wearing a Pompon hat instead.

== Rewards ==
+15,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.01
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Fuck's sake, It's been a long time since things got this messy. Between the frost and this little war, I'd be lucky if half my crew's still breathing. On the bright side, the ones who survived learned fast. They won't be pissing themselves at every bit of rustling in the bushes anymore. Most important thing is, we didn't bend to Prapor and we made his life harder. And you? Solid work, mate. Got the job done and stayed alive. Take whatever you want off that shelf. I even threw in some extra from the rewards meant for other PMCs. You know, the ones who didn't make it.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you must eliminate as many PMC operatives who wear the Ushanka ear flap hat as possible while wearing the Pompon hat yourself.

Well, hello there, mercenary. Come to see the old man? Sit down, would you like some tea? No? All right, then. Listen, a gang of looters showed up in the area again. We've got to get them away from this place for good, so that even those who come after them would have a heart attack. So I'm thinking, why don't you take an axe and chop them the fuck up, eh? Can you do that? I don't think any bastard's gonna dare get into that bloodbath afterwards.

Small Business - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You remember my "entrepreneur"? I found him, he's one of the local gang bosses. Who? You don't need to know that. Your job is to go to each of them and remind them that my trade routes are mine alone. Don't touch the chiefs themselves, they're more useful alive. I told you not to touch the bosses themselves! I need to intimidate them, not take them out.

quests.title: Snatch
quests.content:
Snatch is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You're here, good. Now listen carefully. My men went to the meeting place, their job was to replace the folder these snakes were so diligently preparing with the one I had arranged, but it's already been several hours since my group stopped responding. The last time they contacted me, they reported seeing a group of Rogues. Knight and his men are not aware of this operation, perhaps one of them interfered with the delivery. The first thing you must do is to check the Rogues' base and find the lost data, but don't go to them right away, or they'll figure out I'm involved and will start asking questions. Then you'll have to deliver it to the federal reserve base, a meeting place has been set up at the machinery and equipment repair center. Find that folder and leave at the base, and bring the real one to me. It's crucial to deliver this information to me. It's time to find out who these suicidal moles are.

== Objectives ==
Extract from Lighthouse
Obtain the forged intelligence at the Rogue base on Lighthouse
Obtain the original intelligence in the repair station on Reserve
Stash the forged intelligence under the BMP-2 in place of the original
Bring the original intelligence to Lightkeeper

Welcome back. Now, let's see what they're up to.

== Guide ==

Our partnership has been quite fruitful lately, it's great -- and I want to trust you more. After all, reliable people are valuable. quests.title: Special Comms
quests.content:
Special Comms is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Salutations! An important assignment has just come from the high-ups. Top priority and all that jazz. There's a path from Priozersk to the Reserve base, and our guys need communication in those parts urgently. The path? Ah well, I'll share it with you, but make sure nobody else knows about it! When the Contract Wars were in full swing, some artisan managed to lay a path parallel to our road. We tracked the guy down and started interrogating him on who he was working for, what kind of mission he was on, you know the drill. We thought we'd captured a spy! Yet he kept calling himself a mushroom picker and grinning like a moron. We wanted to send him to headquarters. But at night our mushroom picker disappeared, no one saw him again after that. So, with your help, we'll build a communication line along this path, and you'll be responsible for the equipment. You'll deliver a part of it to the place, go to the Reserve base, and leave the second part there.

== Objectives ==

quests.title: Special Order
quests.content:
Special Order is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there, soldier! Got a job for you that I wouldn't trust to just anyone. Special order, you could say. I need an ice axe. Wipe that look off your face! And keep your mouth shut about this job, or we'll both catch hell. So don't go checking the Flea Market or asking the other traders. You need to find one yourself, quietly. No unnecessary witnesses. Got it? Word is Shturman was seen carrying the right kind of ice axe. The Cultists might've stashed one away in their hideouts, too... But that's unconfirmed. Either way, that's your problem now, not mine! Get this done, and I'll arrange access to a very special weapon, just for you. Ever since the Contract Wars, these things have become almost impossible to get. I'm giving you a one-of-a-kind opportunity here. Don't waste it.

== Dialogue ==
Okay, so, we have a very interesting picture. Might even start believing in all this. If you light a bonfire just as I told you before, three at the same time, and simultaneously keep them lit for a minute or two, then some kind of freak appears. All green, like a Leshy, with horns. Kind of looks like Lightkeeper's chain dog. He's kind of peaceful and doesn't bother anyone. I guess he comes when the campfires signal. Shares some goodies, doesn't talk much, though. Try to keep three fires burning for a couple of minutes to find out if it's all true or just exaggerations. They've already named this freak "Vesna", ha! It's like a Maslenitsa, you burn bonfires, or rather effigies of Morana, you kill the spirits of winter, and then spring comes. What a freak show. Only thing missing now is pancakes with caviar. Oh, and that scary story I promised will come a bit later, now is not the time for that. So long.

In this quest you first have consume a can of squash spread and a bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine in raid.

Afterwards you have to kill 6 followers of Morana in one raid and extract.

Followers of Morana can be found near bonfires. They are neutral to players until they are harmed or a bonfire in their vicinity is lit.

3 bonfires per raid appear in different locations on Ground Zero, Customs, Woods, Shoreline, Interchange, Reserve, Lighthouse and Streets of Tarkov.

Appearance of a bonfire
Appearance of a Morana follower

== Trivia ==
Morana is the slavic goddess of death and winter.
Vesna is the slavic goddess of youth and spring.

quests.title: Stabilize Business
quests.content:
Stabilize Business is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I told you the driver knows the right paths! That's where I'll send the shipment, although I don't have time for that at present. First I have to deal with those who killed my couriers. I already found the culprits, so now it's for Ragman to send his regards. I can't do anything to help the driver until this matter is handled. That's why I suggest you take care of it. Quicker you start, quicker you finish.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 7 Scavs in one raid on Ground Zero
Survive and extract from the location

+24,100 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.03
124,000 Roubles
130,200 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1

1× IOTV Gen4 body armor (Assault Kit, MultiCam)
That's great! Now there is nothing to interfere with my operations, and we can think about expansion. For now, I need to figure out how to prepare for the BTR coming under my roof. Just be patient for a little longer.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to eliminate 7 Scavs on Ground Zero in a single raid and survive.

quests.title: Staff Shortage
quests.content:
Staff Shortage was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there mate! Did'ya hear about my master plan? Alright don't get pissy, I don't employ people for nothing. And if anyone doesn't like the terms, they can file a fucking complaint against me. This isn't Moscow. It's time for everyone to come down to earth and accept our grim fucking reality. Alright, so here's what this job's about. That bloody forest freak is getting active and bothering my mates. His friend Partisan has ruined the supply routes, and they're also hunting my recruiters. So I thought you'd be a good fit for this counteraction. Cover my mates at the checkpoints, and bury this Partisan fuck in the ditch somewhere. I'll make it worth your while. I need these recruits urgently, mate.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize Partisan
Eliminate 10 PMC operatives

== Rewards ==
+16,300 EXP
Skier Rep +0.05
150,000 Roubles
157,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
172,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Milkor M32A1 MSGL 40mm grenade launcher
6× 40x46mm M386 (HE) grenade
6× 40x46mm M406 (HE) grenade
6× 40x46mm M433 (HEDP) grenade
12× 40x46mm M576 (MP-APERS) grenade
Fucking blimey! That fucker's been an annoyance to everyone for a long while. Now we at least have safe places to bring in volunteers. I've also done some secret spy shit, so nobody's gonna find my bases now. Good job, mister operator.

== Failure Penalty ==
Skier Rep -0.05
Wait, so you're the one who's doing Jaeger's fucking mission? What, doing threesome tea parties with Partisan too? Go to your fucking woods all together then, don't bother showing up here again! Don't meddle with my business, you'll fucking regret it, got it?!

quests.title: Stay Clear of Blast Zone
quests.content:
Stay Clear of Blast Zone is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come on, have a seat, no point standing around... You didn't run into those black-clad soldiers on your way here, did you? Good. Partisan crossed paths with them while pulling back not long ago, barely made it out alive. Something has to be done about them, or this will end badly. And I'm not talking about pillaging like the Scavs do. This is a far more serious threat. Those fsoldiers are more dangerous than anyone else we've dealt with. Which is exactly why meeting them head-on would be a mistake. Hunters set traps instead of charging wolves with a knife for a reason. These soldiers keep searching around our local health resort. That's where we'll hit them. I need you to plant TNT charges at every entrance to the grounds. Partisan will take up a position in the nearby forest and finish off the group once the explosions have done their work.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Plant a TP-200 TNT brick at the Health Resort west side fence breach on Shoreline
Plant a TP-200 TNT brick at the Health Resort north side fence breach on Shoreline
Plant a TP-200 TNT brick at the Health Resort east side fence breach on Shoreline

== Rewards ==
+30,000 EXP
300,000 Roubles
315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× HK G28 7.62x51 marksman rifle
3× HK417/G28 7.62x51 10-round magazine
2× 7.62x51mm M62 Tracer ammo pack (20 pcs)
Think I heard a couple of those blasts myself. Sounds like Partisan settled the score with the ones who jumped him last time. You need to know your enemy, and you need to know your own limits. It worked this time, but this won't be the end of it. So watch yourself, and don't go looking for trouble.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to plant 3 TP-200 TNT bricks at the breaches of the health resort fence on Shoreline.

quests.title: Stay Frosty
quests.content:
Stay Frosty was a community goal Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Bad news, warrior. You may have thinned out Skier's people, but now he's started hiring PMCs. And the bastard's not backing off one bit. We need to put Skier back in his place. I hear all his so-called allies wear those pompon ski hats. Anyone using it is to be treated as a hostile on sight. Looks like this profiteer wants a real war. Fine then, he'll get one! Until I say otherwise, this task is your top priority. You're not the only one getting this order, so watch your fire alright? Our guys will be wearing ushankas. And you don't go outside without one yourself anymore. Don't take pointless risks.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate PMC operatives in Pompon hats while wearing a Ushanka ear flap hat
Note: The objective in the PvE mode is to eliminate any PMC operatives while wearing a Ushanka ear flap hat instead.

== Rewards ==
+15,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.01
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Good work. We fought hard, no doubt about it... Lost plenty of people too. If it were up to me, I'd have avoided all this. But you know how it is. You can't let a bandit like that start believing in himself, or he'll go completely out of control and make things worse for everyone. Be glad you made it out of that mess alive. Take your reward. You earned it.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you must eliminate as many PMC operatives who wear the Pompon hat as possible while wearing a Ushanka hat yourself.

In the PVE mode you must eliminate PMC operatives while wearing a Ushanka hat.

== Trivia ==
This was a community goal quest. The current progress could be found here. The final result was 62,999 killed Pompon hat PMCs.

quests.title: Stay on Top
quests.content:
Stay on Top was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov: Arena.

== Dialogue ==
You really think once you're on top, no one's going to throw you off? No way! Blink and you'll be swept down. And then you have to start all over again. So keep looking over your shoulder. And get used to defending your status every day. Kill! Survive! That's what the Arena's all about. Remember that. Show everyone what you're worth!

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 50 enemies in BlastGang or TeamFight mode

quests.title: Staying Light
quests.content:
Staying Light was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You came at the right time. I just finished a patrol, and I'll tell you this — something strange is starting. Too many people have been moving through the forests lately, and they're better equipped than usual. I haven't burned through this many rounds on a single run in a long time. Don't even think about leaving your hideout without a solid stock of ammo. I can feel they're preparing for something. I can't sleep at night. Last time it felt like this was right before that blue blast in the city center. Feels like something's about to happen — something that'll change Tarkov forever. Uneasy times are upon us. An extra pair of hands won't go amiss. Help me thin out this infestation in our city, and I won't forget the favor.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 100 targets

== Rewards ==
+17,400 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.03

It's done? And still they keep swarming in… I've taken plenty of gear off their scavenger corpses, the best of it I keep close. I don't need it, but I'm sure you'll make good use of it in your righteous fight. Take it. And stay sharp. Something big is coming, my gut's never been wrong.

quests.title: Steady Signal
objectivesKo: 삼림(Woods)의 아무 기상 관측소에 MS2000 마커 부착하기
quests.content:
Steady Signal is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings. I have a job for you. There are several weather stations scattered throughout the Priozersk forest. Back when things were still normal, they monitored atmospheric conditions. To keep them running continuously, they were equipped with independent power supplies. Now they're just sitting there, rusting away. I doubt anyone will object if I put those power supplies to better use. There's just one problem: nobody knows exactly where all the stations are. You spend plenty of time in that forest, so find one and mark it with a strobe marker. I'll pay you for the work, don't worry.

== Objectives ==
Mark any of the weather stations with an MS2000 Marker on Woods

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles

The signals are already coming through. My people are on their way to the forest. Here's your payment.

quests.title: Stealing the Stolen
quests.content:
Stealing the Stolen was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
We've managed to obtain recordings of communications between the Rogues and Glukhar. They were attempting to buy out equipment from the radar complex, hardware that survived the EMP strike and was being stored in the bunkers. Looks like Glukhar refused to cooperate, and after that Knight decided to storm the bunkers. I don't want ex-USEC operatives getting any chance to establish contact with my European partners.
I could also make use of reliable communication equipment myself. The Rogues have already done half the work for us, all that's left is to take those crates off their hands. Most likely, the units carrying the cargo haven't made it far from the warehouses at the Reserve base. Once you secure the equipment, leave it at locations where my people can retrieve the boxes. Look for worker shacks... or whatever you call them. The first point is near the abandoned USEC checkpoint on the main road through the woods. The second is on the hill by the gas station on the customs territory. The last one is downtown, at the collapsed construction crane.

== Objectives ==
Stash 2 Radar station spare parts at the weather station on Woods
Stash 2 Radar station spare parts in the specified bunkhouse on Customs
Stash 2 Radar station spare parts in the specified bunkhouse on Streets of Tarkov

== Rewards ==
+12,000 EXP
3,000 Dollars
3,150 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
3,450 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× HK 416A5 5.56x45 assault rifle
3× AR-15 5.56x45 HK Steel Maritime STANAG 30-round magazine
3× 5.56x45mm M855 ammo pack (50 pcs)
+1 Operational event task
Judging by the contents of those crates, the Rogues are indeed assembling relay units and mobile communication stations. They're clearly trying to reach someone, possibly even outside the blockade. Keep bringing me these components, and I'll make it worth your while.

== Guide ==

Stash 2 Radar station spare parts each on Woods, Customs and Streets of Tarkov. Radar station spare parts can be found in the backpacks of Rogues on Reserve.

quests.title: Stick in the Wheel
quests.content:
Stick in the Wheel is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Here about the BTR driver again? Listen, it's not that simple. But things are slowly progressing, thanks to you. By the way, the Scavs are really coming down on my soldiers right now. I don't know if it's Skier who has learned something about our plans, or if someone is actively recruiting new bandits, but it's impossible to do business like this, that's for sure. If you want your comrade and I to work together, you have to remove this hindrance.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 30 targets on any location

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
1× AS VAL 9x39 special assault rifle
3× VSS/VAL 9x39 6L25 20-round magazine (Plum)
4× 9x39mm PAB-9 gs ammo pack (20 pcs)
No more sticks in the wheels now. Thank you. You can tell your friend that I will soon prepare everything for him to come under our protection.

In this quest you have to eliminate any 30 targets on any location.

quests.title: Stick to It
quests.content:
Stick to It is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I already told you everything in the car. But if you really wanna get the smugglers to put in a more comfortable transport option to Icebreaker, you'll need to help them out with their fight against the Rogues first. Looks like things between them are pretty serious, and honestly I have no idea where it's going worst. So you can take initiative anywhere you want, just make sure there are fewer Rogue fighters left. Otherwise the smugglers won't even listen to you, they've got bigger problems right now.

The door

Eliminate 30 Rogues

+25,000 EXP
100,000 Roubles

Didn't think you'd do it this well. Good work, man.

quests.title: Stimulating Demand
quests.content:
Stimulating Demand is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey. Got a little number for ya. One of Knight's lads got in touch with me recently, so I was already gearing up for a new supply line... Keeping the Rogues stocked with gear's only gonna do me good, specially if them smugglers are starting to get a bit too fucking big for their boots! But after the first order of basic supplies and ammo, the whole thing went quiet. Reckon the Rogues think they're all sorted now and have properly dug in at the chalets. So I'm thinking, why not give 'em a little nudge to start buying again, eh? Just make bloody sure none of 'em cottons on that I'm behind it, got me? Heard some important package turned up for them recently. That's what we're after. We need to make it look like Prapor's lot came calling, and we need to put on a proper show. So grab something unmistakably Russian and carry out a textbook raid on the chalets, then relieve 'em of their little box! Bring the box to me, mind. Never know when something like that might come in handy.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 Rogues or The Goons with 7.62x54R caliber weapons on Lighthouse
Locate and obtain the cargo package at the Rogue chalets on Lighthouse
Hand over the package

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.75
1,650 Euros
1,732 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,897 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Golden neck chain
2× Glock .45 ACP KRISS G30 MagEx 30-round magazine
2× .45 ACP RIP ammo pack (50 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of TDI KRISS Vector Gen.2 .45 ACP submachine gun at Skier LL3
Fucking beautiful! So, you didn't look inside the box, did ya? Good lad, that's exactly what I wanted! Now hand it over. I'll have a look myself.

== Guide ==

The cargo package can be found in the black (southern) chalet on Lighthouse. It is located in the basement under a green metal table.

quests.title: Stirrup
quests.content:
Stirrup is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Ah, it's you again. Decided to stick around and do more business with me, eh? Fair enough, mate. I've got a bit of a situation I need sorted out around the region. There's always some random lot getting in the way, firing shots, taking valuable gear off my lads, and putting them down without a second thought. Doesn't exactly fit with my, let's say, business model. So I need them to understand they've stepped into something serious. Thin their numbers out with pistols and let them know there's professionals working around here. I'll pay you for every head you bring down.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 10 target with pistols on Factory

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.25
450 Euros
472 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
518 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
Ah-hah, now that was a stirrup if I ever seen one! I got word from all channels that some devil is at large and grounded quite a bunch of people. You rock, get your reward.

quests.title: Stop the Fight!
quests.content:
Stop the Fight! was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Have you heard of the recent commotion, mercenary? The soldiers are not only killing bandits but now even ones of their own! Too much celebratory vodka or something? Or some patriotic movements... Well, it doesn't matter. I have sent a USEC mercenary to guard a group of valuable refugees, but he got killed by our fellow countrymen. Just because he was a USEC! Well, they are to blame as well: they shot my hired BEARs on another mission. All my plans went to waste! The survivors say that the most aggressive ones were wearing Santa Claus and Ded Moroz hats. Please, mercenary, get rid of them all.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 12 PMC operatives who are dressed in Santa or Ded Moroz hats

== Rewards ==
+13,100 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.01
75,000 Roubles
78,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
86,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× ETG-change regenerative stimulant injector
Excellent, I think further financial damage can be prevented. You deserve a reward.

quests.title: Straw
quests.content:
Straw was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Another note for you: "My interns are not hindered from their work, now I can deal with your problem. I already have my suspicions about the chemical compounds in the river. Your blood tests only confirm my suspicions. I have a solution, but you'll have to come in person to get it. Go to the Shoreline and I'll meet you there. And wear an ushanka so we can recognize you from afar. We won't shoot at you, but don't try any tricks. It's in your best interest. If you come over, I'll give you everything you need."

quests.title: Stray Dogs
quests.content:
Stray Dogs is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good day to you, soldier. Though what's so good about it? You know what a wise man once said? "People were made to torment one another". When I first read that, I thought it couldn't be true. Now I remember those words, and my heart aches. We've got a new gang stirring up trouble in the city. I sent one of my men to talk to them, to try and bring them to their senses. They sent his head back to me. The letter I had asked him to deliver, they stuffed it into his mouth... They're not from around here. All of them came out of USEC, though they've long since turned their backs on their own. They need to be tracked down and wiped out, every last one of them. This is our land. There'll be no more talking with them.

== Objectives ==
Locate and eliminate Knight (in one raid)
Locate and eliminate Big Pipe (in one raid)
Locate and eliminate Birdeye (in one raid)

quests.title: Superhuman

Hey, fighter. I won't waste time, let's get straight to it. We've got a very, very important sponsor. The guy's a bit of a nut, but he pours in serious money. I take his requests extremely seriously, and I don't just hire anyone for these things. Recently, he pitched me an unusual idea, and, well you get the picture, it needs to happen. Good day, brother! I've got a job for you. Have you seen how many cash registers at Ultra are locked up? You can't just break into them. Some weird stuff in these fancy-looking chemical containers. Looks a bit like your gun suppressor, just bigger. No clue what's inside: some new narcotic, or bloody Omega-3 or something.
