What'chu want, merc? A job? Ha! Looking for a good net salary and a full social package? Alright then, I'll give you a job. I still barely know you, so let's see what you can do. I'll give you this: find me a white body armor, the one that looks like paper, and one Toz shotty. Gonna gear up my guys a little. But make sure to get the fresh ones, got it? quests.title: Supply and Demand
quests.content:
Supply and Demand was a community goal Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Judging by the latest news, the situation in Tarkov cannot be called stable. We have to make do with what we have. However, I have a unique proposition for you. A new phase of the conflict is about to develop. History repeats itself in cycles, and my predictions never fail me. I have just received a good shipment of all kinds of stuff, and thanks to you, I can finally breathe freely. I've decided to invest in a major market research. Just like the last time, I need you to use your favorite weapon, but now you'll be wearing a special tracker that will help us stay in touch. I've recruited some of your other colleagues to do the same. The most popular weapons will be put on sale. If it works out well, I'll even try to get a discount on the rest of the stuff. So, you in?

== Objectives ==
Eliminate PMCs with your favorite weapon

== Rewards ==
15× Physical Bitcoin
Thank you, man. Stay in touch.

== Guide ==
In this quest you must eliminate as many PMC operatives as possible while using any weapon.

== Trivia ==
This was a community goal quest where players contributed globally to the progress. The current status could be tracked here. The final results were 152,875 kills globally, which resulted in the reward being 15 Physical Bitcoins and Mechanic's prices being cheaper by 5% for everyone in the following wipe, as announced on Twitter.

quests.title: Supply Plans
quests.content:
Supply Plans is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, young man. Truly glad to see you. I have a very important assignment, not for everybody to take on. Will you take it? Then listen. Do you know the sawmill in the Woods? So, during the Contract Wars period, it was used as one of the makeshift backup supply bases for TerraGroup. And I am very interested in TerraGroup supply plans in this region. I think they should be somewhere on the territory as well. Try to search for the temporary quarters for workers - there should be a secure case for documents with a special symbol.

Survive and extract from the location

Can’t stop wondering at the reliability of your services. Here is your cut.

quests.title: Surplus Goods
quests.content:
Surplus Goods is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. I've decided to get involved with military electronics, it's quite a promising business, and I've got interested people for that. And the army, as you know, has the most secure communication: digital encryptions, GPS, GLONASS and all kinds of other things. So anyway, I've got info about some device on Reserve, usually seen in workshops in the service and repair centers, I think it's used in machinery, it's some kind of control and navigation block. I want you to find this block and bring it to me. Would be interesting to see what it has inside of it. I'll reward you of course.

== Objectives ==
Obtain the MBT Integrated Navigation System on Reserve
Hand over the navigation system to Mechanic

== Rewards ==

So that's how it looks! Great. Thank you, I'll study it more thoroughly later. Here's your reward, as promised.

In this quest you need to pick up and extract with an MBT Integrated Navigation System. It can be found inside a locked room in the bigger of the two garage buildings at the repair center (white knight) on Reserve. A RB-ST key is required to open the door.

quests.title: Surprise
quests.content:
Surprise is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I came up with a great idea to make the Arena even better. And I need your help. I need to find some armor plates for a guy. He's a frequent performer, so it's time to give him an upgrade to get the crowd excited. That's the thing about shows, you don't add wood in time, the fire goes out. Well, now go get me some armor plates. The crowd's gonna squeal when they see him!

quests.title: Surprise Gift
quests.content:
Surprise Gift is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I heard you got involved in this affair with Fence and Ref. So of course you decided to come to me. You want to mess with Ref? Hmm, that would be beneficial to me. Bring me the dirt on him, and I'll find a way to use it.

== Objectives ==
Return to the old champion's hideout on Customs

Hand over the found info

1,187 Dollars
I'm glad you understand who it's more advantageous to be friends with.

So why even come to me in the first place if you're just going to give the intel to one of those two?

By completing Between Two Fires or Decisions, Decisions, you will fail and lose access to this quest.

The champion's room is located on the second floor of the three-story dorms building on Customs, between the rooms 209 and 211. A Dorm overseer key is required to enter it.

quests.title: Surveillance
quests.content:
Surveillance is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, friend... You know, I wasn't always alone. Loneliness does not bother me, of course, especially since I have a neural net if I want to talk to someone really intelligent... Still, lately it's been weighing on me to think about my relatives. My brother and his wife and kids - will you look them up? The Samoylovs, they lived in Concordia. My brother drove a very recognizable car with a tiger aerography... It might be easier to find them through his car.

== Objectives ==
Obtain the data on vehicle movement at the Concordia residential complex parking lot on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the information

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP

So, this is a recording of the first hour after the events began... There, you see his car? And there's him. Okay, they're getting in the car, driving away... They should have left before the shelling started. What a relief!

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find a hard drive on Streets of Tarkov. It can be found inside the Concordia security room which is located in the basement parking garage of the Concordia building. There are multiple spawns throughout the room.

quests.title: Swift
quests.content:
Swift is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
We've come a long way, haven't we? You've learned a great deal. Now you can teach the newcomers of Tarkov a thing or two yourself. Show them that without armor, they shouldn't even think about stepping outside their hiding place.

Eliminate any 10 targets without wearing any armor or helmets on Woods

Jaeger Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles

You made the old man proud. Carry the lessons forward.

This quest takes place on Woods. You are required to kill any 10 targets without wearing any armor vest, armored chest rig, armored headwear or armored face cover. Armored eyewear is allowed.

If you want to protect yourself during this quest, you can choose to still wear armor, but unequip it before killing a PMC.

Swift Retribution is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

So? Feel how smooth it runs now? You did me a solid with the wheels. Now we can start thinking about the fuckers who robbed my base. They can't have gotten far, they're probably still in the nature reserve. Go and punish those fucks, will you?

In this quest you have to eliminate 10 Scavs on Woods.

quests.title: Take Two
quests.content:
Take Two was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, bruv! Thought the flash drive job was over? No way it is! We took the shell off, but there's another one underneath. All the files are encrypted too. Tell me, do you have a computer in your cave? Sweet. I talked to Mechanic again and got instructions on how to decrypt them with a computer. I can't do it myself, and my boys would sooner break it than decrypt it.

== Objectives ==
Hand over Documents with decrypted data

== Rewards ==
86,300 EXP
Skier Rep +0.04
292,000 Roubles
306,600 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
335,800 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Granit Br5 ballistic plate
You got it? This is awesome. Come here, let's look at it, read it, familiarize the fuck out of it.

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks craft for Documents with decrypted data at Intelligence Center level 1.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to hand over the documents with decrypted data to Skier. To obtain them, multiple encrypted flash drives need to be decrypted at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. It is possible that a decryption process yields no progress at all, making the total amount of required flash drives variable.

quests.title: Taking What's Mine
quests.content:
Taking What's Mine was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Tell me, are you ready to help save Arena? As long as you don't switch sides and run to Skier, the reward will be generous. I'll even dig up a couple of rare pieces from my stash just for you. There are still convoys in Tarkov that never made it to their destination because of those pillaging assholes. We need to hit back properly so they don't try this again. And yeah, we also need to make up for the missing reward gear from previous collections. At least partially. I'm setting up a new convoy to collect whatever's left along the coast. That's where you come in. Bring all the masks you can find. You'll need to cross over to the fishers' island using the old barge, there's an old house still standing there. Stash my gear somewhere inside it.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 10 pillagers
(Optional) Do not assist Skier with preparing the ambush on Customs
Stash 4 painted CQCM masks in the specified spot on Shoreline

== Rewards ==
+15,000 EXP
75 GP coins
79 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
86 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× FN SCAR-H 7.62x51 assault rifle (Black)
3× FN SCAR-H 7.62x51 20-round magazine (Black)
5× 7.62x51mm M61 ammo pack (20 pcs)
You're sure you cleared it all out? Just to be clear, what you do here might decide the fate of the entire Season! Turns out Skier's behind all this shit, and if my boats hit Customs, we're in serious trouble. I'll call you as soon as I hear anything. Be ready to move and fight.

== Failure Dialogue ==
Now I finally get why I haven't seen you around the arena much lately. Gladiators rely on their own strength and don't resort to underhanded schemes. Your scheme with Skier won't ruin the new season. But if you dare show your face in the arena again, you'll have to start from the very bottom — and don't count on me to give you a hand!

== Guide ==
The masks have to be stashed at the destroyed room in the house on the Shoreline island.

House location marked on map
Stashing location

quests.title: Tarkov-Style Diplomacy
quests.content:
Tarkov-Style Diplomacy is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon, young man. Let's get straight to the point. I recently lost some of my people on the Shoreline. Naturally, that was unfortunate, but there is still a new source of medical supplies operating there. I've decided we need to approach this source from a different angle. No more attempts to take anything by force. I learned from one of the locals that this source is known as Sanitar. He is a doctor who performs surgeries out in the open and leaves his instruments nearby, inside buildings. Retrieve his medical tools for me. I believe he will be much more willing to discuss future supplies once he understands that we can reach him at any moment without him even noticing.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain Sanitar's surgery kit on Shoreline
Hand over Sanitar's surgery kit to Therapist
Locate and obtain Sanitar's ophthalmoscope on Shoreline
Hand over Sanitar's ophthalmoscope to Therapist

== Rewards ==
+28,200 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Thank you. I will handle things from here. I'll return his instruments along with a letter. This way, Sanitar will understand what we expect from him.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find Sanitar's Surgery kit marked with a blue symbol and his Marked Ophthalmoscope on Shoreline.

The surgery kit can be found on the second floor of the office building at the pier, located on top of a wardrobe.

Always arriving just when I need you! Long story short, we've got lots of rookies joining us. I love young blood, the crowd does even more so. However, we need to make sure they don't all get iced in the first fight. Show them the ropes, how to shoot and win the crowd's attention. Obviously, you're not gonna work for free! quests.title: TerraGroup Employee
quests.content:
TerraGroup Employee is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good day to you, mercenary. Because the day is actually good. I was right, the new stimulants are connected to TerraGroup. Mechanic found information about Sanitar. Not too much, and it was very expensive for us, but it's better than nothing. Sanitar worked for TerraGroup, and not as an ordinary employee. Graduated in medicine, specialist in infectious diseases, divorced... Well, that's all the information we have on him. Give me more, my friend, I'm very interested in where he got access to such resources. Find his workplace and find out more.

== Objectives ==
Locate Sanitar's workplace in the Lab
Locate and obtain any information about Sanitar's work
Hand over the found intel

+2 Stress Resistance skill levels

We have decoded that flash drive. There's a lot of important information there, but I can't tell you everything. It's classified. I can tell you about Sanitar though, he's a scientist. He studied and developed drugs, and then tested them on people. Very... bold, or, as they sometimes say, unethical research.

quests.title: Textile - Part 1
quests.content:
Textile - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Notes ==
Depending on the faction of the player there will be a different dialogue and reward.

== Dialogue ==
== BEAR Exclusive ==
Oh, brother, come in. Wanna get something cool? I have some new clothes in store for you, but it's rare and not cheap. Bring me these things, and make sure they're pristine, no traders. My supplies are completely out and I'm overwhelmed with orders. You can check Ultra, they used to sell those materials there back in the day, but the looters probably took it all over Tarkov. Let me make a list for you, I need a lot of stuff.

== USEC Exclusive ==
Come on in, no need to stand in the doorway. I have a job for you. I'm all busy with orders, and I'm almost out of materials. Can you find me some? I'll be able to offer you something new in return. It won't be cheap though. Made in.. well, you know where. And yeah, make sure that those materials are pristine, get them yourself, without traders' help. Anyway, bring them in as soon as you get them. Find them wherever you want, but I think there was a big supply of them in the Ultra mall. Lemme make a list for you.

== Objectives ==
Find 5 Aramid fabrics in raid
Hand over 5 Aramid fabrics to Ragman
Find 10 Ripstop fabrics in raid
Hand over 10 Ripstop fabrics to Ragman
Find 3 Paracords in raid
Hand over 3 Paracords to Ragman

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
1× Mystery Ranch Blackjack 50 backpack (MultiCam)
1× Peltor ComTac IV Hybrid headset (Coyote Brown)
Unlocks barter for Mystery Ranch Blackjack 50 backpack (MultiCam) at Ragman LL4

== BEAR Exclusive ==
Unlocks purchase of BEAR TIGR lower clothing at Ragman LL3
You got it? Nice. Come back soon, I'll tell you what else I need. There will be something special for you. In the meantime, go on and try on the new clothes.

== USEC Exclusive ==
Unlocks purchase of USEC Commando lower clothing at Ragman LL3
Unlocks purchase of IOTV Gen4 body armor (Assault Kit, MultiCam) at Ragman LL4
You got it? Good work. Come back a bit later, I will have another task for you. You can try on the new clothes, by the way.

== Guide ==

Aramid fiber fabric can commonly be found in clothing stores on Interchange. Ripstop fabric can be found in the same locations, though more rarely. They can also be found inside of Sport bags, Buried barrel caches, and Ground caches.
Paracord can be found in Sport bags. They can also be found spawning on the map Reserve. For more specific spawn locations visit the Paracord page.

Pieces of fabric locations on Interchange

quests.title: Textile - Part 2
quests.content:
Textile - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Notes ==
Depending on the faction of the player there will be a different dialogue and reward.

== Dialogue ==

== BEAR Exclusive ==
So, here's another list of the stuff I need. As soon as you have it - bring it here, and make sure it's in good condition. No traders and all, well, you know the deal. I'm thinking about some new outfits for you, something recognizable, warming the Russian heart. I have no idea what's the business between you and the yanks, but these days your life is as shitty as theirs. Shit happens. Anyway, good luck to you.

== USEC Exclusive ==
Come on in, I was just thinking about you. Alright, so listen, I need more of these items listed here, and they have to be brand new, no traders. Come on, don't make faces too early! I'll get you some cool news clothes for this, the Kansas spirit and all or whatever. Just imagine that, running and gunning here in a foreign country in clothes like from the ranch! Well anyway, I'm waiting for the listed items, the reward is generous.

== Objectives ==
Find 10 Fleece fabrics in raid
Hand over 10 Fleece fabrics to Ragman
Find 10 Cordura polyamide fabrics in raid
Hand over 10 Cordura polyamide fabrics to Ragman
Find 5 KEKTAPE duct tapes in raid
Hand over 5 KEKTAPE duct tapes to Ragman

1× 6Sh118 raid backpack (EMR)
1× Safariland Liberator HP 2.0 Hearing Protection Headset (FDE)

Unlocks purchase of BEAR TIGR upper clothing at Ragman LL3

C'mon, so you have everything? Leave 'em somewhere in the corner and come here, I need to measure you. This stuff is quite a rarity in our current conditions, so don't get mad about the price. But at least the American spirit won't abandon you, he-he.

The Cordura polyamide fabric and Fleece fabric can commonly be found in clothing stores on Interchange. They can also be found inside of Sport bags, Buried barrel caches, and Ground caches.
KEKTAPE duct tape can be found anywhere construction supplies spawns, drawers, and inside of toolboxes.

quests.title: That’s a Great Plan, Walter
quests.content:
That’s a Great Plan, Walter was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, gangster! My overseas colleague and I were working out a little deal, but things didn't seem to go according to plan. We needed to get a shipment across town, but it was too risky to move it all at once. So they split up the big shipment into lots of little ones and locked the cases. Even if some loser finds it, they won't be able to open it! Peacekeeper said the shipment's already in Tarkov, but my guys at the drop points haven't seen shit yet. Be a good boy and go check it out. Scour around, and if you find our cargo, bring it here. Easy day's work, yeah?

quests.title: The Art of Explosion
quests.content:
The Art of Explosion is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there, soldier! I recently worked out a deal to get my hands on a new kind of weapon. Same family as grenades, only a whole lot nastier. This isn't the sort of thing you hand out to just anyone. It takes discipline, good judgment. Plus the stock's limited.So if you want to buy this kind of serious hardware from me, prove you know how to put explosives on target. No shortcuts. I'd rather not have you blowing yourself up or turning one of your own into a casualty.Use whatever gets the job done. Underbarrel launchers, homemade grenades, doesn't matter to me. I only care about the results.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 20 PMC operatives with grenades or grenade launchers

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Grenade Launchers skill levels
+4 Underbarrel Launchers skill levels
Prapor Rep +1.5
400,000 Roubles
420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× RShG-2 72.5mm rocket launcher
1× Granit 4 ballistic plate (Front)
Unlocks purchase of RShG-2 72.5mm rocket launcher at Prapor LL4
Unlocks purchase of Granit 4 ballistic plate (Front) at Prapor LL4
Yup, I've already heard about your handiwork. In your hands, an RShG's more of an asset than a liability. Like I said, these things are hard to come by, but I'll set one aside for you whenever I get a shipment.When you use it, make sure you've got plenty of space around you and nobody standing behind you. Oh, and read the instructions printed on the launcher. Don't be an idiot.

In this quest you have to kill 20 PMC Operatives with grenades, underbarrel grenade launchers, grenade launchers or rocket launchers. Kills with the stationary AGS-30 grenade launcher do not count.

Note: The 40x46mm M576 (MP-APERS) grenade does not work for this quest, because it is a buckshot cartridge instead of an actual grenade.

== Trivia ==
This quest was released together with the video "Art of Explosion"

quests.title: The Bad Batch
quests.content:
The Bad Batch was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

== Dialogue ==
Howdy there, champion! Got some news for ya. One ridiculously rich guy's decided he wants to host a tournament with us. He's offering serious cash, plus he's a good fella too... Helped us get the Arena off the ground. Can't exactly turn him down. He's supplying the weapons himself, and that's where things get interesting. These things kick so hard they'll break your fingers after a couple of shots. No idea where he got them, but I've already signed on. So get in on it too. You'll make a fortune.

Play a match in SBEU HERO mode

quests.title: The Bosses gathering
quests.content:
The Bosses gathering was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, there's an emergency for you. I got a tip that all the local gangsters are gathering. Well we all ain't saints now. In short, folks say the bosses will all gather to talk business. At Reserve base. But the information is not accurate. Go there, observe, check out the situation. And then let me know what's all the commotion about. If you make it out alive, of course.

+1 level Charisma
+1 level Stress Resistance

quests.title: The Bunker
quests.content:
The Bunker is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, warrior. I'll get straight to the point. Word is they've uncovered an entrance to an underground bunker beneath our reserve military base. Where the hell it came from, I've got no idea, but the place ought to be interesting. I'm not sending my own boys into the unknown, they're more useful to me alive. So head over there and take a look around, search for entrances and exits as well. If it turns out this bunker wasn't built for grunts, but for the top brass, report back to me.

== Objectives ==
Locate the underground bunker on Reserve
Locate the control room in the underground bunker on Reserve
Locate the hermetic door leading to the hospital (White Bishop) on Reserve
Locate one of the two hermetic doors leading to the academy building (Black Bishop) on Reserve
Locate one of the two hermetic doors leading to barracks #1 (Black Pawn) on Reserve
Locate one of the two hermetic doors leading to barracks #2 (White Pawn) on Reserve
Locate the hermetic door leading to the air control center building (King) on Reserve

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Alright don't be shy, mark those entrances right on this map. I'll get your reward in the meantime.

== Guide ==
The underground bunker on Reserve can be reached by using any staircase. The hermetic doors are the entry doors to the bunker. The control room is located in the center of the bunker. All objectives have to be completed in the same raid.

quests.title: The Bunker - Part 2
quests.content:
The Bunker - Part 2 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, merc, you are just in time, you are exactly who I need. Do you remember that fucking command bunker you found under the Reserve base? Long story short, my guys went there, and it turned out to be a real nasty place. Built with a high level of protection: filters, generators, all entrances are blocked by extremely strong hermetic locks, it's like an underground fortress. But the raiders opened the fucking thing and dug in like Alabama ticks. So, my men got in serious trouble, less than half made it out of there. But you know, now it's even more intriguing, for fuck's sake. So my people will not go there anymore for no reason, but if you could find a safe route for them... You are an experienced guy, so I need you to quietly, on those soft paws of yours, find out where all the entrances are. The guys said the entrances had those big hermetic doors. So it's up to you to scout the way in.

== Requirements ==
Must be level 15 to start this quest.

== Objectives ==
Locate the hermetic door leading to the hospital (White Bishop) on Reserve
Locate one of two hermetic doors leading to the academy building (Black Bishop) on Reserve
Locate one of two hermetic doors leading to barracks #1 (Black Pawn) on Reserve
Locate one of two hermetic doors leading to barracks #2 (White Pawn) on Reserve
Locate the hermetic door leading to the building of the air control center (King) on Reserve
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+9,200 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.03
25,000 Roubles
26,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
28,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Kalashnikov AKS-74UB 5.45x39 assault rifle
1× 5.45x39mm BS gs ammo pack (120 pcs)
1× AK CAA RS47 handguard
1× AK-74M CAA AKTS AK74 buffer tube
Welcome back, I'm listening. Aha, so that's how it is... The door is right there, right? Just draw it right on top of my map, don't worry. So this bunker connects almost all facilities of the base? Fuck, how convenient, you could travel half the base under everyone's nose. Now it's clear why the raiders are there, the entire base is under control there. Thank you, warrior! Here's your reward.

== Guide ==
For this quest you have to locate and visit hermetic doors in the underground bunker system on Reserve. For the subtasks 2, 3 and 4 you only need to find one of each which leaves 5 in total. The doors have to be visited in the same raid.

quests.title: The Choice

The Choice is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

Greetings, mercenary. As I see, you are not wasting your time and have achieved a lot on your way. Sometimes in life, you know, we have to lose something to achieve something bigger in the end? Not everyone is ready for this. Many aren't willing to take risks in their entire life, they are afraid, they don't believe in themselves. What about you, are you ready for this yourself? Are you ready to sacrifice something of value to achieve a bigger goal?

The Cleaner is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

You know, I have foreign partners who are working on evacuating important assets from Tarkov. They are especially interested in Reserve and the laboratory beneath the city. But recently, they have encountered some competition... Can you help and eliminate these obstacles?

quests.title: The Door
quests.content:
The Door is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hi, I have a delicate matter. I'm a man of science and I'm used to always find an explanation for everything. As you know, I'm interested in all sorts of signals coming from the territory of our beautiful city. There is a strange place where all my scans are strangely muffled, as if there is nothing there, empty, which is impossible from a scientific point of view. The source itself is in the second or third floor of a certain building. Why don't you go check it out, see if there's some kind of equipment? Set up a couple cameras for me for surveillance. The reference point will be the house with the astronaut mural on the wall.

== Objectives ==
Locate the cause of the signal interference on Streets of Tarkov
Install a WI-FI Camera to watch the door
Install a WI-FI Camera to watch the stairwell
Note: The "Install" objectives will appear after the "Locate" objective is completed.

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Oh, it's you. The signal went through, but it didn't clear up the situation - there are random looters and curious people wandering around, but still at some moments the signal goes blank, and the cameras go crazy. And then there's this weird door... I don't personally believe in the supernatural. I'll keep an eye out, stay in touch. Thanks for your work.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to place two WI-FI Cameras in the Klimova 16A building on Streets of Tarkov. A Rusted bloody key is required. One has to be placed in the staircase in front of the locked door on the fourth floor, and the other one has to be placed at the heater next to the chained door in the area behind the locked door.

quests.title: The Extortionist
quests.content:
The Extortionist is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Kinda busy right now! Although... Hang on a sec. There is an urgent matter. There was a firefight about an hour ago in the garages across the river. Just where my errand boy was headed. To hell with him, he was a total moron anyway. But he had with him one particular key. A mighty complex key, I might add. To the door that can be freaking anywhere, you know? This clown was delivering one very valuable thing to me. The bastard hid it somewhere and locked it with this arsetormenting key and came to me to talk up the price. What a bitch! I even raised the pay a little for the smart move, but this wanker still hasn’t told me where it was and went to get it for himself. And I’m almost sure he’s got done in there. Find the key, and then find me that package even if you have to check all doors from the center to the port.

Locate and obtain the hidden valuable cargo on Customs

You’re a damn Pinkerton! Helped me out big time! So, you found my idiot errand boy? Well, screw him. If you do something similar, you'll get smoked like him too. Go on, buzz off, I've got some stuff to do.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to pick up a folder from a locked cabin on Customs. The required Unknown key can be found on a dead Scav that is also located on Customs. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid, regardless of whether or not a player in the raid has this quest active.

quests.title: The Good Times - Part 1
quests.content:
The Good Times - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello again! Remember the good old time when all the major fighting took place at Polikhim? People were buying tons of gear from me back then. There was a kit, the most popular among PMCs. I was wondering how it performs in the field nowadays. Check it out for me and tell me how it is, yea?

== Requirements ==
This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.
Reach Loyalty Level 2 with Prapor, Therapist, Skier, Mechanic and Ragman.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 PMC operatives while wearing 6B43 body armor and Kiver-M helmet on Factory

Thanks for your help, soldier! Nowadays, there's battles all over the city, and everyone's got their own different equipment. It's an arms race, I'll tell you that!

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 5 PMCs on Factory while wearing both the FORT Kiver-M bulletproof helmet and the 6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR).

== Trivia ==
This quest is a reference to the beginnings of the game. Back when the only helmet was the FORT Kiver-M bulletproof helmet and the only available armors were the PACA Soft Armor and the 6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR). So running a Kiver-M helmet + 6B43 armor combo on Factory was the meta.

quests.title: The Good Times - Part 2
quests.content:
The Good Times - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The factory run was amazing, your stories made my memory come flooding back! The gunfights are one thing, but when the bandits' leaders showed up, that's when it got real hot. Reshala was the first to show up, always bragging about his gold TT. Back then, everyone wanted one of these in their holster. But now, for some reason, the demand for TTs is going down. Can you remind everyone what kind of weapons real men fight with?

Older models always have a kind of personality to them. And this one, the gilding, the grip... Something about it just feels right, doesn't it?

quests.title: The Graven Image
quests.content:
The Graven Image was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Alright, I've got good news for you. Partisan managed to eavesdrop on the cultists' conversation before the tripwire killed them. The Harbinger, as they call him, is in charge of this whole terror parade. He promised them that if they did what he told them, they'd receive the new Gift of the Unheard. What the hell? I have no idea what this means. But I'm certain that if you let them perform the damn ritual, there'll be countless victims amongst the decent folk. People have started fleeing the Streets, they say a ghost is hunting for souls. We don't know the details of this mystery, but it's definitely connected to the whole thing! And we know who's behind it. We need to take out the Harbinger, and if you find any creepy crap near him, try to bury it deep in the ground. Maybe that'll keep the cultists in line.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize the Oni
Locate and neutralize the Harbinger
Locate and neutralize the Ghost

== Rewards ==
+40,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.04
200,000 Roubles
210,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
230,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Armasight Zeus-Pro 640 2-8x50 30Hz thermal scope
1× SIG Sauer ECHO1 1-2x30mm 30Hz thermal reflex scope
1× Abandoned factory marked key
1× Mysterious room marked key
The bastards are taken care of? Damn things belong in hell anyway. Hopefully, the rest of the cultists will back off and go back to their dens. Funny thing is, Zryachiy's been absent lately, too. I wonder if he came down from the Lighthouse to finish the ritual and let those demons out into the light of day.

== Guide ==
The special Cultists Oni, Harbinger and Ghost appear between 22:00 and 7:00 in the same spawn locations as the Goons. They can be found on the following locations:

== Customs ==
In the construction area around the Scav base and the laboratory.

== Woods ==
At the antenna in the northwest (Scav Bunker extraction).

== Shoreline ==
At the weather station on the hill in the southeast.

== Lighthouse ==
At the water treatment plant in the north, and at the blue chalet.

quests.title: The Guide
quests.map: Customs, Factory, Ground Zero, Interchange, Lighthouse, Reserve, Shoreline, Streets of Tarkov, The Lab, Woods
quests.content:
The Guide is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come in, I have a high-paying assignment for you. Some important people from outside the region... require the services of a professional guide. Someone who can lead a group to their destination, provide cover, and not ask unnecessary questions. They are willing to pay very well for this. Do you think you are suitable for the job? Prove yourself, and I will vouch for you.

== Objectives ==
Survive and extract from Woods or Interchange with the "Survived" exit status
Survive and extract from Factory or Customs with the "Survived" exit status
Survive and extract from Shoreline or Reserve with the "Survived" exit status
Survive and extract from The Lab or Lighthouse with the "Survived" exit status
Survive and extract from Ground Zero or Streets of Tarkov  with the "Survived" exit status
Eliminate any 15 targets

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+2 Stress Resistance skill levels
+4 DMRs skill levels
Peacekeeper Rep +1.5
2,750 Dollars
2,888 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
3,162 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Velocity Systems SLAAP Plate (Tan)
Unlocks purchase of Velocity Systems SLAAP Plate (Tan) at Peacekeeper LL4
Unlocks purchase of AR-15 Vltor MUR-1S 5.56x45 upper receiver at Peacekeeper LL4
Unlocks craft for 4.6x30mm AP SX at Workbench level 3
Very good work. You really could become an excellent guide! I will contact you with further instructions once my clients are ready. Here is your advance payment.

== Failure Dialogue ==
Well... I know this kind of task is not easy. That is exactly why I need a serious candidate, you understand?

== Guide ==
You must survive a raid at each location consecutively without dying, disconnecting, or running out the timer. If you do any of these you will have to start again. If you extract from the raid with a "Run Through" status, you will not reset the quest, but that raid will not count as being completed. To avoid the "Run Through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting. You do not have to do the maps in any order, they can be done in any fashion as long as you survive.

This quest can also be completed in a single raid when using transits.

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Administrator
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Administrator is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Notes ==
Depending on the faction of the player there are different dialogues and objectives.

== Dialogue ==
== BEAR Exclusive ==
In our line of work, we can't afford to rest or slow down. Evil won't be defeated that way. So here's my next task for you. I've been told that something suspicious is happening at the Reserve base, around the loading area. Head there and deal with whatever filth has gathered there. And don't forget to fire the signal flare first, so I know you've begun your work. I'll take care of anyone who tries to run.

== USEC Exclusive ==
You're not one of us, of course, but I can tell there's something in you... something that understands. In our line of work, we can't afford to rest or slow down. Evil won't be crushed that way. So here's my next task for you. I've been told that something suspicious is happening at the water treatment plant, around the loading area. Head there and deal with whatever filth has gathered there. And don't forget to fire the signal flare first, so I know you've begun your work. I'll take care of anyone who tries to run.

== Objectives ==
== BEAR Exclusive ==
Launch a yellow signal flare at the train depot on Reserve
Eliminate any 6 targets at the train depot on Reserve

== USEC Exclusive ==
Launch a yellow signal flare at the train station on Lighthouse
Eliminate any 6 targets at the train station territory on Lighthouse
Note: The "Eliminate" objective will appear after the "Launch a yellow signal flare" objective is completed.

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,050 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2

== BEAR Exclusive ==
You and I make a fine team.

== USEC Exclusive ==
Surprisingly, the two of us make a good team.

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being inside the train area on Reserve or Lighthouse, depending on your faction. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. Afterwards you have to kill any 6 targets in the area in the same raid.

BEAR: Reserve kill and flare areas marked on map
USEC: Lighthouse kill and flare areas marked on map

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Angry Watchman
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Angry Watchman is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon. I have a task for you. Before all this, customs and factory personnel lived in the dormitories on Customs, but now there are only looters. The Scavs are one thing, these fools have their brains completely beaten off, but your mercenary colleagues often go there too, and this is not good at all. They just rob the place, I hate those damn looters! Whatever times are, you must always remain human. Clear the dorms area, let the place breathe in peace again.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 PMCs in the Dorms area on Customs

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Corrugated hose
I've heard what you did. Looks like it's calmer out there now, with way fewer looters. You have my gratitude.

== Guide ==

Kill area marked on map

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Big Game
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Big Game is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I recently came across a family in the woods, a father and his son. Both were exhausted, and the boy had taken a bullet. I brought them back to my place, patched the kid up, and fed them both. The father told me they didn't make it out during the evacuation. Later, some bandits took them in like livestock. Forced them to work at an auto shop, with a bullet to the head as the alternative. Their leader goes by Kaban. Apparently, he's a respected man among them. The two of them escaped during the night and somehow made it through the gunfire into the woods, where I found them. The boy's wound was too severe. He didn't make it through the night. So, to the point. If another gang of criminals has taken root in this city, then you and I need to deal with them. Avenge that father's loss, and make sure something like this doesn't happen to anyone else again.

== Objectives ==
Locate and eliminate Kaban

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
One less scumbag to worry about. You did well, kid.

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Control
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Control is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello-hello. I've got a new job for you. There's been a lot of talk lately about those so-called laboratories. I don't like all this commotion, especially all the pillagers dragging whatever they can get their hands on out of those places. Head down there and thin their ranks. Make an example of them so others think twice before following in their footsteps. Do it quickly, or they won't get the message.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 10 targets in The Lab (in one raid)

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Throwables skill levels
Jaeger Rep +1.5
400,000 Roubles
420,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
460,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
Unlocks barter for Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant MRS) at Jaeger LL4
I've already heard rumors of what you did. Keep it up.

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Controller
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Controller is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come on in. As a hunter, I can tell you for sure that holding control over the target is really important. Sometimes if you manage to blind the animal, even the most dangerous one, it stops being dangerous to you. This works with humans as well. Who cares how pimped out their guns are if they're as blind as moles? I want you to show me if you're able to properly blind your enemy.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 2 PMCs while they are suffering from the stun effect

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
1× NcSTAR ADO P4 Sniper 3-9x42 riflescope
1× 7.62x51mm M80 ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant AICS) at Jaeger LL3
Learned the lesson? Good. See, you can disarm an enemy in many ways.

== Guide ==
You can use the M7290 grenade, the Zarya grenade or a KS-23M with the Zvezda flashbang round to cause the stun effect for this quest. Factory is a recommended location for this quest, as there are ample opportunities to engage PMC's at close distance, thus reducing their chance to escape the stun effect.

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Crooked Cop
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Crooked Cop is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come in, sit by the fire. We need to talk. Tarkov needs to be cleansed. Our next target is a former cop known as Kollontay. He was causing trouble even before everything fell apart, and now he's only gotten worse. Find him and deal with him. They say he's holed up in the MVD academy downtown.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize Kollontay
Hand over the found in raid Kollontay's police baton

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
It's done? I'm glad to hear it. There's a little less filth in our city now. Here's your reward.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to kill Kollontay as well as find his PR-Taran police baton in raid.

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Eraser
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Eraser is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come in, have a seat. I've got a special job for you. You know the military base south of the customs terminal? There's a man holed up there, a former Marine. Even before everything fell apart in Tarkov, he had already turned to crime. His people had connections everywhere: law enforcement, customs, the whole lot. When it all went to hell, the gang fell apart, except for him... He gathered a circle of trusted men, fellow former soldiers, and dug in at the base. Now he's selling off military stockpiles on the black market and doesn't take kindly to visitors. Worse still, I've heard he's smuggling goods beyond the region. That has to end. Rid Tarkov of him and his crew. And one more thing: bring me a few trophies from them.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize Glukhar
Hand over 2 found in raid Glukhar's guards' helmets
(Optional) Search Glukhar's guards and collect their helmets of Class 4 or higher

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Welcome back, hunter. So you dealt with the bandits? I can only imagine how much trouble they gave you. You did well. Excellent work.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill Glukhar and hand over 2 found in raid helmets of class 4 or higher. You can hand over any of the following helmets:
Altyn assault helmet (Olive Drab)
Vulkan-5 LShZ-5 bulletproof helmet (Black)
HighCom Striker ULACH IIIA helmet (Black)
HighCom Striker ULACH IIIA helmet (Desert Tan)
MSA Gallet TC 800 High Cut combat helmet (Black)
Ops-Core FAST MT Super High Cut helmet (Black)
BNTI LShZ-2DTM helmet (Black)
Maska-1SCh bulletproof helmet (Olive Drab)
MSA ACH TC-2002 MICH Series helmet (Olive Drab)
6B47 Ratnik-BSh helmet (EMR cover)
NPP KlASS Tor-2 helmet (Olive Drab)
NFM HJELM helmet (Hellhound Grey)
ZSh-1-2M helmet (Black cover)
ZSh-1-2M helmet (Olive Drab)

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Factory Chief
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Factory Chief is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good day to you. There's a special task for you today. A new individual dug in the old chemical plant, the one TerraGroup used for their shady business, locals call this man Tagilla. Either breathed in some chemicals or got hit in the head - the fellow went completely off the rails. Murdering both his own people and the others. He uses a sledgehammer, and he's good with it, even a professional shooter would begrudge him. He's finished many people in that factory's corridors. Scavs respect him and don't get in his way. There's no place for such as him on this earth... You know what to do, hunter.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize Tagilla
Find 1 BOSS cap in raid
Hand over 1 BOSS cap to Jaeger

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
That's good news. The world will only get cleaner. Hope the bastard didn't get you with his sledgehammer?

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to kill Tagilla (Not Shadow of Tagilla) and find his cap in raid.

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Forest Cleaning
quests.map: Lighthouse, Reserve, Shoreline, Streets of Tarkov
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Forest Cleaning is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings. For years I've been hunting in these woods, and among other things, I've learned that animals are way more humane than humankind itself. When the conflict started, all that's left of those remains of humane in people just vanished entirely. There are so many monsters out there that I can't even imagine. Those are no longer people, nor they are animals, they are something way worse... We can't let them destroy our city, we have to sort this out. Deal with this, hunter.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 50 Scavs on Streets of Tarkov, Reserve, Lighthouse, or Shoreline

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Shustrilo sealing foam
They made their choice when they stepped on the wrong path. You have done the right thing, hunter, thank you.

== Guide ==
Kill 50 Scavs on Streets of Tarkov, Reserve, Lighthouse, or Shoreline.

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Justice
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Justice is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good to see you, kid. Have you ever tracked prey during a hunt? When all this chaos started in Tarkov, I've seen all kinds of things. Those who were supposed to uphold the law became even worse than the criminals they were meant to stop. Some of them didn't even bother changing out of their uniforms, can you believe that? I have my own reasons for wanting them gone. Deal with the remaining members of Reshala's crew. They'll be wearing police uniforms, so you won't have any trouble recognizing them. And bring me one of their armor vests as a trophy.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 3 Reshala's guards
Hand over one of Reshala's guards' armor vest

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Corrugated hose
You did a good thing. One more piece of filth has been removed from this world. Here, this is from both me and the Mechanic.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 3 of Reshala's followers and hand over 1 of their found in raid armors. You can hand over any of the following:
6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR)
BNTI Gzhel-K body armor
BNTI Zhuk body armor (EMR)
BNTI Zhuk body armor (EMR)
FORT Defender-2 body armor
FORT Redut-M body armor
NPP KlASS Korund-VM body armor (Black)

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Liberation
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Liberation is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
When life goes to hell, you find out real quick who people really are. Who stays human, and who doesn't. Not everyone manages to hold on to their conscience. Word reached me that a new force has appeared in the region. All they care about is looting and taking whatever isn't nailed down. They call themselves the Raiders. Former soldiers and mercenaries, gathering into squads and putting key locations under their own "protection". Folks say they've got an influential patron somewhere beyond the border. Put those bandits down.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 6 Raiders

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Shustrilo sealing foam
So they're operating near laboratories and military facilities... Oh, I hope it won't start another war, on top of the one already going on. Well, kid, it's not for us to resolve this, at least for now.

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Outcasts
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Outcasts is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there, kid, I have bad news. Word reached me that a bunch of scum had settled somewhere on the coast beyond the collapsed tunnel. They do whatever the hell they want, harass the whole territory - like a pack of wild wolves. And it's not even some local bandits, but your former work colleagues. As I understand it, when the whole conflict began, their main base was somewhere on the cape. Unlike you, these do not want to return home, but to plunder our land to the last, those bastards! Get rid of them and be careful, soldier.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 10 Rogues

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Shustrilo sealing foam
Finally, you're back! I've started to worry. Come, let me at least get you something to eat.

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Relentless
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Relentless is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come on in, kid. Got anything interesting to tell? Eh, forget it, don't want to listen about your war. Got enough of it here. I don't have much to teach you anymore, you know how to stand up for yourself, and you know of justice well. Met the local bandit leaders too. But have you tried getting them all at once? The task in not an easy one, but the goal is worth it. The most important thing is what mark we leave behind us.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate Tagilla
Eliminate Killa
Eliminate Reshala
Eliminate Shturman
Eliminate Glukhar
Eliminate Sanitar

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Shotguns skill levels
+4 Throwables skill levels
Jaeger Rep +1.5
400,000 Roubles
420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
100 GP coins
105 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
115 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× FLIR RS-32 2.25-9x 35mm 60Hz thermal riflescope
Unlocks barter for Armasight Zeus-Pro 640 2-8x50 30Hz thermal scope at Jaeger LL4
Unlocks Hog Hideout shooting range target style

I've heard, I've heard. You did the right thing, kid. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

== Failure Dialogue ==
Couldn't handle it, I figure? Don't worry, I don't blame you, boy, it's not an easy task. So go on, recuperate and come back.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill all described bosses in one "life". This means that you have to kill them all, and extract successfully to complete the quest. For the locations of the bosses check their respective pages.

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Sadist
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Sadist is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there, kid. Something nostalgic came over me. I remembered how I walked along the coast, it was beautiful there, the waves roll in, the sun, the beach, and the sunsets there were outstanding, and now what? The smell of rot and desolation everywhere, can't even breathe properly in the city... And on top of all that, a new moron showed up. They call him Sanitar. This scum conducts experiments on people and perhaps does even more terrible things. You can't leave it like this, such people.. such abominations should not walk our ground. The world will only become cleaner. Deal with this.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate Sanitar
Hand over the found in raid Sanitar's bag

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Covert Movement skill levels
Jaeger Rep +1.5
400,000 Roubles
420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
100 GP coins
105 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
115 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Trijicon REAP-IR thermal scope
You did the right thing. Even if others say that Sanitar did good deeds, he brought much more evil. Don't believe those people's lies. I've seen people like Sanitar before: once they go crazy, there's no turning back. You can only shoot them like rabid dogs.

== Failure Penalty ==
So you believed that woman? You do realise that she's just deceiving you for her own benefit? Do you think that because Sanitar treats some people, he can't kill others? You've completely gone insane with that war or yours, can't distinguish black from white. Get out of my sight, I want to be alone.

== Guide ==

By completing A Difficult Choice, you will fail and lose access to this quest.

In this quest you have to kill Sanitar and hand over his found in raid bag.

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Secured Perimeter
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Secured Perimeter is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I've heard there's trouble brewing at the chemical plant these days. Looters are crawling all over the place, carrying off anything they can get their hands on. And I know every inch of that place. I worked security there myself for half a year, before TerraGroup showed up. None of this sits right with me. Those bandits need to be taught a lesson. Make them forget the road to that factory, if only for a little while.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 6 PMC operatives on Factory

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Well done! There's no shortage of scum in Tarkov, and others will come soon enough. But next time, they'll think twice before helping themselves to what isn't theirs.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 6 PMCs anywhere on Factory

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Sellout
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Sellout is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Be well, soldier. Do you like shopping? I used to love it too, we had a shopping center here. It was nice to spend time there, but as everything collapsed, there was no time for entertainment anymore, the stores quickly got looted, and what didn’t get looted got taken over by all kinds of scum as their mainstays. I heard that there was that one person - a former athlete, he's already been racketing before the war, and now as he has felt more power than ever, he's killing everyone indiscriminately. People call him Killa, and his helmet... you won’t miss it. Get rid of him, everybody will say thank you. And take his helmet with you, just in case.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize Killa
Find 1 Killa's Maska-1SCh bulletproof helmet in raid
Hand over 1 Killa's Maska-1SCh bulletproof helmet to Jaeger

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Finally, he got what he deserved. I believe the day is near when there will be no such scum left in these parts. Thank you, kid.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to kill Killa (Not Vengeful Killa) and find a Maska-1SCh helmet in raid.

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Trophy
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Trophy is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I've got a hunting job for you, kid... There's this cockroach around here they call Reshala. I'm sure you've heard of him already, haven't you? Walks around with a golden pistol, showing it off like some kind of king. He's been interfering with me and my work for a long time, dragging his gang along with him. A lot of good people have ended up dead because of him. As for him, he's nothing but a coward, always hiding behind his guards. Help me get rid of him, and Tarkov will breathe a little easier. While you're at it, bring me his pistol. It'll make a fine gift for the Mechanic. Just be extremely careful. Good hunting, warrior.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize Reshala
Hand over the found in raid Reshala's Golden TT-33 pistol to Jaeger

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Corrugated hose
You've done a good deed. One less bastard walking on this land. Take this, a gift from me and Mechanic.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to kill Reshala and find his golden TT pistol in raid.

quests.title: The Huntsman Path - Woods Keeper
quests.content:
The Huntsman Path - Woods Keeper is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
For many years working as a gamekeeper, I know that if there is an infection in the forest, then you need to get rid of it immediately before the whole forest gets infected. One such infection settled here, they call it Shturman, he and his crew set up at the sawmill, so now I don't feel safe even in my own reserve. Deal with it, it will be for the better for the forest and the people. But be careful, kid, Shturman has friends, and they all can shoot well.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize Shturman
Search Shturman for his stash key
Hand over 1 Shturman's stash key to Jaeger

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
So you made Shturman finally leave the sawmill. Well, not bad, many people can breathe in peace now. I might even move closer to the city myself, closer to home. Here's the reward, found some strange stashes in the woods, and that's what was in them. I don't need them, but you might find them useful.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to kill Shturman and find his stash key in raid.

quests.title: The Invisible Hand
quests.content:
The Invisible Hand is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, bro. My friendly competitors are poaching my customers. If they want to declare a trade war on me, then my answer has to be very serious. I found out how they transport their goods. They hire guys with big backpacks. Take care of those mules, will you?

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 15 targets that are using a 20+ container size backpack

== Rewards ==
+12,800 EXP
86,000 Roubles
90,300 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
98,900 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Gold skull ring
Sick! That's how trade issues should always be dealt with.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill any 15 targets that are wearing a backpack with 20+ slots.

quests.title: The Key to Success
quests.content:
The Key to Success is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good day to you! We already went so far together, you’re like a brother to me. Like family, see, don’t get me wrong. So, like a brother, answer frankly, do you like reading? I devoured books back then, as a kid. But now I need a serious book, for business. A rare bitch for sure, but I know you can get a devil from under the ground if you'd want. Get me the book about designing clothes from special fabrics, all that military stuff has to be made with aramid fabric, which has its own tricks to it. There should be a manual for them, in two volumes. If you can get it, that’d be capital. Should probably check in the book stores, they must be there. ULTRA had, as I remember, the "Knigoyed" and "Museum of History" stores, so make sure to search them both.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the Clothes design handbook - Part 1 on Interchange
Hand over the Clothes design handbook - Part 1 to Ragman
Locate and obtain the Clothes design handbook - Part 2 on Interchange
Hand over the Clothes design handbook - Part 2 to Ragman

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Phase control relay
1× MSA Sordin Supreme PRO-X/L headset
1× Walker's XCEL 500BT Digital headset
You really found them? Thank you, friend. Don't get any ideas, these books are very important, they'll help me with my business.

== Guide ==

The first book is located in a store called "МУЗЕЙ ИСТОРИИ" ("Museum of History") on the second floor of the shopping mall on Interchange. It can be found in a pile of books on the floor.

Store location marked on second floor map
The store that contains the first book, arrow marks the pile of books
First book location

The second book is located in a book store on the first floor of the shopping mall on Interchange. It can be found on the middle shelf, in the lowest row that contains books.

Store location marked on first floor map
The store that contains the second book, arrow marks the middle shelf
Second book location

quests.title: The Old-Fashioned Way
quests.content:
The Old-Fashioned Way was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

== Dialogue ==
Let's make the show even more spectacular. The rules are simple: one head, one round. Put them together and you've got yourself a bloody firework. The Arena crowd never gets tired of clean headshots. So let's keep it classic—and make every shot count. Get to work, operator.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 30 opponents with headshots in CheckChamber mode

== Rewards ==
+14,000 EXP
450,000 Roubles
40 GP coins
1× Valuables crate (Rare)
2 Battle Points

quests.title: The Price of Celebration
quests.map: Shoreline, Lighthouse, Reserve, Woods, Customs, Interchange
quests.content:
The Price of Celebration was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Can you fucking believe this? First they tried to steal my gas cans, and now they're gathering at the Christmas trees directly on my gang's routes! Because of this, I have to change my plans and organize other paths for the couriers. They're gonna freeze to death with all those long-ass detours. I'm not gonna wait for them to get done with the celebrations and go to their holes after. This bullshit has to stop right now. The ones who take part in this "Khorovod" wear special armbands. Those tossers made glowing targets of themselves! I need the job done quickly, so I'm gonna call other mercs as well. You can work as a group if you want, but I can't guarantee they won't shoot at you. You know, every man for himself, and all that.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 10 PMC operatives who are wearing the Christmas armband
Note: The objective in the PvE mode is to eliminate 10 PMC operators while not wearing the armband yourself.

== Rewards ==
+13,250 EXP
Skier Rep +0.03
2,200 Euros
2,310 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,530 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka
3× Bottle of Dan Jackiel whiskey
1× Ballistic plate case
Clean work, mate! We got back some of the routes already. And those Christmas lovers... They could've guessed that all this excitement and celebrations are only hindering business and wasting precious resources. So they got what they deserved. Never fucking unclench your ass in Tarkov.

== Failure Penalty ==
Skier Rep -0.03
Did you really think you could go against my people without me knowing about it? This ain't gonna cut it, mate. Get the fuck outta here.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 10 PMCs who are wearing the Khorovod armband.

Note: The objective in the PvE mode is to eliminate 10 PMC operators while not wearing the armband yourself.

quests.title: The Price of Independence
quests.content:
The Price of Independence is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
We foiled Skier's plans, and I'll tell you this - we can't let this opportunity slip away. When he recovers, he will never let me out of his sight. That's why we need to think of a defensive plan now, because you and I are both going to get nailed! So listen, I've got a plan all worked out. Except I don't have anybody else I'd trust to do something this complex. I was able to dig up some background intel on Skier. The kind of information that could compromise him real bad if it fell into the right hands. It's all in this letter, and it's our guarantee. You need to pick it up at the customs area. The letter will be on the top floor of the building by the construction site. You know, the one near the railroad platform, you'll see it. Hopefully. From there, go straight to the reserve base and leave it in the headquarters on the third floor, at the fortified point with windows. The key is to make sure that Skier's men don't intercept the letter. That is why after stashing the letter, run to Priozersk and make some noise. After you kill a couple of Scavs, go to the lighthouse peninsula and shoot a flare. You need a yellow one, don't get it mixed up! The best place to do it is on the pier at the vacation houses and on the platform at the train station, it'll distract the guys from Skier's nearest base. After that, you run out of there! I've written all the instructions on a piece of paper to make sure you don't fuck it up. You gotta do it all at once, you understand?

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the incriminating letter on Customs
Use the transit from Customs to Reserve
Stash the letter on the third floor of the military headquarters on Reserve
Use the transit from Reserve to Woods
Eliminate any 3 targets on Woods
Use the transit from Woods to Lighthouse
Launch a yellow signal flare at the train station warehouse on Lighthouse
Launch a yellow signal flare at the pier on Lighthouse
Survive and extract from Lighthouse
Eliminate 10 Scavs while completing the other objectives

== Rewards ==
+85,400 EXP
BTR Driver Rep +0.5
300,000 Roubles
Unlocks barter for RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Blue) at Mechanic LL2
Unlocks barter for Graphics card at Mechanic LL3
Unlocks achievement All-Wheel Drive
Ho-ly shit! You did it! You're the only one to stick up for me. What's most important is that we've already prepared the stage. It won't be easy, but Prapor promised to help, and the letter ought to work too. I won't forget all the help you've given me. Drop by often, friend.

== Failure Dialogue ==
It didn't work out, friend. Skier has intercepted the damn letter. We sure were close, weren't we? Nobody even knew about this! I guess I don't have any options to break away from Skier yet.

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to find the Incriminating letter on the third floor in the northern building of the industrial plant on Customs. Afterwards you have to transit to Reserve and stash it on the third floor of the military headquarters (Black Bishop). Next you have to transit to Woods and kill any 3 targets there. Lastly you need to transit to Lighthouse and launch a yellow flare at the train station and the pier, and extract. While doing these objectives, 10 Scavs also need to be killed. Dying or extracting at any point before completing all objectives will reset fulfilled objectives besides collecting the Incriminating letter.

== Customs Letter location ==
The letter can be found in different spots in the office on the third floor of the northern building at the industrial plant.

quests.title: The Punisher - Harvest
quests.content:
The Punisher - Harvest was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You're finally in touch, mercenary. I was just approached by a man who calls himself a Master. He asked to find you, because from his words you understand the essence of the matter and deserve Their respect. The master asked me to tell you that there is a new job for you. It is necessary to eliminate experienced colleagues throughout Tarkov. I will give you the necessary equipment to complete the task. Let me be honest with you, my friend. I do not approve Master's methods, but the benefits offered are very attractive. I can't tell you everything, but I can give you some advice: special times are coming, save your ammunition if you want to survive. Our work with you is very productive, and I would not like you to die in this massacre.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 50 PMC operatives
Hand over 50 found in raid level 25+ dogtags

== Rewards ==
15,000 Dollars
15,750 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
17,250 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2

Unlocks purchase of 5.56x45mm SSA AP at Peacekeeper LL1
Unlocks purchase of 7.62x39mm MAI AP at Peacekeeper LL1
Unlocks purchase of 7.62x51mm M993 at Peacekeeper LL1
Unlocks purchase of 9x19mm PBP gzh at Peacekeeper LL1

== Initial Equipment ==

In this quest you have to kill 50 PMCs and hand over 50 found in raid dogtags from players of level 25 or higher.
