This quest was released as part of the "Ammo Shortage" event on the 25th of November, 2023.

quests.title: The Punisher - Part 1
quests.content:
The Punisher - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there, man. Well, my friends are clearly up to something. Last time you dropped some Scavs, they called me almost instantly, and, you know, it seemed like they had a bit of entertainment going on. Making bets, making cash. Long story short, they want you to decimate Scavs again, but this time on Customs and using a good old AKS-74U. I don't really want to know what kind of show they are making of it, but they offer some top cash. So, you in?

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 25 Scavs with AKS-74U on Customs

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Lobaev Arms DVL-10 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant Urbana)
Unlocks craft for 5.45x39mm PP gs at Workbench level 2
Look at you, a Punisher if I ever saw one! There's a rumor going about that some monster is dropping the scum in big numbers. My cronies send you their regards and some splendid presents.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 25 Scavs on Customs with short AK series assault rifles. You can use any of the following:
AKS-74U
AKS-74UN
AKS-74UB
SAG AK Short

quests.title: The Punisher - Part 2
quests.content:
The Punisher - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
MHello soldier, I have a job for you. Well then, it's about time we make this world a better place. The shoreline is under increasingly frequent attacks by different bandit gangs, this seriously interfered with my friends' operations. Help them with their Scav problem and we'll send a handsome reward your way. But I have one condition: you have to sort this one out using an AKM series gun, my friends have to see who helped them.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 15 Scavs with AKM series weapons on Shoreline

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
1× RPK-16 5.45x39 light machine gun
1× AK-74 5.45x39 6L31 60-round magazine
Unlocks barter for RPK-16 5.45x39 light machine gun at Prapor LL2
Unlocks barter for AK-74 5.45x39 6L31 60-round magazine at Prapor LL2
My friends now know about you, great job. There is still plenty of uglies left, but we have only started. Here, the friends got you a little present.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 15 Scavs on Shoreline with AKM series weapons. You can use any of the following:
AKM
AKMN
AKMS
AKMSN
AK-103
AK-104
VPO-136

quests.title: The Punisher - Part 3
quests.content:
The Punisher - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there, soldier. My pals are definitely up to something. Soon as you finished off those Scavs last time, they started blowing up my phone. And you know what? Sounds like they're putting on some kind of show over there. Taking bets, making money. Anyway, they want you to thin out the Scavs again, only this time you'll be working on the military base, and you'll have to use Russian-made weapons. Hell if I know what kind of spectacle they're cooking up, but they're offering good money. So, you in?

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 12 Scavs with 9x39mm caliber weapons on Reserve
Find 7 Lower half-masks in raid
Hand over the items

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
5× 7.62x39mm PS gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of 7.62x39mm PS gzh at Prapor LL3
Nailed it, huh? Nice, grab your reward. I bet it's not the last job from my comrades, they really got interested in your Scav extermination.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

quests.title: The Punisher - Part 4
quests.content:
The Punisher - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Oh yeah, your last Scav massacre was something else! People keep coming up to me asking what the hell's going on. Turns out my buddies struck a deal with the locals and are putting together some kind of staged fights. Gladiator-style, you could say. Anyway, you're basically their... what's the word... test guy. They come up with ideas, watch how you handle them, then tweak things based on what they see. And now they want to keep it going. This time the jobs are a bit tougher. Hunt down Scavs wearing chest rigs and take them out with an SVD or a TKPD. Bring me their knives as trophies, too. So, what do you say, soldier?

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 10 Scavs while using an SVDS or TKPD on Lighthouse
Eliminate 10 Scavs while wearing a Scav Vest on Lighthouse
Find 5 Bars A-2607 95Kh18 knives in raid
Hand over the items

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
3× 7.62x54mm R PS gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)
3× 9x39mm SP-6 gs ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of 7.62x54mm R PS gzh at Prapor LL4
Unlocks purchase of 9x39mm SP-6 gs at Prapor LL4
Mighty wicked, warrior. Grab your reward. Come back later, my friends have got some more work for you.

== Guide ==

Either the Scav Vest or the Security vest can be used for the Scav kills.

The Bars A-2607 95Kh18 knives are carried by Scavs. Make sure to not confuse them with the similar looking Bars A-2607 Damascus knives.

quests.title: The Punisher - Part 5
quests.content:
The Punisher - Part 5 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The Masters — that's what my friends have started calling themselves — are moving on to the next stage. Now they need gear for this whole gladiator business. I'd help them myself, but I've got more important things to deal with. So you find what they need, and I'll make sure it gets to them in your name. Oh, one more thing: they wanted to see how good machine guns look in action... I'm sure you've already figured out what that means. Good luck out there, warrior!

== Objectives ==
Find any Kalashnikov AK-74 assault rifle in raid
Hand over the AK-74
Find a Colt M4A1 assault rifle in raid
Hand over the M4A1
Find any 2 Makarov PM pistols in raid
Hand over the pistols
Eliminate 10 PMC operatives with Light machine guns
Eliminate 20 Scavs with Light machine guns

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
1× Kalashnikov AK-308 7.62x51 assault rifle
1× AK-308 7.62x51 QD sound suppressor
1× Document case
Unlocks purchase of Kalashnikov AK-308 7.62x51 assault rifle at Prapor LL4
Unlocks purchase of AK-308 7.62x51 QD sound suppressor at Prapor LL4
Got it all done? That's what I like to see! Here's your reward.

== Guide ==

To hand over a weapon it must be in usable condition. If a weapon's icon is red, it is missing vital parts and can not be turned in.

quests.title: The Punisher - Part 6
quests.content:
The Punisher - Part 6 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, soldier. You know... I think I'm done with these jobs from the Masters. The PMCs have teamed up with the local bosses and started putting the squeeze on them. And they're not just trying to shut them down... They want to take over! Getting caught in the middle of that is way too risky. So this is my last job for them. After this, I'm done. This time they want us to thin out the PMCs across the whole region. Thirty kills should satisfy them. Use machine guns, 9x39 weapons, SVD, TKPD, AKS-74U series, or AKM series, so everyone who needs to gets the message. They also want proof this time. Bring me ten PMC dogtags, any faction, and I'll make sure they end up where they're supposed to.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 30 PMC operatives with the specified weapons on Lighthouse, Shoreline, Reserve, Ground Zero or The Lab
Hand over 10 BEAR or USEC Dogtags
Locate and neutralize any 5 Bosses

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
5× 9x39mm SP-6 gs ammo pack (20 pcs)
1× SR-3M 9x39 compact assault rifle
1× Secure container Epsilon
Unlocks purchase of SR-3M 9x39 compact assault rifle at Prapor LL4
The money's tempting, but these jobs... They're getting getting out of hand. Ah, whatever. Here's your cut.

== Guide ==

Partisan and Zryachiy do not count for the boss kills.

quests.title: The Root Cause
quests.content:
The Root Cause was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings. I figure you're already aware of the recent situation, granted you've found the blood samples Jaeger brought me. I've analyzed them, but it's not sufficient. In order to get started, I need a sample of the virus itself. This is extremely dangerous, so use every precaution during the mission! Come and see me as soon as you find it. This is to minimize the time the virus is out in the open.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the virus sample in The Lab
Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+24,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.03
90,000 Roubles
94,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
103,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× TerraGroup Labs keycard (Yellow)
Only when you know what you're up against can you make an effective remedy. But that will take time. The information that may have been stored on some TerraGroup devices would help speed up the process. I have contacted Mechanic. If he finds anything useful, he will contact you himself.

== Guide ==

To complete this quest, you need to find a TG-Vi-24 sample in the locked laboratory area inside the containment block on the first level of The Lab. There are multiple sample spawns throughout the area.

quests.title: The Secret Recipe
quests.content:
The Secret Recipe is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I recently got my hands on some sort of diary connected to food development. It's got all sorts of addresses, deliveries, and some weird shit being moved out of TerraGroup offices. Long story short, to make their fancy grub taste so good, those fuckers were adding some unknown ingredient from the labs. And it was addictive, so more people would keep coming back and handing them their money. Made them easier to deal with too... Proper dodgy stuff. Go check what they were hauling out of those offices. Maybe there's still something left behind. The notes keep mentioning some kind of red vial.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the secret ingredient at the TerraGroup office on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the chemical additive

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.25
1,000 Euros
1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
Nice work, man. Let's see what comes out of this. I got some contacts that can figure it out. I feel like we're in some serious shit again, merc.

== Guide ==
Not all spawn locations for the quest item require this key. It is not entirely needed to complete the quest.

In this quest you have to find the secret component on Streets of Tarkov. There are multiple spawns throughout two buildings.

Buildings marked on map

== TerraGroup security post ==
== First spawn ==
Turn right immediately after entering the front door, then left at the end of the corridor. Back left corner desk, next to the phone.

== Second spawn ==
Inside the TerraGroup meeting room, directly on the left when you enter the building. Located on the shelf in the back right.

== TerraGroup office ==
== Third spawn ==
Turn left after entering, go to the desk in the back left corner. The vial is located inside a file organizer.

== Fourth spawn ==
In the backmost cubicle, located on the desk in the back right.

== Fifth spawn ==
In the meeting room at the back right of the office, tucked in a rolled up blueprint.

quests.title: The Secret to Productivity
quests.content:
The Secret to Productivity is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. Before everything happened in the city, there was this software company. I can't remember its name anymore, only that they made the best software in their niche. I still use some of their work to this day. It wasn't a large company, and I still can't figure out how they managed to produce such high-quality software in so little time. They had to be hiding something, and I'd like to know what it was. See if you can uncover their secret. Maybe you'll notice something that wouldn't stand out to someone who grew up here.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Unravel the secret of the IT firm's employees' high morale on Streets of Tarkov
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
So, a hookah lounge... Not a bad carrot. Around here, we're much more familiar with the stick, so I never would've made that connection.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find and enter the "Hive" hookah lounge in the Malevicha street no. 5 building on Streets of Tarkov. A Relaxation room key is required to access it.

Hive hookah lounge location marked on map
Door to the hookah lounge

Dying before extracting will reset the first part of this quest.

== See also ==
Corporate Perks - The BEAR counterpart quest

quests.title: The Stylish One
quests.content:
The Stylish One was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So there's this dandy asshole in Ultra mall. Lurking around, cleaning the supplies, gunning everyone down right on spot. Folks out there are hella scared of him. I tell you what, you punish him properly, and I will get you a nice stylish jacket just like his one so you could give it a proper use. Could cosplay as him and shit. Just be careful, the dude is hella dangerous.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate Killa 50 times

== Rewards ==
+1 Charisma skill level

Got it done already? Nice job. Wait here a minute, I need to measure your sizes and figure out the sewing technique for this one. As promised. But hey, you gotta understand that the materials ain't cheap these days, so be prepared for the price. Still, it's got three stripes, an icon of style, you know.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill Killa 50 times.

== Trivia ==
Prior to the achievement system, this quest unlocked the Adik tracksuit.

quests.title: The Survivalist Path - Cold Blooded
quests.content:
The Survivalist Path - Cold Blooded is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come here, I've got a test for you. You must always maintain your composure, in every situation. You lose control or panic - you die. And no matter what happened - whether you've caught a bullet or just got drunk. But even with shaky hands, you have to shoot sharp. Prove to me that you can do this.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 2 PMC operatives with headshots while suffering from the tremor effect

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
2× 12/70 AP-20 ammo pack (25 pcs)
2× Saiga-12K 12ga automatic shotgun
Unlocks craft for 12/70 AP-20 armor-piercing slug at Workbench level 3
So you can even handle tremors? Great! To be honest, I didn't think you would succeed, the task was very difficult.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 2 PMC's with headshots while suffering from . Hands tremor is caused by 45 seconds of untreated pain. You can also use a SJ9 TGLabs combat stimulant injector to get the effect on demand.

quests.title: The Survivalist Path - Combat Medic
quests.content:
The Survivalist Path - Combat Medic was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I just can't count how much shit have I seen while working as a gamekeeper. So many different people used to get lost in these woods. Some of them made it out alive and well, some of them didn't. You have to be one hell of a tough asshole to get out of the woods alive. Let's make a real survivalist out of you. Come to me when you're ready.

== Objectives ==
Reach the required Vitality skill level of 5

== Rewards ==
+5,900 EXP
+2 Surgery skill levels
Jaeger Rep +0.02
50,000 Roubles
52,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
57,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
How do people say? What is difficult in training will become easy in a battle! This skill will come in handy, trust me on this one. Your training is almost complete. Looks like you are ready to become the Hunter.

== Guide ==
You can raise your Vitality level by:
Taking damage
Bloodloss

You can use an eTG-change regenerative stimulant injector or a Propital regenerative stimulant injector and run through fire or obtain a heavy bleed to level up your vitality

quests.title: The Survivalist Path - Eagle-Owl
quests.content:
The Survivalist Path - Eagle-Owl is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
As I've read in one article, the human eye can get used to the darkness. You know, I wanted to check, and I almost broke my leg in a deadfall. Guess I'm a little old for such a metamorphosis. But you, I think, are in the prime of life. A well-trained night eyesight can help us very much in our difficult tasks. So take care of this. You're a tough guy, you can take a punch. But what if you can't see anything at night and suddenly get ambushed by some scum? Those things happen quite often, not everyone can take NVGs into their raids. So, show me how you see in the dark, without any gadgets.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 6 Scavs in the time period of 21:00-04:00 without using any NVGs or thermal sights (Excluding Factory)

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
3× Armasight Vulcan MG 3.5x Bravo night vision scope
1× VSS Vintorez 9x39 special sniper rifle
4× 9x39mm SPP gs ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of VSS/VAL TOZ 6P29M mount at Jaeger LL3
How many you say there were, six? And you got them all without the "goggles"? Indeed, you are a great night hunter, kid.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 6 Scavs on any map aside from Factory in the time period of 21:00-04:00 without using any night vision devices, thermal vision devices, night vision scopes or thermal vision sights. Equipped but switched off devices still prevent quest progress.

quests.title: The Survivalist Path - Junkie
quests.content:
The Survivalist Path - Junkie is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Times are harsh these days, you know it well. You have to survive by all means, even if those means are not the safest for your health. For example, those stimulants, folks started seeing them more frequently in the region. In reality, it's a narcotic of some sort, I feel that TerraGroup is involved here for sure. But anyway, want it or not, but you will have to learn how to use them in combat, these drugs do not only kill, but sometimes help you survive.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 15 Scavs while under any stimulant effect on Woods

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
1× Dorm room 314 marked key
5× 12/70 RIP ammo pack (5 pcs)
4× 5.56x45mm Warmageddon ammo pack (20 pcs)
4× 5.45x39mm BT gs ammo pack (120 pcs)
Unlocks barter for Dorm room 314 marked key at Jaeger LL4
So I see you've made it. How's your head? Dizzy? Feeling like you're going to throw up? That's the side effects of those drugs, you have to pay the price to stay alive, even pay with your health. But anyway, listen here, I have some tips on how to reduce those side effects, so next time you would feel a little better.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 15 Scavs on Woods while having any buff or debuff from stimulants or provisions active. The  effect does not count.

quests.title: The Survivalist Path - Thrifty
quests.content:
The Survivalist Path - Thrifty is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello there! You came right in time, I'm just packing up to go hunting. Do me a favor, not for service, but as a sign of friendship. Arrange a couple of rest spots for my way back: the trip is long, so I'll have to stop for a breather somewhere. The places should be safe, leave a Russian MRE and a bottle of water for each, agreed? At the same time, remember how to survive if you get caught with your pants down. I've got some stashes hidden here and there, for example, but you don't need to know about them yet.

== Objectives ==
Stash 1 Iskra ration pack in the ZB-016 bunker on Woods
Stash 1 Bottle of water in the ZB-016 bunker on Woods
Stash 1 Iskra ration pack in the ZB-014 bunker on Woods
Stash 1 Bottle of water in the ZB-014 bunker on Woods

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
3× Iskra ration pack
1× Metal fuel tank
Unlocks purchase of Iskra ration pack at Jaeger LL2
You did it? Thank you. I just got ready for the trip, so you're just in time. See you in a couple of days, fella.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to stash 1 Bottle of water (0.6L) and 1 Iskra ration pack each in the bunkers ZB-016 and ZB-014 on Woods.

Bunker locations marked on map

== ZB-016 ==

ZB-016 bunker entrance
Stashing location in the bunker
Wooden crate where the items have to be stashed

== ZB-014 ==

ZB-014 bunker entrance
Stashing location in the bunker
Wooden crate where the items have to be stashed

quests.title: The Survivalist Path - Tough Guy
quests.content:
The Survivalist Path - Tough Guy is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You know, in combat - as in hunting, there are only two behavior models. You are either a hunter or prey. And since you intend to become a real hunter, you must learn to track prey without exposing yourself.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 3 Scavs in a single raid without using any medicine on Woods

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
3× CMS surgical kit
3× Pile of meds
Unlocks purchase of Surv12 field surgical kit at Jaeger LL3
Successful? Great! Sweat saves the blood! Don't get too ecstatic now, there are some more tasks for you.

== Failure Dialogue ==
So you failed, huh? Well, will be a lesson for you. Try again, and remember your mistakes.

== Guide ==
Do not use any Medical items while in a raid while the quest is active.
If you complete the objective to kill the three Scavs without healing the task will still fail if you heal before handing it in. In addition, if you complete the objectives but do not click complete with Jaeger, then healing in a later Woods raid will cause failure of the quest.
Surviving the raid is not necessary for the quest to be completed.
Off-raid healing does affect this quest.
Drinkable alcohol is a painkiller that will not fail this quest.

quests.title: The Survivalist Path - Unprotected but Dangerous
quests.content:
The Survivalist Path - Unprotected but Dangerous is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello there, come in, take a seat. The path of ours is not easy, not easy at all. Fighting scum is dangerous and requires extraordinary skills. For example, being fast, quiet, agile and deadly. Flanking the enemy, outplaying them on their own field. Your buddies chained in their body armor will never be able to master these skills. Therefore, before embarking on serious tasks, hone this skill.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 PMC operatives without wearing any body armor or plate carriers

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
1× Armband (Train Hard)
1× Kalashnikov AKMSN 7.62x39 assault rifle
10× 7.62x39mm FMJ ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks barter for Surv12 field surgical kit at Jaeger LL2
As one famous person used to say "Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee". A piece of good advice, you better remember it. So, do you feel how easy it is to move without all those plates on you? If you move fast, you don't even need body armor to deal with scum.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 5 PMCs without wearing any armor vest or armored chest rig. Armored headwear, face cover and eyewear is allowed. If you want to protect yourself during this quest you can still wear armor, but unequip it before killing a PMC.

quests.title: The Survivalist Path - Wounded Beast
quests.prerequisites: The Survivalist Path - Unprotected but Dangerous
quests.content:
The Survivalist Path - Wounded Beast is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello there. Has it ever happened to you that you got into trouble, but there is no time to take care of the wound as you have to save your skin? Self-control in the most difficult situations is the key to survival. This is a very important skill in these difficult days for our city. Show me how well you handle pain.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 3 Scavs while suffering from pain effect

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
1× Benelli M3 Super 90 12ga dual-mode shotgun
1× 12/70 flechette ammo pack (25 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of Benelli M3 Super 90 12ga dual-mode shotgun at Jaeger LL2
Unlocks Bear Hideout shooting range target style
Handled it? Nicely done. Your training is almost done, friend. If we keep it that way, we may start taking care of the order in the city earlier than planned.

== Guide ==
Dehydration and broken bones cause pain. Easiest way to break your leg bones is to fall a few meters or to intentionally fail the Hideout gym training to break your arm.
Using a Jar of DevilDog mayo is an easy way to achieve pain through dehydration, although it comes with the side effect of constant damage over time.
Using painkillers, morphine and/or similar medication will remove the status effect, and as such kills will not count towards the quest.

quests.title: The Survivalist Path - Zatoichi
quests.content:
The Survivalist Path - Zatoichi was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I tell you what. If your opponent is blind - there's nothing he can do against you. No matter what gear he has on him. Same works for you. Only the skill and confidence can help one get over such a situation.

== Objectives ==
Kill 2 PMC operators while being blinded by flashbang grenade

== Rewards ==
+12,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.03
30,000 Roubles
30× 12/70 RIP
80× 5.56x45mm Warmageddon
So you survived? Who could've thought.

== Trivia ==
This quest was removed on 28. May 2020 with patch 0.12.6.7456
Zatoichi (座頭市) is the name of a fictional blind samurai from feudal Japan.

quests.title: The Survivalist Path - Zhivchik
quests.unlocks: The Survivalist Path - Unprotected but Dangerous
quests.content:
The Survivalist Path - Zhivchik is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello there, warrior! My hunt went as planned. You know, the water you prepared for me did really come in handy. By the way, how good are you at handling dehydration? Show me how long PMCs can stay without water.

== Objectives ==
Survive for 5 minutes while suffering from complete dehydration (Excluding Factory)
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
2× Aquamari water bottle with filter
2× Water filter
Unlocks barter for SOG Voodoo Hawk tactical tomahawk at Jaeger LL2
No way you can survive for so long! Impressive. Here you go, drink this, regain your strength.

== Guide ==
You can consume certain items that decrease your hydration to quickly get into the dehydration state. For example, a Jar of DevilDog mayo gives -99 and a Can of condensed milk -65 hydration. You can also use the gym module in your hideout to drain energy and hydration before starting a raid.

Alternatively, if you play with friends, you can ask them to shoot you in the stomach, which will get you into the dehydration state too. Keep in mind that this will also decrease your energy rapidly.

Don't forget to bring enough Meds or a Propital regenerative stimulant injector to outheal the damage, and enough Drinks to continue the raid afterwards.

If you extract from the raid with the "Run Through" extraction status, the quest will not count as being completed. To avoid the "Run Through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting. If you happen to get a run through, you can survive and extract from another raid on any location to complete the quest.

== Trivia ==
Zhivchik (живчик) translates roughly to "lively" or "peppy".

quests.title: The Tarkov Butcher
quests.content:
The Tarkov Butcher is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Have you heard the stories about the serial killer who was operating in the city? The first rumors about the "Tarkov Butcher" appeared during the Contract Wars. But because of the conflict, the investigation was abandoned. An acquaintance of mine has taken an interest in this case and is looking for traces left by the Butcher. To track him down, we need to understand his motives and what drove him. The documents we managed to recover from the police department state that the Butcher worked as a driver for one of the meat processing plants. The victims' bodies were discovered in refrigerated trucks used for transporting meat… If you can find anything that could help with the investigation, I would be grateful. And one more thing: my acquaintance requires certain medications. Deliver him a chemical container with everything he needs.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the chemical container on Ground Zero
Stash the container by the police station on Streets of Tarkov

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Surv12 field surgical kit
Your discovery will help us in our search for the killer. Thank you. Here is your reward.

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to find a chemical container inside a truck trailer in the underground of Ground Zero. Afterwards it has to be stashed in front of the ministry of the interior academy on Streets of Tarkov.

== Ground Zero Container location ==

Trailer location marked on map
The trailer
First spawn in the pig carcass opposite the first corpse
Second spawn in the back of the trailer in the trash bag
Third spawn in the back of the trailer in the snout of the pig head

== Streets of Tarkov Stashing location ==

Stashing location marked on map
Stashing location

quests.title: The Tarkov Import
quests.content:
The Tarkov Import is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, soldier! Here's the situation. I ordered a batch of imported rifles from Mechanic for some clients. Personally, I still prefer our own weapons. Homegrown gear's always been closer to an old soldier's heart, you know?Anyway, it's an SR-25 fitted with a Hybrid 46 suppressor and a Schmidt & Bender PM II 1-8x24 scope. I need it properly field-tested. And don't waste your time shooting Scavs. I want to know how it performs against fighters who can actually shoot back. I'll issue you one. Put it through its paces, then come back and tell me what you think.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 6 PMCs with SR-25 with Hybrid 46 suppressor and S&B PM II 1-8x24 scope on Lighthouse or Reserve

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Military power filter
Unlocks craft for 9x39mm PAB-9 gs at Workbench level 2
Well, what's the verdict? Serious piece of kit, yeah? Good, that's all I needed to hear. Here's something for your trouble.

== Initial equipment ==

quests.title: The Tarkov Mystery
quests.content:
The Tarkov Mystery was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey. Something interesting came up. You see all these flash drives popping up all of a sudden? It's like some wanker's been dumping them on purpose. Get me one. Let's see what's so interesting about them. Anyway, these thumb drives are lying around with all the electronics. Roger-roger?

== Objectives ==
Find the encrypted flash drive in raid
Hand over the encrypted flash drive to Skier

== Rewards ==
+6,300 EXP
Skier Rep +0.03
28,000 Roubles
29,400 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
32,200 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× .300 Blackout CBJ ammo pack (50 pcs)
3× AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG 30 GEN M3 STANAG 30-round magazine
1× SIG MCX .300 Blackout assault rifle

SIG MCX .300 Blackout assault rifle

Already? Excellent. Here, this is for your work. I always keep my word.

The flash drive can be found in:
Pockets and bags of Scavs

Common fund stash
Dead Scav
Drawer

Safe

== Trivia ==
This questline was released together with the video "BBD".

quests.title: The Tarkov Shooter - Part 1
quests.content:
The Tarkov Shooter - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Here you are. Only you and Sniper can survive that long in the field, raid after raid, it looks like. He was recently looking for a reliable guy, who can be entrusted with a task and won't let him down. He says the best way to test a person for his task is to check their skills with bolt-action rifles. He's a serious man, so I think he needs a fighter for something important. What do you think, can I recommend you? Try yourself in as the "Tarkov Shooter". if you pass all Sniper's tests, I’ll arrange you a contact with him. So, here's the first task he prepared: we need to test your accuracy with iron sights from a medium distance, let's say 40 meters.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 Scavs from over 40 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle with iron sights

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Mosin Rifle AIM Sports MNG rail mount
2× Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Recoil Pad
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle AIM Sports MNG rail mount at Jaeger LL1
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Recoil Pad at Jaeger LL1
So, do you feel like Zaitsev yet? Sniper is satisfied with the first test results and has already prepared the next task.

== Guide ==
To do this task, grab a bolt-action rifle or an MP-18 and do not attach any scopes or sights. Use only the iron sights. Factory is not recommended for this quest as there are not many places where you can effectively engage at 40m or further. Only Scavs count towards this quest, not PMCs. Woods, Shoreline, and Customs are good maps because of the sniper Scavs that can be spotted from a far distance.

== Trivia ==
The success dialogue refers to Vasily Zaitsev, a famous Soviet sniper during World War II.

quests.title: The Tarkov Shooter - Part 2
quests.content:
The Tarkov Shooter - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
My friend, Shabelsky was his last name, used to write stories about the war. Even I had a fun time reading them sometimes. So recently he sold the rights to the entire series of books, and they made a movie after them in the West. But now he wants more money from the movie company, he hit the hard times, apparently. Even messaged me to look up some decent fighters here in Tarkov. It seems the whole world has forgotten about our city... They only remember us when they need a hired gun, and while things are going good they prefer to not notice our situation at all. Anyway, I digress. Are you ready for the second task from Sniper? You have to shoot at heads and legs from the same distance, 40 meters.

== Objectives ==
Shoot any target in the legs from over 40 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle 3 times
Shoot any target in the head from over 40 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle 2 times

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Mosin Rifle Tacfire Tanker Style 7.62x54R muzzle brake
2× Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Tri-Rail mount
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Tri-Rail mount at Jaeger LL2
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle Tacfire Tanker Style 7.62x54R muzzle brake at Jaeger LL2
Not bad, not bad. Even I wouldn't be so accurate with my shots, I'm way too old now. While you were shooting, Sniper has prepared the next test for you.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to use a bolt-action rifle or MP-18 to land 3 hits on any entities legs, and 2 hits on any entities heads from over 40 meters away. The leg hits can all be done on the same target. Hits on group members don't count.

quests.title: The Tarkov Shooter - Part 3
quests.content:
The Tarkov Shooter - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I see you're quite a good shot, kid. Sniper said he wants to test your reaction time. The faster one wins, as he says. As in that film, remember, "The Good, the Bad and the Ugly", only with a bolt-action rifle instead of a revolver. Life here certainly isn’t a movie, but the reaction and the choice of position are very important in the firefight, especially in urban conditions. If you survive this, help yourself to my cowboy hat, I have one around here somewhere. You choose yourself, who you want to be: the good, the bad, or the ugly.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 3 PMCs from less than 25 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Mosin Rifle Tacfire pistol grip
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle Tacfire pistol grip at Jaeger LL2
Unlocks craft for .366 TKM AP-M at Workbench level 1
Unlocks Colored Hideout shooting range target style
You have got a good reaction time since you're still standing here. Grab your new hat, as promised! Go on, shooter, new tests await you.

== Guide ==
To do this quest, grab a bolt-action rifle or an MP-18. Factory is a recommended location for this quest, as there are ample opportunities to engage PMC's at 25m or closer.

You can use the M7290 grenade, the Zarya grenade or a KS-23M with the Zvezda flashbang round to flash and stun PMC'S and make them easier targets.

quests.title: The Tarkov Shooter - Part 4
quests.content:
The Tarkov Shooter - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
It's good that you're alive, tasks from Sniper are not easy. Let's wait for a little before the next test. There is going to be a lot more complicated sniper work from now on, so my advice is that you master your bolt-action rifle handling skills some more. Come back when you're ready.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 15 targets with a bolt-action rifle

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Mosin Rifle ATI Monte Carlo stock
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle ATI Monte Carlo stock at Jaeger LL3
Unlocks craft for 7.62x54mm R BT gzh at Workbench level 3
Ready? Then let's get to work. Sniper took a big interest in you.

quests.title: The Tarkov Shooter - Part 5
quests.content:
The Tarkov Shooter - Part 5 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
As Sniper likes to say: "The best tool against a sniper is another sniper". It is not a rare case in combat, but you have to keep in mind that the enemy is a well-trained and well-prepared shooter. They are smart, will take up tricky positions, and try to deceive you. Even if they're not a professional military man, but a former gamekeeper or so. You need to "tie down" the enemy sniper, make them show themself - then, they're all yours. Well, these are recommendations I was asked to give you. Scavs just find rifles with scopes and climb up on the roofs or rocks, thinking they're actual snipers. Those are the ones you have to eliminate.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 Sniper Scavs while using a bolt-action rifle

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Mosin Rifle ProMag Archangel OPFOR PRS chassis
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle ProMag Archangel OPFOR PRS chassis at Jaeger LL3
There are no foul tricks in the sniper play. Good work, kid.

== Guide ==
Although they don't spawn 100% of the time, sniper Scavs can currently be found in the following locations:

== Streets of Tarkov ==

== Customs ==

== Shoreline ==

== Woods ==

quests.title: The Tarkov Shooter - Part 6
quests.content:
The Tarkov Shooter - Part 6 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Neutralizing your target is more effective without any noise, from a safe distance. The next test from Sniper is a practice in this kind of business. Get a suppressor and shoot experienced enemies from medium distances.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 PMCs while using a suppressed bolt-action rifle

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
400,000 Roubles
420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Vortex Razor HD Gen.2 1-6x24 30mm riflescope
1× Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle
Unlocks purchase of Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant PRO) at Jaeger LL4
Unlocks purchase of Vortex Razor HD Gen.2 1-6x24 30mm riflescope at Jaeger LL4
The enemy is absolutely helpless when they don't know where they get shot from. You did well, shooter.

quests.title: The Tarkov Shooter - Part 7
quests.content:
The Tarkov Shooter - Part 7 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Do you like classic literature? Why do you think Dostoevsky is so popular with those who've never been to Russia? I've been wondering about it for a while until this TerraGroup scandal emerged. Its executives, I assume, were very familiar with classics and what they do to us. Such a situation can only be pulled in a society where people can combine both lies and betrayal and irrational, unexplainable self-sacrifice, which are more abundant in Tarkov than in any other place. Dostoevsky wrote about it, these people can live with the highest commitment to other people and at the same time be the best at killing. Sometimes we forget about this. The next task from Sniper is your personal count, and not in cash, obviously.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 PMC operatives with a bolt-action rifle without dying

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
1× SWORD International Mk-18 .338 LM marksman rifle
1× Mk-18 .338 LM 10-round magazine
1× .338 Lapua Magnum FMJ ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of SWORD International Mk-18 .338 LM marksman rifle at Jaeger LL4
It seems that sometimes being smart isn’t enough to act smart. Well, a good old bolty can be of help with this. Sniper is silent for now, so let's wait for a little before your next tasks. I will let you know when there are new tests for you.

== Failure Dialogue ==
This is not an easy task. Try again.

== Guide ==
The kills can be done over multiple raids, but dying at any point before actually handing in the completed quest will fail it.

quests.title: The TerraGroup Trail - Part 1
quests.content:
The TerraGroup Trail - Part 1 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Got a job for you. My men found a big cache in the Health Resort area. The group was not small, but even they couldn't take everything: money, weapons, jewelry. But the main thing - information and components of something, and what exactly - you do not need to know yet. I'll make sure to inform you after we're done here. The head of the group got really carried away, I never seen him like that. They haven't been in touch since, and they talk nonsense over the radio.

== Objectives ==
Locate Fence's men who went missing on Shoreline
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to find Fence's missing men on Shoreline and extract. They are located at a military truck between the swamp village and the health resort.

Location marked on map
The truck

== Trivia ==
This questline was released together with the video "The TerraGroup Trail" and was part of the 1st day quests from the pre-wipe quest chain, and was unlocked on the 28th of July, 2023.

quests.title: The TerraGroup Trail - Part 10
quests.content:
The TerraGroup Trail - Part 10 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Establishing a foothold in the region is not just about money and weapons, mercenary! It's also about diplomacy. We continue our plan with the local authorities. Let's make it look like Sanitar took what should have gone to the other bosses. Yes, we'll set him up. Leave a bag of evidence on Sanitar in a conspicuous place, I've already prepared the bag. And to draw attention to it, you're gonna have to do some damage to one of the Bosses' territories. I suggest we go into the territory of Kaban, who used to be neutral before.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 30 targets while using VSS Vintorez 9x39 special sniper rifle in the car dealership area on Streets of Tarkov
Plant Sanitar's bag on the second floor of the car dealership near Kaban's office

== Rewards ==
+28,500 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.03
600 Dollars
630 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
690 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× M203 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher
5× 40x46mm M386 (HE) grenade

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to kill any 30 entities with a VSS Vintorez 9x39 special sniper rifle in the vicinity of the LexOs car dealership on Streets of Tarkov. Afterwards you have to place a Sanitar bag near Kaban's office in the closed section on the second floor of the car dealership. A Car dealership closed section key is required to enter it.

Kill area and LexOs location marked on map
The LexOs car dealership
Closed section grate door on the second floor
Placement location

This quest was part of the 5th day quests from the pre-wipe quest chain, and was unlocked on the 1st of August, 2023.

quests.title: The TerraGroup Trail - Part 11
quests.content:
The TerraGroup Trail - Part 11 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. I did the job, but the information from this device has nothing to do with me. And you didn't bring anything to me, understand? Hand the files over to Lightkeeper. But there's a little hitch - only part of the data was on the laptop, and the other part was probably stolen, and without it, this puzzle can't be put together. And you won't believe whose digital footprint was on the laptop. Sanitar's. Looks like he still has the rest of the data. But okay, for now, another thing. As you know, Lightkeeper is not easy to get to, but it's urgent, so I think I can help you with that. So, I've assembled the transmitters to get in contact with the Lightkeeper. Now we need to install them in the Lighthouse area. I figured out where a good place might be. Number one: inside the helicopter at the water treatment plant. Another one: an abandoned USEC cottage, it should have the right equipment, and you can tap into it to boost the retransmitter's output. And number three and four: somewhere high up, closer to the Lighthouse itself, and another one by the beach. And be careful. Don't get too close to the lighthouse itself just yet. A customer told me there was a sniper up there.

== Objectives ==
Plant a radio repeater inside the Mi-8 helicopter at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
Plant a radio repeater inside the abandoned USEC cottage on Lighthouse
Plant a radio repeater on the hill in front of the Lighthouse island
Plant a radio repeater on the roof of the landing stage on Lighthouse

== Rewards ==
+15,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.01
30,000 Roubles
33,600 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
34,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2

== Failure Dialogue ==
Oh, you have already intalled it? Well, let's move on then.

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks purchase of Radio repeater at Mechanic LL1.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to place 4 radio repeaters in different locations on Lighthouse. It is recommended to place them in separate raids, carrying them in your secure container. If you have a Secure container Epsilon, you can safely place 2 per raid.

After placing the repeater you'll have a 40 second countdown during which someone can pick it up and prevent you from finishing the task.

Placement areas marked on map
Inside the MI-8 helicopter
Inside the USEC cottage on the desk
On a plateau where a ground cache is located
On the roof of the sunken building

== Trivia ==
This quest was part of the 3rd day quests from the pre-wipe quest chain, and was unlocked on the 30th of July, 2023.
This quest as the same objectives as the quest Network Provider - Part 2

quests.title: The TerraGroup Trail - Part 12
quests.content:
The TerraGroup Trail - Part 12 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So, I got in touch with the Lightkeeper, now you will have to get yourself a transmitter to reach the Lighthouse. There's a case somewhere in the warehouse, I'll look for it. But unfortunately, I don't have the necessary resources for the internals, and I wasn't planning on looking for them. So all my hope is on you. And the job isn't really all that difficult.

Hand over a Piece of plexiglass
Hand over an Insulating tape

Hand over a Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter

+27,400 EXP

quests.title: The TerraGroup Trail - Part 13
quests.content:
The TerraGroup Trail - Part 13 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
All right, hand me the transmitter. Just a moment. There's a problem, it's not tuned in. You need to re-flash it. And look for the flash drive in the streamer room at the customs office, they might have it there.

== Objectives ==
Obtain the V4 Flash Drive on Customs
Reflash the Radio transmitter
Hand over the V4 Flash Drive to Mechanic
Visit the lighthouse building

== Rewards ==
+28,500 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.01

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks craft for Digital secure DSP radio transmitter at Intelligence Center level 1.

== Guide ==

There are two possible locations for the V4 flash drive on the northern second floor section of warehouse #6 (USEC stash building) on Customs. After obtaining it, you have to reflash the transmitter at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted. After the reflashing is done, the transmitter is fully functional and can be used to bypass the Claymores and Zryachiy guarding the bridge to the lighthouse peninsula, allowing you to visit the lighthouse building and meet Lightkeeper.

Note: If not all members of your lobby-made group have an encoded transmitter, it will have the "blocked" state and the bridge can't be passed.

Warehouse #6 location marked on map

Second spawn on the desk next to the greenscreen

This quest was part of the 4th day quests from the pre-wipe quest chain, and was unlocked on the 31th of July, 2023.
This quest is a simplified version of the quest To the Light - Getting Acquainted

quests.title: The TerraGroup Trail - Part 14
quests.content:
The TerraGroup Trail - Part 14 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Well met. What brings you here, mercenary? Oh, so that's how it is. Well, this kind of data is indeed useful. So here's the deal: I'll help you get the last piece of the puzzle, but not for free. So you'll do a favor for me. I've been wanting to go to the TerraGroup lab for a while now, but I haven't gotten around to it. You'll go there and look for special reagents left behind by the scientists and staff. Your Sanitar was involved in their development. I'll be waiting for you with reagents in hand. Bon voyage.

== Objectives ==
Obtain Reagent Omega from the testing area in The Lab
Obtain Reagent Beta from the laboratory zone in The Lab
Obtain Reagent Alpha from the laboratory testing area in The Lab
Hand over Reagent Omega
Hand over Reagent Beta
Hand over Reagent Alpha

== Rewards ==
+30,000 EXP
Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
2× Far-forward GPS Signal Amplifier Unit
1× Advanced current converter

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find three reagent containers on The Lab and hand them over to Lightkeeper.

Note: You need at least one 2x2 and one 1x1 free inventory slot as you hand the containers to Lightkeeper to receive the quest rewards and continue to the next part.

== First reagent container ==
On a table near the dome on the first level.

Locations marked on map

== Second reagent container ==
In the laboratory block/zone on the second level. TerraGroup Labs keycard (Green) required to enter.

Locations marked on map

== Third reagent container ==
In the laboratory testing/experiments area on the first level. TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black) required to enter.

Locations marked on map

This quest was part of the 4th day quests from the pre-wipe quest chain, and was unlocked on the 31th of July, 2023.

You were able to get all the information, my people were able to use it. I'm going to take the contents of the cache and all the information to the big earth. To the highest bidder. You can find them in the Priozersk protected area, under the cell tower.

quests.content:
The TerraGroup Trail - Part 19 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So, it looks like this is gonna be the end of this particular mess. Everyone got what they wanted, the traders will keep it quiet, the Bosses have been appeased. My men have access to the item, and the buyers from the "big land" have been found. The transfer is complete, the only thing left to do is to get the shipment out of Tarkov's territory. But we have to do it at night and without witnesses, even if it's my people... We can't allow any leaks, you understand.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 7 targets during night time on Shoreline (in one raid)
Send a signal with a flare from the top of the small lighthouse on the coast to the ship waiting in the bay (in one raid)
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+50,000 EXP
Fence Rep +0.5
+2 inventory slot lines in stash
:
The clients got what they wanted. And I got what I wanted. Now, the most important thing is that everything these people got was a fake, a decoy. The real data from the laptop is still on Tarkov's territory. This is way more global than any of us realized. I promised to tell you exactly what my men found in Sanitar's stash, where it all began. They found components and documentation for a bomb capable of incinerating entire cities worth of electronics... The data from the cache is old, and it looks like the actual prototype has already been used. My guess is that the entire conflict in Tarkov was created artificially as a testing ground for this device. Everything that happens in Tarkov is just the beginning of something bigger. But that's just my guess. The truth is beyond comprehension. For now.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==
On Shoreline in the same raid: Kill any 7 entities in the time period of 22:00-10:00 and shoot a yellow flare into the sky from the top of the lighthouse at the pier.

If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you.

Afterwards, survive and extract from the location.

My men already caught one and interrogated him at the checkpoint. He's a total freak! When he snapped back to reality, he told us they had a big fight with the Rogues. Listening to him, it was a hell of a fight. But he kept talking about some fuck all laptop. The problem is, he didn't have any sort of hardware on him. quests.content:
The TerraGroup Trail - Part 7 was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come in, mercenary. I suppose you're anxious to know what the analysis shows. Simply put, after the drug is administered, control between the dorsolateral and dorsomedial prefrontal cortex is increased, the medial superior cortex is inhibited and-- Okay, I understand. I'll make it even simpler. It's a truth serum, mercenary. Or an intermediate version of trying to create one. Because even after a short time after administration, the opposite effect occurs: the patient stops distinguishing truth from fiction, becomes delusional, cognitive impairment takes place. This serum has Sanitar written all over it, I'll tell you that. Please explain the situation to Peacekeeper. This diabolical drug must not leave Tarkov, or better yet, it must be completely destroyed.

== Objectives ==
Deal with Peacekeeper

== Rewards ==
+5,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.01

== Dialogue ==
Good day, mercenary! So, you're asking for my help. Yes, I could arrange it, but not for free. And I'm afraid you don't have the resources to buy a favor of this magnitude from me. The blue helmets in Tarkov need more resources: weapons, financial, human. Can you at least get me three tank battalions so I can finally stop the bloodshed in the region? Exactly. Only the government structures have those resources. What we can do is get HQ to decide to increase my funding sooner rather than later. Let's make it look like the Russian Armed Forces have started pouring huge sums of money into supporting the Tarkov group. Then Visser will definitely sign the necessary papers, and then it's all done. So, mercenary, a favor for a favor?

== Dialogue ==
I tried contacting Sanitar and the Goons to solve your problem, but to no avail. I suggest we go another way: we start a war of authority. Believe me, in this confrontation, Sanitar won't have time for chemical experiments. First, let's make a small diplomatic gesture to increase the trust of the local Bosses in my humble person. I have chosen brothers Killa and Tagilla, as well as Reshala, Shturman and Glukhar for our diplomatic act. You will deliver gifts to them on my behalf, and I will additionally write letters inviting them to shop with me at a nice discount.

quests.content:
The Walls Have Eyes is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You got here just in time, man! I remember you helped me a hell of a lot with surveillance in the suburbs. And now there's all this commotion at the chemical plant, I bet you're well aware of it! Be a true pal, arrange some eyes for me there too, yea? I've seen some cranes there, they would be a perfect place for a camera. Alright, chop chop.

quests.title: Thirsty - Breadwinner
quests.content:
Thirsty - Breadwinner is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The Thirsty dude? You too?! Why are you all bringing him up all of a sudden? Yeah, I worked with this guy. Сouldn't last five minutes without a drink. We made some good money with him back then. Always brought good loot, that guy. My respect to him. But he's been out of the game for a long time, at least in Tarkov. I can give you a tip on where he dumped his extra supplies, but not for free. I'm looking for two tanks of propane right now. Why don't you find it for me, and then we'll talk about your guy?

== Objectives ==
Find 2 Propane tanks (5L) in raid
Hand over the items

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
1,000 Euros
1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Expeditionary fuel tank
You got it? That's a good start. Now we can talk about Thirsty.

== Guide ==

The easiest way to complete this task is via utilizing your Scav character on Interchange to loot the OLI store, as propane tanks are commonly found on the shelving in the area.

quests.title: Thirsty - Delivery
quests.content:
Thirsty - Delivery is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So, I keep my word. Before you, Sanitar was sniffing around that guy, too. But his business proposition was shite, so I didn't tell him anything. I'll tell you, but a bit later. Here are some nice propane tanks for you. Yeah, the ones you brought. Now you have to stash them. One in the nature reserve, in the Scav bunker with the radio tower. The other at the Customs area, in the little store by the crossroads. Just make sure to not shoot the tanks, okay? If you finish the job, you'll get more info.

== Objectives ==
Locate the specified stash spot on Woods
Locate the specified stash spot on Customs
Stash the first Propane tank (5L)
Stash the second Propane tank (5L)

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
1× Weapon case
You done? Very well. I'll give you a bonus for not bitching about the job. So, anyway, Thirsty used to hang around in the west wing of the Health Resort, in the basement. That was a long time ago, before the junkies got there. We cleaned that place out a long time ago, but maybe there's something left, I don't know. Check it out for yourself.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

quests.content:
Thirsty - Echo is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Thank you for reaching out. I know you're investigating a certain person called Thirsty. Sanitar is investigating him as well, for a specific reason. He's always hunting for any information on TerraGroup's activities. Surely it's all connected. If you can intercept the data first, bring it to me, I'll pay you handsomely. Besides, in my hands, it won't cause another disaster.

Obtain the information in Thirsty's hideout

quests.title: Thirsty - Hounds
quests.content:
Thirsty - Hounds is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
We need to talk. Sanitar's goons have been prowling the shore area at nights. Obviously looking for something. Can't let it go unchecked. Scare them off while I try to find out what they're up to.

== Requirements ==
Reach Loyalty Level 2 with Jaeger, Skier and Therapist.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 12 Scavs in the time period of 22:00-7:00 on Shoreline

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
6× 12/70 RIP ammo pack (5 pcs)
2× SOK-12 12ga SAI-02 10-round magazine
1× Saiga-12K 12ga automatic shotgun
You fought them off? Excellent! I found out they're looking for Thirsty's hideout. He was the guy who used to always bring a double supply of water with him. I haven't seen him in a while, right after he mixed up with Skier. I guess it led to a bad end for him.

== Guide ==
Head to Shoreline between 22:00 and 7:00. It is recommended to go into the raid by at latest 5:00, so you have time to advance the quest before 7:00.

quests.title: Thirsty - Secrets
quests.content:
Thirsty - Secrets is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello again. I was able to extract some scraps of information about a certain drug from the diary you brought. The owner of the diary used it frequently. It's some sort of combat stimulant, I think you might be interested in it. I can provide you with samples if you help me reproduce and test it. Here's a list of the items you'll need.

== Objectives ==
Hand over the 2 found in raid items: Adrenaline injector
Hand over the 4 found in raid items: Bottle of OLOLO Multivitamins

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
6× 2A2-(b-TG) stimulant injector  Note: Only obtainable by buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.
Unlocks craft for 2A2-(b-TG) stimulant injector at Medstation level 2

I was sure you'd be interested in this! Here are the results of the work.

== Guide ==

quests.title: Thirty Pieces of Silver
quests.content:
Thirty Pieces of Silver was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
We still do not know who the final recipient of all these drops is. The smugglers are unlikely to help us, they have already chosen their side. But there is another way to find out which of the local players decided to go against me. Bring me more of those shipments. I'll check the serial numbers and pull the records from the NATO bases in Finland while I'm at it. Some of those facilities fall under Edward's oversight, and if this kind of equipment ended up here, it means it had to be written off somewhere first. I'm only interested in the packages meant for the smugglers, so focus on sealed electronics boxes and weapon cases with NATO gear. And one more thing. Make it clear to those smugglers that if they want to do business with Europe, they'll have to go through me and no one else.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 25 smugglers
Obtain and hand over 3 contraband boxes
Obtain and hand over 3 locked smugglers' weapon cases

== Rewards ==
+15,000 EXP
1,400 Dollars
1,470 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,610 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× SIG MCX-SPEAR 6.8x51 assault rifle
6× AR-10 7.62x51 Lancer L7AWM 25-round magazine
10× 6.8x51mm SIG Hybrid ammo pack (20 pcs)
While you were gathering the shipments, I checked the records from the NATO bases in Finland. Nothing unusual on paper. The write-offs are all within normal limits. But real professionals know how to stay within those limits. Gear gets written off early because of outdated inspection procedures, and Edward knows that very well. Most of the items seem to be parts of individual soldier equipment. Not much in terms of weapons. Which means Ragman is trying to use Edward to refresh his warehouses... I don't know what pushed him to take a step like that, but I'll deal with him. For now, you can take a breather.

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks craft for Opened case at Workbench level 1.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to eliminate 25 Smugglers, hand over 3 Contraband boxes and 3 Sealed weapon casees.

Smugglers can be found in groups of 3-4 on Customs, Woods, Shoreline, Interchange, Lighthouse, Streets of Tarkov and Ground Zero (Level 21+).

quests.title: This Is My Party
quests.map: Shoreline, Lighthouse, Reserve, Woods, Customs, Interchange
quests.content:
This Is My Party was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I didn't think I'd call you again this year, but I need your help. People really loved our "Khorovod", we should do it again. Except that some asshole is turning on us, turning our soldiers against us. They're PMCs too, but they don't wear our armbands. You know we're doing the right thing. We need to save the celebration, and get those assholes away from our Khorovod. Shoot anyone who goes near the trees without the armband. No one's gonna get in the way of people doing good deeds.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 10 PMC operatives without the Christmas armband in the Khorovod mode

== Rewards ==
+13,800 EXP
Parpor Rep +0.03
186,000 Roubles
195,300 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
213,900 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
1× Document case
Mission accomplished? Well done, warrior! Now they'll let us celebrate Christmas in peace. Tell me, who do you have to be to not love this kind of celebration?

== Failure Penalty ==
Prapor Rep -0.03
After all you've done... How could you? Looks you didn't learn shit from what I told you.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 10 PMCs who are not wearing the Khorovod armband in the Khorovod mode.

quests.title: This Tape Sucks
quests.content:
This Tape Sucks is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello again. I received a patient who was recently wounded in the resort cellars and barely escaped from this monster in a bull mask... Obvious mental trauma, perhaps more than one. But besides the stories about this Minotaur, the patient also mentioned many confinement and even torture chambers. You surely recognize the unacceptable nature of such human confinement, even under wartime conditions, so I am counting on your cooperation. We must get to the bottom of what is or was going on in these cellars. Explore those jail rooms and try to uncover any information or evidence that will help us find out who is responsible for what happened. And most importantly, what was the purpose of all these "experiments".

== Objectives ==
Locate the torture room inside The Labyrinth
Locate and obtain any evidence of torture
Hand over the found information

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× SJ12 TGLabs combat stimulant injector
2× Meldonin injector
2× 3-(b-TG) stimulant injector
1× Taurus poster
A video tape... You haven't watched it yet, have you? Now I know what is happening. I was wrong before. The resort was one of the evacuation points when it all started, and its cellars could have been used for, uh, different purposes... The situation wasn't so severe yet at that time, and they tried to isolate the deceased bodies from crowded places. This tape is definitely not a cause for concern... However, I would refrain from visiting these cellars if I were you. Ventilation in bomb shelters has always been a weak point, and humidity only contributes to possible intoxication...

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to find the torture room inside The Labyrinth. Afterwards you have to obtain evidence of the torture in form of a videotape. There are multiple spawn locations near the room.

Torture room location marked on map
The torture room
Spawn 1: Under the door
Spawn 2: In the wall opposite the room
Spawn 3: In the hand of a dead Scav on the ground under the arch opposite the roomNote: The body doesn't always spawn, but the tape can still be there
Spawn 4: On top of bloody barrels adjacent to the arch opposite the room

quests.title: Tigr Safari
quests.content:
Tigr Safari is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Okay, here's the next deal. Russia kindly supplied the UN peacekeeping mission with several Tigr vehicles. The mission has now been almost completely withdrawn, and those vehicles have been left sitting idle. I need you to find any one of them on Customs and mark it with a beacon. There are still plenty of valuable components left inside that can be removed and sold to American intelligence. I suggest searching along the main road. Unfortunately, I do not have any beacons available at the moment, so you will have to sort that out yourself.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark any UN Tigr vehicle with an MS2000 Marker on Customs

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.1
550 Dollars
578 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
632 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
I trust you did not discuss this operation with the local authorities? Great. Here is your reward.

== Guide ==

MS2000 Markers can be bought from Prapor or Ragman.

quests.title: Time-Tested
quests.content:
Time-Tested was a community goal Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

This is it, warrior! It's time for the decisive breakthrough in this arms race! Peacekeeper is in a vulnerable position, so we have to take him down for good. quests.title: Timeout
quests.content:
Timeout was a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, mercenary. I know you want to get to Lightkeeper, but that won't work right now. He's busy. I don't know what's going on exactly, and truthfully, I don't want to. It's best not to get too cocky with people like him. Don't worry, we'll find out when he's available again. In the meantime, take care of other things.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.
Scav karma of at least +2

== Objectives ==
Wait until Lightkeeper contacts Mechanic

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper has contacted me through his channel and said he's now available for business.

quests.title: To Great Heights! - Part 1
quests.content:
To Great Heights! - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Well-well, you've finished your first assessment. I think it's right about time for a new champion of the Arena to rise. And it's going to be you. By consent, of course. We don't practice cruelty here, haha! I can help you reach heights and riches beyond your wildest dreams. You just have to take me up on my offer. But, you know, actions always trump words. So go ahead, enter the Arena and win. That's how I will know you're ready to push forward.

== Objectives ==
Win a match in CheckPoint or LastHero mode in Arena

== Rewards ==
+2,800 EXP
Ref Rep +0.02
55 GP coins
58 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
63 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
I never doubted you for a second, brother! But remember, we're here to entertain people. We need a bigger show! Sometimes it looks like you're just shooting cans, you know.

quests.title: To Great Heights! - Part 2
quests.content:
To Great Heights! - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You're under my wing from now on, brother. I'll make sure you get progress good, but you're gonna have to get your ass in gear more often. Let's start with the basics. The Arena's in Tarkov, but the biggest sponsors are overseas. They watch every game, place bets, throw money at the favorites. And you need to get some of those big shots interested. Get their attention, show them you're worthy. Make a name for yourself. One win alone isn't enough to do it. Show them you can make a thrilling performance!

== Objectives ==
Win a match in TeamFight, BlastGang, or CheckPoint mode in Arena

== Rewards ==
+3,500 EXP
Ref Rep +0.02
32 GP coins
34 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
37 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Weapon crate (Rare)
I see the progress you're making! They're starting to talk about you overseas. People are interested. It's a sign that you're doing the right thing!

quests.title: To Great Heights! - Part 3
quests.content:
To Great Heights! - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You're doing great! But it's too early to stop. Shine your face more often, impress the audience. Stand out. Become the one they talk about, the one they come to see. Then the cash will come, and then other goodies: cars, girls... Although Tarkov is a little short on the latter. Anyway, the Arena is a great career opportunity right now, ha!

== Objectives ==
Win 2 matches while claiming at least 3rd place in TeamFight, BlastGang, or CheckPoint mode in Arena

== Rewards ==
+4,500 EXP
Ref Rep +0.03
28 GP coins
29 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
32 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Valuables crate (Rare)
Unlocks the Arena item transfer service on Ref for main characters
And now you're one step closer to the big leagues! Respect, brother.

quests.title: To Great Heights! - Part 4
quests.content:
To Great Heights! - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
How's the mood? Battle-ready? Ready to shine in the Arena once more? Ready to shred some motherfuckers? The crowd is betting on you, so don't let the audience down! Speaking of that. You got some money? You gotta bet on yourself and then win a few times. You'll make tons of cash, and you'll be famous. Bring the money, I'll organize everything. Just be warned: if keep losing too often, you start again.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 1,000,000 Roubles
Win three out of six matches in TeamFight, BlastGang or CheckPoint mode in Arena
Failure condition: Lose 4 matches

== Rewards ==
+5,600 EXP
Ref Rep +0.05
35 GP coins
37 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
40 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
2,500,000 Roubles
2,625,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,875,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Supply crate (Rare)
Here's your paycheck. I deducted all my services from it straight away: bribing opponents, fees, and all that. What, you thought I work for free?

== Failure Dialogue ==
Oh man, you almost did it. Try again, the audience still seems to favor you.

== Guide ==

The 1,000,000 Roubles can be handed over from both the main game and the Arena stash. If 4 out of 6 matches are lost, the quest fails and the Roubles need to be handed over again for a new try.

quests.title: To Great Heights! - Part 5
quests.content:
To Great Heights! - Part 5 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I have good news! Excellent news, in fact! I hope you've already picked out a little apartment in Tarkov's elite neighborhood, because you'll have it soon with all this money! Kidding. All the houses in those neighborhoods are soon gonna collapse anyway. Anyway, some very powerful people from across the border are interested in you. Powerful and wealthy. I can't tell you their names, it's a business secret, and I'm not violating what I signed. So, these people are ready to take you under their wing and sponsor you heavily, but first they want guarantees. You need to become the champion. Fly high, soar above the rest. You're gonna have to spend more time in the Arena. I can see it in your eyes that you're ready.

== Objectives ==
Win a match claiming at least 2nd place in the team in TeamFight, BlastGang, or CheckPoint mode in Arena

== Rewards ==
+6,900 EXP
Ref Rep +0.04
40 GP coins
42 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
46 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
You're really good. A very famous French man — I won't tell you his name for privacy — is interested in you. Lispy as hell, but he's offering good money. I've already arranged for your sponsorship.

quests.title: To Great Heights! - Part 6
quests.content:
To Great Heights! - Part 6 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So, you thought that was it, that you'd reached the top? Think again. Yeah, people are betting on you, but you've got to make sure they don't forget about you. Otherwise they'll wave goodbye and start tossing money at someone else. And we don't want that. I've got a solution for you. People remember victories best — especially a streak of them. Set up a streak like that for yourself, and you can relax after.

== Objectives ==
Win 2 matches in a row in TeamFight, BlastGang or CheckPoint mode in Arena

== Rewards ==
+7,700 EXP
Ref Rep +0.04
55 GP coins
58 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
63 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks barter for APOK Tactical Wasteland Gladius at Ref LL2
All done? Well, I hardly had any doubts. Here, take this, a nice little bonus for you.

== Dialogue ==
Lightkeeper contacted me again. And for this task, he specifically requested the same person who handled the previous job. Meaning you. Our little trick worked, but that doesn't make the whole situation any clearer. I can only assume that, for some reason, Lightkeeper wants to keep all these jobs secret even from his own people. Could he be looking for a mole among them? Either way, this is our only chance to establish a working relationship, so all we can do is carry out the tasks and avoid asking unnecessary questions. Now, the instructions. Lightkeeper wants you to go to the intersection in the Customs area, discreetly install a camera in the little shop, and then send an RSP signal at the road crossing toward the coast. And yes, the entire area around it needs to be cleared of any potential observers beforehand. Once you've sent the signal, get out of there. Whoever comes to the rendezvous point mustn't see you.

+30,000 EXP
So, did you notice anything suspicious? No? Alright. Let's sum up what we know. First, we planted a hard drive containing disinformation at the Lab. Then Lightkeeper sent his group after the drive, and now he's used you to call someone out for a meeting. Obviously, he wants to find out who's going to show up at the rendezvous point. And if he doesn't know that yet, then according to the original plan, someone else was supposed to show up for the meeting. Which means the information about how to arrange the meeting belonged to that person, and Lightkeeper stole it from them. Could it have been our potential mole, the one he identified with the help of that disinformation drive? I think the pieces are starting to fall into place.
